title: Assistant Chief Engineer
location: Client Site - USA - GA - Atlanta - 40 Perimeter Center E
description:
Job Title

Assistant Chief Engineer

Job Description Summary

The Assistant Chief Engineer supports the Chief Engineer in managing the daily operation, maintenance, and reliability of mission-critical data center infrastructure. This role helps lead technical staff, coordinates preventive and corrective maintenance, responds to operational incidents, and ensures work is completed safely, accurately, and in accordance with approved data center procedures and standards.

Job Description

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

  • Assist with the operation, inspection, and maintenance of mission-critical systems, including UPS equipment, generators, switchgear, PDUs, CRAC/CRAH units, fire/life safety systems, and BMS/DCIM platforms.
  • Support and help coordinate preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs across electrical, mechanical, and controls systems.
  • Provide day-to-day leadership to technicians and vendors by assigning work, monitoring progress, reinforcing standards, and verifying safe, accurate task completion.
  • Respond to alarms, equipment abnormalities, and operational events; assist with troubleshooting, escalation, incident response, and post-event documentation.
  • Execute, review, and support continuous improvement of SOPs, MOPs, EOPs, and maintenance procedures.
  • Monitor vendor activities to ensure work is completed in accordance with site rules, safety requirements, maintenance standards, and approved scopes of work.
  • Maintain accurate records for maintenance activities, inspections, incidents, equipment status, rounds, and operational handoffs.
  • Assist with capacity planning, equipment upgrades, commissioning, construction support, and turnover activities while protecting uptime and operational continuity.
  • Promote a strong safety culture, including compliance with LOTO, electrical safety, arc flash awareness, OSHA requirements, NFPA standards, and site-specific policies.
  • Serve as the onsite escalation point and acting lead when the Chief Engineer is unavailable, as assigned.

Requirements

  • 5–8 years of experience in data center operations, critical facilities engineering, or a comparable mission-critical environment.
  • Prior lead, shift-lead, or supervisory experience preferred.
  • Working knowledge of electrical and mechanical infrastructure, including UPS systems, generators, switchgear, HVAC equipment, fire/life safety systems, and controls platforms.
  • Experience using BMS, EPMS, or DCIM systems to monitor equipment performance, alarms, and operating conditions.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical one-lines, mechanical drawings, schematics, sequence-of-operation documents, and technical manuals.
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and decision-making skills in time-sensitive operational environments.
  • Familiarity with applicable standards and requirements, including Uptime Institute guidance, NEC, NFPA, OSHA, and site-specific safety programs.
  • Strong communication, documentation, teamwork, and customer-service skills.
  • Ability to work assigned shifts, participate in on-call rotations, and respond to after-hours operational needs as required.
  • Relevant certifications preferred, such as CDCP, DCEP, electrical/mechanical trade certifications, or equivalent credentials.

description:
Job Title

Brokerage Coordinator

Job Description Summary

The Brokerage Coordinator will report to the Director of Operations and will serve as the support for the fee-earner and/or team. This position is responsible for support and management of client service activities such as pitch and proposals, transaction support, and fee-earner administrative support. The Brokerage Coordinator will interact with various departments within the organization on behalf of the fee-earner to ensure they are able to meet the needs of their clients.

Job Description

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage database
  • Manage content creation process with regards to timeline and production cycle
  • Coordinate with other departments based on the needs of the fee-earner
  • Support timeliness of deliverables
  • Provide sales and deal support

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Pitch and proposal coordination
  • Manage coordination with Marketing, Research, and Financial Analyst on behalf of fee-earner for the creation of pitch/proposal and deliver content as necessary
  • Populate template market documents such as tour books, property flyers, and brochures
  • Create or assist with production and design marketing and collateral deliverables (eg. Pitch presentations, proposals, property flyers, brochures, marketing eblasts, event invitations, tour books, floor plan edits, updating stacking plans)
  • Abstract leases and draft proposals with direction from supervising C&W real estate professional
  • Compile information to be used in periodic landlord leasing activity reports
  • Organize transaction documents, including confidentiality agreements, leases, contracts, listings, closing documents, etc for deal submission.
  • Handle client contact lists, including database management
  • Prepare expense reports, schedule meetings, book travel.

MAINTAIN CRM

  • Enter new leads and opportunities into the CRM system and update accordingly
  • Schedule meetings with Client on behalf of fee-earner and coordinate any other arrangements as needed
  • Assist in planning, scheduling, and promoting of fee-earner hosted events
  • Coordinate travel and other logistics for fee-earner as necessary
  • Prepare deal related documents and provide to fee-earner for review, approval, and delivery
  • Conduct Other Administrative Duties as necessary

BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s Degree (Business, Marketing, Communications, or Finance a plus) preferred
  • Administrative experience for executive level professional for more senior positions preferred
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office
  • Intermediate knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Photoshop and Salesforce a plus

COMPETENCIES

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Ability to multitask
  • Ability to take direction from multiple sources
  • Excellent project management skills
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Demonstrated aptitude to solve problems and navigate through obstacles

title: Operating Engineer
location: Client Site - USA - FL - Jupiter - 110 Front St
description:
Job Title

Operating Engineer

Job Description Summary

Responsible to ensure the efficient operation and maintenance of mechanical, electrical and plumbing equipment and systems for the assigned property(s). Responsibilities include (but are not limited to) maintaining a clean and safe working environment, performing rounds, conducting routine assessments, performance of day-to-day preventive and corrective maintenance, painting, and housekeeping for assigned properties

Job Description


• Perform all plumbing, electrical, or HVAC requirements of the building(s)
• Maintain heating equipment, chillers (air and/ or water cooled), DX units, pumps, cooling towers, fan coil units, VAV, and air distribution systems, etc.
• Monitor and adjust all mechanical/pneumatic equipment, steam stations, control gauges, distributor panels, valves, thermostats, diffusers, and other equipment necessary to provide a comfortable environment for the buildings
• Verify field conditions and perform any necessary repairs or adjustments
• Monitor Energy Management
• Repair doors, ceilings, hand railings, and floors and other general repairs, adjustments and installations about the property
• Perform repairs to plumbing fixtures (water closets, urinals, flush valve assemblies, lavatories, etc.)
• Perform preventive maintenance duties in accordance with C&W standards, building protocol, manufacturer recommendations and industry best practices. including changing filters, cleaning coils, flushing condensers, punching tubes, greasing fan, pump and motor bearings as required, inspecting and adjusting belts, replacing motor bearings, aligning pulleys and shafts, monitor condenser, chilled, heating and secondary water chemical treatment and its associated feed equipment, clean and maintain cooling towers, and perform annual inspections and other scheduled routines as directed.
• Inspect engine room equipment, fan room equipment, cooling tower, all motors, house pumps, electric rooms, back-up generator, fire pump(s), sump pump(s), and ejector pumps. Replace lamps, light fixtures, reinstall or replace signage, verify rooms are clean and clear of obstructions and debris
• Check for properly operating emergency exit signs and lights and ensure free and clear access to emergency stairs and exits. Perform additional fire and life safety inspections as per NFPA and local jurisdiction, C&W standards, building protocol and as directed by superiors and property management
• Document and report activities to supervisor
• Respond immediately to emergency situations (fire, evacuation, equipment failure, etc.) and customer concerns
• Comply with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agency, and company directives as relates to building operations and practice safe work habits
• Complete all required C&W Safety Training as scheduled annually
• Comply with C&W Uniform Dress Code while working and maintain a neat and clean appearance while on the property at times other than working hours

KEY COMPETENCIES
• Technical Proficiency
• Initiative
• Flexibility
• Multi-Tasking
• Sense of Urgency

IMPORTANT EDUCATION
• High School Diploma of GED Equivalent
• Graduate of apprentice program or trade school preferred

IMPORTANT EXPERIENCE
• 5+ years of related work experience in operating mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems in a commercial property setting

ADDITIONAL ELIGIBILITY QUALIFICATIONS
• Appropriate license/permit for trade as may be required, i.e. Journeyman or Master Electrician License or City Licenses, such as Refrigeration Certificate of Fitness, High Pressure Boiler License, High Pressure Steam Operator, etc.)
• May be required to have certification as a Universal Technician for CFC’s depending on market licensure requirements
• Possess and maintain a valid driver’s license and good driving record with periodic checks (where applicable)
• Basic Computing Skills in Outlook, Excel & Word
• Experience in operation, maintenance and basic repair of HVAC, boilers, heaters, pumps, refrigerant systems, compressors, water systems, etc.
• Knowledgeable in energy management systems, techniques and operations.
• Thorough knowledge in all building systems operations, maintenance and repair.

May be only maintenance staff member on duty during certain shifts; may be required to work extended periods of time without relief when responding to priority/emergency situations (including overtime type assignments); may require shift work and/or on call duties

WORK ENVIRONMENT
This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines. Regularly required to travel outside between properties in varying weather conditions.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
• Must have ability to stoop, stand, climb, frequently lift a minimum of 50 lbs. of equipment (pumps, tools, ladders) and safely install rigging/lifting devices
• Regularly required to crouch and reach to install/move equipment by bending forward at the waist or by bending legs and spine
• Involves movement between departments, floors, and properties to facilitate work
• Ability to speak clearly so others can understand you
• Ability to read and understand information presented orally and in writing
• Regularly required to utilize vision abilities, allowing reading of printed material, drawings, and schematics

title: Embedded Product Application Engineer
description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




Embedded Product Application Engineer is responsible for providing technical support for AMD Embedded products, platforms, software, and tools. The role acts as the primary technical interface between customers, field teams, and engineering organizations to resolve customer issues, improve product quality, and drive customer success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and drive customer technical support cases from initial investigation through resolution.
  • Debug complex hardware, software, firmware, and system-level issues.
  • Reproduce customer issues in lab environments and perform root cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to resolve product defects and technical escalations.
  • Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting assistance to customers.
  • Develop expertise in assigned AMD products, platforms, and technologies.
  • Analyze logs, traces, schematics, software outputs, and hardware behavior to diagnose issues.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Contribute to product supportability by identifying documentation gaps and improvement opportunities.
  • Participate in new product readiness, validation, and support enablement activities.
  • Develop automation tools, scripts, and AI-assisted debug solutions to improve support efficiency.
  • Work effectively with global teams across engineering, product management, field sales, and marketing organizations.
  • Deliver high-quality customer experiences while meeting support and responsiveness targets.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline with 3–6 years of relevant industry experience.
  • Strong debugging and analytical problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with embedded systems, hardware design, software development, AMD Ryzen or Epyc technologies, or technical support.
  • Understanding of computer architecture, digital design, embedded platforms, or operating systems.
  • Ability to investigate and resolve complex technical issues independently.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a global, cross-functional environment.
  • Customer-focused mindset with strong ownership and accountability.

Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Understanding of AMD Embedded series of APU or CPU architecture.
  • Board bring-up, firmware, BIOS, BSP, or device driver development.
  • High-speed interfaces such as PCIe, Ethernet, DDR, USB, MIPI, DisplayPort, Video, RF, or Networking.
  • Hardware debug using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, and laboratory equipment.
  • C, C++, Python, Shell, PowerShell, or automation scripting.
  • System validation, performance analysis, and debug methodologies.
  • Customer-facing technical support or applications engineering.
  • AI-assisted debugging, automation, and knowledge management tools.
  • Experience using defect tracking, CRM, or case management systems

title: Technical Coordinator, AML TA
description:
About Northern Trust


As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.


Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.


With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.



Major Duties :1. Takes responsibility for the timely and accurate completion of workload allocated including tasks processed through Northern Trust’s workflow process. • Actively participates in the review of investor documentation and information in adherence with Northern Trust’s AML processes and procedures.

2. Works with colleagues and line management in reviewing such investor documentation and efficiently highlighting outstanding investor due diligence documentation (if any) to the Investor AML Department in Ireland, by agreed modes of communication, with professionalism of approach and timely escalation of material issues arising.

3. Escalates and assists with resolution of more complex problems and critical issues, including those received from other Northern Trust partners (including primarily the Northern Trust Investor AML Department in Ireland).

4. Works with colleagues and line management to ensure that all queries from other Northern Trust partners (including primarily the Northern Trust Investor AML Department in Ireland) are dealt with efficiently and professionally.

5. Takes responsibility for completion of support services for Ireland & UK Investor AML processes and procedures in conjunction with Northern Trust colleagues in Ireland and provides regular, meaningful and accurate periodic updates to his/her line manager and colleagues in Bangalore, Pune and Ireland.

6. Maintains strong working relationships with partners in Northern Trust Investor AML Department in Ireland.

7. Works with his/her line management and other colleagues to ensure that the Investor AML support teams in Bangalore and Pune meet the required audit, risk and compliance standards as determined, from time to time, in accordance with advised changes in processes and procedures pursuant to amendments in prevailing legislation, guidance and best practice.

8. Maintains an up to date knowledge of Investor AML good practice and uses this knowledge to promote enhancements to Northern Trust’s AML processes and procedures.

9. Performs additional work where volume or absence requires such workload to be completed.  


ACCOUNTABILITIES

1. The successful candidate is required to comply, and ensure direct and indirect reports comply, with the global AML regulatory regime in which Northern Trust operates as appropriate to the above role.

2. The successful candidate is expected to exercise due care and diligence, and ensure that the responsibilities of the role are organized and controlled within the ambit of regulation, compliance and risk management.

3.. The successful candidate is required to observe proper standards of market, business and personal conduct, demonstrating integrity in the execution of such duties.

Knowledge :• Knowledge of day-to-day Investor AML processes and procedures and the wider funds administration business.

• Previous people management experience.

• Previous experience in an Investor AML servicing role.

• Strong organizational and communication skills.

• Effective risk management.

• Ability to research and understand complex issues and deliver solutions agreed with line management. General knowledge of the global Investor AML regulatory environment.

• General knowledge of Microsoft Office applications relating to designated areas of responsibility.

Experience :• Overall experience of 4-6 years

• Bachelor’s degree with emphasis in Accounting, CA or ICWA Inter/Master degree/IAQ/IOC or equivalent a plus

• Experience in Audit/Operational Control/ Risk or equivalent

• Accounting / financial services/ capital markets work experience or equivalent

• Should be flexible for shifts and extended working hours.


Working with Us


As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.


Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.


Reasonable Accommodation


Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.



About Our Bangalore Office


The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Vacature: Kassamedewerker bij Van Cranenbroek in Budel
description:
Begroet jij klanten met een glimlach en maak je gemakkelijk een praatje? Als kassamedewerker bij Van Cranenbroek in Budel maak jij het verschil met een vriendelijke ontvangst en aandacht voor de klant. Je werkt met collega’s die je op weg helpen, leert het kassawerk stap voor stap en krijgt een vast rooster. Zo weet je waar je aan toe bent, op je werk én daarbuiten.

Wat ga jij doen?

Een klant rekent spullen voor de tuin af, de volgende heeft nieuwe werkkleding gevonden. Jij begroet hen, scant de artikelen en zorgt dat het afrekenen klopt. Een kort praatje als het kan, vlot helpen wanneer het druk is: jij hebt oog voor de klant.

Dit zijn jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Je maakt je kassa klaar voor de dag en controleert het wisselgeld.

  • Je scant artikelen zorgvuldig en helpt klanten bij het afrekenen en bij retouren.

  • Je controleert prijzen, aanbiedingen en bonnen. Klopt er iets niet? Dan zoek je het uit, samen met een collega als dat nodig is.

  • Je beantwoordt klantvragen en verwijst klanten bij specifieke vragen naar de juiste afdeling.

  • Je houdt je kassalade op orde en verwerkt betalingen volgens onze werkwijze.

  • Je zorgt voor een nette kassaplek en vult tassen en bonrollen aan.

  • Waar nodig help je kort mee op de winkelvloer, bijvoorbeeld met aanvullen of opruimen.

Samen met je collega’s zorg je dat de kassa’s soepel draaien én dat klanten met een goed gevoel naar huis gaan.

Vaste werkdagen

Bij ons kun je vanaf 24 uur per week werken. Samen bespreken we het aantal uren en je vaste rooster. Je hebt inspraak in je doordeweekse werk- en vrije dagen, rekening houdend met de bezetting in de winkel. De afspraken die we maken, blijven de basis van jouw werkweek.

Je werkt iedere vrijdagavond tijdens de koopavond en iedere zaterdag. Op vrijdag is de winkel tot 20.00 uur open. Juist op deze drukke momenten is er volop leven in de winkel. Je helpt veel klanten en pakt samen met je collega’s aan. Zo vliegt de werkdag voorbij.

Met je vaste rooster weet je ook op welke doordeweekse dagen je vrij bent. Handig voor je afspraken, hobby’s en andere dingen die voor jou belangrijk zijn.

Dit krijg je van ons

Niet alleen elke dag plezier en uitdaging maar ook aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • € 2.600 tot € 2.900 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur.

  • Iedere gewerkte minuut uitbetaald.

  • Een vast rooster met inspraak in je doordeweekse werkdagen.

  • Een inwerkprogramma en begeleiding van collega’s.

  • Vakantiegeld en 25 vakantiedagen plus 1 extra dag bij fulltime, naar rato van je contracturen.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding vanaf 10 km: € 0,23 p/km (tot max. 20 km per dag).

  • Goede pensioenregeling: 24,75% premie, waarvan 18,675% door Van Cranenbroek wordt betaald.

  • Personeelskorting en gratis fruit op het werk.

  • Maaltijdvergoeding bij werken op koopavond.

  • Een inwerkprogramma en begeleiding van collega’s.

  • Een gezellige sfeer met teamuitjes (o.a. nieuwjaarsborrel en soms een frietwagen).

Je komt werken bij een nuchter familiebedrijf met winkels in Nederland en België. We houden van aanpakken, helpen elkaar en vinden een prettige sfeer op de werkvloer belangrijk.

Je helpt mensen graag en begroet klanten met een glimlach. Je werkt nauwkeurig en blijft ook op drukke momenten vriendelijk en rustig. Samen met je collega’s zorg je dat iedere klant prettig wordt geholpen.

  • Je bent klantvriendelijk, maakt gemakkelijk contact en helpt collega’s waar nodig.

  • Je gaat zorgvuldig om met geld, artikelen en bonnen.

  • Je beheerst het Nederlands voldoende om klantvragen te begrijpen, uitleg te geven en klanten bij het afrekenen te helpen.

  • Je leert graag hoe onze kassa en werkwijze werken.

Herken jij jezelf hierin? We maken graag kennis met je. Vertel ons kort wie je bent en hoeveel uur je wilt werken.

Samen bespreken we jouw plek in ons kassateam in Budel.

title: EIC Apprentice
description:
Job Title

EIC Apprentice

Job Description Summary

The Apprenticeship Program is a 6 month to 1 year Program that trains you for your future. The Valuation & Advisory Apprentices shall largely be involved in execution of valuation assignments and coordination with internal/external stakeholders and ensuring timely and quality deliverables.

Job Description

About the Role:

  • To conduct the primary field survey and interaction with local brokers etc. and to prepare databases of various real estate asset classes.

title: Maataloustyöntekijä, 20 h / viikko, JUVA
description:
Sinä ammattitaitoinen maataloustyöntekijä, tule meille Juvalle töihin! Tarjolla on vakituinen, osa-aikainen työ. Työtä on noin 20 h / viikko. Tarjoamme työntekijäillemme Epassin!
Etsimme maatalousalan ammattilaista, jolla on jo kokemusta lypsylehmistä. Pääset osallistumaan monipuolisesti maitotilan töihin. Tehtäviin kuuluu muun muassa eläinten hoitoa ja ruokkimista, yleisestä siisteydestä huolehtimista ja koneiden pesua. Traktorin ja pienkoneiden ajotaito on välttämätön. Työkielenä on suomen kieli. Tehtäväksi voi tulla vuoroja myös viikonloppuisin.
Tässä tehtävässä noudatetaan maaseutualan työehtosopimusta ja palkka on tessin mukaan vähintään 11,10 € / h, riippuen kokemuksestasi.
Työstä, asiakkaastamme ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää työhaastattelussa.
Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!
---



Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.

Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

title: Senior Mobile Security Developer
description:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Mobile Security Developer for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy, home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. This is a Hybrid role, offering the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life, with 2 days a week spent connecting with colleagues in our London office or on client site.


The Role

As a Senior Mobile Security Developer, you will define squad-level technical architecture and technical approach. You are a technical expert who ensures quality, security, and compliance across projects, driving robust and scalable solutions.

This role will be pivotal in building, delivering, and driving the security of our mobile platform, while being an integral part of our full-stack mobile practice, contributing to end-to-end development and security excellence across both front-end and back-end mobile systems.

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Design and Delivery of a World-Class Security Framework: Lead the design and delivery of security services, including mobile penetration testing, research, consultancy, and advisory engagements.

  • Technical Strategy & Architecture: Define secure technical approaches, identify risks, and develop effective threat models and mitigation strategies.

  • Strategic Planning: Translate business objectives into technical strategy and ensure technical roadmaps align with long-term client goals.

  • Agile Practices: Expertise in Agile methodologies, with a focus on resolving impediments and driving adoption across teams.

  • Client Engagement: Communicate effectively with clients, manage expectations, and provide practical, risk-based security recommendations.

  • Continuous Improvement & Collaboration: Drive innovation, adopt emerging security practices, share knowledge, and support team success.

What you'll bring:

We are seeking a highly technical expert with a strong focus on mobile platform security. You should bring:

  • Mobile Security Expertise: Strong hands-on knowledge of Android and iOS security fundamentals, common mobile threats and vulnerabilities, security architecture, controls, and mitigation techniques.

  • Mobile Security Testing: Practical experience in mobile penetration testing, security assessments, threat modelling, and implementing or assessing security controls.

  • Security Problem Solving: A systematic and analytical approach to identifying, investigating, and resolving mobile security issues.

  • Authentication & Cryptography: Strong understanding of authentication, authorisation, cryptography, encryption, and secure design principles, with the ability to recommend appropriate cryptographic controls.

  • Continuous Improvement: A proactive approach to improving security practices, tooling, controls, and ways of working.

Desirable knowledge & experience:

  • Mobile Security Tooling & Analysis: Experience with reverse engineering, analysis techniques, and tools such as Burp Suite Pro, Frida, Objection, JADX, IDA Pro, Hopper, Radare, ADB, Apktool, YARA, Xcode, and Android Studio.

  • Mobile Development & DevSecOps: Knowledge of Android/iOS development, secure development practices, DevSecOps tooling, testing, and automation frameworks.

  • Development & Reverse Engineering: Familiarity with C, Java, Kotlin, Objective-C, Swift, JavaScript, Python or Bash, and ideally ARM/ARM64 assembly.

  • Security Research: Awareness of emerging security technologies, Cloud security, and developments in mobile operating systems, APIs, tools, and security libraries.

What to expect from our hiring process

  • 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

  • 2. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. Depending on the role, this will be a focused take-home task (capped at 2–3 hours to respect your time) or a practical presentation.

  • 3. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: IT Business Analyst
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Summary:

The IT Business Analyst will act as a key liaison between Information Technology and business stakeholders within Engineering and Program Management. The role is responsible for understanding business needs, analyzing current processes, documenting requirements, and supporting the delivery of technology solutions that improve efficiency, usability, compliance, and business performance.

This role will focus on translating business needs into clear functional and non-functional requirements, supporting solution design, facilitating user acceptance testing, and helping ensure that IT solutions are adopted successfully by the business.

  • Engage with business stakeholders to understand problems, opportunities, objectives, and expected outcomes.
  • Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, and non-functional requirements.
  • Map current-state and future-state processes, identify gaps, and recommend practical process or system improvements.
  • Translate business requirements into user stories, use cases, process flows, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.
  • Work closely with IT teams, vendors, project managers, and business users to ensure delivered solutions meet agreed business requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Requirements Gathering and Analysis: Facilitate interviews, workshops, and working sessions with business stakeholders to capture, analyze, prioritize, and validate business needs and requirements.
  • Business Process Analysis: Document current-state and future-state processes, identify pain points and improvement opportunities, and support the definition of more efficient ways of working.
  • Documentation: Prepare and maintain business requirements documents, functional specifications, user stories, use cases, process flows, data flows, acceptance criteria, decision logs, and traceability documentation.
  • Solution Design Support: Collaborate with architects, developers, application owners, vendors, and project teams to ensure proposed solutions are feasible, fit for purpose, and aligned with business requirements.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as a communication bridge between business users and technical teams, ensuring requirements, priorities, risks, and decisions are clearly understood by all parties.
  • Testing and User Acceptance Testing: Support test planning, define acceptance criteria, coordinate user acceptance testing, assist with defect triage, and confirm that delivered solutions meet business expectations before go-live.
  • Project Delivery Support: Support project managers and delivery teams by clarifying scope, tracking requirement changes, maintaining action logs, and helping resolve business or functional questions during delivery.
  • Project Management: There will be opportunities to lead small to medium-sized projects, taking ownership of delivery, coordination, and outcomes.
  • Change and Adoption Support: Assist with change impact assessments, training preparation, communication materials, and post-implementation support to promote successful adoption of new systems and processes.
  • Data and Reporting: Analyse data where required to support business decisions, validate requirements, define reporting needs, and measure whether delivered solutions achieve expected outcomes.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve business processes, system usability, application performance, service quality, and overall business value delivered through IT solutions.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Experience: Typically 3–7 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, IT Analyst, Product Analyst, or related role supporting technology-enabled business change.
  • Business Analysis Skills: Strong experience with requirements elicitation, process mapping, gap analysis, functional specifications, user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, and requirements traceability.
  • Technology Knowledge: Working knowledge of enterprise applications, system integrations, data flows, reporting, IT service management, and software development lifecycle practices.
  • Tools and Methods: Experience with tools and methods such as ServiceNow, Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Office, Visio, Power BI, Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, BPMN, UML, or similar business analysis and delivery practices.
  • Automotive or Engineering Domain Knowledge: Experience supporting Engineering, Program Management, manufacturing, automotive, or product development processes is preferred but not required.
  • Certifications: Business analysis, Agile, ITIL, or project delivery certifications such as IIBA, CBAP, CCBA, ECBA, PMI-PBA, Scrum, or ITIL are beneficial.

Personal Attributes:

  • Analytical Thinking: Able to break down complex business problems, identify root causes, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate between business and technical audiences.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively with cross-functional teams, business users, IT teams, vendors, and project stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: Produces clear, accurate, and complete documentation that supports effective delivery and decision-making.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable working across changing priorities, multiple initiatives, and evolving business needs.
  • Customer Focus: Focused on delivering solutions that meet user needs and create measurable business value.

PRIMARY LOCATION

Central Tech Unit Plymouth MI

title: Product Associate UX / Intern / Working Student
description:
TL;DR — Construction software looks like it was designed in 2000. Because most of it was. As Product Asociate, you define how alago looks, feels and behaves.

alago brings AI-powered project management to the construction industry. As our Product Associate, you'll own a core product areas end to end: how messy project data becomes an early warning that a €200M project is about to go wrong.

That's what we're fixing. 15 people, 30+ customers, €1M+ pre-seed from leading construction-tech VCs and one of Germany's largest project developers. The product is live and used daily on real construction sites — which means the interesting work is only starting.

Aufgaben

What you'll actually do

  • Design the product. Take features from rough idea to high-fidelity UI. You'll work on the tools construction teams open every single day and make them feel effortless.
  • Make AI feel right. Define how AI shows up in Alago and what it feels like to work with it. Nobody has solved this well for construction yet.
  • Prototype and spec. Build clickable prototypes in Figma or with AI tools, and contribute to specs so the team can ship fast.
  • Run discovery. Talk to users, research how other products solve similar problems, and turn what you find into concepts the team can build on.
  • Grow the design system. Design components in Figma and work with engineers to build them.
  • Make Alago look good everywhere. Brand, landing pages, launch materials, everything that carries the product outward.

Qualifikation

Must-haves

  • Enrolled student in design, HCI, media informatics, architecture, or a related field.
  • C1 German: you'll talk to German construction project managers.
  • Figma proficiency: components, prototyping, systems thinking.
  • Technical enough to collaborate: you won't write production code, but you understand how web apps work and can work alongside engineers.

Bonus points

  • You've designed for AI products before and have a take on how generative features should feel.
  • You have strong opinions on products you love and hate. You notice details other people miss.
  • Experience with Figma Make, Claude, Cursor, Lovable or similar.
  • Past work in B2B SaaS or complex enterprise tools.
  • Interest in animation (Rive, Lottie), iconography or illustration.
  • Side projects that show you care about craft.

Benefits

🧠 Work directly with founders. Ann (CPO) will mentor you on product thinking and UX craft.

👥 Direct user access. Join customer interviews. Watch users interact with your designs.

⚡ See impact fast. Your work goes live in days. Get feedback, iterate, improve.

🏠 Vibrant Munich office culture. At least two days per week in our central Munich office. Flexible remote work for the rest.

👟 EGYM Wellpass. Whether you need a yoga session for inspiration or a punching bag to get through ideas, we got you covered.

🚀 Grow into a full-time design role after graduation if it's a mutual fit.

1. Submit your story
Share your portfolio—show us your process, not just final designs. Tell us about a UX problem you solved.

2. Intro Call (30min)
Get to know alago and learn about our vision.

3. Design Challenge (90min)
Solve a real UX problem from our product. Show us how you think.

4. Offer 🎉
We'll get back to you within 24 hours.

Job Title

Senior Project Manager

Job Description Summary

This role leads the end‑to‑end delivery of corporate interior fit‑out projects for occupier clients, ensuring outcomes on scope, schedule, cost, quality, and EHS. The Senior Project Manager (SPM) builds trusted client relationships, orchestrates consultants and contractors, and enforces C&W governance, reporting, and commercial controls throughout the project lifecycle.

Job Description

About the Role:

  • Own project delivery from initiation to close‑out—charter, budget, master schedule, procurement strategy, construction oversight, testing & commissioning, handover, and defects management—while maintaining clear risk, change, and stakeholder management plans.
  • Lead client engagement: capture requirements, set success criteria, run governance forums, and provide executive‑level reporting (cost to complete, cashflow, EAC, progress KPIs) in line with PDS standards.

Job Title

EHS Specialist

Job Description Summary

Reporting to Site manager, the Environmental, Health and Safety Specialist works within a facility management organization that provides a variety of O&M services that includes R&D Labs, critical data environments and commercial office space. This role is responsible for completing all assigned tasks while maintaining a constant focus on environmental, health and safety requirements.

Job Description

PRINCIPAL DUTIES:

  • Inspect site for batteries. Pickup batteries from all AMD locations. Package and prepare batteries per shipping regulations. Coordinate batteries shipment, schedule shipments, take photographs of shipments and sign on behalf of AMD. Submit documentation to onsite AMD EHS Engineer.

  • Inspect site for electronic waste. Pickup electronic waste from all AMD locations and deliver to the central e-waste collection area. Coordinate shipments of electronic waste. Submit documentation to onsite AMD EHS Engineer.

  • Inspect site for hazardous waste. Pickup hazardous waste from all AMD locations. Package and prepare hazardous waste per hazardous waste regulations. Coordinate shipments of hazardous waste. Submit documentation to onsite AMD EHS Engineer.

  • Perform site chemical inventories to support provincial chemical reporting requirements.

  • Perform ventilation surveys and verify the DA lab hood face velocities

  • Support labs with empty box management (shipping and identification of heavy combustible storage locations.) Support labs for waste disposal/reclaim by identification and shipping of waste and reclaim.

  • Inspect labs for personal/residential equipment used for industrial use. (i.e small clips on cooling fans to cool test equipment.)

  • Submit request to CW staff to manage issues found inside the lab.

  • Perform monthly indoor EHS inspections such as monthly indoor inspection, site walk through (inside and outside site), inspect the UPS room weekly, monthly fire extinguisher inspection, eye wash station/shower, First aid kit and AED inspection.

  • Inspect all soldering stations weekly to ensure engineers are not using lead solder. Inspect ventilation filters and report results to EHS engineer (i.e PPE violations, photos, etc.)

  • Perform noise surveys.

  • Update and support all evacuation planning, map production, assembly area marking, etc.

  • Review, approve and audit hot work activities.

  • Submit energy metrics in online tool. This includes electricity, water, waste, etc.

  • Perform Air Permit equipment inventory.

  • Identify workspace ergonomic concerns.

  • Perform refrigerant inventory and work mechanical team to identify all HVAC equipment with leaks

  • Attend compliance audits and work to correct any alleged violations identified.

    • Distribute and Safekeep COVID PPE such as mask and gloves.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
About the Role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will play a key role in NinjaOne's global Platform Engineering organization, partnering closely with our US-based Platform Engineering team to support production software deployments and drive the evolution of our deployment platform.

This role has two primary areas of responsibility:

  • Production Deployment Engineering – sharing ownership of production deployments and release operations across our SaaS platform to ensure reliable, predictable, and high-quality software releases.

  • Deployment Automation & Platform Engineering – designing and implementing automated deployment solutions that eliminate manual processes, improve developer productivity, and enable engineering teams to deliver software faster and more safely.

As part of our growing Singapore engineering team, you'll help provide expanded operational coverage for global production deployments while creating additional capacity for the broader Platform Engineering organization to focus on strategic initiatives and platform modernization.

This is a hands-on technical role. You'll collaborate closely with Software Engineering, SRE, QA, Product Management, Release Management, and Security teams to build scalable, secure, and highly automated software delivery platforms.

Location – Hybrid, Singapore

What You’ll be Doing

Production Deployment & Release Engineering

  • Covering the planning, coordination, and execution of software deployments into production environments, ensuring high availability, minimal downtime, and predictable releases.

  • Share ownership of production deployment operations with the US Platform Engineering team, providing global coverage and operational continuity across production environments.

  • Partner with Engineering, SRE, QA, Release Managers, and Product teams to plan, coordinate, and execute production software releases, maintenance windows, and emergency deployments while ensuring deployment readiness, operational stability, and clear stakeholder communication.

  • Develop and maintain deployment standards, release readiness processes, rollback procedures, and operational playbooks.

  • Contribute to post-release reviews and drive continuous improvements that increase deployment reliability and reduce operational risk.

  • Serve as the technical escalation point during complex production deployments and critical release activities.

Deployment Engineering & Automation

  • Design and implement automated deployment solutions that improve software delivery speed, consistency, and reliability.

  • Build reusable deployment frameworks, standardized deployment workflows, and self-service deployment capabilities.

  • Develop CI/CD modernization initiatives using CircleCI and related technologies.

  • Identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive operational work through automation and engineering solutions.

  • Improve deployment frequency, release quality, and engineering efficiency through continuous process improvements.

About You

  • 5-7+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Build & Release Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, or related disciplines.

  • Strong experience supporting and automating production software deployments in cloud environments.

  • Deep expertise building enterprise-scale CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar platforms.

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Ansible.

  • Experience managing artifact repositories such as JFrog Artifactory.

  • Experience designing deployment automation, release orchestration, and software delivery workflows.

  • Strong understanding of Git workflows, branching strategies, pull request processes, and release management.

  • Strong scripting or programming experience using Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages.

  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Good-to-have:

  • Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.

  • Experience with AWS services and cloud-native architectures.

  • Experience integrating DevSecOps capabilities including SAST, SCA, DAST, SBOM generation, secrets management, and policy enforcement.

  • Experience improving engineering productivity and DORA metrics.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (preferred).

About Us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries.

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a singl e console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.

NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

What You’ll Love

  • We prioritise your work/life balance offering a hybrid work environment and free in-office lunches throughout the week

  • We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement

  • Grow personally and together with one of the fastest growing companies globally

  • Develop your skills through our renowned training platform

  • Receive competitive compensation

  • Collaborate with an amazing international workforce

It is responsible for shaping and implementing the Gulf donor engagement approach, strengthening War Child’s positioning in the region and contributing to portfolio development and income generation.
Working under the direction of the Head of Institutional Funding & Grants Delivery, the role coordinates engagement across WCAF teams and FMs, ensuring aligned approaches, effective relationship management and progression of partner and funding opportunities in a developing donor market.

  • Lead the development and management of donor relationships across the Gulf region, strengthening War Child’s positioning and ensuring coherent and targeted engagement across key stakeholders.
  • Drive pipeline development and opportunity identification in the Gulf market, proactively shaping and advancing funding opportunities in a relationship-driven and evolving donor landscape.
  • Lead the planning and coordination of donor engagement across the Alliance, ensuring alignment between WCAF, Members and country teams on Gulf-related opportunities and partnerships.
  • Use donor intelligence, market insights and trend analysis to inform engagement and opportunity development, ensuring positioning is aligned with donor priorities and regional dynamics.
  • Oversee the progression of Gulf funding opportunities, working closely with Programme Funding Advisors, Account Managers and Proposal Quality to ensure timely and coordinated development of proposals.

  • Support the development of partnership models and collaboration approaches suited to the Gulf context, enabling effective engagement with a diverse range of actors.
  • Ensure appropriate use of systems and alignment with organisational processes, working in coordination with Compliance & Performance to support visibility, tracking and reporting of Gulf opportunities.
  • Represent War Child in external Gulf-facing engagements, networks and forums, strengthening relationships and expanding the organisation’s presence and partnerships in the region.
ROLE-SPECIFIC OR CONTEXT RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Act as the primary strategic focal point for Gulf donor engagement, leading coherent and coordinated engagement across the Alliance and ensuring alignment with organisational priorities.
  • Under the leadership of the Head of Institutional Funding & Grants Delivery, lead the delivery and implementation of the Gulf Engagement Strategy, translating strategic priorities into actionable approaches, partnerships and funding outcomes.
  • Lead market development in the Gulf region, driving proactive engagement and positioning in a relationship-driven donor environment and expanding War Child’s presence across priority donors and partners.

  • Development or humanitarian setting experience;

title: Developer Technology Engineer, Energy
description:
Our work at NVIDIA is dedicated towards a computing model focused on visual and AI computing. For two decades, NVIDIA has pioneered visual computing, the art and science of computer graphics, with our invention of the GPU. The GPU has also shown to be spectacularly effective at solving some of the most complex problems in computer science. Today, NVIDIA’s GPU simulates human intelligence, running deep learning algorithms and acting as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. We are looking to grow our company and teams with the smartest people in the world and there has never been a more exciting time to join our team!

NVIDIA is looking for a passionate, world-class computer scientists and engineers (Compute Developer Technology - DevTech) to accelerate Energy simulation and AI workflows on NVIDIA platforms. You will focus on CUDA performance optimization for workloads such as seismic processing (e.g., imaging/inversion pipelines), reservoir simulation, power grid simulators, and related HPC/AI production workflows. You will work hands-on with customer and partner engineering teams as well as NVIDIA product and engineering groups to deliver measurable speedups and scalable performance on multi-GPU and multi-node systems.

What you will be doing:

  • Profile, analyze, and optimize GPU-accelerated applications with emphasis on CUDA kernels, memory movement, concurrency, and end-to-end throughput.

  • Drive performance improvements across the stack:

    • CUDA C++ kernel optimization, launch configuration, memory hierarchy, streams/events

    • GPU libraries (as applicable): cuBLAS, cuFFT, cuSPARSE, cuSOLVER, NCCL

    • Multi-GPU and multi-node scaling using MPI + NCCL, CPU/GPU overlap, communication patterns

  • Build reproducible benchmarks, performance reports, and tuning recommendations (before/after, methodology, scaling curves).

  • Develop and maintain reference implementations, examples, and/or patches to customer code to enable performance and portability.

  • Support customer engagements (POCs to production), including debugging correctness/performance issues and advising on best practices for deployment (containers, schedulers, clusters).

  • Collaborate with internal teams to file actionable issues, validate fixes, and influence roadmap based on real customer requirements in Energy.

  • Build internal libraries and resusable code that would lead to future NVIDIA products.

What we need to see:

  • BS/MS (or equivalent experience) in CS/CE/EE/Physics/Applied Math or related field.

  • Strong programming skills in C/C++ and Python on Linux.

  • Hands-on experience with CUDA programming and GPU performance optimization concepts.

  • Experience profiling and debugging performance using tools such as NVIDIA Nsight Systems / Nsight Compute (or equivalent).

  • Understanding of parallel computing and performance fundamentals (vectorization, threading, NUMA, memory bandwidth/latency).

  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both engineers and non-engineers.

  • 5+ years relevant experience in GPU/HPC optimization; strong track record of delivered speedups and scaling improvements.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Leads performance reviews with customer stakeholders; creates reusable playbooks/reference designs. Experience/Skills (typical)

  • HPC experience with MPI, distributed systems, and multi-node performance tuning.

  • Energy/HPC domain exposure:

    • Seismic processing pipelines, RTM/FWI-style patterns, FFT/stencil/linear algebra heavy codes

    • Reservoir simulation (sparse/iterative solvers), preconditioning, domain decomposition

    • Power grid simulation / transient stability / optimization workflows

  • Experience with CI/perf regression testing, containerized workflows (Docker/Apptainer), and schedulers (Slurm).

  • Familiarity with AI workflows used alongside simulation (data prep, training/inference integration, pipeline performance).

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

title: QA Director
description:
Quality Assurance Director
Auckland
Permanent, Full Time



About Whitecliffe
Whitecliffe is a leading independent tertiary institution in New Zealand, renowned for delivering innovative, industry-connected education. With campuses in Auckland, Manukau, Wellington, and Christchurch, we pride ourselves on having teaching staff with extensive industry experience who support our graduates to turn creativity into a career.



About the role
We're seeking a strategic, decisive, and relationship-focused Quality Assurance Director to lead Whitecliffe's academic quality assurance and compliance framework. This role is responsible for Whitecliffe's institutional quality system, holding end-to-end accountability for compliance coordination, regulatory submissions, and operational QA system management. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, you will ensure the design, implementation, and ongoing evaluation of Whitecliffe's quality assurance systems — including ongoing institutional implementation of NZQA's Institutional Quality Assurance Framework (IQAF) — and lead the organisation's response to an evolving regulatory environment.

You will champion change management and continuous improvement as core institutional capabilities, leading structured initiatives that help academic and professional teams adopt new quality practices with minimal disruption to learners. You will create, own, and continuously refine Whitecliffe's overarching quality assurance frameworks, policies, and toolkits, ensuring they remain fit-for-purpose, evidence-informed, and scalable across delivery areas.

As the senior escalation point for student complaints and appeals relating to academic quality and regulatory matters, you will ensure these are resolved fairly, consistently, and in line with NZQA requirements — using systemic learnings to strengthen quality enhancement planning. You will lead preparation for and coordination of external review processes, represent Whitecliffe in engagements with NZQA and other regulatory bodies, and own accountability for course accreditation, re-accreditation, and provider registration processes.

You will work collaboratively with academic leaders and teaching teams to strengthen reflective self-review practices, support meaningful use of academic quality data, and embed sustainable quality enhancement approaches across the institution. This role gives effect to Te Tiriti o Waitangi, ensuring its principles and commitments are embedded throughout governance, programme delivery, learner support, and quality assurance processes, and that Whitecliffe can demonstrate it is actively responding to the aspirations of Māori learners, whānau, hapū, iwi, and communities.


What you will bring

  • Leadership experience in academic quality assurance, compliance, or regulatory management within higher education or a comparable regulated environment
  • Ability to build effective relationships across academic and professional teams and lead organisational change in a collegial manner
  • Project and change leadership capability, including planning, coordinating, and delivering complex initiatives to deadline
  • A strategic, confident, and collaborative approach — with the credibility to represent quality assurance to governance bodies and senior leadership
  • A relevant tertiary qualification in governance, education, administration, business, or a related discipline — or equivalent professional experience
  • Working knowledge of NZQA compliance requirements, including the Institutional Quality Assurance Framework (IQAF), self-assessment, and evaluative quality assurance practice
  • Demonstrated experience leading change management initiatives within complex, regulated organisations
  • Proven ability to design, implement, and continuously improve quality assurance frameworks, policies, and systems
  • Willingness and capability to act as an escalation point for complex or sensitive matters, including complaints, appeals, or disputes, with sound judgement and discretion
  • Demonstrated understanding of contemporary tertiary quality assurance and self-assessment practice within the New Zealand context
  • Ability to interpret and apply regulatory requirements in complex academic and governance contexts
  • Ability to interpret and synthesise academic quality and performance data to support evidence-informed decision-making and improvement planning
  • Ability to oversee governance, policy, compliance, and academic quality documentation systems, ensuring accessibility, version control, and audit readiness


As Whitecliffe continues to strengthen and mature its quality assurance and regulatory practices, this role will be instrumental in shaping the long-term development of sustainable systems, institutional capability, and quality leadership across the organisation. This is an opportunity to lead meaningful change — driving regulatory readiness, academic quality enhancement, and institutional capability at a strategic level.

title: Freelance Video Game Translator (m/f/d): Japanese to Indonesian
description:
You know the difference between a literal translation and a text that’s properly localized and culturally adapted. So do we.

Altagram is expanding its network of freelance translators and proofreaders for Japanese into Indonesian. We localize games across every genre, from narrative RPGs to live-service worlds to small indie titles, and we do it with linguists who play the games they work on.

⚡ What you’d work on

Projects vary, which is a large part of the appeal. Depending on your interests and skills, you might work on:

  • In-game text: dialogue, quests, item descriptions, tutorials, UI and menus.
  • Marketing and store content: Steam pages, trailers, social posts, ad copy.
  • Subtitling: cutscenes, trailers, promotional video.
  • Linguistic quality evaluation (LQA).
  • Culturalization analysis.

Most assignments are translation and proofreading, with MTPE on selected projects.

⭐ Your rates

Tell us your rates in the application form: per word and per hour, for translation, proofreading, and MTPE. We work in EUR, USD, and KRW.

✅ What we’re looking for

  • Native-level Indonesian and excellent command of Japanese.
  • Demonstrated experience localizing video games, not general content.
  • Confident working in memoQ (required).
  • Familiar with Plunet TMS (required).

⏳ What happens next

  1. We review your application.
  2. If there’s a fit, we’ll invite you to complete two short test pieces of roughly 450 words each, one for translation and one for proofreading, depending on which services you want to offer. The tests are unpaid, and they’re a required step in our screening. If you’d rather not complete unpaid tests, we understand, and we won’t be able to take the application further.
  3. We come back to you with a decision either way.

We’re selective, and we’d rather be straight with you about that upfront than waste your time.

❗ A note on verification. To protect against fraudulent applications and impersonation, we may ask you to verify your identity. This can involve a photo of yourself holding your ID or passport, with your face and the document details clearly visible, and the name matching the one in your application. We use these documents for verification only and delete them once that’s complete.

The heart of our success lies in our powerful, diverse team, strengthened by their care and understanding for each other. As part of our freelance team, you can expect to work in an exciting environment filled with passionate people who share your devotion for detail and love for games. We bring together the top talents from different levels of experience - from budding beginners, all the way up to professionals.

At Altagram everyone is celebrated for their unique backgrounds, life experiences and mindsets. We value personal growth and strive for an equal opportunity workplace that welcomes every individual. We strongly believe that when we create space for everyone’s story - from wherever it originates - we will thrive as a result of this collective knowledge! Together our different perspectives will empower us on a journey towards innovation in our industry, setting new standards along the way.

Join us today so that your voice may help shape tomorrow!

description:
Overview

Software Engineer (Full Stack) - Essex Management

Location - Mostly remote within the US. (Please be advised that there is an expectation despite majority of the work being remote that one can come into the HQ in Rockville, Maryland roughly 10% of the year for new project kicks offs, team building, company town halls etc.)

About Essex

This position supports "Essex, an Emmes Company". Essex is a biomedical informatics and health information technology-focused consultancy founded in 2009 and headquartered in Rockville, MD. The Essex team comprises experts with extensive experience in strategically developing and managing complex health and biomedical information programs for clients in the Federal Government, research academia, and private sectors.

Primary Purpose


This is an engineering role that works as part of the software engineering team towards the development and deployment of enterprise and informatics software systems to support cancer clinical trials and research. The role provides a strong career growth opportunity in an innovative technology environment working in one of our nation's premier research organizations.


Responsibilities

  • Manage individual task priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.
  • Develop scalable, reliable, and performant enterprise-level software systems and services for our clients, using an Object-Oriented programming language and software libraries/framework.
  • Write well-tested and maintainable code leveraging unit, integration, and BDD tests.
  • Contribute to project documentation, including architecture diagrams, sequence diagrams, API documentation, and technical SOPs.
  • Participate in SCRUM Sprint planning, standup, review, and retrospective meetings.
  • Work in a collaborative cross-functional team environment to move features (JIRA tasks) across all tiers in a CI/CD Agile SCRUM environment.
  • Be a proactive part of the software engineering team, looking to make improvements to our engineering practices.
  • Shadow senior team members during interviews.
  • Contribute to mentoring junior members of the team

Qualifications

Required Experience:

  • Strong communication skills (oral and written).
  • Experience coding in C#/.NET, Python, Java, or comparable programming languages.
  • Experience building enterprise software systems that run in Azure Cloud environment using technologies such as Azure Container Apps (or AKS), Azure Functions, Azure Queue Storage (or Service Bus Queues), Azure Service Bus Topics (or Event Grid), Azure Blob Storage, Azure API Management, Azure Cosmos DB (Table API), Azure AI Search, Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server, Azure Cosmos DB (Gremlin API), Azure Cosmos DB (MongoDB API), Azure Bicep (or Azure CDK).
  • Experience developing software systems with a backing relational and/or NoSQL databases using ORM libraries such as SQLAlchemy.
  • Experience developing microservices with RESTful API and/or grpc to exchange data via JSON, XML, and other data exchange formats.
  • Experience working in an agile development environment with methodologies such as SCRUM or Kanban.
  • Experience using Git, GitHub, and GitHub Actions.
  • 6 years of software development experience in one or more programming languages and with data structures/algorithms.
  • Azure Fundamentals or Associate certification.
  • Possession of a Bachelor or Graduate degree in a technical field such as Computer Science from an accredited college or university (according to CHEA).

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience with AI-assisted engineering practices and tools such as GitHub Copilot, Codex, or Claude Code, as well as conducting efficient and accurate code reviews of AI-generated code.
  • Two or more years of experience building enterprise software systems that run in a Production Azure Cloud environment.
  • Experience with container and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes are
    a plus.
  • 2+ years of working with a CI/CD pipeline using Git, GitHub, and GitHub Actions
    (or similar tools).
  • Experience integrating with Okta and additional 3rd party systems
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and AWS is a plus.

Be Part of One Team, One Purpose.

At Emmes Group, we’re shaping the future of clinical research—where human intelligence meets cutting-edge technology to drive meaningful advancements in healthcare. With over 47 years of scientific excellence, we’ve led groundbreaking research in cell and gene therapy, vaccines, infectious diseases, ophthalmology, rare diseases, and neuroscience.

Through our two business units—Emmes, a full-service CRO, and Veridix AI, our technology, data, and analytical solutions —we are modernizing clinical trials and accelerating the development of life-changing therapies.

We believe that every clinical breakthrough starts with people—people who are passionate, purpose-driven, and ready to make an impact. At Emmes Group, we bring People, Science, and Technology together to collaborate with our customers and deliver global health impact. Our culture is built on integrity, collaboration, and innovation, ensuring that every challenge is met with perseverance and accountability.

If you’re looking for a career where your work advances global health and where scientific excellence meets real-world impact, join us and be part of something bigger. One Team, One Purpose.

  • Support the development and implementation of scalable operating systems and processes as SLT grows.

    • optimize instructor allocations
    • optimize class types (Essentials, Hardcore, etc.)

  • Assist in the performance management of instructor operations in collaboration with Training & Development, including monitoring punctuality, professionalism, client interaction, and adherence to studio marketing and sales responsibilities.
  • Ensure a consistent, high-quality front desk and client experience across all studios.



Customer Service & Client Management:

  • Ensure managers handle client inquiries and resolve issues so that clients feel heard and valued in a timely and professional manner.
  • Drive client retention across the portfolio through personalized follow-ups, milestone recognition, and a focus on rewarding loyalty.

title: Analist Ondermijning
description:
Welke uitdaging bieden wij?

Als Analist Ondermijning voer je diepgaande analyses uit naar ondermijnende criminaliteit en ben je verantwoordelijk voor het bewaken van een sterke, actuele informatiepositie. Je analyseert data uit verschillende bronnen, verzamelt deze informatie en weet deze te duiden. Hiervoor zoek je actief de samenwerking op met partners. Als analist signaleer je trends en ontwikkelingen, risico’s en kansen binnen sectoren, branches en gebieden en breng je dit proactief in binnen het Programmateam Ondermijning. Met jouw analytisch en kritisch denkvermogen stel je informatieproducten op (zowel op casus- als fenomeenniveau) waarmee je de operationele ondermijningsaanpak binnen de gemeente aanstuurt. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor de doorontwikkeling van datagedreven en informatiegestuurd werken en fungeer je als vraagbaak voor collega’s met betrekking tot datavraagstukken.

Welke verantwoordelijkheden krijg je

Je maakt onderdeel uit van het Programmateam Ondermijning, dat binnen het team Veiligheid, Zorg en Toezicht Sociaal Domein valt. Dit team maakt onderdeel uit van het Domein Samenleving. In deze rol werk je nauw samen met collega’s en diverse ketenpartners, waaronder politie, OM en RIEC.

Jouw taken bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Voorbereiding van (integrale) controles;

  • Onderzoek naar complexe casuïstiek en signalering van mogelijke misstanden, onder andere in samenwerking met de Adviseur Ondermijning bij RIEC-casussen;

  • Contact met regionale en lokale ketenpartners en deelname aan overlegstructuren;

  • Ondersteuning van de BIBOB-coördinator waar nodig bij analyse en onderzoek; en

  • Advies over de doorontwikkeling van datagedreven en informatiegestuurd werken.

Waar ben je goed in

Je onderzoekt een vraagstuk vanuit meerdere kanten met een scherp gevoel voor zaken die ondermijnende criminaliteit raken. Je onderscheidt hoofd- van bijzaken en je weet snel tot de kern of essentie van het vraagstuk te komen. Hierbij heb je oog voor het grotere geheel en de langere termijn. Je bent creatief, kunt snel schakelen en je ziet zelf waar je verantwoordelijkheden liggen. Daarnaast weet je effectief gebruik te maken van relevante informatiesystemen en verschillende informatiebronnen te combineren. Je bent in staat om data en (jaar)cijfers te analyseren, verbanden en ontwikkelingen te signaleren en deze op een heldere en inzichtelijke manier te presenteren. Daarbij vertaal je informatie naar inzichten die bijdragen aan het signaleren en duiden van ondermijnende criminaliteit. Je bent een echte teamspeler, die flexibel is als het werk hierom vraagt. Je anticipeert op verschillende situaties en handelt proactief. Bovenal ben je integer en in staat en bereid te werken met gevoelige informatie.

Op welke ervaring bouw je verder

Naast jouw proactieve aanpak en analytisch vermogen vragen wij het volgende van jou:

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een afgeronde opleiding integrale veiligheidskunde, criminologie, rechten, ICT of vergelijkbaar;

  • Meerdere jaren werkervaring als data analist, rechercheur, veiligheidskundige of vergelijkbaar;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het werken in integrale samenwerkingsverbanden.

Wat bieden wij nog meer

Naast een informele werksfeer, leuke collega’s en een mooi onboardingsprogramma, bieden wij jou de volgende arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van maximaal € 5.624,- o.b.v. 36 uur per week conform schaal 10;

  • Een individueel keuzebudget (IKB) van 17,05% dat je kunt inzetten voor extra vakantiedagen, een nieuwe fiets etc.

  • Een ruim aanbod in cursus- en opleidingsmogelijkheden, gericht op jouw ontplooiing en ontwikkeling;

  • Een duurzaam pensioen via het pensioenfonds ABP, waarvan 70% vergoed door gemeente Lansingerland’;

  • Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor 12 maanden met uitzicht op een vast contract.

Meer weten?

Maatwerk, uitdaging en ontwikkeling zijn kernwoorden in ons personeelsbeleid. Past deze uitdaging bij jou als persoon en zie jij raakvlakken met jouw eigen ervaring en hetgeen wij vragen, reageer dan zo snel mogelijk, maar uiterlijk donderdag 1 oktober 2026.

Eerst nog wat vragen? Neem dan contact op met:

-Annika de Vries, Teammanager Veiligheid, Zorg en Toezicht Sociaal Domein (010-8004212);

-Alex Broeders, Corporate Recruiter (06 - 41 55 75 84).
