Zomaar een dag als Accountmanager new business...

Je start je dag in Breda met een kop koffie en bekijkt je agenda. Na een producttraining bij VWPFS de vorige dag, ben je volledig voorbereid op je commerciële week. Als Accountmanager Lease Buitendienst richt jij je met name op het genereren van new business. Vanuit de binnendienst ontvang je leads, die je verdiept uitwerkt en vervolgens actief opvolgt met een belafspraak of bezoek.

Later op de dag in de voorbereiding naar je nieuwe week heb je al diverse nieuwe acquisitie-afspraken gemaakt. Op weg naar deze gesprekken ben je alert op wat je ziet in de omgeving aan bedrijven. Toch maar eens proberen zonder afspraak in contact te komen. Op de terugweg van je geplande afspraak, stop je bij het gescande bedrijf en probeert met de juiste persoon in gesprek te komen. Niet gelukt, maar wel je kaartje en informatie achter kunnen laten, ga je op kantoor verder met de koude acquisitie. Je plant voor jezelf een nieuwe “cold canvas” ronde in bij dat bedrijventerrein. Je vasthoudendheid wordt beloond met een afspraak! Klanten die je aansluit, blijven bij jou in portefeuille en worden niet overgedragen. Door de tijd heen verschuiven de activiteiten dus van acquisitie naar een mix van acquisitie en relatiebeheer. Je bouwt feitelijk je eigen portefeuille op.

Aan het einde van de dag is er een bijeenkomst gepland met de afdeling Fleetsales waarbij de gezamenlijke doelstellingen worden besproken, je bedient immers vaak dezelfde klanten. Later die avond is er een netwerkbijeenkomst waarbij je op natuurlijke wijze beweegt in deze groep.

Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti ja haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana. Olemme haastatteluun kutsuttaviin hakijoihin yhteydessä puhelimitse. Paikka täytetään heti, kun sopiva henkilö on löydetty eli hae heti! Lisätietoja tästä työstä ja muista Workerin tarjoamista työmahdollisuuksista voit kysyä arkisin Terhiltä 050 544 6533 / terhi.karresmaa@worker.fi.

Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

”Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti”, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

title: Software Engineer
description:
Job Title Software Engineer Job Description We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our team and help build, enhance, and scale our products. If you’re someone who brings fresh ideas, has a curious mindset, and thrives in an engineering environment focused on delivering strategic business value, we’d love to hear from you. As a Software Engineer, you’ll play a central role in shaping the future of our product suite across the engineering teams at UnderwriteMe. You’ll lead technical initiatives, mentor others and help us build systems that are scalable, maintainable, and deliver value to our users. Your work will span the full software development lifecycle, from idea to production, and you’ll be empowered to take ownership of complex engineering challenges. While this is the culture we’re striving for, we’re not fully there yet, we’re looking for engineers who are excited to help us upskill the team and actively shape this environment together.

What you will be doing

You’ll contribute directly to the development and continuous improvement of our products and platforms, focusing on building adaptable and resilient solutions that can evolve with the needs of our users and business. Whether it’s designing new features or refining existing systems, you’ll ensure that everything we build is robust, production-ready, and aligned with our long‑term goals. You’ll be actively involved in system design and architectural discussions, helping the team arrive at thoughtful, simple solutions to complex problems. Your experience and insight will be key in shaping how the team works, bringing fresh ideas, introducing new ways of thinking and helping to evolve our engineering practices to be more efficient and impactful. Collaboration will be a core part of your role. You’ll work closely with product managers to understand priorities, influence the roadmap, and ensure we maintain a healthy balance between delivering new features and strengthening our technical foundations. You’ll also embrace a DevOps mindset, taking full ownership of your code from idea and development through to deployment, including AWS solution design, security, and observability. Beyond your technical contributions, you’ll play a vital role in supporting the growth of your teammates through code reviews, pair programming, and knowledge sharing. You’ll help foster a culture of learning, ownership and continuous improvement, ensuring that your team grows stronger together with every project you take on.

What type of person fits the role

You’re a thoughtful and pragmatic engineer who sees software development as a means to solve meaningful problems, not just to write code. You care deeply about building systems that are simple, maintainable, and valuable to users. You’re naturally collaborative, working closely with engineers, product managers, and designers to shape solutions that balance technical soundness with real impact. You thrive in team-based environments, such as pairing or ensemble programming, and see shared problem-solving as a core part of your day‑to‑day. You’re comfortable navigating trade‑offs, knowing when to prioritise speed and when to invest in long‑term quality. You take pride in your work but remain open to feedback, iteration, and learning from others. You’re curious, proactive, and always looking for ways to improve, whether that’s refining your own skills, helping teammates grow, or evolving the systems you work on.

Technical Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience applying modern software engineering practices in a collaborative team setting, including iterative development, automated testing, and continuous integration and delivery.
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language (e.g. Java, Kotlin, or similar), ideally with experience in Spring Boot and cloud-native development.
  • Practical experience designing and building cloud-based systems, with the ability to use cloud services to create scalable, resilient, and observable solutions.
  • Proven ability to make sound technical decisions independently, while working closely with teammates to deliver solutions from idea to production.
  • Experience improving or evolving existing systems, including working with legacy codebases and simplifying or automating manual workflows.

About UnderwriteMe

UnderwriteMe is an Insurtech software business and subsidiary of Pacific Life Re (PL Re), a global life and pensions reinsurance firm. We have a vision to help everyone purchase protection insurance by using data and disruptive technology to transform our partners and markets in order to make their underwriting processes as quick and efficient as possible. Our core products are:

  • Decision Platform - a B2B enterprise platform that provides a best‑in‑market Underwriting Rules Engine used by over 30 insurers to power their underwriting decisions. The product is sold across UK & Ireland, Asia-Pacific and North America. The platform combines our engine with technology to source and process third‑party information supporting underwriting decisions for insurers. We are already working on capabilities, powered by AI, to make these decisions even more efficient.
  • Protection Platform - a B2B2C marketplace used by over 15,000 advisors to power quoting and purchase of protection products in the UK. We currently deliver 16% of the UK markets protection policies and we are already working to increase our reach.

Working for UnderwriteMe

Joining UnderwriteMe means being part of a technology company that is committed to bringing a fresh and dynamic approach to insurance. You’d be working with a team of highly technical experts made up of people with backgrounds in software, fintech, and insurance. Every person in our global team is valued for the unique qualities they bring to our business and we seek to build their expertise and support their individual ambitions at every step. Of course, we take our work seriously and we know our team can operate under great pressure. We work hard and thrive on achievement, but we also know how to have fun and relax too. We regularly host a range of team building days to strengthen our team's connection with each other and reflect on their successes. Providing employees with a healthy work‑life balance is very important to our culture. We have a wide range of employee benefits and we host regular social activities and wellbeing initiatives. We are also committed to supporting our employee's involvement in their communities, by actively fundraising, hosting charity events, and overseeing volunteering opportunities.

Benefits (Only for Permanent and Fixed Term Employees)

  • Leave 25 days of annual leave with option to buy/sell more days
  • Adoption and fertility leave
  • Generous enhanced parental leave
  • Healthcare Comprehensive private insurance coverage for employee and dependents
  • Group Life Insurance coverage of 9x basic annual salary and Group Income Protection up to 75% of basic annual salary
  • Optical benefits
  • Savings & Retirement 15% combined employee/employer contributions
  • Wellness Subsidized gym membership
  • Access to Employee Assistance Program
  • Cycle to Work and Electric Car
  • Salary Sacrifice Scheme
  • Time off for volunteering
  • Charitable matching of employee donations

You Can Be Who You Are

We are committed to a culture of diversity and inclusion that embraces the authenticity of all employees, partners and communities. We support all employees to thrive and achieve their fullest potential. As part of our commitment to accessibility for all, UnderwriteMe will, upon the request of the applicant, provide accommodation during the recruitment process to ensure equal access to applicants with disabilities. Please contact us about your needs, and we will consult with you to ensure suitable accommodation is provided.

UnderwriteMe Values

Please click here to view our company values UnderwriteMe is transforming the life insurance industry through technology by bringing Insurers, Intermediaries and Customers closer together in the marketplace. We recognise the need to change the life insurance application journey from a complicated, inefficient experience to one that makes the buying process easier and faster for customers and advisers alike. Founded in 2012, our journey started with the Underwriting Rules Engine and Protection Platform in the UK, and we have now grown to become a leading InsurTech provider across Europe, Asia and Australia.

title: Machine Technician II

221 Grove Street, New Castle, Pennsylvania 16101

Shift: 12hr 2-2-3 rotating shift 7:50am-8:20pm

As a fully competent Machine Technician II, the Machine Technician II will operate blow-mold, grinders, trimmer machines and conveyor systems. Role is responsible for troubleshooting process problems and performing minor maintenance to ensure continued operation of the production line. Machine Technician II is also responsible for following our company's Good Manufacturing Practices.

In addition to Machine Operator responsibilities, the Machine Technician II role will include, but is not limited to the following:

  • Demonstrates mastery of entry-level Machine Operator skills and is capable of teaching Level-1 Machine Operator skills.
  • Demonstrate the adherence to quality control and blow mold process procedures.
  • Demonstrate mechanical abilities to troubleshoot and resolve process issues.
  • Demonstrate working knowledge of preventive maintenance procedures
  • Demonstrates basic Machine Operator skills by maintaining critical processing outputs such as adjusting parisons, tail adjustments, regrind levels, weights controls and other operator required adjustments.
  • Runs two lines consistently.
  • Repair or replace pneumatic and hydraulic lines.
  • Assist with preventive maintenance, mold, neck and blow pin and other mechanical changes.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve process problems.
  • Able to operate on multiple platforms, cross functional, can train entry-level Machine Operators, and can shadow Machine Operators (site-specific, if applicable based on plant equipment).
  • Duties may differentiate by plant based on equipment and plant design.
  • Can efficiently change colors without excessive product loss.
  • Receives instructions on specific job task by Lead Operator or Supervisor. Assistance is furnished on unusual problems and work is reviewed for application of sound professional judgment.

  • Reasonable mandatory overtime may be required due to business needs.

QUALIFICATIONS:

The requirements listed below are minimum requirements for the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities who are otherwise qualified to safely perform the essential functions of the job, unless such accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the Company.

EXPERIENCE:

• Intermediate mathematical skills are required.

• Intermediate computer experience.

• Three plus years’ equivalent machine operator experience.

EDUCATION:

• Prefer High School diploma or general education degree (GED).

TRAINING:

• Completion of Altium Machine Technician Level II training.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities who are otherwise qualified to safely perform the essential functions of the job, unless such accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the Company. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee frequently is required to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.

title: Medication Safety Officer
description:
Job Details

ChristianaCare is seeking a Medication Safety Officer (MSO) to serve as an enterprise-wide leader advancing the safe and effective use of medications across our health system.

This is not a traditional pharmacy operations position. It is a highly visible quality and safety role for an accomplished pharmacy professional who wants to influence medication safety on a broader scale, using clinical expertise, data, technology, and collaboration to identify risk and drive meaningful, system-level improvement.

As Medication Safety Officer, you will work across ChristianaCare’s acute and ambulatory settings, partnering with pharmacy, clinical, quality, operational, and executive leaders. You’ll help identify emerging medication-safety risks, establish priorities, translate data into action, and bring multidisciplinary teams together to develop and implement solutions.

You’ll also have the opportunity to be at the forefront of strategic planning, program development and implementation, and the optimization of innovative medication-management and safety technologies as ChristianaCare continues to expand the reach and impact of pharmacy expertise across the organization.

We’re looking for someone who combines strong medication-safety and clinical knowledge with the ability to influence, connect, and lead across disciplines. You know how to take complex medication-safety information and make it meaningful to others. You can build relationships, gain consensus, navigate differing perspectives, and move important work forward, even without direct authority.

Experience leading healthcare quality or safety initiatives, working with regulatory and performance-improvement requirements, and using data to identify opportunities for improvement will position you well for success.

Most importantly, you’ll bring curiosity, sound judgment, and a collaborative approach to creating safer systems for patients.

Education/Experience Requirement:

  • Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) degree required. Completion of an ASHP-accredited PGY1 pharmacy residency or equivalent health-system pharmacy experience required.

  • Minimum five years of progressive health-system pharmacy experience, including at least three years of medication safety, quality improvement, pharmacy informatics, or related systems-level leadership experience required.

  • Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams, applying performance-improvement methods, analyzing safety data, and implementing sustainable changes across complex clinical operations required.

  • Completion of a PGY2 residency or fellowship in Medication-Use Safety and Policy, Health-System Pharmacy Administration and Leadership, Pharmacy Informatics, or another relevant specialty preferred.

  • Experience with enterprise electronic health records and medication-use technologies required; experience with Epic medication-management functionality, clinical decision support, pharmacy automation, and data visualization preferred.

ChristianaCare offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package, including:

  • Day-one medical, dental, and vision coverage

About ChristianaCare

Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, ChristianaCare is one of the country’s most dynamic health care organizations, centered on improving health outcomes, and innovating to make high-quality care more accessible and affordable. ChristianaCare includes an extensive network of primary care and outpatient services, home health care, urgent care centers, three hospitals (1,430 beds), a freestanding emergency department, a Level I trauma center and a Level III neonatal intensive care unit, a comprehensive stroke center and regional centers of excellence in heart and vascular care, cancer care and women’s health. It also includes the pioneering Gene Editing Institute.

ChristianaCare is nationally recognized as a great place to work. ChristianaCare is rated by Newsweek as one of the World’s Best Hospitals and is continually ranked among the best in the U.S. in national quality and safety ratings. ChristianaCare is a nonprofit teaching health system with more than 300 residents and fellows. With its groundbreaking Center for Virtual Health and a focus on population health and value-based care, ChristianaCare is shaping the future of health care.

title: Remote | Medical Writer / Clinical Document Author — $50–$80/hour
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
We are sharing a specialised consulting opportunity for experienced Medical Writers and Clinical Document Authors with strong expertise in regulatory medical writing, Clinical Study Reports, ICH E3, periodic safety documentation, eCTD structure, TFL interpretation, and source-data verification to contribute to an advanced AI training and clinical-documentation evaluation project.

Selected professionals will author and review realistic clinical-document evaluation tasks, assess AI-generated regulatory content for scientific and structural accuracy, trace narrative claims back to source data, and provide clear written rationales that support improvement of AI-assisted clinical writing tools. The work requires substantial hands-on regulatory authoring experience and strong judgement across clinical and safety documentation. No prior experience in AI is required.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Study Report Evaluation

  • Author and review evaluation tasks based on Clinical Study Reports
  • Assess whether generated content follows appropriate clinical-document conventions
  • Review efficacy, safety, discussion, and conclusion sections for scientific accuracy
  • Identify missing, unsupported, or internally inconsistent statements
  • Distinguish substantive scientific issues from acceptable stylistic variation

ICH E3 Structure & Document Quality

  • Assess Clinical Study Reports against ICH E3 expectations
  • Review document organisation, sequencing, and section completeness
  • Evaluate cross-referencing between sections and supporting materials
  • Review appendix structure and document-management consistency
  • Identify structural deficiencies affecting regulatory usability

Source Data Verification

  • Trace narrative claims to underlying tables, figures, listings, and protocols
  • Verify that clinical statements are supported by source data
  • Identify discrepancies between narrative interpretation and statistical outputs
  • Assess whether reported findings accurately reflect available evidence
  • Document unsupported or overstated conclusions clearly

TFL & Protocol Interpretation

  • Review tables, figures, and listings supporting clinical narratives
  • Interpret protocol-defined objectives, endpoints, and analysis requirements
  • Evaluate consistency between protocols, TFLs, and written conclusions
  • Identify population, endpoint, or interpretation mismatches
  • Apply strong scientific judgement when reviewing complex clinical evidence

Periodic Safety Documentation

  • Review content derived from DSURs, PSURs, and PBRERs
  • Apply familiarity with ICH E2F and ICH E2C conventions
  • Evaluate safety narratives and aggregate reporting for accuracy
  • Assess consistency between safety documentation and supporting evidence
  • Identify gaps or errors affecting regulatory interpretation

Scientific Accuracy & Clinical Reasoning

  • Evaluate the scientific defensibility of clinical narratives
  • Identify factual, interpretive, or contextual errors

Evaluation Framework & Best-Practice Development

  • Experience identifying discrepancies between narrative content and source data

  • Excellent written and verbal communication ability
  • Strong attention to detail and regulatory judgement
  • Ability to provide structured and actionable written feedback
  • Advanced degree in life sciences, pharmacy, medicine, or a related field is highly valuable
  • Equivalent depth of regulatory authoring experience may also be considered
  • Experience across multiple clinical phases and therapeutic areas is advantageous
  • Oncology and haematology expertise is especially valuable

Engagement Details

  • Fully remote
  • Compensation: $50–$80/hour
  • Work will involve regulatory medical writing, CSR evaluation, ICH E3 review, TFL interpretation, protocol analysis, source-data verification, periodic safety documentation, and AI-assisted content evaluation

title: Principal Product Manager, Platform Foundations
description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.


At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.


Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


Lead the evolution of platform operations and administration within Genesys Cloud. This role defines the experiences that help customers and developers monitor usage, manage operational complexity, automate administration, and scale confidently on Genesys Cloud.

You will drive strategy and execution for key Platform Foundations areas including API usage visibility, platform limits, configuration-as-code and CI/CD deployment workflows, storage transparency, self-service administration, and operational tooling. Working closely with engineering, architecture, customer success, and field teams, you will turn complex platform systems into scalable customer experiences.

This is a high-visibility opportunity to shape how Genesys Cloud evolves from reactive platform management to intelligent, AI-driven platform operations. You will help define AI-powered experiences that identify usage patterns, anticipate platform constraints, recommend corrective actions, and help customers operate more efficiently at scale.

What You’ll Do:

  • Define and execute the roadmap for Platform Foundations experiences across API usage, platform limits, storage reporting, configuration management, self-service tooling, and operational controls.

  • Lead the evolution of customer-facing self-service experiences that improve transparency, reduce manual intervention, and help customers manage Genesys Cloud with confidence.

  • Build intelligent platform experiences that help customers identify inefficient usage patterns, prevent limit-related disruptions, optimize platform consumption, and scale operations more efficiently.

  • Develop AI-powered operational guidance that helps customers understand usage decisions, automate routine administrative actions, and improve system efficiency through proactive recommendations and workflow automation.

  • Drive API usage visibility, reporting, standards, and change management to help customers, partners, developers, and internal teams build safely and efficiently at scale.

  • Lead the evolution of configuration-as-code and CI/CD deployment workflows for Genesys Cloud, enabling repeatable, DevOps-aligned administration and deployment workflows.

  • Define platform storage reporting and transparency capabilities that support operational insights, customer governance, cost awareness, and future monetization opportunities.

  • Drive consistent platform patterns that simplify administration and improve customer experience across a distributed microservices architecture.

  • Engage with strategic customers, partners, field teams, support, professional services, and customer success teams to validate needs, shape priorities, and accelerate adoption.

  • Lead cross-functional alignment across product, engineering, UX, product marketing, finance, legal, and go-to-market teams to deliver enterprise-ready platform experiences.

What You’ll Bring to the Role:

  • 8+ years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS, cloud platforms, developer platforms, infrastructure, APIs, DevOps tooling, AI-powered products, or large-scale B2B products.

  • Proven track record defining and delivering complex technical products across cross-functional engineering and product organizations.

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to define product strategy using customer insights, market trends, and business objectives.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead initiatives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with multiple dependencies.

  • Passion for creating intuitive administrative experiences that improve customer outcomes.

  • Strong technical fluency with APIs, microservices, cloud architecture, developer experience, infrastructure as code, platform operations, or related domains.

  • Experience building customer-facing self-service experiences for technical or administrative users, especially in areas such as usage visibility, configuration management, reporting, governance, provisioning, or operational tooling.

  • Experience translating complex technical systems into intuitive product experiences that deliver clear customer and business value.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence executive leadership and align distributed teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with API platforms, API governance, developer tooling, usage analytics, rate limiting, or customer-facing API change management.

  • Experience with Terraform, infrastructure as code, CI/CD workflows, configuration management, or enterprise DevOps practices.

  • Experience with storage reporting, retention, data governance, usage-based monetization, cost transparency, or operational optimization.

  • Experience building AI-powered copilots, recommendation systems, intelligent assistants, anomaly detection, or proactive operational guidance in enterprise software.

  • Experience defining platform standards, governance models, or reusable design patterns across large-scale SaaS platforms.

  • Familiarity with CCaaS, customer experience platforms, enterprise communications, or AI-powered experience orchestration.

Our Benefits:

At Genesys, we’re committed to supporting your well-being, growth, and work–life balance. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:

  • Flexible work options – Choose what works for you with hybrid schedules, work-from-home flexibility, and the option to collaborate onsite in our state-of-the-art Galway office.

  • Career development & growth – Access continuous learning opportunities, mentoring, and clear paths for advancement.

  • Competitive pension scheme – Invest in your future with an excellent employer-supported pension plan.

  • Annual bonus program – Be rewarded for your impact and contributions.

  • Comprehensive health coverage – Including private health insurance, access to company dental plan, and wellness supports.

  • Financial protection – Enjoy Income Protection and Life Assurance, along with access to dedicated financial planning resources to help you make confident, informed decisions about your future.

  • Family-friendly policies – Generous paid maternity and paternity

Why Genesys?

At Genesys, employees are part of a global team transforming customer and employee experiences through innovation and empathy. Genesys is building the future of AI-powered experience orchestration and enabling organizations around the world to create deeper connections with their customers.

#LI-MC1


Working at Genesys

  • AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year.
  • A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work.
  • Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support.
  • Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families.
  • Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys.

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.


What Happens After You Apply

Job Title

Project Manager

Job Description Summary

The MEP Manager is responsible for leading and managing all Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) services for construction projects from design to commissioning. The role involves planning, coordination, and execution of MEP systems to ensure they meet design intent, quality standards, timelines, safety norms, and budget targets. The position requires close collaboration with architects, structural engineers, consultants, contractors, and clients to deliver integrated and efficient building systems.

Job Description

About the Role:

Project Planning & Coordination:

  • Oversee complete MEP planning, design review, and implementation for all construction projects.
  • Coordinate with design consultants and architects to ensure design compliance with project requirements and applicable codes.
  • Integrate MEP systems with structural and architectural works.

Execution & Supervision:

  • Manage day-to-day site activities related to HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting, BMS, and other MEP installations.
  • Ensure that all work is executed as per approved drawings, specifications, and safety standards.
  • Supervise and monitor MEP subcontractors and vendors for timely delivery and installation.

Quality & Compliance:

  • Conduct regular inspections and ensure adherence to quality standards and statutory regulations.
  • Review material submittals, method statements, and technical drawings.
  • Ensure compliance with local building codes, IS standards, and client specifications.

Budget & Cost Control:

  • Prepare and monitor MEP budgets and cost estimates.
  • Review and approve vendor quotations and subcontractor bills.
  • Identify and control cost overruns through value engineering and efficient resource utilization.

Testing & Commissioning:

  • Plan, supervise, and validate the testing and commissioning of all MEP systems.
  • Ensure proper handover documentation and O&M manuals are submitted to the client.

Team Management:

  • Lead a team of MEP engineers and site supervisors across multiple projects.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and training to the team.

Client & Stakeholder Coordination:

  • Act as the main point of contact for all MEP-related discussions with the client and consultants.
  • Present progress reports and resolve any design or execution conflicts proactively.

About You:

Key Skills:

  • MEP Design & Coordination
  • Project Execution & Commissioning
  • Cost & Budget Management
  • Vendor/Subcontractor Management
  • Quality Assurance & Safety Compliance
  • Value Engineering
  • Leadership & Team Development
  • Client & Consultant Communication

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical / electrical engineering (Master’s preferred).
  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in MEP design, execution, and project management within the construction industry.
  • Proven track record in managing large-scale commercial, industrial, or residential projects.
  • Strong understanding of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting, and ELV systems.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit MEP, and MS Project/Primavera.

As one of the leading global real estate services firms transforming the way people work, shop and live working at Cushman & Wakefield means you will benefit from;

title: School Maatschappelijk Werker (24-28 uur) – Krimpenerwaard  (schoolvakanties vrij)
description:
Als schoolmaatschappelijk werker bij Kwadraad probeer je kinderen in hun kracht te zetten. Het schoolmaatschappelijk werk is er op gericht problemen bij kinderen in een zo vroeg mogelijk stadium te signaleren en helpt kinderen bij het versterken van hun eigen probleemoplossend vermogen. Zo help je om te gaan met verschillende emoties of vervelende gebeurtenissen. Of werk je aan het vergroten van de sociale vaardigheden. Met jouw hulp krijgen kinderen weer meer zelfvertrouwen en werken ze aan hun weerbaarheid.

Een greep uit je dag

Je wandelt vroeg een school binnen in Lekkerkerk om de voortgang van een aantal trajecten met de intern begeleider te bespreken. Je werkt op verschillende basisscholen. Deze ochtend spreek je een gescheiden stel ouders dat zich zorgen maakt over hun kind. Ze merken dat de scheiding impact heeft en hun kind minder presteert op school. Je doet een brede uitvraag en start de individuele begeleiding van het kind op. Ook kijk je of het kind kan deelnemen aan een KIES training. Tijdens de begeleiding van het kind ben je nauw betrokken met ouders.

Met een vraag van de school in je achterhoofd rij je door naar het kantoor in Lekkerkerk. Je hebt overleg met je Kwadraad-team. Net als jij zijn je collega’s veel buiten de deur op scholen. Samen nemen jullie de agenda door en bespreken een centraal thema: hoogsensitiviteit bij kinderen. Samen bespreken jullie de programma’s die ingezet worden om de kinderen effectief op weg te helpen. Daarnaast is er nog tijd om kort de bijzonderheden op de verschillende scholen en gebieden te bespreken.

Na een korte rit en een snelle boterham, kom je aan op een school in Schoonhoven. Je hebt een gesprek met de intern begeleider waarbij je informatie, advies en consultatie geeft. Daarna staan gesprekken gepland met kinderen. Via oplossingsgerichte gesprekstechnieken, creatieve methoden en kennis van de ontwikkelingspsychologie kom je tot de kern van wat nodig is. Door je expertise weet je als geen ander hoe je partijen rondom het kind in kunt schakelen om tot een oplossing te komen. Na schooltijd stap je in de auto onderweg naar een school in Bergambacht. Hier geef je samen met de collega een faalangsttraining aan kinderen. In de auto onderweg naar huis belt je ‘maatje’, dit is je naaste collega waarmee je spart en casuïstiek bespreekt. Ze wil een luisterend oor – vandaag is er een ongeval naast het schoolplein geweest waarbij ze verwerkingsondersteuning heeft geboden. Jij luistert en denkt mee. Mogelijk kunnen jullie morgen even samenkomen om het vervolg te bespreken.

Jouw team
Je werkt in de Krimpenerwaard in een team met 6 schoolmaatschappelijk werkers bij Kwadraad, waarin jullie als professionals grotendeels autonoom opereren. Binnen het team maken jullie goede werkafspraken en zetten jullie capaciteit passend in. Samen met de Algemeen Maatschappelijk Werkers, Jeugdmaatschappelijk werkers, het sociaal raadslid en de coördinator van project Steunouder geven jullie de opdracht in Krimpenerwaard vorm.

Maatschappelijk werk centraal

Als schoolmaatschappelijk werker bij Kwadraad zorg je ervoor dat de hulpvraag rondom een kind bij docenten, ouders en het kind zelf wordt opgepakt. Dankzij jouw ondersteuning zijn kinderen die het moeilijk hebben extra ondersteund. Je bent onder andere verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Een zorgvuldige inventarisatie samen met de cliënt (ouder/kind) over de hulpvraag, zodat een zorgvuldige analyse en hulpverleningsplan kan worden opgesteld.

  • Informeren en advisering aan de school (hulpvraag verheldering, advies geven over aanpak). Je kunt signaleren en toeleiden naar hulp vanuit het jeugd ondersteuningsteam.

  • Kennisdeling. Je deelt je expertise en geeft informatie en advies op scholen, aan professionals en aan ouders. Met als doel het steeds beter te doen.

Dit breng je mee

  • Een relevant hbo-diploma. Bijvoorbeeld social work, MWD, SPH of Pedagogiek.

  • Een registratie in het Registerplein (kamer ‘Maatschappelijk Werkers’), of SKJ-registratie, of in de mogelijkheid deze op korte termijn te behalen.

  • Kennis van en affiniteit met het onderwijswerkveld en kinderen en hun ouders/opvoeders.

  • Schakelvermogen. De diversiteit in onderwijsstructuren en preventie past bij je.

  • Je bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs B en auto.

Dit geven we jou

Ons vertrouwen. En de vrijheid om te bouwen aan een mooie maatschappelijke opgave. Daarnaast:

  • Een salaris in schaal 8 van cao Sociaal Werk tussen de € 3.507,- en € 5.326,- bruto op basis van 36 uur, dit is inclusief arbeidsmarkttoeslag volgens de nieuwe salaristabellen in de cao van oktober 2026.

  • Een jaarcontract met de mogelijkheid tot verlenging en uitzicht op een vast dienstverband bij Kwadraad.

  • Een vrij te besteden Individueel Keuze Budget. Het budget bedraagt ruim 16% van het jaarsalaris, inclusief 26 uur aan bovenwettelijke vakantieuren op basis van 36 uur.

  • Een loopbaanbudget van 1,5% van het maandsalaris dat kan worden ingezet voor persoonlijke groei en loopbaanontwikkeling.

  • Tegemoetkoming reiskosten voor de auto. Als je met het ov reist, vergoeden wij de kosten volledig. Fiets je liever? Dan belonen we je gefietste kilometers. Duurzaam bewegen staat bij ons centraal.

Kwadraad: wij zijn er, je bent welkom

Jouw nieuwe werkgever? Die ondersteunt mensen bij problemen waar zij in het leven tegen aan kunnen lopen. Wij helpen bij het vinden van duurzame oplossingen waar zij met eigen talent, inzet en netwerk aan werken. Relatieproblemen, opvoedvragen, eenzaamheid, scheiden, schulden, rouw, onzekerheid, stress of geweld; wij bieden een stevige professionele basis.

Onze teams zijn actief binnen 35 gemeenten en krijgen daarbij ondersteuning vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Gouda, onder andere op het gebied van ICT en HR.

Ook testen of je bij Kwadraad past? Klik dan hier.

Enthousiast?
Dan zien we graag je cv en motivatie voor 6 oktober 2026 tegemoet. Als we voldoende geschikte kandidaten hebben sluiten we de vacature eerder. Heb je vragen over de functie dan staat je collega Marieke je graag te woord. Stuur haar een e-mail en zij belt je terug.

title: BXMA - Multi-Asset Investing - Senior Investment Strategist
description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at . Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.


Blackstone Multi-Asset Investing (BXMA) manages $109 billion across a diversified set of businesses. We strive to generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our clients across market cycles. Our strategies include Absolute Return, Multi-Strategy, Total Portfolio Management, and Public Real Assets.

The Multi-Strategy Investing platform (“MSI”) was launched in 2011 and is the team's flagship commingled multi-strategy fund. MSI’s mandate is flexible across the capital structure – investing in equities, preferreds, converts, bonds, loans and structured investments. The team can execute on both private and public opportunities across geographies or industries.

The MSI team is able to leverage the broader Blackstone network (including Real Estate, Private Equity, Credit, and Strategic Partners), and the team’s direct relationships to source attractive investment opportunities. The team seeks an Investment Analyst for its fundamental equity team to support the fund’s fundamentally-driven investment process.

We are seeking a highly strategic, analytically rigorous, and execution-oriented Senior Investment Strategist to partner closely with the Chief Investment Officer in leading a dynamic Multi-Strategy Hedge Fund platform. This role sits at the center of the investment organization, helping synthesize information across portfolio managers, risk teams, research analysts, market developments, and macroeconomic trends into actionable insights and recommendations.

The successful candidate will combine strong analytical skills, sound market judgment, and exceptional communication capabilities. They will serve as a trusted advisor to the CIO, helping identify key themes, evaluate opportunities and risks, challenge assumptions, and ensure important developments across the platform are surfaced and contextualized in a timely manner.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with the CIO to support investment decision-making, portfolio reviews, and strategic priorities across multiple asset classes and strategies.
  • Aggregate, analyze, and synthesize information from portfolio managers, research teams, risk functions, counterparties, and market sources into concise, actionable insights.
  • Support the CIO in evaluating portfolio positioning, capital allocation, thematic exposures, liquidity considerations, and risk-adjusted opportunities.
  • Conduct independent research and analysis on market developments, macroeconomic trends, industries, and investment opportunities relevant to the platform.
  • Prepare decision-oriented materials and analyses for investment committees, portfolio reviews, and senior leadership discussions.
  • Identify cross-strategy observations, portfolio implications, and risk considerations that may not be readily visible at the individual manager level.
  • Help the CIO prioritize key investment issues by filtering large volumes of information and highlighting the developments most relevant to portfolio performance and risk.
  • Serve as a thought partner to portfolio managers and investment teams by providing analytical support, challenge, and alternative perspectives.
  • Coordinate efforts across investment, risk, analytics, and operations teams to support informed decision-making.
  • Drive special projects focused on portfolio analytics, market intelligence, investment process enhancements, and strategic initiatives.
  • Act as a central coordination point across investment, risk, operations, and executive leadership functions to facilitate timely communication and execution.
  • Serve as a proxy for the CIO in selected internal and external meetings when appropriate.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in investment management, hedge funds, asset management, investment banking, or related financial markets roles.
  • Strong understanding of multi-strategy investing, including exposure to equities, credit, macro, relative value, and/or quantitative strategies.
  • Proven experience synthesizing large volumes of qualitative and quantitative information into concise, actionable conclusions.
  • Exceptional analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills, capable of engaging effectively with senior investment professionals.
  • Proven experience operating in a high-performance environment with sound judgment, discretion, and attention to detail.
  • Strong project management and organizational capabilities, with a track record of driving execution across complex initiatives.
  • High intellectual curiosity, commercial orientation, capable of maintaining perspective amid rapidly changing market conditions.
  • Advanced degree and/or CFA preferred.

title: Oracle Configuration Engineer
description:
Gaming:

Welcome to the world of land-based gaming. At Light & Wonder, it’s all about the games, and our Gaming team builds cutting-edge technology, products, and content for the most iconic casinos and operators across the globe.

Position Summary

Design and develop Configurator Solution Models for gambling products using Oracle Configurator and related modules, as well as Agile PLM.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Work with Engineering, Project Management, Order Management, and Manufacturing to identify the product structure and business rules needed for configuring gambling products. This collaboration will take place for New Product Introductions (NPI) as well as enhancements to existing products.

  • Design the Oracle Configurator Guided Selling Questions/User Interface (UI), set up Option Classes for the Bill of Material (BOM) items, and write the appropriate rules needed to arrive at a customer-specific Bill of Material.

  • Use Oracle’s Product Information Management (PIM) module, create Catalogs, Attribute Groups, and Display Formats in Configurator Instance.

  • Use best practices in Oracle Configurator to reduce the number of rules required for ease of Solution Model maintenance.

  • Create Engineering Change Orders (ECO) in Agile Product Lifecycle Management to create BOM for Pick to Order (PTO), and Assemble to Order (ATO) models and Option Classes. Transfer the BOM to Oracle ERP through Agile ECO implementation.

  • Test Configurator output against the Engineering BOM to insure order accuracy.

title: Trust Architect
description:
SUMMARY

Trust Architects build trust in the AI and trust among the people who use it. They make sure every system Avanade Next ships is safe, reliable and ready for production — and that the client's people are confident, capable and willing to adopt new ways of working alongside it.

The role operates across two dimensions. Trust in the AI: evaluation frameworks, accuracy measures, security controls, governance controls and human-in-the-loop safeguards. Trust in the people: adoption design, capability uplift, ways of working and confidence in human-agent collaboration.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Building trust in the AI

  • Design and run evaluations: define accuracy targets, build the harness, drive the system to target and evidence it.

  • Set governance, risk and security guardrails before build begins, and keep them current as the system evolves.

  • Embed guardrails, controls and human-in-the-loop review, including the feedback loop that improves the system after release.

  • Establish the evidence required for a system to move from prototype to production, and hold the release gate.

  • Own the regulatory and privacy position on the engagement — APRA, MAS, data residency and client-specific obligations.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with FDEs so trust, evaluation and monitoring capability is built in from the outset.

Building trust in the people

  • Design the adoption and change approach that builds confidence through transparency, education and demonstrated outcomes.

  • Help the client redesign ways of working and human-agent interaction so the system fits how people actually work.

  • Lead enablement so the client's people can and do use what has been built.

  • Drive uptake and user confidence after go-live, tracking active usage rather than reported satisfaction.

  • Support executive and Board confidence with clear governance, accountability and decision-making frameworks.

  • Contribute evaluation harnesses, guardrail patterns, governance frameworks and adoption assets to the APAC library.

KEY MEASURES

  • Governance, guardrails and security controls in place before build starts on every engagement.

  • Target accuracy, safety and governance thresholds met and evidenced before production release.

  • Adoption above 70% active usage at 90 days post-go-live, with effective human-in-the-loop operation.

  • Full compliance with Avanade responsible AI standards and client regulatory obligations.

  • Reusable trust, evaluation and adoption assets contributed from every engagement.

.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years across AI governance, model risk, security, responsible AI, or large-scale technology change and adoption. Strength in two of these with a credible path into the third is expected — few candidates will have all of it.

  • Hands-on evaluation experience with generative or agentic systems is strongly preferred over policy-only backgrounds.

  • Working knowledge of the APAC regulatory environment relevant to their market.

  • Practical change and enablement capability with technical audiences and frontline users alike.

  • Able to build trust with sceptical stakeholders and to say no with evidence.

  • Comfortable in a role that is still being defined, in a track with no established internal precedent.

.

title: Teammanager Twente
description:
In Twente zitten we niet stil. De komende jaren breiden we ons vervoeraanbod verder uit en verwelkomen we nieuwe collega's. Daarom zijn we op zoek naar een Teammanager Bus die houdt van aanpakken, verbinden en bouwen.

Samen met vijf collega-teammanagers ben je verantwoordelijk voor zo'n 500 chauffeurs verdeeld over vijf vestigingen. Daarbij krijg je je eigen team en vestiging onder je hoede.

Wat werken in Twente bijzonder maakt? Het noaberschap. We kijken naar elkaar om, helpen elkaar waar nodig en zijn trots op wat we samen neerzetten. Dat merk je in de samenwerking met collega's, maar ook in het contact met onze chauffeurs en reizigers.

Ben jij zichtbaar op de werkvloer, maak je gemakkelijk contact en weet je mensen in beweging te krijgen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Teammanager Bus ben jij de schakel tussen onze chauffeurs, de operatie en de organisatie. Je bent zo veel mogelijk op de vestiging aanwezig, kent je mensen en weet wat er speelt.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • het begeleiden, coachen en ontwikkelen van chauffeurs;

  • het realiseren van afgesproken doelstellingen zoals punctualiteit en rituitval;

  • het verder verbeteren van de prestaties van jouw vestiging en de concessie Twente;

  • het uitvoeren van het HR- en inzetbaarheidsbeleid;

  • het zorgen voor een veilige en prettige werkomgeving;

  • het afhandelen van klantreacties en het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening;

  • het meedraaien in het calamiteitenrooster (ongeveer één week per twee maanden).

Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met onder meer planners, HR, technici, materieelbeheer en collega-teammanagers.

Wat maakt deze functie aantrekkelijk?

  • Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid voor je eigen vestiging.

  • Je werkt in een regio waar samenwerking en noaberschap vanzelfsprekend zijn.

  • Je speelt een belangrijke rol in de verdere groei van Arriva Twente én in de verduurzaming van het openbaar vervoer.

  • Je werkt samen met een ervaren en betrokken team van collega-teammanagers.

  • Je krijgt de ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

  • Geen dag is hetzelfde. Je bent bezig met mensen, operatie, prestaties én ontwikkeling.

Wat breng jij mee?

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar leidinggevende ervaring in een operationele omgeving.

  • Ervaring met verandertrajecten en het begeleiden van teams in transitie.

  • Kennis van verzuimbegeleiding en HR-processen.

  • Uitstekende sociale vaardigheden en het vermogen om draagvlak te creëren.

  • Beheersing van de Nederlandse taal; basiskennis van het Engels is een pré i.v.m. internationale chauffeurs.

Je bent zichtbaar, benaderbaar en weet hoe je een team in beweging krijgt. Je combineert structuur en duidelijkheid met empathie en oog voor de mens.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een uitdagende fulltime functie (40 uur) in loonschaal 10 (APN) met een minimum salaris van bruto € 4.907,- en maximum bruto salaris van € 6.826,- per maand.

  • 30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. 40 uur).

  • Diversiteitsverlof: je mag een doordeweekse feestdag uitruilen met een erkende nationale feestdag uit een andere geloofsovertuiging of cultuur;

  • 8% vakantiegeld.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Een dynamische werkomgeving waarin je écht het verschil kunt maken.

  • Een organisatie in beweging, met volop ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

  • Een team en leidinggevende die jou ondersteunen, maar ook vertrouwen op jouw zelfstandigheid.

  • Een dertiende maand.

  • Gratis privéreizen met zowel Arriva bussen als treinen.

Solliciteer nu!

De procedure bestaat uit twee gespreksrondes en een online assessment. Wil je meer weten over de vacature? Stuur dan een mail naar Maayke,

maayke.busstra@arriva.nl of naar Ricardo Abbas (Corporate Recruitment), ricardo.abbas@arriva.nl.

De vacature is zowel intern als extern opengesteld. Bij gelijke geschiktheid wordt voorrang gegeven aan interne kandidaten.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet in behandeling genomen.

title: Lead, Business Continuity Management
description:
About Northern Trust


As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.


Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.


With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.



Lead, Business Continuity Manager (APAC Location)

Location

Bangalore / Pune

Position Summary

The Lead, Business Continuity Management (APAC Location) is responsible for the development, implementation, governance, testing, and continuous improvement of Business Continuity Management (BCM).

This role serves as the primary APAC focal point for technology continuity planning while partnering with global technology teams, infrastructure organizations, cybersecurity, enterprise risk management, business units, and regional regulators. The incumbent will ensure that critical technology services can withstand, respond to, and recover from disruptive events while maintaining compliance with internal policies and regional regulatory requirements.

The role requires balancing regional execution with global alignment, ensuring APAC-specific risks, regulatory obligations, and operational requirements are effectively incorporated into the enterprise resilience framework.

Key Responsibilities

Business Continuity Strategy & Governance

  • Lead the APAC Technology Business Continuity Program.

  • Develop and maintain regional technology continuity and resilience strategies aligned with global frameworks.

  • Ensure regional BCM practices are aligned with enterprise risk management standards and global technology policies.

  • Establish governance forums, metrics, reporting, and executive dashboards for continuity and resilience programs.

  • Support annual reviews of continuity policies, standards, procedures, and recovery strategies.

Continuity Planning & Preparedness

  • Develop, maintain, and govern Technology Business Continuity Plans (BCPs).

  • Ensure recovery plans exist for critical platforms, infrastructure services, applications, and technology processes.

  • Coordinate Business Impact Analyses (BIA) and risk assessments across APAC technology functions.

  • Assess dependencies involving third-party vendors, cloud service providers, and critical technology partners.

  • Maintain inventories of critical services, applications, recovery strategies, and recovery objectives.

Disaster Recovery & Resilience Testing

  • Coordinate disaster recovery testing programs across APAC technology teams.

  • Manage tabletop exercises, simulation exercises, crisis management drills, and failover testing activities.

  • Validate Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).

  • Track remediation of gaps identified through testing and post-incident reviews.

  • Produce executive summaries and lessons-learned reports following exercises.

Operational Resilience

  • Support identification and mapping of Important Business Services (IBS) and technology dependencies.

  • Assess resilience vulnerabilities across people, process, technology, facilities, and third-party ecosystems.

  • Assist in establishing impact tolerances and resilience performance measures.

  • Support enterprise operational resilience initiatives and regional regulatory requirements.

Crisis Management & Incident Response

  • Support technology crisis management and major incident response activities.

  • Participate in regional command centers during significant incidents.

  • Coordinate communications, issue escalation, decision tracking, and recovery governance during disruptions.

  • Facilitate post-incident reviews and corrective action plans.

Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary APAC liaison between global BCM teams and regional technology leadership.

  • Partner with:

    • Infrastructure Engineering

    • Cyber Security

    • IT Operations

    • Technology Risk Management

    • Enterprise Risk

    • Corporate Services

    • Business Units

  • Provide guidance and coaching to technology teams regarding continuity planning requirements.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Risk Management, Business Administration, or related discipline.

  • Master's degree preferred.

Professional Certifications (Preferred)

  • CBCP (Certified Business Continuity Professional)

  • MBCI (Member, Business Continuity Institute)

  • ISO 22301 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor

  • PMP

  • ITIL

Experience

  • 8-12 years of experience in Business Continuity Management, Disaster Recovery, Operational Resilience, Technology Risk, or Technology Operations.

  • Minimum 3-5 years managing continuity programs within a technology organization.

  • Experience supporting large-scale global technology environments.

  • Experience managing regulatory, audit, and risk management engagements.

  • Financial services experience preferred but not mandatory.

Technical Knowledge

Strong understanding of:

  • Business Continuity Management (BCM)

  • Disaster Recovery (DR)

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking

  • Executive Communication

  • Stakeholder Influence

  • Risk-Based Decision Making

  • Program Management

  • Problem Solving

  • Cross-Cultural Leadership

  • Collaboration Across Global Teams

  • Continuous Improvement Mindset

Success Measures

The role will be measured by:

  • Completion and quality of APAC continuity plans.

  • Regulatory and audit outcomes.

  • DR testing completion and success rates.

  • Reduction in continuity-related risk exposure.

  • Timely closure of resilience remediation activities.

  • Executive and regulatory reporting quality.

  • Recovery readiness for critical technology services.

  • Alignment of APAC resilience practices with global standards.

Scope of Responsibility

  • Regional ownership of Technology BCM and Operational Resilience for APAC.

  • Coordination with global continuity and recovery teams.

  • Support for technology operations spanning multiple APAC countries and time zones.

  • Influence across infrastructure, application delivery, cyber security, and technology operations teams.

  • Participation in executive crisis management and major incident governance.


Working with Us


As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.


Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.


Reasonable Accommodation


Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.


About Our Pune Office


The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

description:

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




MTS SOFTWARE SYSTEM DESIGN ENGINEER

THE ROLE:

The MTS Software System Design Engineer will serve as a leader within the Release and Test Engineering Organization with strong foundation of AI and Test automation leveraging AI. This role will need to have a holistic view of development and validation workflows for systems products, strong background towards automation of CLI/UI test cases, have good understanding of CLI and UI automation tools/frameworks and augment test automation by being hands-on. This will need the person to define optimal risk-based test strategies, build AI assisted scalable automation and implement/support automation of complex system-level debugging and contribute to improving release quality and engineering efficiency. This role will collaborate with system architecture, firmware, BIOS, drivers, development, validation, and product engineering teams. This role can involve leading a small team of test case development/automation engineers.

THE PERSON:

The ideal candidate would be self-directed, quality-focused, and hands-on technical leader with deep expertise in software validation, test architecture, automation, debugging, and quality engineering. The candidate should have a strong understanding of H/W platform architectures and platform-software interactions preferably with AMD platform architectures. He should have experience in translating product requirements into comprehensive validation coverage, and using AI for generation and improvement of tests, failure triage, defect prediction, and QA productivity.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Complement and work with functional owners to drive defined QA test strategy through the test work flow for new AMD platform and system-software features.
  • Review requirements and technical designs, identify quality risks and testability gaps, and define measurable entry, exit, coverage, and release-quality criteria.
  • Leverage various test frameworks, automation frameworks and reporting frameworks for generating/automating functional, regression, integration, compatibility, stability, performance, power, and end-to-end validation of different products.
  • Write production-quality test automation using Python or equivalent languages and integrate continuous validation into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Plan, Generate, Review and execute test cases for coverage across representative hardware, operating systems, firmware, BIOS, drivers, applications, workloads, and system configurations.
  • Support defect discovery, reproduction, prioritization, regression-point identification, root-cause isolation, and closure of complex system-level issues across different products with AMD product architectures.
  • Support automation of analysis of test results, logs, telemetry, defect pattern identification, and quality metrics for identifying systemic risks, coverage gaps, and recommending corrective or preventive actions.
  • Leverage, Automate and Develop practical AI-assisted solutions for test generation, test prioritization, anomaly detection, failure clustering, log summarization, defect prediction, and automated triage.
  • Partner with development and cross-functional teams to improve design-for-testability, establish quality gates, communicate risks, and drive issues to closure before release.
  • Mentor QA engineers and champion test engineering standards towards automation and continuous improvement in coverage and defect containment.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

  • 10+ years of relevant industry experience in system validation, test strategy and design, test automation and defect management/release qualification.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and working knowledge of C or C++, with experience developing maintainable test automation, utilities, APIs, data pipelines, and validation tools.
  • Proven experience building reusable automation frameworks and integrating automated functional, regression, integration, stability, and performance tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • A good understanding of System architecture and platform components, including CPU, GPU, NPU (preferably AMD) and their hardware-software interactions is desirable.
  • Experience validating complex system software across Windows or Linux environments and representative hardware, firmware, driver, and application configurations.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Working knowledge of artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, and large language models, with experience applying AI to test automation, analytics, or failure triage.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, defect tracking, test management, quality metrics, dashboards, requirements traceability, code reviews, and technical documentation.
  • Excellent analytical, risk-assessment, problem-solving, communication, collaboration, planning, mentoring, and technical leadership skills.
  • Hands-on experience/familiarity in the above is a must requirement
  • Experience of leading a small team in the above space would be a positive differentiator

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Responsible to ensure the efficient operation and maintenance of mechanical, electrical and plumbing equipment and systems for the assigned property(s). Responsibilities include (but are not limited to) maintaining a clean and safe working environment, performing rounds, conducting routine assessments, performance of day-to-day preventive and corrective maintenance, painting, and housekeeping for assigned properties

Job Description

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Perform all plumbing, electrical, or HVAC requirements of the building(s)
• Maintain heating equipment, chillers (air and/ or water cooled), DX units, pumps, cooling towers, fan coil units, VAV, and air distribution systems, etc.
• Monitor and adjust all mechanical/pneumatic equipment, steam stations, control gauges, distributor panels, valves, thermostats, diffusers, and other equipment necessary to provide a comfortable environment for the buildings
• Verify field conditions and perform any necessary repairs or adjustments
• Monitor Energy Management
• Repair doors, ceilings, hand railings, and floors and other general repairs, adjustments and installations about the property
• Perform repairs to plumbing fixtures (water closets, urinals, flush valve assemblies, lavatories, etc.)
• Perform preventive maintenance duties in accordance with C&W standards, building protocol, manufacturer recommendations and industry best practices. including changing filters, cleaning coils, flushing condensers, punching tubes, greasing fan, pump and motor bearings as required, inspecting and adjusting belts, replacing motor bearings, aligning pulleys and shafts, monitor condenser, chilled, heating and secondary water chemical treatment and its associated feed equipment, clean and maintain cooling towers, and perform annual inspections and other scheduled routines as directed.
• Inspect engine room equipment, fan room equipment, cooling tower, all motors, house pumps, electric rooms, back-up generator, fire pump(s), sump pump(s), and ejector pumps. Replace lamps, light fixtures, reinstall or replace signage, verify rooms are clean and clear of obstructions and debris
• Check for properly operating emergency exit signs and lights and ensure free and clear access to emergency stairs and exits. Perform additional fire and life safety inspections as per NFPA and local jurisdiction, C&W standards, building protocol and as directed by superiors and property management
• Document and report activities to supervisor
• Respond immediately to emergency situations (fire, evacuation, equipment failure, etc.) and customer concerns
• Comply with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agency, and company directives as relates to building operations and practice safe work habits
• Complete all required C&W Safety Training as scheduled annually
• Comply with C&W Uniform Dress Code while working and maintain a neat and clean appearance while on the property at times other than working hours
KEY COMPETENCIES
• Technical Proficiency
• Initiative
• Flexibility
• Multi-Tasking
• Sense of Urgency
IMPORTANT EDUCATION
• High School Diploma of GED Equivalent
• Graduate of apprentice program or trade school preferred
IMPORTANT EXPERIENCE
• 5+ years of related work experience in operating mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems in a commercial property setting
ADDITIONAL ELIGIBILITY QUALIFICATIONS
• Appropriate license/permit for trade as may be required, i.e. Journeyman or Master Electrician License or City Licenses, such as Refrigeration Certificate of Fitness, High Pressure Boiler License, High Pressure Steam Operator, etc.)
• May be required to have certification as a Universal Technician for CFC’s depending on market licensure requirements
• Possess and maintain a valid driver’s license and good driving record with periodic checks (where applicable)
• Basic Computing Skills in Outlook, Excel & Word
• Experience in operation, maintenance and basic repair of HVAC, boilers, heaters, pumps, refrigerant systems, compressors, water systems, etc.
• Knowledgeable in energy management systems, techniques and operations.
• Thorough knowledge in all building systems operations, maintenance and repair.
May be only maintenance staff member on duty during certain shifts; may be required to work extended periods of time without relief when responding to priority/emergency situations (including overtime type assignments); may require shift work and/or on call duties
WORK ENVIRONMENT
This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines. Regularly required to travel outside between properties in varying weather conditions.
PHYSICAL DEMANDS
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

• Ability to read and understand information presented orally and in writing

title: Fire Protection Engineers (Data Centre Construction) JB
description:
Job Description: Fire Protection Engineer

Position Purpose

The Fire Protection Engineer designs and supervises systems that detect and put out fires without destroying sensitive electronic hardware. They ensure the building complies with strict life-safety laws.

Key Responsibilities

  • Specialized Suppression: Oversee the installation of data centre-specific fire systems, including Pre-Action sprinklers and Gas Suppression Systems (e.g., FM-200, Novec 1230, or Inert gas).
  • Early Detection: Supervise the deployment of VESDA (Very Early Smoke Detection Apparatus) and regular smoke detector networks.
  • Bomba Clearance: Manage room integrity testing (door fan tests) for gas rooms and lead inspections to secure the Certificate of Completion and Compliance (CCC) from Jabatan Bomba dan Penyelamat.
  • Life Safety Integration: Ensure fire alarm systems smoothly trigger fire doors, access control overrides, and HVAC shutdowns during emergencies.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
