Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition
Performs implementation, regular problem solving, maintenance and support for a agile software development.

Responsibilities
• Designing, modifying, developing, writing and implementing software programming applications for target system using agile methods.
• Acquiring client requirements; resolving workflow problems through automation optimization.
• Writing source codes for new applications, and/or generating and enhancing code samples for existing applications.
• Utilizing automated testing tools to perform the testing and maintenance.

Skill Descriptors
Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
• Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
• Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
• Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
• Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
• Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
• Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
• Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
• Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Software Development: Knowledge of software development tools and activities; ability to produce software products or systems in line with product requirements.
Level Extensive Experience:
• Conducts walkthroughs and monitors effectiveness and quality of the development activities.
• Elaborates on multiple-development toolkits for traditional and web-based software.
• Has participated in development of multiple or large software products.
• Contrasts advantages and drawbacks of different development languages and tools.
• Estimates and monitors development costs based on functional and technical requirements.
• Provides consulting on both selection and utilization of developers' workbench tools.

Software Development Life Cycle: Knowledge of software development life cycle; ability to use a structured methodology for delivering and managing new or enhanced software products to the marketplace.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Describes similarities and differences of life cycle for new product development vs. new release.
• Identifies common issues, problems, and considerations for each phase of the life cycle.
• Works with a formal life cycle methodology.
• Explains phases, activities, dependencies, deliverables, and key decision points.
• Interprets product development plans and functional documentation.

Software Integration Engineering: Knowledge of software integration processes and functions; ability to design, develop and maintain interfaces and linkage to alternative platforms and software packages.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Has experience with designing data exchange interfaces to and from software product.
• Describes tools and techniques for extraction, transformation and loading of electronic data.
• Cites examples of common linkage requirements for software products and vendors.
• Works with integrating software into the customer or partner framework and infrastructure.
• Participates in the development of technology interfaces and bridges.

Software Product Design/Architecture: Knowledge of software product design; ability to convert market requirements into the software product design.
Level Extensive Experience:
• Demonstrates experience with the architecture and design of major or multiple products.
• Describes major software architecture alternatives and considerations.
• Explains design considerations for commercial database systems, operating systems and web.
• Displays experience in estimating the cost of a specific design of a proposed product.
• Facilitates design reviews and walkthroughs.
• Analyzes benefits and drawbacks of specific software designs and architecture.

Software Product Technical Knowledge: Knowledge of technical aspects of a software products; ability to design, configure and integrate technical aspects of software products.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Maintains and utilizes data related to install base configurations and environments.
• Solicits customer feedback; reports and monitors bugs and implementation issues.
• Participates in defining and conducting technical acceptance tests.
• Participates in creating technical requirements for software development and deployment.
• Explains basic environment and product configuration options.

Software Product Testing: Knowledge of software product testing; ability to design, plan, and execute testing strategies and tactics to ensure software product quality and adherence to stated requirements.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Participates in test readiness reviews, functional, volume, and load testing.
• Describes key features and aspects of a specific testing discipline or methodology.
• Tests software components for compliance with functional requirements and design specifications.
• Explains procedures for documenting test activities and results (e.g. errors, non-conformance, etc.)
• Conducts functional and performance testing on aspects of assigned products.

title: Casemanager Gebiedsteam Utrecht Zuid – GGZ-agoog / Verpleegkundige
description:
Gebiedsteam Utrecht Zuid verleent specialistische ambulante behandeling aan mensen die een zorgvraag hebben op verschillende levensgebieden zoals wonen, werken, zingeving, gezondheid, zingeving, financiën en sociale contacten. Wij werken volgens de F-ACT methode: ambulante, wijkgerichte zorg: rehabilitatie, crisiszorg, behandeling en hulp bij herstel door verschillende mensen die in één team samenwerken.

We werken intensief samen met Lister en tevens met de gezondheidscentra, de buurtteams van de gemeente, diverse ketenpartners en naastbetrokkenen. Daardoor kunnen we snel op- en afschalen in de intensiteit van zorg.

Wat ga je doen?
Als casemanager maak je deel uit van een multidisciplinair team, waarin iedereen vanuit de eigen expertise bijdraagt aan één gezamenlijk doel: goede zorg voor onze patiënten. In nauwe afstemming met de andere behandelaren heb jij de regie over de begeleiding en behandeling van jouw eigen caseload. Je ziet patiënten bij hen thuis in de wijken Hoograven en Lunetten of op onze locatie aan het Furkaplateau 15 in Utrecht.

Je werk is afwisselend en je bent betrokken bij verschillende onderdelen van het behandelproces. Zo voer je intakes uit, werk je samen met collega’s in crisissituaties en bied je systeem- en klachtgerichte behandelingen. Daarbij stem je steeds af wat een patiënt nodig heeft en werk je samen met het team aan passende zorg.


Wat hebben we jou te bieden?

Ontwikkeling staat bij Altrecht centraal. In de zorg die we bieden, in onze aanpak en in jouw carrière. Bij ons krijg je de kans om te groeien en impact te maken. Vanuit een inspirerende omgeving, met bevlogen collega’s.

Daarnaast krijg je van ons:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.000,- tot € 5.294,- (FWG 55 in de cao GGZ) op basis van 36 uur per week.

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% (volledige dertiende maand) en 8,33% vakantiegeld.

  • 166 vakantie uren en 35 levensfase-uren per jaar op basis van 36 uur per week. Wil je nog extra tijd voor jezelf? Dan kun je extra verlof bijkopen, tot een maximum van 36 uur, afhankelijk van de omvang van je dienstverband.

  • Een jaarlijks balansbudget. Je kunt het bedrag uit laten betalen, extra verlof kopen of het bedrag verhogen tot € 1.400,- als je het inzet voor een vrijetijdscursus.

  • Een pensioenregeling bij Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn, een collectieve inkomensverzekering bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en korting op aanvullende ziektekostenverzekering via IZZ of Zilveren Kruis.

  • Alflex. Ons meerkeuzesysteem voor extra arbeidsvoorwaarden. Hiermee kun je jouw salaris fiscaalvriendelijk inzetten voor bijvoorbeeld een fiets, een sportschoolabonnement of aanvullende reiskostenvergoeding.

  • De Altrecht Academie. Hier vind je een uitgebreid aanbod aan (online) scholingen voor de specialistische GGZ. En dankzij intervisie met je bevlogen collega´s groei je elke dag verder in je werk.

Wie ben jij?
Jij bent een zelfstandige en proactieve professional die tegelijkertijd graag samenwerkt binnen een multidisciplinair team. Je kijkt verder dan alleen de zorgvraag en hebt oog voor het hele verhaal van de patiënt. De complexiteit van de doelgroep spreekt je aan: je krijgt er energie van om samen met de patiënt en je collega’s te zoeken naar een passende behandelweg. Je werkt herstelgericht, neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je eigen caseload en weet wanneer je de samenwerking met anderen moet opzoeken. Ervaring met ambulant werken, ketenzorg en netwerkontwikkeling is een pré.

En neem je mee:

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding Verpleegkunde, Social Work, SPH of MWD. Heb je een agogische achtergrond, dan heb je deze aangevuld met een post-hbo-opleiding tot GGZ-agoog.

  • Affiniteit met en aantoonbare kennis en ervaring in de behandeling en herstelgerichte begeleiding van de EPA-doelgroep.

  • Heb je een verpleegkundige vooropleiding? Dan beschik je over een geldige BIG-registratie en registratie in het V&V-register.

Wie zijn wij?

Gebiedsteam Utrecht Zuid is een multidisciplinair team van ongeveer 10 collega’s met verschillende professionele achtergronden en expertises. We werken volgens de F-ACT-methodiek en bieden specialistische ambulante zorg in de wijken Hoograven en Lunetten.

Samenwerking staat binnen ons team centraal. We werken nauw samen met elkaar, naastbetrokkenen en verschillende partners in de wijk, waaronder Lister, gezondheidscentra en buurtteams. Door de korte lijnen kunnen we de zorg rondom onze patiënten goed op elkaar afstemmen en waar nodig snel op- of afschalen.

Enthousiast en nu?

Word jij onze nieuwe collega? Dan nodigen we je graag uit om te solliciteren met je CV en een motivatie. Binnen een paar dagen laten we je weten of je wordt uitgenodigd voor een gesprek.

Twijfel je of deze baan iets voor jou is? Neem ook dan gerust contact op met Caroline Vos, teammanager van het gebiedsteam, op 06-83257533 of per mail via ca.vos@altrecht.nl. Je bent van harte welkom om eerst kennis te maken zodat we je kunnen vertellen hoe we werken.

Goed om te weten

  • Een dagdeel meelopen kan onderdeel uitmaken van de sollicitatieprocedure. Zo leren wij elkaar beter kennen.

  • Acquisitie op basis van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

  • Solliciteer rechtstreeks via. Zo weten we zeker dat jouw sollicitatie goed bij ons binnenkomt.

title: Järjestelmäasiantuntija, rakennusautomaatio (Helsinki)
description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme kahta kokenutta rakennusautomaatioalan ammattilaista vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Helsinkiin. Kyseessä on suorarekrytointi, eli tehtäviin valittavat henkilöt työllistyvät suoraan asiakasyrityksemme palvelukseen.

Tehtävä tarjoaa mahdollisuuden osallistua monipuolisiin rakennusautomaatioprojekteihin, joissa vastaat järjestelmien ohjelmoinnista, käyttöönotosta ja teknisestä asiantuntijatyöstä. Rooli soveltuu sinulle, jolla on jo käytännön kokemusta rakennusautomaatiosta ja haluat syventää osaamistasi vaativien projektien parissa.

Työn painopiste on erityisesti Schneider Electricin rakennusautomaatiojärjestelmien ohjelmoinnissa sekä Siemens Desigo -ympäristössä. Kokemus näistä järjestelmistä katsotaan vahvaksi eduksi.

Työssäsi vastaat rakennusautomaatiojärjestelmien ohjelmoinnista ja käyttöönotosta sekä niiden sujuvan toiminnan varmistamisesta projektien eri vaiheissa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu myös järjestelmien testaus, optimointi ja vianhaku sekä automaatio- ja LVI-prosessien käytännön soveltaminen erilaisissa kohteissa. Lisäksi toimit teknisenä asiantuntijana projekteissa ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, projektitiimien sekä muiden sidosryhmien kanssa varmistaaksesi hankkeiden onnistuneen toteutuksen.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • vähintään muutaman vuoden kokemusta rakennusautomaatiojärjestelmien ohjelmoinnista ja käyttöönotosta
  • ymmärrystä automaatio- ja LVI-prosessien toiminnasta
  • kokemusta Schneiderin ja/tai Siemens Desigo -järjestelmistä

title: AI Regulatory Engineer
description:
Job Description Summary

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented AI Regulatory Engineer to ensure that AI-based clinical features for ultrasound systems comply with evolving global regulatory requirements—particularly FDA regulations for AI-enabled medical devices.


This role is critical as AI has become a highly regulated domain, requiring specialized regulatory strategies, risk management approaches, and lifecycle governance. The AI Regulatory Engineer will work closely with AI engineering, clinical, quality, product management, and regulatory affairs teams to define and execute the correct AI regulatory and submission strategy across the full product lifecycle.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

AI Regulatory Strategy & Compliance

• Interpret and apply regulatory frameworks and guidance for AI-enabled medical devices, including FDA, EU MDR/IVDR, and global regulations.

• Define and drive AI regulatory strategies for clinical ultrasound features, including SaMD and AI-enabled device functions.

• Support FDA submission pathways (e.g., 510(k), De Novo, PMA) for AI-based features, including AI-specific regulatory positioning.

Risk Management & Safety for AI

• Lead AI-focused risk management activities in accordance with ISO 14971, addressing AI-specific hazards such as bias, robustness, generalization risk, and clinical misuse.

• Perform and maintain AI-specific risk analyses (e.g., AI FMEA, algorithm hazard analysis, clinical performance risk).

• Ensure traceability between clinical requirements, AI behavior, risk controls, and verification/validation evidence.

Regulatory Documentation & Submissions

• Prepare and maintain AI-related regulatory documentation, including:

• AI descriptions and intended use statements

• Training and validation dataset descriptions

• Performance evaluation and clinical evidence summaries

• Algorithm change management and lifecycle documentation

• Support creation of FDA-ready AI documentation, including transparency, explainability, and human-factors considerations.

AI Lifecycle & Change Management

• Define regulatory-compliant processes for AI updates, retraining, and post-market changes, aligned with FDA expectations.

• Support implementation of Predetermined Change Control Plans (PCCP) or equivalent AI lifecycle strategies.

• Ensure alignment between AI development practices and regulatory expectations for locked vs. adaptive algorithms.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Collaborate closely with:

• AI engineers and data scientists

• Clinical and medical affairs teams

• Quality, systems, and V&V engineers

• Product management and regulatory affairs

• Embed regulatory and safety requirements early into AI design, data strategy, and clinical validation plans.

Regulatory Intelligence & Audits

• Monitor evolving AI regulations, FDA guidance, standards, and industry best practices.

• Communicate regulatory changes and their impact on AI roadmaps and product strategy.

• Support internal audits, design reviews, and external regulatory inspections related to AI and clinical safety.

• Provide training and guidance on AI regulatory and safety topics to engineering and product teams.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, or related field.

• Experience working in regulated medical device environments, preferably involving AI-driven clinical features.

• Solid understanding of medical device regulatory frameworks, with emphasis on FDA and EU MDR.

• Experience with risk management methodologies and safety processes for medical devices.

• Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with AI-enabled medical devices, SaMD, or clinical decision support systems.

• Familiarity with FDA guidance on AI in medical devices, Good AI Practice, and AI lifecycle governance.

• Experience supporting FDA submissions involving software or AI components.

• Knowledge of AI-related topics such as dataset governance, algorithm performance metrics, bias mitigation, and explainability.

• Certification or formal training in regulatory affairs, quality, or safety (e.g., RAC, TÜV, ASQ).

• Experience working with global regulatory regions (US, EU, Asia).

description:

Financial and Budget Management

Skills and experience

  • Demonstrated experience in financial planning, workforce management and management reporting. Degree in maths, analytics, economics, finance or accounting preferred.

  • Proven workforce & capacity management and resource planning skills.

  • Advanced analytical, problem-solving and management-reporting skills.

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing capability.

  • Ability to translate complex data into clear recommendations.

  • Continuous-improvement mindset with an understanding of automation and AI opportunities.

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

Our AI portfolio spans model development through to production inference at scale, in a highly regulated healthcare context. This role exists to make sure that infrastructure runs reliably, scales predictably, and gets AI engineers' work safely into production.

What to expect

This is what you can expect from us as a Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

  • Purposeful work – your work keeps our AI portfolio reliable and performant for hospitals and aftercare providers who depend on it daily.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

This is how you will make an impact as a Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

  • Our AI portfolio needs to run reliably and perform well. Thus it has to be properly monitored.

  • Capacity needs planning, support scaling initiatives, and ensure our systems remain stable as the company grows.

  • SageMaker models need to be continuously delivered, following AWS' best practices.

  • AI engineers need assistance with productionalizing AI workloads end-to-end, from code to container build, and rollouts using optimal deployment strategies.

How we build

We run a modern cloud-native stack to build, ship, and operate AI workloads reliably in a regulated healthcare environment.

  • Cloud: AWS (The European Sovereign Cloud partition)

  • Runtime: Kubernetes and Postgres

  • Inference: Bedrock, SageMaker, ClearML

  • Observability: Datadog, LangFuse, OTEL

  • CI/CD: GitHub Enterprise Cloud with Actions

  • Plus various auxiliary tools for security, compliance and operations: DockerHub, Google as IdP, SonarCloud, VPNs, QuickSight, CDN, Snowflake, ETLs, etc.

Requirements

Here's how we picture you as our Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

These are the knowledge and skills you need:

  • Experience with AWS (CloudFormation, IAM, ECR, SageMaker, Bedrock, S3, SQS, DynamoDB, RDS, KMS).

  • Experience with Kubernetes (EKS) in production (kustomize, HPA and KEDA based autoscaling).

  • Experience deploying SageMaker models, setting up custom inference containers (HuggingFace and/or OSS model) and endpoints (provisioning, autoscaling, and blue/green rollouts).

  • Familiarity with observability & LLMOps best practices and solutions (Datadog, Langfuse, LLM/GenAI tracing, OTel, CloudWatch).

  • Proficiency in Python, specifically with FastAPI and async task management.

  • Knowing how to set up ML/LLM GPU inference on EKS (GPU-backed instances, Nvidia driver/plugin).

  • Ability to own technical decisions and collaborate directly with other teams.

  • Troubleshooting, RCA, and resolving problems. When things get stressful, you stay cool headed and work through issues step by step, asking for support from SMEs when needed.

  • Preference for writing over talking, resulting in clear, concise, yet complete documentation and asynchronous communications.

  • This is a cross-functional role bridging the gap between applications and the platform. Ability to both explain complex concepts clearly to non-domain experts, and extract information through well-formed questions during verbal communication, is a must.

Bonus points:

  • Healthcare or regulated-domain experience (e.g. ISO 27001, C5).

  • Self-hosting/home lab.

  • Nvidia Triton/vLLM or similar.

  • MLflow, Kubeflow, ClearML, DVC, Vertex AI.

  • Slack and GitHub automations (bots, workflows, apps, etc.).

This will help you decide if you want to join us – our values are:

  • Strong opinions, weakly held. We adapt, negotiate trade-offs, and reconsider decisions when necessary. We don't stick to one implementation – we re-evaluate and adjust as needed (including throwing away the old one).

  • Pragmatic choice of tools and avoidance of one-size-fits-all thinking.

  • Bringing professionalism and empathy to how you work with others.

  • Strong belief in solid technical fundamentals and preference for understanding and first principles over memorization.

  • Language proficiency (at least English, but the more, the better).

title: Impact Investing Senior Associate, Private Corporate Credit
description:
At M&G, our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.

Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.

Through telling it like it is, owning it now and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.

We will consider flexible working arrangements for any of our roles and offer workplace adjustments to ensure you have the support you need to succeed in your role.

Opportunity

M&G is a long-established player in Private Credit, serving a global client base and bringing three decades of experience in European credit markets. The Private Corporate Credit team manages €10 billion in liquid and illiquid strategies across Broadly Syndicated Loans, High Yield Bonds and Direct Lending. Sustainability is well embedded in the investment process.

Impact Private Credit is developing into a core growth area for M&G. In 2025, the team launched an Article 9, private credit mandate on behalf of Dutch institutional investors that targets positive outcomes. Several other clients are in advanced discussions for a similar strategy.

As our Impact Private Credit activity scales, we are seeking an Impact Investing Senior Associate to join the Private Corporate Credit investment team. This is an investment-facing role that combines impact analysis with close exposure to credit underwriting, fund management and engagement with private companies.

The successful candidate will work alongside fund managers, originators, credit analysts and sustainability specialists. Subject to oversight, they will assess whether prospective investments can deliver credible, measurable real-world outcomes without compromising the disciplined credit standards of our funds.

The Role

As an Impact Investing Senior Associate, you will:

  • Support the assessment of pipeline opportunities, preparing impact due diligence alongside the investment team’s credit analysis and responding to ad hoc questions and challenges as opportunities develop;

  • Contribute to the development and consistent application of impact measurement and management processes, reflecting market practice and evolving guidance;

  • Monitor the impact performance of investee companies and portfolios, supporting quarterly and annual reporting requirements;

  • Robustly engage with prospective and existing portfolio companies on impact intent, corporate purpose, sustainability performance, disclosure, impact metrics and relevant ESG and impact risks;

  • Record engagements, objectives and outcomes, maintaining reliable portfolio-level and investee-level data over time;

  • Support the maintenance and development of Private Credit impact frameworks, including theories of change, impact scoring, additionality assessment and outcome measurement;

  • Keep abreast of relevant regulation, policy, market standards and industry guidance, helping the team understand the practical implications for existing portfolios and new investments;

  • Support annual impact reports, client materials, responses to internal and external information requests, and occasional thought leadership;

  • Work with colleagues across Private Corporate Credit, wider Private Markets – including those responsible for other Impact strategies - Stewardship and Sustainability, Risk, Compliance, Product and Distribution to deliver clear and consistent impact analysis;

  • Build constructive relationships with external bodies and market participants, including standard-setters and impact-investing organisations.

About You

You will bring:

  • Experience in impact investing and sustainability, ideally from a Private Markets background, together with a clear desire to apply that expertise in an investment environment;

  • Practical understanding of impact measurement and management across a range of social and environmental themes;

  • Experience assessing, engaging with or monitoring companies seeking to deliver positive outcomes;

  • An ability to test impact claims critically, distinguish impact from broader ESG integration, and communicate conclusion;

  • Familiarity with recognised impact frameworks and metrics, such as GIIN and IRIS+, and an awareness of evolving market standards;

  • Working knowledge of relevant sustainability regulation, including SFDR and SDR;

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce concise, high-quality material for senior, client and investment audiences;

  • Confidence working with both qualitative evidence and complex data and an ability to turn analysis into clear conclusions;

  • Effective stakeholder management and a collaborative style, with the judgement to work across investment, sustainability and client-facing teams;

  • A proactive approach, personal accountability and the ability to manage competing priorities while escalating uncertainties appropriately.

Working Environment

Private Corporate Credit is a team managing €10bn in assets under management, part of M&G’s broader €30 bn Private & Structured Credit business within its €90bn Private Markets. The investment team works across liquid and illiquid corporate credit and collaborates closely with dedicated origination, leveraged finance research, sustainability and client teams.

This Impact Investment Specialist role is deliberately embedded within the investment team. It is suited to someone who wants to deepen their specialist impact expertise while developing a practical understanding of credit underwriting and selection, portfolio construction and the responsibilities of investing client capital. The environment values sound judgement, intellectual curiosity, constructive challenge and collaboration.

What we offer:


We’re dedicated to supporting your wellbeing and helping you thrive, both at work and beyond. Our benefits are designed to help you balance your professional and personal life, and financially plan for the future. Our UK benefits include:


  • A valuable pension scheme of up to 18% (13% made up of employer contributions and 5% employee contributions).
  • Access to our Share Save and Share Incentive Plan, alongside financial wellbeing and support services to help give you real confidence to put your money to work.
  • Enjoy 38 days annual leave (including bank holidays), with the opportunity to purchase up to five extra days. Our Time Off When You Need It policy gives you the flexibility - to balance work and personal commitments.
  • Our market-leading Inspiring Families policy includes comprehensive support and paid parental leave covering maternity, adoption, surrogacy, and paternity leave - because supporting families is an important part of our inclusive culture.
  • Health & Protection cover includes Private Healthcare, Critical Illness cover and Life Assurance for you, with additional family options - for peace of mind.

To explore more about life at M&G and our full benefits offering, visit Life at M&G


At M&G we strive to have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture, underpinned by our policies and employee-led networks that offer networking, support and development opportunities for the diverse communities our colleagues represent. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds – across gender, ethnicity, age, disability, sexual orientation and more – including neurodivergent individuals, career returners and those with military service experience.


M&G is proud to be Level 3: Disability Confident Leader under the UK Government Disability Confident employer scheme, and we welcome applications from candidates with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you would like to participate in the initiative, you will have the opportunity to indicate this on your application.


We are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment process. All candidates have the opportunity to request reasonable adjustments when applying. If you need any additional support at any stage, please contact us at: careers@mandg.com

title: Communicatieadviseur | Gehandicaptenzorg | 32 uur | Rhenen
description:

We werken in een klein team, daardoor is veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng en initiatieven. Jij kunt meehelpen om de afdeling Communicatie verder te professionaliseren en er liggen uitdagende communicatievraagstukken, zowel intern als extern in samenwerking met netwerkpartners en diverse stakeholders

Wat ga je doen?

Als adviseur ondersteun en adviseer je (gevraagd en ongevraagd) organisatie breed op het gebied van interne een externe communicatie. Je bent zichtbaar voor collega’s en vindt het leuk om te verbinden.

  • Je vertaalt organisatiedoelstellingen naar concrete communicatieplannen. Je adviseert, neemt de regie en zorgt voor de uitvoering.

  • Je pakt alle zaken rondom arbeidsmarktcommunicatie op en werkt hierin samen met een extern bureau.

  • Je bent sterk in het ontwikkelen van online en offline content, zowel tekstueel als visueel, voor onder andere de website, het intranet, nieuwsbrieven, social media en brochures.

  • Je bent eindredacteur van het magazine.

  • Je coördineert onze social media, weet hoe je deze effectief inzet en werkt hierin samen met een externe partner.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de contentplanning voor onze online en offline zichtbaarheid.

Dit neem je mee

Je bent een enthousiaste en stevige professional, kunt goed schriftelijk en mondeling communiceren en stelt het belang van de organisatie voorop. Je kunt goed omgaan met uiteenlopende meningen en belangen en denkt in mogelijkheden! Je hebt professionele ervaring in een soortgelijke functie, bij voorkeur in de zorg of non-profit.

Daarnaast is het belangrijk dat jij:

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau en een relevante opleiding op het gebied van communicatie hebt

  • Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring hebt;

  • Ervaring hebt met stakeholdermanagement, projectmatig werken en beleidsontwikkeling

  • Communicatief vaardig, organisatiesensitief en initiatiefrijk bent

  • Een sterke affiniteit met de zorg hebt en als geen ander begrijpt dat goede communicatie essentieel is

  • In ieder geval op vrijdag inzetbaar bent, overige dagen in overleg

  • Bij voorkeur ervaring met CMS systemen als Wordpress en Umbraco, Canva, Spotler, videobewerking

  • In het bezit bent van een rijbewijs

Dit bieden we jou

  • Inschaling op basis van kennis en ervaring in schaal FWG 55 Gehandicaptenzorg (per 1-11-26 minimaal €3.622 en maximaal €5.304 bruto per maand o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband (36 u/w))

  • Een contract voor 32 uur (iets minder is bespreekbaar) voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op onbepaalde tijd

  • De mogelijkheid om werkzaamheden gedeeltelijk vanuit huis en op ons kantoor te doen

  • Arbeidsvoorwaarden conform de cao Gehandicaptenzorg

  • 8% vakantietoeslag en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering

  • 144 vakantie-uren en 57 uur balansverlof per jaar (op basis van 36 uur)

  • Ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • Een prachtige werkomgeving midden in de natuur

Hier ga je werken

Je standplaats is Zideris. Je werkt vanuit onze locatie aan de Cuneraweg in Rhenen, met de mogelijkheid om deels hybride te werken. Binnen Zideris vorm je samen met de strategisch communicatieadviseur en een communicatieadviseur a.i. een professioneel en creatief team.

De strategisch communicatieadviseur geeft sturing aan het team en bewaakt de koers, prioriteiten en samenhang in het werk. Samen stemmen jullie werkzaamheden en prioriteiten af, sparren jullie met elkaar en is er natuurlijk ook tijd voor een kop koffie.

Over Zideris

Bij Zideris werk je in de gehandicaptenzorg op een plek waar jij wordt gezien. Als professional én als mens. Wij geloven dat goed werkgeverschap begint bij vertrouwen, ruimte en eigenaarschap. Pas als jij jezelf kunt zijn, kun je er echt zijn voor een ander. Je werkt in een kleinschalig team, dichtbij huis, waar je elkaar kent, samen leert en samen verantwoordelijkheid draagt. We zoeken actief de verbinding met bewoners, hun netwerk en met elkaar. Werk je in een ondersteunende rol, dan draag je daar op jouw manier aan bij door collega’s en teams in de zorg goed te ondersteunen vanuit jouw kennis en expertise. Zo maken we samen het verschil in het dagelijks leven van mensen. Je kunt rekenen op goede begeleiding, ruimte om je te ontwikkelen, flexibele werktijden en betrouwbare arbeidsvoorwaarden. Of je nu starter bent, ervaren begeleider of een carrière switch overweegt: bij Zideris krijg je de kans om je vak met aandacht en eigenheid uit te oefenen. Nieuwsgierig? Ontdek onze visie door de ogen van collega’s, of volg de vlogs uit de praktijk van collega Milou op ons YouTubekanaal.

Enthousiast?

title: Software Engineer
description:
AlliedOffsets is a leading provider of data and technology solutions on the voluntary carbon markets. We have built the industry’s first meta-registry of carbon offsetting projects, retirement transactions, corporate buyers, and intermediaries, in order to promote transparency and clarity for those looking to understand the carbon offsetting industry.

Our data is used by some of the leading financial, academic, and professional services organizations in the world to analyze the market. Project developers also use our data to help new sustainable projects get off the ground, understand organizations to partner with, and create the right pricing structure for its offsets.

Our mission is to make the carbon offsetting market more transparent, enabling more quality carbon offsetting projects from being launched, with more of the financial benefits flowing to the underlying communities that the projects operate in.

Our products include subscription-based access to the database, bespoke client data gathering and visualization, and research reports for leading government and international development organizations.

As our team grows, we are looking for a software engineer to come help us build on our success to date!

The Role

The role sits at the intersection of software developer and data scientist and gives you considerable responsibility and ownership of your path. At the core, it involves:

  • Data engineering and analysis – extending the data pipeline which feeds our carbon market dashboard and bespoke analytics platform
  • Developing the back-end code and infrastructure for the API – providing access to our offsets data to external clients
  • Contributing to full stack projects, developing products both internally and for client – from web apps to visualize bespoke data requests, to more sophisticated apps that support the flow of alternative finance to emerging markets

Responsibilities

You will be working on the following:

  • Extending and maintaining the codebase for the data pipeline which feeds into our carbon offsets database
  • Data gathering, processing and analysis; researching and implementing ways to unlock data from new sources (public websites, APIs, .pdf reports, etc.)
  • Building out the functionality of our public API: New features will include tighter integration with our data pipeline, and additional microservices to handle new client requests.
  • Overseeing the implementation of security and DevOps best practices for the deployment of our products.
  • Working closely with our researchers, clients and other developers to understand this fast-moving field.
  • Setting the technical direction of the company moving forwards, in collaboration with senior management.
  • Developing awesome products and tools for our clients: Examples include building bespoke data dashboards or custom clients to integrate with our API. We always have new and interesting projects that promote international development and sustainability!

Technologies

The current team works primarily with Python (for data engineering, analysis and back-end development) and JavaScript (for front end development). We are looking for a candidate with strong experience in Python, and knowledge of JavaScript is a definite plus.

In terms of web frameworks, past projects have typically used some combination of Flask, Django and Vue. But ultimately we want to use the right tool for the job, and in this role you will have significant opportunities to shape our tech stack, moving forwards.

Depending on the candidate’s interests, there will be room to work with our other developers on the application of machine learning tools to extract and model data (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow).

Minimum Qualifications

We are looking for a candidate with at least 3 years of professional experience as a back end developer. Some flexibility on this is possible if you’ve worked on similar projects, either professionally or on sustained independent projects (if so, please share details in your application – links to github etc. are welcome where possible!)

  • Significant experience with data engineering, or working on data-intensive back-end applications which involve cleaning and processing complex data.
  • Experience maintaining, building and deploying rest APIs with frameworks like Flask, Django or FastAPI.
  • A solid understanding of relational databases, and experience with or willingness to learn PostgreSQL.
  • Solid experience of security best practices for developing and maintaining APIs, and potentially handling sensitive data.
  • Solid DevOps experience with at least one modern cloud hosting platform that’s appropriate for our products. (We typically use Heroku, but experience with AWS, GCP or others is very welcome.)
  • Experience using Python libraries for data analysis, such as pandas, scikit, numpy, nltk, matplotlib, jupyter.
  • Ability to communicate effectively on both technical and non-technical levels, and to cultivate a supportive environment for more junior developers.

If you don’t quite tick all of these boxes, but feel as though you would be a good fit for this role, feel free to get in touch and we’ll be happy to discuss further.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Vue or other similar JavaScript framework
  • Experience with simple NLP methods using Gensim and scikit-learn
  • Knowledge of testing methodologies and an uncompromising ethic around automated testing
  • Experience with microservices architecture

Perks

  • Coming on board in the early stages of a startup with tremendous growth potential
  • Joining a small, agile team with flat hierarchy and freedom to shape the role
  • Having considerable autonomy to work on side projects
  • Budget toward new computer
  • Flexible working or office in central London, when desired
  • Competitive salary
  • Workplace pension

title: Environmental Consultant
description:
Senversa Pty Ltd is an Australian employee-owned environmental consulting firm with offices in Melbourne, Sydney, Newcastle, Adelaide, Perth, and Brisbane. Our team is committed to delivering high quality environmental advice to our clients and while providing a supportive and dynamic environment for our staff.


Our Environmental Management & Approvals (EM&A) team has seen remarkable growth since its inception 6 years ago. We aim to help clients embed robust environmental risk management practices, as these avoid the future costs and disruption associated with pollution incidences, contamination clean-up, or regulatory actions for non-compliance.

The team is looking for a passionate and creative Consultant to join our high-performing team, to be based in Adelaide and help shape our continued success. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with a multidisciplinary team delivering a wide variety of projects to the public and private sector; and the chance to help shape the EM&A team’s ongoing growth and direction.


Why Senversa?


  • Senversa is 100% employee owned, is a certified B Corporation, carbon neutral and a DCA Inclusive Workplace, recognising that we constantly strive to make a positive impact across our staff, clients, suppliers, community and the environment.
  • Annual leave allowance (up to 30 days).

  • 50/50 Hybrid Working Policy (Adelaide Office).

So, what will you do?


Delivery and contribution to quality environmental management, approvals and
sustainability
services, including:

title: Senior Solutions Architect, DevOps
description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Senior Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps Solutions Architect to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial organizations around the world are using NVIDIA products to redefine deep learning and data analytics, and to power next-generation data centers. Join the team building and advising on many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world!

We are looking for someone who combines deep technical expertise with strong consulting and communication skills. This role will engage directly with customers, partners, and cross-functional teams to assess, architect, and guide the implementation of large-scale infrastructure projects. The scope spans system architecture, Kubernetes-based platforms, and automation—serving as both a trusted advisor and a hands-on technical leader.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Advise on and help maintain large-scale computational and AI infrastructure, including monitoring, logging, and workload orchestration (Kubernetes and Linux job schedulers).

  • Provide consultative guidance and perform hands-on troubleshooting across the full stack—from bare metal and operating system, through the software stack, container platform, networking, and storage.

  • Assess customer environments and recommend optimized, production-ready Kubernetes-based container platforms integrated with enterprise-grade networking and storage solutions.

  • Serve as a key technical resource: develop, refine, and document standard methodologies and operational guidelines to be shared with internal teams and customer stakeholders.

  • Support Development activities and engage in POCs/POVs to validate new features, architectures, and upgrade approaches.

  • Create and deliver high-quality documentation, including runbooks, onboarding materials, and best-practice guides for customers and internal teams.

  • Act as the technical leader for assigned customer accounts, providing strategic guidance on DevOps and platform architecture and influencing long-term infrastructure and operations decisions.

What We Need to See:

  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related fields, with 5+ years of professional experience in managing scalable cloud environments and automation engineering roles.

  • Cloud & HPC Expertise: Proven understanding of networking fundamentals, data center architectures, and hands-on experience managing HPC/AI clusters, including deployment, optimization and troubleshooting.

  • NVIDIA GPU Expertise: Demonstrated hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and optimizing NVIDIA GPU-accelerated infrastructure, including driver management, CUDA toolkit integration, and GPU workload profiling.

  • Kubernetes & AI/ML Workloads: Extensive experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration, resource scheduling, scaling, and integration with GPU-accelerated and HPC environments.

  • Hardware & Software Knowledge: Strong familiarity with HPC and AI technologies (CPUs, GPUs, high-speed interconnects) and supporting software stacks.

  • Linux & Storage Systems: Deep knowledge of Linux (RedHat, Ubuntu), OS-level security, and protocols.

  • Automation & Observability: Proficiency in Python and Bash scripting, configuration management, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform). Experience with observability stacks (Grafana, Loki, Prometheus) for monitoring, logging, and building fault-tolerant systems.

  • Solution Architecture & Customer Engagement: Strong background in crafting scalable solutions and providing consultative support to customers, including leading architectural reviews and presenting to executive stakeholders.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for software deployment and automation.

  • Solid hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes and its operators for GPU and Network management.

  • Practical experience with SLURM, MPI, enroot and job provisioning

  • Experience with SW change management of clusters across compute, network and storage.

  • Experience with NVIDIA Base Command Manager (BCM) for provisioning, managing, and monitoring GPU clusters at scale as well as background with RDMA-based fabrics (InfiniBand or RoCE) in HPC or AI environments.

We serve a diverse clientele including retail fueling stations, commercial and government fleets, and emergency power customers.


The Petroleum Construction Foreman takes a hands-on leadership role on the job site ensuring prompt, efficient progress of the work. The Foreman determines priorities for work to be done, sometimes on their own initiative and authority, but more often based on needs communicated by management.


Job Duties:

  • Safety Meetings
  • Selected training sessions as directed by the Installation Manager
  • Keep accurate daily records on each job. This should include, as a minimum, a record of all tests, inspections, the daily progress on the job, visitors to the job and situations that may affect the schedule in a negative way.

title: Data & AI Platform Team Leader

Job Description Summary

The team provides data management solutions, AI development infrastructure, software integration frameworks, evaluation and verification capabilities, and scalable deployment mechanisms.

This role requires end-to-end ownership and a broad systems perspective, from understanding customer needs and product requirements to enabling successful product delivery.

If you're looking for a meaningful opportunity to make a real impact on healthcare and help improve patients' lives, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Data Engineers and Software Engineers.
  • Define team priorities, roadmap, and execution plans aligned with business and product objectives.
  • Foster engineering excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive effective cross-functional collaboration with Algorithm, Clinical, Product, Verification, Regulatory, and Systems Engineering teams.

Data Infrastructure & Data Operations

AI Software Platform & Integration Infrastructure

  • Enable rapid prototyping and evaluation environments for algorithm development teams.

Verification, Validation & Development Infrastructure

Quality & Regulatory Compliance

  • Partner with Regulatory, Quality, and Product teams to support audits, submissions, and lifecycle management activities.

  • Experience with automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of healthcare and medical imaging standards such as DICOM and FHIR.
  • Experience with Linux and Windows development environments.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and modern DevOps technologies.
  • Familiarity with FDA design controls, software lifecycle processes, and regulatory requirements for medical devices.

Why Join Us

This role provides a unique opportunity to lead a highly impactful engineering team that enables the successful development, integration, validation, and deployment of AI technologies across multiple healthcare products. You will play a key role in establishing the scalabledata and software foundations that accelerate innovation while ensuring compliance with the highest standards of quality, reliability, andpatient safety.

The job is open to men and women equally

description:
Job Title

Senior Dock Master

Job Description Summary

The Senior Dockmaster is responsible for the overall leadership, operational excellence, and strategic coordination of all dock, shipping, receiving, transportation, and freight movement activities within a high-volume commercial logistics environment. Serving as the central authority for dock operations, the Senior Dockmaster drives safety, efficiency, carrier performance, inventory accuracy, workforce productivity, and customer service while ensuring seamless movement of goods throughout the facility.
This position functions as the operational liaison between operations, transportation providers, tenants/customers, vendors, building management, and senior leadership. The Senior Dockmaster proactively identifies operational risks, implements process improvements, manages dock capacity, and ensures compliance with all applicable safety and transportation regulations

Job Description

Job Description

Strategic Dock Operations Leadership

  • Direct and oversee all shipping, receiving, dock scheduling, freight handling and transportation activities.
  • Establish operational priorities to ensure efficient dock utilization and uninterrupted workflow.
  • Manage dock capacity planning and throughput optimization for a high-volume operation.
  • Serve as the primary operational authority for dock related decision making and issue resolution
  • Develop and implement strategies that improve productivity, reduce congestion, and enhance client experience.
  • Monitor operational trends to anticipate volume fluctuations and resource requirements.

Transportation & Carrier Management

  • Manage relationships with carriers, freight brokers, transportation providers, and logistics partners
  • Coordinate scheduling protocols to maximize delivery turn times and dock efficiency.
  • Escalate and resolve complex freight claims, service failures, and shipment discrepancies.
  • Participate in carrier reviews and recommend operational improvements.

Operational Planning & Workflow Optimization

  • Develop daily, weekly, and seasonal dock operating plans based on forecasted volume and business requirements.
  • Analyze workflow data and operational metrics to identify bottlenecks and process inefficiencies.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean, Six Sigma, 5S, or similar methodologies.
  • Implement best practices that improve labor productivity, dock cycle times, and freight flow.
  • Coordinate staffing requirements and labor allocation based on business demands.

Team leadership & Workforce Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop dock personnel and support teams who utilize the dock.
  • Establish performance expectations and operational accountability standards.
  • Conduct training programs focused on safety, compliance, equipment operation, and process excellence.
  • Mentor team members to develop advanced operational competencies and leadership capabilities.
  • Foster a culture of safety, teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Assist with workforce planning, scheduling, and succession development.

Safety, Security & Regulatory Compliance

  • Maintain full compliance with OSHA, DOT, company safety requirements, and operational standards.
  • Align dock operations with institutional property safety frameworks and risk management programs.
  • Lead dock safety initiatives, audits, inspections, and incident investigations.
  • Develop corrective action plans to mitigate operational and safety risks.
  • Ensure adherence to cargo security procedures, trailer seal controls, and chain-of-custody requirements.
  • Monitor hazardous material handling processes where applicable.

This position will provide key support to the client’s Environmental Sustainability team to track water usage, waste diversion and assist with sustainability initiatives throughout the client’s real estate portfolio. PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITES:

  • Regularly review utility consumption database by conducting data audits and verification checks
  • Complete required monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting for water and waste data
  • Track facility-level waste data on monthly basis and identify areas of opportunity for reduction, recycling, composting, diversions, and exemptions

  • Analyze water consumption and irrigation consumption data to determine and report anomalies
  • Assist with baseline creation for future water targets

  • Create internal and client presentations

  • Develop an understanding of client’s supply and value chain

  • Represent C&W with professionalism and cooperate with other C&W personnel to achieve goals and objectives

title: Assistent Projectmanager Sensorisch Onderzoek
description:
Ben jij een spil in het web die energie krijgt van het organiseren en in goede banen leiden van diverse projecten op het gebied van sensorisch onderzoek? Dan is de rol assistent Projectmanager zeker iets voor jou!

Stap in de rol

Als Assistent Projectmanager ga je, onder de vleugel van een Projectmanager, aan de slag met diverse lopende projecten. Jaarlijks komen er vanuit verschillende formules als zo’n 10.000 aanvragen binnen voor onderzoeken en samen met jouw team van circa 7 (assistent) Projectmanagers verwerken jullie deze.

In deze functie zal je te maken hebben met:
Diversiteit in je werkzaamheden (geen dag is hetzelfde). Het ene moment ben je bezig met het verwerken van data in een rapport, en plotseling kan er een spoedaanvraag binnenkomen waarvoor je zaken direct in gang moet zetten zoals: vragenlijsten maken, het doorgeven van de inkoop en het controleren en coderen van binnenkomende producten.

Uitdaging in de breedste zin van het woord:
Jij bent iemand die zich thuis voelt in een dynamische omgeving en die zeker in drukke periodes weet van aanpakken en doorpakken. In minder drukke periodes is er ruimte voor innovaties, hierin bepaal jijzelf je eigen betrokkenheid.

Doorgroeimogelijkheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling:
Normec Sensory is een hard groeiend bedrijf, zij zijn zowel in Nederland, België en in Duitsland actief. De eerste logische stap is het doorgroeien naar projectmanager, waarin je veel contact zult hebben met klanten en de eindverantwoordelijkheid draagt voor hun sensorische onderzoeken. Maar niks is uitgesloten. Mocht je interesse hebben om door te groeien naar een andere afdeling binnen Normec Sensory, zoals bijvoorbeeld planning of inkoop, of blijk je in de toekomst interesse te hebben in een andere business unit binnen de groep Normec Foodcare? Het is allemaal mogelijk!

Ons aanbod

Een uitdagende werkplek in een leuk team binnen een groeiende en winstgevende (internationale) organisatie.

Wat mag jij verder verwachten van de deze vacature en Normec Foodcare:

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband

  • Je ontvangt een salaris tussen de €2.650 en €2.850 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur per week en afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

  • Een functie in dagdienst. Je kunt starten tussen 07:30 en 09.30 uur en de eindtijd ligt dan tussen 16:00 uur en 18:00 uur. Dat wordt samen met jouw collega’s bepaald

  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag en reiskostenvergoeding

  • De mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen

  • Een goede pensioenregeling

  • Als lerende organisatie biedt Normec Foodcare een continu ontwikkelprogramma waarbij je gestimuleerd wordt om je talenten te ontwikkelen

  • Daarnaast krijg je toegang tot onze Online Academy met keuze uit meer dan 800 opleidingen die jij gratis mag volgen op basis van je persoonlijke interesses

  • Mogelijkheid tot deelname fietsplan

  • Collectieve ziektekostenverzekering bij VGZ

  • Er is een actieve personeelsvereniging met het gehele jaar door allerlei activiteiten

Jouw profiel

Voor deze vacature van Assistent Projectmanager zoeken wij iemand die in staat is snel te schakelen en meerdere ballen in de lucht te houden, daar je vaak aan verschillende projecten tegelijk werkt. Ook is het belangrijk dat je nauwkeurig werkt. Werkervaring is fijn, maar ook starters zijn meer dan welkom.

Verder herken jij jezelf in de volgende punten:

  • Je beschikt over minimaal hbo-werk- en denkniveau en hebt bijvoorbeeld de opleiding Levensmiddelentechnologie of Voeding en Diëtetiek afgerond

  • Affiniteit met marktonderzoek en/of de food industry is een pré

  • Je bent beschikbaar voor minimaal 32 uur per week

  • Je bent leergierig, communicatief vaardig en proactief

  • Je gaat graag een uitdaging aan en vindt het leuk om samen te werken met verschillende disciplines

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal (in woord en schrift)

Over Normec

Met een indrukwekkende groei door de jaren heen is Normec uitgegroeid tot een van Europa’s toonaangevende specialisten op het gebied van kwaliteit en veiligheid, met meer dan 5.500 medewerkers verspreid over 50 locaties. Normec ondersteunt organisaties om veilig, efficiënt en kosteneffectief te innoveren. Zo zorgt Normec ervoor dat elk project bijdraagt aan een gedeelde, duurzame toekomst. Werken bij Normec betekent bijdragen aan deze missie, terwijl je carrière zich ontwikkelt in een dynamische, snel veranderende omgeving, waar je impactvolle oplossingen creëert voor klanten én een duurzame wereld van morgen.

Tot op heden heeft het bedrijf meer dan 75 overnames voltooid in 9 landen en opereert het binnen 4 divisies. Normec Foodcare is één van de 4 divisies met meer dan 1000 medewerkers. Normec Foodcare is dé kennispartner op het gebied van voedselveiligheid, productkwaliteit en smaak. Wij bieden uitgebreide ondersteuning in de gehele voedselketen, van grondstof tot consument.

Normec Sensory is onderdeel van Normec Foodcare en een marktonderzoekbureau gericht op het in kaart brengen van consumentenfeedback voor de food industry. Alle producten die in de supermarkt staan (en meer) worden bij ons getest. Als assistent projectmanager, werk je nauw samen met één of twee projectmanagers. Als team ben je verantwoordelijk om het gehele proces van diverse sensorische consumentenonderzoeken in goede banen te begeleiden.

Interesse? Laten we kennismaken!

Ben je geïnteresseerd in deze vacature? Dan kijken we uit naar jouw sollicitatie! We behandelen jouw gegevens vertrouwelijk en zorgen ervoor dat je binnen vijf werkdagen een reactie van ons ontvangt. Voor vragen over deze vacature kun je contact opnemen met Jill Bettonvil, International Recruiter bij Normec Foodcare, via +31614889190. Hij helpt je graag verder!

De procedure:

  • Eerste telefonische screening en verdere bespreking van de vacature

  • Persoonlijk gesprek bij Normec

  • Referentiecheck (na jouw goedkeuring)

  • Tweede gesprek/bespreken arbeidsvoorwaarden bij Normec

  • Gefeliciteerd, je hebt je nieuwe uitdaging gevonden

Op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging binnen de voedingsmiddelenindustrie, maar is deze functie niet helemaal wat je zoekt? Volg Werken bij Normec Foodcare op LinkedIn en blijf op de hoogte van al onze vacatures.

title: Group Product Manager, Fortellis Marketplace & API Platform
description:
Remote (with flexibility to work from the Austin, TX office as desired or needed)

About Us:

CDK Global is a leading provider of cloud-based software to dealerships and Original Equipment Manufacturers (“OEMs”) across automotive and related industries. The Company’s cloud-based, software as a service (“SaaS”) platform enables dealerships to manage their end-to-end business operations including the acquisition, sale, financing, insuring, repair, and maintenance of vehicles. By automating and streamlining critical workflows, the integrated platform of modern solutions enables dealers to sell and service more vehicles by creating simple and convenient experiences for customers and improves their financial and operational performance.

Position Summary

CDK is looking for a technical, strategic, and customer-focused Group Product Manager to lead Fortellis Marketplace, the leading integration ecosystem in the automotive retail industry. Fortellis enables dealers, OEMs, ISVs, developers, and CDK product teams to connect through APIs, integrations, apps, and marketplace experiences.

This role will lead a team of Product Managers and own the product strategy, roadmap and execution for the Fortellis Marketplace, that includes CDK’s API Platform, the API & App Developer Experience, and creating an industry-leading Integration Hub experience for our customers. The leader will own and partner with other Product & Engineering Teams, Architecture, and commercial teams to strengthen our API strategic framework, how CDK builds APIs for the market, and the operating model across the organization.

This role is a blend of strategy, API leadership, technical product management, customer experience, and team leadership. A successful candidate will be a self-starter with business acumen, a product-led growth mindset, and a strong ability to work with customers and cross-functional teams to solve complex problems.

The ideal candidate should have experience building and scaling API platforms, developer ecosystems, integration and marketplaces, app marketplaces, self-service experiences, and front-end customer experiences. This person should understand how APIs and marketplace products are designed, governed, implemented, monetized, supported, and measured across an enterprise environment.

This is a high-impact role for a hands-on product leader who wants to create the next generation of marketplace experiences for APIs, apps, integrations, MCPs, AI Agents, and self-service workflows.

Position Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution plan for the Fortellis Platform and Marketplace.

  • Lead and develop Product Managers responsible for APIs, Fortellis Platform/API Gateway, Developer Experience, and App Marketplace capabilities.

  • Own CDK’s API strategic framework across Product & Technology, including API market strategy, design standards, quality expectations, lifecycle practices, governance, launch readiness, and monetization.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to define how CDK builds, publishes, governs, measures, and manages APIs for the market.

  • Lead API lifecycle strategy across intake, discovery, prioritization, design, documentation, governance, publishing, adoption, monetization, support, and retirement.

  • Establish and evangelize API-first and agent-ready product practices that improve API quality, developer experience, platform consistency, and readiness for AI/agentic use cases.

  • Be an evangelist in the market for API adoption and the Fortellis experience

  • Innovate Fortellis marketplace capabilities that support APIs, apps, integrations, MCP-enabled connectivity, AI Agents, and agentic product experiences across CDK products.

  • Improve the overall product experience for dealers, OEMs, ISVs, developers, and internal CDK teams across discovery, onboarding, subscription, provisioning, billing, support, and usage through automation and agentic workflows

  • Execute marketplace and Integration Hub experiences that make it easier for customers and partners to discover, activate, and manage APIs, apps, integrations, MCPs, and AI-enabled capabilities.

  • Use customer research, product analytics, marketplace metrics, API usage data, AI/agent utilization insights, operational trends, and financial measures to guide prioritization, manage OKRs, align cross-functional stakeholders, and ensure the team delivers measurable customer and business outcomes

  • Manage team priorities, roadmap commitments, OKRs, and product operating rhythms to ensure the team is focused, accountable, and delivering measurable outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or equivalent industry experience.

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience in enterprise SaaS, platform products, API platforms, developer platforms, integration platforms, ecommerce marketplaces, app marketplaces, or similar ecosystems.

  • Experience managing, coaching, or mentoring Product Managers.

  • Strong experience building, launching, governing, and scaling APIs across an organization.

  • Strong understanding of API strategy, lifecycle management, gateways, developer portals, API documentation, standards, monetization, governance, and decentralized API ownership models.

  • Experience defining API design standards, quality expectations, launch readiness practices, governance routines, and operating models across multiple product and engineering teams.

  • Experience building products with usage-based pricing, subscription models, partner revenue-share models, or marketplace business models.

  • Experience working in decentralized product and engineering organizations where API, platform, integration, or marketplace ownership spans multiple teams.

  • Experience building or scaling self-service marketplaces, app marketplaces, partner platforms, developer ecosystems, or commercial marketplace experiences.

  • Strong front-end customer experience instincts across discovery, search, purchase, subscription, onboarding, provisioning, billing, support, and customer self-service.

  • Experience with, or strong working knowledge of, AI Agents, agentic product experiences, MCPs, workflow automation, or AI-powered platform experiences.

  • Technical depth to partner effectively with Engineering, Architecture, Security, Data Platform, AI Platform, and UX teams.

  • Strong customer discovery skills and the ability to understand the needs of customers, partners, developers, internal publishers, implementation teams, and support teams.

  • Ability to translate business strategy into measurable OKRs

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex platform, API, marketplace, and governance topics in clear business language.

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, UX, Sales, Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, Implementation, Product Marketing, Security, Legal, Operations, and Finance.

  • Travel up to 15% of time.

Base Salary Range: $150,000 - $190,000

title: AI Software Lead
description:
First Student is North America's leading provider of student transportation, helping millions of students get to and from school safely each day. Our technology teams build and support the operational, safety, customer, and employee-facing systems behind that work, including our HALO platform.

AI is an area of active investment, and this role is part of how we are building practical, reliable, and governed AI-enabled capabilities for the business.

About the Role

This is not a traditional software engineering role, and "Lead" does not mean managing people. You will lead agent-driven software delivery: deciding what to build, decomposing work for AI coding agents, supervising their output, validating quality, and owning what ships.

You will not primarily be measured by writing code line-by-line. You will be measured by your ability to direct AI coding agents effectively, create the scaffolding that keeps their work aligned, review their output with senior-level judgment, and ensure the resulting software is reliable, maintainable, and production-ready.

When the solution itself is an AI agent - such as a routing assistant, dispatcher copilot, or parent communications agent - you will help design, build, evaluate, and operate it in production.

You will work primarily on net-new tools and agents, with some work in existing systems. You will build in our standard stack: React, React Native, and AWS. Many tools may touch student data, so FERPA and enterprise governance are part of the work. You will be a peer in a small AI pod and will help shape the AI governance and delivery practices we are building now.

How You'll Work

You will operate AI coding agents - such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and successor tools - as a primary means of software production. Your value is not typing speed. It is the judgment to know what to build, how to constrain the agent's work, when the output is wrong, and how to prove the result is right.

A key part of the role is building the scaffolding around agent-driven development: project context, tests, architectural rules, file conventions, allowed dependencies, review checkpoints, and patterns that reduce drift over time.

A typical week may include:

  • Translating business problems into specifications, constraints, and implementation plans AI coding agents can execute.

  • Running agents in parallel, reviewing output, and integrating work into maintainable systems.

  • Designing tests, project context, architectural rules, and review checkpoints to keep agent output aligned.

  • Building evals, guardrails, and monitoring for AI-built and AI-embedded systems. Working with stakeholders, architecture, security, and AI governance to clarify requirements and manage risk.

Key Responsibilities

Lead agent-driven software delivery

  • Translate business problems into clear specifications, constraints, and implementation plans for AI coding agents.

  • Direct AI coding agents to design, build, test, and ship applications, workflows, and AI-enabled tools.

  • Decompose ambiguous requests into agent-executable work and validate that outputs meet business and technical requirements.

  • Run agents in parallel where useful; review, reconcile, and integrate their output.

  • Prototype rapidly to gather feedback and inform product direction.

Maintain quality, reliability, and architectural discipline

  • Design and maintain agent harnesses, including project context, architectural rules, file conventions, allowed dependencies, and review checkpoints.

  • Use test-driven practices to constrain agent output and catch drift early.

  • Ensure appropriate automated test coverage across unit, integration, end-to-end, and contract tests based on risk.

  • Review agent-produced code for correctness, security, maintainability, and architectural fit.

  • Enforce patterns that keep codebases maintainable as AI agents contribute to development.

Build and operate AI-enabled systems

  • Build solutions using design systems, tool use, APIs, function calling, RAG, DAG, MCP, context engineering, harness engineering and multi-agent workflows where appropriate.

  • Evaluate models and AI tools across providers based on cost, quality, latency, reliability, security, and fit for purpose.

  • Implement evals, monitoring, logging, and guardrails so AI systems are measurable and supportable.

  • Design for reliable and repeatable outputs where the business requires consistency.

  • Communicate technical concepts, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Partner with architecture, security, and AI governance to align solutions with enterprise standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of Product Management, UI/UX concepts, Business Analysis, Analytics and SDLCs

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including senior-level code review and architectural judgment.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI coding agents or AI-assisted development tools to ship production software beyond basic autocomplete or experimentation.

  • Ability to decompose business problems into clear technical specifications, implementation plans, tests, and review checkpoints.

  • Strong test-driven development and automated testing practices, including using tests to validate AI-generated or agent-produced code.

  • Practical experience building or operating LLM-based systems in production, including evaluation, monitoring, and handling non-deterministic behavior.

  • Experience working in enterprise environments with security, governance, data-handling, and production support constraints.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience building in React, React Native, and AWS.

  • Experience with Product Management, UI/UX, Business Analysis, Analytics and SDLCs

  • Experience with AWS services relevant to AI workloads, such as Bedrock, Lambda, ECS/Fargate, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, or Step Functions.

  • Experience with agent frameworks, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, context engineering, tool use, or function-calling patterns.

  • Experience with LLM observability, evaluation, structured outputs, prompt optimization, guardrails, or deterministic-output patterns.

  • Experience with advanced testing practices such as contract testing, property-based testing, or mutation testing.

  • Experience with Snowflake, Power BI, geospatial, routing, logistics, transportation, or operations-focused software.

  • Experience applying AI within governed enterprise environments, including FERPA-relevant or similarly regulated data.

  • Relevant AWS, AI, cloud, or data certifications.

What Success Looks Like

At 6 months: You have shipped 2-3 production tools or agents through agent-driven development. You have established agent harness patterns, test-first practices, and review standards that the AI pod can reuse. Stakeholders trust your judgment on where AI can help, where it cannot, and what is required to use it responsibly.

At 12 months: You have a portfolio of AI-built and AI-embedded systems running reliably in production. The practices you helped shape are improving delivery speed, quality, and consistency across the team and are beginning to influence broader AI delivery practices across IT.

Working Style

This role requires initiative, judgment, and clear communication. You should be comfortable clarifying ambiguous objectives, making progress with limited direction, escalating risks early, building trust with stakeholders, and documenting the decisions behind your work.

Strong agent-driven engineering requires more discipline, not less. You will be expected to set clear constraints, verify output rigorously, and maintain ownership of the quality of what ships.

Language Requirement
This role requires English proficiency. Federal, state, and local requirements, including U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations, require training, safety communications, company policies, employment documents, and other job-related communications be conducted in English.

Our family of brands include Transco, Total Transportation, Maggies Paratransit, and GVC II. Our employees are at the forefront of safety and innovation; they create and implement the most advanced training and technology the transportation industry has to offer.
