title: PHP Engineer (Europe, Remote)
description:
Company Overview:


Intel 471 empowers enterprises, government agencies, and other organizations to win the cybersecurity war using the real-time insights about adversaries, their relationships, threat patterns, and imminent attacks relevant to their businesses. The company’s platform collects, interprets, structures, and validates human-led, automation-enhanced intelligence, which fuels our external attack surface and advanced behavioral threat hunting solutions. Customers utilize this operationalized intelligence to drive a proactive response to neutralize threats and mitigate risk. Organizations across the globe leverage Intel 471’s world-class intelligence, our trusted practitioner engagement and enablement, and globally-dispersed ground expertise as their frontline guardian against the ever-evolving landscape of cyber threats to fight the adversary - and win.


The Role:


Intel 471 is looking for a PHP Engineer to help maintain and modernize Atlas, an internal application our analysts use to author and publish intelligence content. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, the role is fully remote and open to candidates across Europe on a B2B 12 month contract basis.


Atlas is a mature application, and we're looking for a pragmatic engineer to help it evolve and to support its modernization onto our cloud platform. This is a hands-on role with real autonomy: you'll work on a system used across the company and help shape where it goes next. It suits a full-stack-minded engineer comfortable across an established Laravel codebase and its front-end, improving it methodically, and who values doing careful, dependable work.

Atlas is a mature Laravel application (PHP 8, MySQL) with a JavaScript, CSS and HTML front-end.


Key Duties and Responsibilities:


  • Work across the Atlas stack, the PHP/Laravel back end and its JavaScript/CSS/HTML front-end, building and maintaining features in production.
  • Keep dependencies and the framework current, and improve testing, observability and developer tooling.
  • Triage and resolve production incidents and defects.
  • Extend automated tests, CI and deployment automation so changes ship smoothly.
  • Help modernize Atlas onto our cloud platform, in coordination with the platform and DevOps teams.
  • Document the system's behaviour, dependencies and runbooks so knowledge is shared.
  • Provide regular status updates so priorities stay clear.


Education, Experience & Qualifications:


Essential

  • Demonstrable, significant professional experience building and maintaining production PHP systems.
  • Hands-on experience with the Laravel framework, including safe version and dependency upgrades.
  • Working knowledge of front-end fundamentals (JavaScript, CSS, HTML) to build and maintain Atlas's interface.
  • A track record of improving established codebases safely, evolving them rather than rewriting from scratch.
  • Strong debugging, incident-response and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Solid working knowledge of relational databases and SQL.
  • Fluency with Git and CI/CD, and disciplined testing practices.
  • Able to work autonomously and take responsibility for the work you pick up, backed by the platform and DevOps teams.
  • Professional written and spoken English (B2 or above) for effective work in a distributed team.

Desirable

  • Experience migrating or modernizing established systems.
  • Familiarity with message queues (Kafka), object storage (e.g., S3), containers (Docker/Kubernetes) and AWS.
  • Security-hardening and dependency-management experience.
  • Exposure to cyber threat intelligence, data pipelines or high-volume ingestion systems.
  • React experience, opening up contributions to our Verity platform.
  • Comfort working with AI coding assistants such as Claude or Codex.


The role reports to our Director of Engineering but will be expected to interact and work closely with other areas of the company as needed - in particular the platform and DevOps teams. It is fully remote within Europe and involves occasional travel. The role requires regular contact with our international team located in the United States, South America, Western and Eastern Europe, and Asia, so a comfort working with diverse professional and cultural backgrounds is required.

Benefits:


  • Competitive compensation
  • Remote-friendly culture
  • Wellness programs
  • Employee recognition program
  • A variety of professional development opportunities
  • Inclusive culture focused on people, customers and innovation


Our Culture:

The Intel 471 team is constantly growing and is always on the lookout for talented professionals who seek to operate on the forefront of the fight against threat actors impacting our customers and partners. Our culture of humility and quiet professionalism is a core attribute of Intel 471 and everyone within it. Our culture is collaborative, supportive and fast-paced. We're a mission-driven company. We're looking for talented, 'can-do' minded people with a passion for always doing the right thing.


We believe in supporting a progressive culture that allows all our people to be themselves, enjoy exciting opportunities and grow with us. That's why our culture is founded on our core values of openness, inclusion, integrity and client focus, which set the tone for how we work together and treat each other in order to empower us all – and foster a unique team spirit. View our Culture Guide to find out more about us and what it’s like to work for Intel 471!

title: Seasonal Festival of Lights Elf
description:
Pyramid Global Hospitality is a leading hospitality management company with a portfolio of more than 200 hotels and resorts and over 18,000 associates across the United States, Caribbean, and Europe. Our platform includes Benchmark Resorts & Hotels, a collection of distinctive independent properties; Axiom Hospitality, our European hotel management company; and PYRAMIDWORKS, which provides integrated workplace and facilities services. With corporate offices in Boston, The Woodlands, Texas, and London, Pyramid combines global scale with a hands-on approach focused on exceptional service, operational excellence, and long-term partnerships.


At Pyramid, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to creating an environment where associates are respected, supported, and empowered to grow their careers. Team members have the opportunity to collaborate directly with experienced leaders, take on meaningful stretch assignments, and gain exposure to a diverse portfolio of properties, brands, and markets. Whether you are beginning your hospitality career or bringing years of experience, you'll find opportunities to learn, develop, and make an impact.


Our commitment to associates, guests, owners, and the communities we serve has helped make Pyramid and our properties among the most recognized in hospitality. From being named among the best places to work by respected publications such as USA Today, The Boston Globe, and The Houston Chronicle to earning top travel accolades from Travel + Leisure, Condé Nast Traveler, Forbes Travel Guide, and U.S. News & World Report, these recognitions reflect the culture, service excellence, and commitment to people that define the Pyramid experience.

About our property:

Welcome to The Mission Inn Hotel & Spa, a legendary property in the Pyramid Global Hospitality portfolio located in the heart of Riverside, California. Featuring 238 guest rooms and over 160,000 sq ft of meeting and event space, this AAA Four-Diamond, National Historic Landmark spans an entire city block and offers a truly unique and dynamic environment for hospitality professionals.

At The Mission Inn Hotel & Spa, we are proud to deliver exceptional service within a setting rich in history and architectural beauty. As a member of our team, you’ll be part of a community-driven environment where collaboration and connection are at the core of everything we do. Our work is purpose-driven, rooted in preserving the legacy of this iconic property while creating meaningful experiences for every guest.

We offer a wide range of opportunities across multiple departments, including guest services, food and beverage, housekeeping, sales and events, and more. Whether you are beginning your career or looking to grow within the industry, you’ll find a supportive culture where your contributions are impactful and recognized.

Joining our team means becoming part of a people-first culture where your development and success are a priority. If you’re ready to build your career at an iconic destination known for its history, scale, and influence, we invite you to explore opportunities at The Mission Inn Hotel & Spa and apply today.

#PGH-MI

What you will have an opportunity to do:

The Mission Inn Hotel & Spa is seeking an enthusiastic, dependable, and service-oriented individual to join our team as our Seasonal Festival of Lights Elf for the Annual Festival of Lights celebration.

This seasonal position plays an important role in helping create a memorable and welcoming experience for our guests and visitors throughout the holiday season. The ideal candidate will take pride in their work, demonstrate professionalism, work well with others, and be prepared to contribute to the successful operation of this special annual event.

As part of the Festival of Lights team, you will have the opportunity to work in a unique and exciting environment while supporting the traditions, guest experiences, and seasonal activities that make this celebration so special at The Mission Inn Hotel & Spa.


If you are a person who enjoys engaging with people from all over the world and making meaningful connections, as well as taking steps to “WOW” people, we want you! This is a tremendous opportunity for a driven person to grow a career in hospitality with a world-class property.


Your Role:

  • Help guests discover their “Wanderlust” experience
  • Provide exceptional customer service by being engaging and taking sincere interest
  • Interacts with all guests. The bell person/ guest services attendant will welcome each guest to our hotel.
  • If guests are arriving by motor vehicle, you will open their door as you welcome them to the resort/hotel
  • You will be escorting and orienting the guest to the front desk for check-in.
  • You will park and retrieve guests vehicles as requested
  • Upon check-in, you will escort the guests and their luggage to their room. As you do so, you will be explaining our amenities and fun facts they should know about our hotel.
  • You will be working together with other attendants to ensure each guest has a personalized experience and will “dive" to open the door for all guests.
  • Assist lobby attendant in keeping entrance area clean and organized
  • "Be the difference" with all guest and employees and do more than just “the norm".

What are we looking for?

  • At least one year in a customer service role with high guest interaction
  • A Valid drivers license with no major infractions for 6 months
  • Hospitality industry experience is a plus.
  • Ability to solve problems when they arise.
  • Ability to work in a team environment is a must.
  • Pleasant and helpful personality.
  • Must be able to work a full shift standing and going back and forth to the valet lot and different areas of the hotel.
  • A strong desire to make an impact on other people
  • An outgoing and engaging personality
  • Excellent verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced setting
  • Ability to stand for the duration of the shift
  • Must be available to work various shifts including weekends and holidays

Compensation:

$16.90

-

$16.90

Pyramid Global Hospitality is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

title: Senior Software Engineer
location: 1720 W Rio Salado Pkwy Tempe, AZ 85281
description:
What’s Under the Hood

DriveTime Family of Brands is the largest privately owned used car sales finance & servicing company in the nation. Headquartered in Tempe, Arizona and Dallas, Texas, we create opportunities and improve the lives of our customers and our employees by placing a focus on putting the right customer, in the right vehicle, on the right terms and on their path to ownership.

The DriveTime Family of Brands spans across DriveTime, Bridgecrest and SilverRock. You can find us at the intersection of technology and innovation as we use our proprietary tools and over two decades of industry knowledge to redefine the process of purchasing, financing, and protecting your vehicle.

That’s Nice, But What’s the Job?

This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas or who need sponsorship now or in the future are not eligible for hire at this time.

In short, as our Senior Software Engineer, you are responsible to drive several exciting initiatives, help solve problems, no matter how big or small, work on business-critical projects built around cutting-edge technologies, and convey strategy and accuracy to our top-level decision-makers.

In long, as the Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable full‑stack applications using Angular and .NET

  • Partnering closely with product owners, business analysts, and technical teams to understand existing processes and system dependencies

  • Translating mainframe‑era workflows into clean, well‑documented APIs and services

  • Building and maintaining RESTful and GraphQL APIs to support front‑end and back‑end integration

  • Creating Angular‑based single‑page applications with strong attention to usability and performance

  • Contributing to event‑driven and workflow‑oriented solutions, including asynchronous processing, reconciliation, and backfill scenarios

  • Writing clean, testable, and maintainable code aligned with engineering best practices

  • Owning engineering solutions end‑to‑end and proactively identifying opportunities to improve reliability, observability, and scalability

  • Ensuring applications meet security, performance, and compliance expectations

  • Participating in code reviews and mentoring junior engineers to support team growth and continuous improvement

So What Kind of Folks Are We Looking For?

  • Ability to establish cross-functional, collaborative relationships with business and technology partners

  • Strong collaborators who can communicate technical concepts clearly to non‑technical stakeholders

  • Problem solvers who take ownership and think critically about long‑term maintainability

  • Team players who value clean code, testing, and thoughtful design

  • People who are curious, adaptable, and open to evolving engineering practices

  • Engineers comfortable using AI‑assisted development tools responsibly, with a strong human‑in‑the‑loop mindset

The Specifics.

  • 5+ years of full‑stack development experience with C# and .NET

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field or equivalent work experience

  • Hands‑on experience building scalable, distributed systems

  • Strong experience developing APIs using RESTful and/or GraphQL approaches

  • Experience designing and working with event‑driven architectures

  • Strong knowledge of SQL Server, including complex queries and stored procedures

  • Proficiency with front-end development (Modern Angular, React, or Vue)

  • Experience writing unit tests and supporting high‑quality, maintainable codebases

  • Working knowledge of Azure cloud services such as App Services, Functions, and Azure SQL

  • Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation

Nice to Have.

  • Background in financial services, accounting systems, or corporate finance environments

  • Experience modernizing legacy or monolithic applications into service‑oriented or microservices architectures

  • Exposure to real‑time data streaming and messaging platforms (e.g., Kafka / Confluent)

  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes (AKS)

  • Familiarity with workflow or process automation tools such as Pega BPM or Informatica

  • Experience working with Snowflake, including querying and performance tuning

So What About the Perks? Perks matter

  • Work From Home. Feel free to rock the casual wear while still being camera ready. You will be working from your home office (in an approved city & state) and make sure you have a conducive and quiet workspace with no distractions and reliable and secure internet.
  • Medical, dental, and vision, oh my! DriveTime Family of Brands covers a sizable amount of insurance premiums to ensure our employees receive top-tier healthcare coverage.
  • But Wait, There’s More. 401(K), Company paid life insurance policy, short and long-term disability coverage to name a few.
  • Growth Opportunities. You grow, I grow, we all grow! But seriously, DriveTime Family of Brands is committed to providing its employees with every opportunity to grow professionally with roughly over 1,000 employees promoted year over year.
  • Tuition Reimbursement. We’re as passionate about your professional development as you are. With that, we’ll put our money where our mouth is.
  • Wellness Program. Health is wealth! This program includes self-guided coaching and journeys, cash incentives and discounts on your medical premiums through engaging in fun activities!
  • Gratitude is Green. We offer competitive pay across the organization, because, well… money matters!
  • Paid Time Off. Not just lip service: we work hard, to play hard! Paid time off includes (for all full-time roles) wellness days, holidays, and good ole' fashioned YOU time! For our Part-timers, don't fear you get some time too...vacation time is available - the more you work, the more you earn!

Anything Else? Absolutely.

DriveTime Family of Brands is Great Place to Work Certified! And get this: 90% of our rockstar employees say they feel right at home here. We could spend a lot of time having you read about ALL our awards, but we’ll save time (and practice some humility) just naming a few others; Comparably Awards: Best Company for Diversity, Best Company Culture and Best Company Leadership, oh and don’t forget Phoenix Business Journal Healthiest Employers (okay, we’ll stop there)!

Hiring is contingent upon successful completion of our background and drug screening process. DriveTime is a drug-free, tobacco-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer.


And when it comes to hiring, we don't just look for the right person for the job, we seek out the right person for DriveTime. Buckle up for plenty of opportunities to grow in a professional, fun, and high-energy environment!

title: Software Developer (.NET/C#) – NAVSUP Programs
description:

Position: Software Developer (.NET/C#) – NAVSUP Programs

Overview: ITC Defense is seeking a Software Developer (.NET/C#) to support NAVSUP Weapon Systems Support in Philadelphia, PA. This position supports the design, development, enhancement, integration, and maintenance of mission-critical Navy applications used to support logistics and supply chain operations. The successful candidate will work closely with government stakeholders, software engineers, analysts, and testers to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable software solutions supporting the Navy Community.

Responsibilities:
Software Development

  • Develop enhancements and new capabilities for WebRoR, EFTS, SCIP, and other Navy Community applications.
  • Develop object-oriented software using C#, ASP.NET, MVC, SQL Server, HTML, JavaScript, Web Services, and REST APIs.
  • Design and implement scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions.
System Design & Integration
  • Collaborate with functional and technical stakeholders to define software requirements.
  • Develop system context models, technical designs, and interface specifications.
  • Design database structures, tables, triggers, and APIs to support application functionality.
  • Integrate applications using APIs, web services, and other enterprise technologies.
Testing & Quality Assurance
  • Perform unit testing, integration testing, debugging, and regression testing.
  • Resolve software defects and implement corrective actions.
  • Ensure software complies with security, performance, and quality standards.
  • Participate in code reviews and software quality improvement initiatives.
Configuration Management
  • Manage source code using version control systems.
  • Support sprint branching, code merges, and software deployments.
  • Maintain documentation within software development tracking tools.
Customer Support
  • Troubleshoot application issues.
  • Assist with software documentation and user guidance.
  • Support customer requests and enhancement recommendations.
Minimum Qualifications:
  • Active Secret Security Clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain one, if required by the contract
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 0–4 years of professional software development experience.
  • Experience developing applications using:
  • C#
  • ASP.NET
  • MVC
  • SQL Server
  • HTML
  • JavaScript
  • REST APIs/Web Services
  • Knowledge of object-oriented programming principles.
  • Experience working with relational databases.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve software defects.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and within an Agile software development environment.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Prior experience supporting U.S. Navy, NAVSUP, or other DoD software development programs.
  • Experience supporting Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems.
  • Experience with software testing methodologies, including regression and integration testing.
  • Experience developing automated or manual test plans.
  • Experience using Agile development methodologies.
  • Experience with VersionOne, Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar work management tools.
  • IAT Level II certification (Security+, SSCP, CySA+, GSEC, CND, CCNA Security, or equivalent).
  • Experience developing secure enterprise web applications.

title: Project Coordinator III, Surgical Services
description:
Job Details

ChristianaCare is hiring a full-time Project Coordinator III to join their surgical services/colorectal department at Avenue North in Wilmington, DE.

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Project Coordinator III to support our Surgical Services leadership team in managing workforce operations, physician timekeeping, project coordination, compliance reporting, and process improvement initiatives across multiple surgical specialties.

In this role, you will serve as a critical operational partner, helping ensure accurate payroll administration, regulatory compliance, provider onboarding support, data integrity, and special project execution. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced healthcare environment, enjoys working collaboratively across departments, and has a passion for improving operational efficiency.

Work Schedule:

  • Monday - Friday: 8:00am - 4:30pm

Why You’ll Love Working at ChristianaCare

  • Comprehensive, First‑Day Health Coverage:
    Comprehensive first‑day coverage, including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance. Caregivers earning under $50,000 pay $0 in paycheck premiums for medical and prescription coverage. Enjoy low deductibles, plus $0 copays for unlimited primary care (in‑office or virtual) with ChristianaCare providers and unlimited urgent care visits at GoHealth facilities.

  • Generous Paid Time Off
    Enjoy 32 days of PTO each year, including 7 major holidays, with options to roll over or cash out unused time.

  • Tuition Reimbursement for Career Growth
    Advance your education with up to $5,250 per year in tuition reimbursement.

  • Grow Your Family with Confidence
    We’re here to support every step of your journey to parenthood—whatever that looks like for you. From advanced fertility care through Progyny to free maternity education and support, plus up to $5,000 in adoption assistance, our benefits are designed to help you build your family with confidence and care.

  • Paid Parental Leave
    Receive 12 weeks of paid parental leave to support your growing family, after one year of service.

  • Retirement Planning & Financial Well-Being
    Access two retirement plans, including a 403(b) with up to a 50% match and a company-funded contribution of 3%–5% based on service. Plus, take advantage of free financial coaching, counseling, and budgeting support.

Duties / Responsibilities:

The Project Coordinator serves as a key operational partner within Surgical Services, supporting strategic initiatives and day-to-day operations across the service line. This role is responsible for coordinating projects, managing physician and Advanced Practice Clinician (APC) timekeeping and payroll processes, tracking leave utilization, and ensuring compliance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements. The coordinator maintains workforce records, reporting processes, and Workday functions to support data accuracy and operational efficiency. Working closely with leadership, the position develops reports, presentations, productivity metrics, and analyses that inform decision-making and drive continuous improvement. Additional responsibilities include supporting physician onboarding and credentialing, coordinating FTE changes and payment processes, maintaining departmental SharePoint resources, serving as a liaison among providers and key business partners, and leading workflow optimization efforts. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities while leveraging technology and data to enhance provider and operational performance.


Position Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.

  • PMP Certification within 1 year of hire.

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in healthcare.

  • An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience

Why ChristianaCare

Do you want to make a meaningful impact behind the scenes of healthcare? As a Project Coordinator, you'll play a critical role in supporting operational excellence across Surgical Services through project coordination, workforce administration, compliance oversight, and process improvement initiatives. This is more than a job. It's an opportunity to partner with healthcare leaders and providers to drive efficiency, support strategic priorities, and help deliver exceptional care across our health system.

Whether a position can be supported for remote work will be assessed based on whether ChristianaCare is able to meet the business requirements of the proposed remote location.


When we lead with love, excellence is inevitable.

description:
Help shape the future of mobility.

Imagine a world with zero vehicle accidents, zero vehicle emissions, and wireless vehicle connectivity all around us. Every day, we move closer to making that world a reality. Aptiv’s passionate team of engineers and developers creates advanced safety systems, high-performance electrification solutions and data connectivity solutions so that automakers can bring advanced capabilities to more people around the globe. This is how we enable sustainable mobility and help to prevent accidents caused by human error.

We’re hiring an Electrical/Electronics Engineer to design and develop our automotive products in the areas of Active Safety and User-Experience. This position is located in TCI.

Advanced Software Engineer

Position Summary: We are seeking a skilled developer to create resimulation solutions and scripts for automating ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) analysis on large datasets. This role is crucial in supporting our ADAS and Automated Driving development efforts.

Your Role:

  • Develop and implement resimulation software for ADAS Algorithms

    • Create and deploy Linux applications and scripts for HPC or cloud environments

    • Triage AI/ML perception and control algorithms

    • Analyze data to provide insights and innovative solutions for ADAS development

    • Collaborate with Product owners and team members to manage and prioritize tasks

    • Bring technological innovations to existing products or develop new products

    • Define software requirements, perform analysis and review of software design

    • Define and execute software verification strategies and methods

    • Strong proficiency in C++ programming

    • 6Yrs to 9 Yrs of experience in Software Engineering (Must)

    • Minimum 4 years of experience in C++ (Must)

    • Knowledge of ADAS systems and automotive data

    • Ability to multitask and work in a team environment

    • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English

  • NOTE- Only apply if you meet the basic criteria w.r.t experience & skill.

What will make you stand out:

· Experience working with Spring Boot and Struts.

· Master’s degree in Computer science, Computer Engineering, or related degree programs.

· Front-end development experience with React, Typescript, JavaScript, and CSS.

· Demonstrated enthusiasm for AI-assisted coding and a track record of using state of the art tools to enhance development speed, efficiency, and code quality.

· Familiar with database schema design principles, DB query languages such as SQL, and Domain-Driven Design principles.

· Experience working with large data sets.

Why join us?

You can grow at Aptiv.Aptiv provides an inclusive work environment where all individuals can grow and develop, regardless of gender, ethnicity or beliefs.

You can have an impact. Safety is a core Aptiv value; we want a safer world for us and our children, one with: Zero fatalities, Zero injuries, Zero accidents.

You have support. We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family and your physical and mental health with a competitive health insurance package.

Higher Education Opportunities (UDACITY, UDEMY, COURSERA are available for your continuous growth and development);

Life and accident insurance;

Sodexo cards for food and beverages

Well Being Program that includes regular workshops and networking events;

title: Supply Chain Analyst (x|f|m)
description:
Join our Supply Chain Planning team as a Supply Chain Analyst (x|f|m) and take over a key role in transforming planning and performance data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making across the business. Through analytics, reporting, and planning transparency, you will help improve forecasting, inventory management, and operational performance, enabling better health for more people.
Based on our Campus in Goettingen (Germany) or in Aubagne (France) with the possibility to work some days in a week remotely, you will become part of a team of six dedicated professionals who look forward to shaping the future together with you.

Grow With Us – Your Responsibilities

  • Analyze supply chain, planning, and performance data to identify trends, performance gaps, risks, opportunities, and improvement potential while providing actionable recommendations to planners and leadership teams

  • Develop and maintain KPI reporting, dashboards, and planning analytics covering forecast accuracy, inventory, service levels, supply performance, delivery reliability, and planning adherence to ensure transparency and data consistency

  • Support Demand Reviews, Supply Reviews, Sales & Operations Planning processes, and executive reviews through scenario modeling, sensitivity analyses, business performance assessments, and decision-ready presentations

  • Contribute to root-cause analyses, planning transformation initiatives, and continuous improvement programs by monitoring improvement measures and supporting planning maturity development

  • Drive data governance activities by improving reporting structures, master data quality, KPI definitions, planning standards, and the integrity of planning-related reporting

What Will Convince Us

  • Academic degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Engineering, Data Science, Business Administration, or a related field

  • Professional experience in Supply Chain Planning, Demand Planning, Operations Analytics, Business Analytics, or a comparable analytical function

  • Strong knowledge of forecasting, inventory management, planning processes, KPI reporting, and performance management concepts

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, and reporting tools as well as experience with ERP and planning systems, preferably SAP

  • Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities with the ability to translate complex data into business insights and recommendations

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills combined with a structured, detail-oriented, and continuous improvement mindset

What We Offer

As a growing global life science company, stock listed on the MDAX and TecDAX, Sartorius offers a wide range of Benefits:

  • Personal and Professional Development: Mentoring, leadership programs, Talent Talks, internal seminar offerings

  • Work Life Balance: Remote options, flextime, flexible work schedules

  • Making An Impact Right From The Start: Comprehensive onboarding, including a virtual online platform even before joining, Welcome Workshops, "buddy" as point of contact

  • Welcoming Culture: Mutual support, teamspirit and international collaboration; communities on numerous topics, such as coaching, agile working and business women network

  • This position is filled within the Sartorius Lab Instruments GmbH & Co. KG in Goettingen (Germany) or Sartorius Stedim FMT S.A.S. in Aubagne (France)

We promote diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from people of all nationalities, genders, sexual orientations, religions, age groups, disabilities, and cultural backgrounds.

About Sartorius

Sartorius is part of the solution in the fight against cancer, dementia, and many other diseases. Our technologies help translate scientific discoveries into real-world medicine faster, so that new therapeutics can reach patients worldwide.

We look for ambitious team players and creative minds, who want to contribute to this goal and advance their careers in a dynamic global environment.

Join our global team and become part of the solution. We are looking forward to receiving your application.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
An international technology company is expanding its technical and engineering capability in Penang, Malaysia.

This is a hands-on Lead Software Engineer / player-coach role for an experienced engineer who wants to remain deeply involved in designing and building production software while progressively taking technical ownership of a sophisticated software platform and helping grow the Malaysian engineering team.

You will work closely with senior technical leadership and collaborate daily with international firmware, hardware and engineering teams.

The role sits at the intersection of cloud software, industrial IoT, web and mobile applications, data and AI, offering significant technical ownership and the opportunity to influence architecture, engineering practices and future technology direction.

Key responsibilities

Own and evolve the software platform, including IoT device data pipelines, backend services and APIs, time-series data processing, web and mobile applications, cloud infrastructure and integrations, monitoring, diagnostics and fleet-management capabilities

Turn raw sensor data into reliable, actionable information for industrial users

Develop and maintain modern web and cross-platform mobile applications used for sensor commissioning, configuration and diagnostics, device monitoring, fleet management, troubleshooting and maintenance

Work closely with embedded firmware engineers on end-to-end device-to-cloud architecture, including wireless connectivity, BLE tooling, device provisioning, OTA/DFU workflows, fleet diagnostics, security and device lifecycle management

Help industrialise AI and data-driven functionality across the platform, including time-series analytics and anomaly detection, vibration and acoustic classification, predictive diagnostics, edge AI / TinyML deployment and integration of ML models into production applications

Own software quality end-to-end through architecture and design reviews, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation and release management

Recruit and mentor software engineers, establish engineering practices, contribute to architecture and tooling decisions and help develop the local engineering culture

Contribute directly to the technology roadmap alongside senior technical leadership

About you

7+ years of professional software engineering experience

At least 2 years leading technical projects, mentoring engineers or working as a Technical Lead

Strong software architecture and engineering fundamentals

Solid backend engineering experience using technologies such as Node.js/TypeScript, Python, Go or Java

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP

Experience with containers, automated testing and CI/CD

Experience building data-intensive applications, APIs or data pipelines

Strong understanding of SQL and modern data architectures

Good written and spoken English with the ability to collaborate across countries and time zones

Experience with modern TypeScript frontend development, including Angular, TypeScript, RxJS and Ionic

Experience across IoT, embedded-connected systems, industrial technology, time-series data, machine learning or edge AI would be highly regarded.

About the company

An international technology company developing connected monitoring and intelligent sensing solutions for industrial environments.

The technology combines industrial IoT, wireless sensing, cloud software, data and edge intelligence to help organisations monitor critical assets and transform field data into actionable insights.

The company is expanding its engineering capability in Penang, Malaysia, providing an opportunity to join at an early stage and play a significant role in shaping the local technical team and its engineering culture.

Further information about the company and its technology will be shared with suitable candidates as they progress through the process.

Competitive salary based on experience

High level of technical ownership

Direct access to senior technical leadership

Opportunity to help build a new engineering organisation

Professional development and international exposure

Work on sophisticated technology deployed in real-world industrial environments

title: Children’s Contact Worker
description:
Family Life - Building connection, safety and wellbeing. Together.

  • Work locally in the Bayside Area and make a difference within our community
  • Friday and Saturday availability is essential for this role
  • 1 x Part-Time, Fixed Term until July 2027, 15.2 hours per week (0.4 FTE)
  • 1 x Part-Time, Permanent, 15.2 hours per week (0.4 FTE)
  • Level 4 SCHADS Award $46.70 per hour + Generous Salary Packaging + Super




Family Life is a recognised Employer of Choice. Work with us and be part of our supportive, people-focused culture.



The Opportunity

This is a Friday and Saturday role, and availability across both days is essential. The Children’s Contact Worker is a part-time role based at Frankston – Bunurong Land and provides trauma capable, evidence-based support to separated families who are engaged in high level conflict to effectively manage their parenting arrangements and understand the impact of conflict on their children.

The Children’s Contact Service Worker provides child-focused, safe, and professional services to families experiencing separation and conflict. The role is responsible for facilitating supervised contact and changeovers, conducting risk assessments, maintaining high-quality documentation, and supporting families to comply with court-directed parenting arrangements. The CCS Worker works collaboratively with children, parents, courts, and other stakeholders to ensure services are delivered in accordance with legislative requirements, organisational standards, and best-practice principles.

Key Responsibility Areas

As a Children’s Contact Worker, you will provide safe, child-focused and professional support to separated families by facilitating supervised visits and changeovers, always prioritising the needs and safety of children and families. You will conduct ongoing risk assessments, develop safety plans where required, build positive relationships with children, families and program stakeholders, and provide professional assessments and support in line with court-directed parenting orders. This role also includes maintaining accurate documentation and administrative systems, including CCS observational reports, delivering services in accordance with quality standards, legislation and contractual requirements, liaising with internal and external stakeholders regarding referrals and ongoing family support.

Our Ideal Candidate at Family Life
The successful candidate will bring a relevant tertiary qualification in Social Work, Psychology, Family Therapy, Counselling or a related Human Services discipline, along with experience supporting separated families and managing complex or high-conflict family dynamics. You will demonstrate sound knowledge of child development, trauma-informed practice and family systems theory, strong assessment, report writing and stakeholder engagement skills, and a clear commitment to child safety, professional boundaries and high-quality service delivery. You will also be organised, collaborative and adaptable, with confidence using digital systems, flexibility to work across locations, and availability to work Fridays and Saturdays as a core requirement of the role.



Who we are

At Family Life, we believe every child deserves to thrive in a safe and healthy family environment. Family Life is a specialist family services provider that has worked with children, families and communities for more than 50 years. Our vision is to work with clients and partners to create capable communities, strong families and thriving children.

We are known for our innovation and whole-of-community collective impact approach. Our teams are committed to transforming the lives of our clients and communities to build resilience and healthy relationships. We are proudly purpose-driven, independent and not for profit. We support our community through our specialist family services, community strengthening programs, a network of op shops, a vibrant engaged volunteer community and passionate skilled staff.



Working at Family Life - more than just a job!

It’s the feeling of knowing that your work is contributing to making the community in which you live a better place and working with others who feel the same way.

Additionally, you will have access to:

  • Salary packaging (receive up to an extra $18,500 in tax-free pay per year)
  • Paid Wellbeing Leave and additional Paid Leave for End of Year Closedown
  • Paid Study Leave
  • Purchased Annual Leave Scheme
  • Corporate discount on Private Health Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program, a free and confidential counselling service for employees

How to Apply

Please review a copy of the Position Description that is located on the Family Life Careers page and then complete your application by addressing the Key Selection Criteria in your cover letter.




For further information regarding the position please contact Karen Horely, Program Manager – Family Engagement on (03) 8599 5433.

Applications close: 2 October, 2026


*We will be reviewing applications as they are received, therefore this role may close sooner if we find the right candidate. Please apply now to ensure you do not miss out!



All offers of employment are subject to the Family Life Safety Screening process, including a Working with Children Check and Police Records Check. Any person issued with a negative notice on their Working with Children Check will not be eligible for employment with Family Life.

Family Life values diversity and welcomes applicants who meet the position criteria, irrespective of race and ethnicity, colour, age, gender, gender identity, disability, religion and sexual orientation.

Family Life is a trauma informed organisation and recognises the unique skills, contributions and insights that come from lived experience.

Family Life is a child safe organisation. We value, respect and listen to children and young people. We are committed to the safety of all children and young people. Family Life supports children to meet their potential and thrive. We do not tolerate neglect, mistreatment or abuse of any kind.

title: Training Instructor - New Miner
description:
We are seeking a training instructor for new miners at our mining facilities in Brookwood, Alabama. We expect this person to be a role model for the "Warrior Way" and uphold the highest standards of professionalism, integrity, and teamwork.

Who We Are:

All teammates are required to work in a manner that exemplifies the “Warrior Way” - Safer, Accountability, Follow Through, Excellence, Responsibility. Mining positions may be required to work various shifts, rotating schedules, weekends, and holidays as scheduled. We provide a generous compensation and benefits package, including incentive plans, 401(k) match, paid time off and company paid medical, dental and vision care - all of which start the day you join the team!

About the Role:

Instruction of inexperienced miner students in classroom and underground mining settings. Conduct training in an engaging manner to help miners gain on-the-job skills to promote safety and health in the workplace.
Job duties for this position will require underground instruction for new miners. A significant portion of the responsibilities for this position will require underground training capability (up to 75% underground).

Responsibilities:

  • Classroom Instruction of inexperienced miner classes.

  • Underground skill training and instruction at the job site.

  • Develop new training courses as assigned.

  • Update existing training courses as needed to keep pace with technology and regulatory requirements.

Who You Are:

  • Five years’ underground mining experience.

  • One year of training experience.

  • Holds current MSHA Underground Instructor Qualification.

  • Thorough knowledge of basic mining practices and general labor skills: track work, utilities, timbering, conveyor belts, ventilation controls, etc.

  • Proficient computer skills in Microsoft Office/SharePoint. Must have ability to create, edit, and present

  • PowerPoint presentations and store classroom materials in digital library. Update training material as needed

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Enthusiastic training style and capable of performing work in a systematic and detail-oriented manner.

  • Alabama Mine Foreman/Fireboss Certification or obtain at the next available training opportunity.

Environment and Safety:

  • Improve on safety standards by holding safety meetings, conducting safety interactions, and taking corrective action where required.

  • Ensure adherence to State, Federal and Company workplace policies and standard work procedures for risk identification, risk assessment and risk control.

  • Maintain a high level of safety performance through effective communication, monitoring, and revision of standard work procedures.

  • Identify and report safety risks, accidents, incidents, injuries, and property damage at the workplace.

  • Attend and participate in scheduled safety meetings and training.

  • Investigate accidents and near misses with a view toward positive action, through training, equipment set-up or equipment repair and report on findings and conclusions.

  • Maintain environmental awareness amongst the workforce by holding meetings and involving the environmental department in related subjects.

  • Ensure adherence to environmental policy, work standards, management plans and regulatory obligations and requirements.

  • Integrate environmental policies, programs, and practices into all activities of the organization.

Physical Requirements - Underground:

  • Must be able to stand for long periods of time on uneven, rocky surfaces.

  • Must be able to sit for up to 4 hours to operate equipment or vehicles.

  • Must be able to walk for up to 4 hours at a time.

  • Will need to walk through different sections of the mine with different amounts of clearance and headroom.

  • Walking ability will be based on SCSR emergency evacuation plan required and approved by MSHA.

  • Must be able to wear the required protective footwear, hearing and eye protection, and other personal protective equipment as required by Company and MSHA.

  • Must be able to bend or stoop for a full work period because of mine height.

  • Must be able to climb up and down stairs/steps and climb on and off equipment and ladders.

  • Must be able to do repetitive hand and wrist motions (push, pull, twist, handle) and have quick reflex movements of the arms and legs as well as good hand to eye coordination.

  • Must be able to lift 25 to 50 pounds frequently and occasionally lift items weighing up to 75 pounds.

  • Must be able to work in extreme conditions, including but not limited to changing weather conditions, dust, mud, varying levels of noise from low to high decibels, varying degrees of light and dark, in and around artificial light and in a confined work area.

description:
Overview

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.

Job Description:

Baker Tilly, one of the fastest growing CPA advisory firms in the nation, has an incredible career opportunity for a State & Local Tax Director focused on High Net Worth Individual, Estate, and Trust tax consulting to join and help expand our State & Local Tax (SALT) practice!

Our SALT practice is made up of 300+ professionals across the U.S., providing a full spectrum of state and local tax services. In this role, you will be a senior leader in Baker Tilly's delivery of residency, domicile, controversy, and related state income tax services to high net worth individuals and families.

Working closely with leaders in our Private Wealth practice, you will build a differentiated national capability serving high net worth individuals, families, business owners, executives, and family offices. You will lead our most complex and significant residency matters, strengthen key client and referral relationships, drive business development, oversee technical quality and risk, and develop the next generation of leaders within the practice.

You will enjoy this role if:

  • You want to be recognized as a senior advisor and subject matter leader in high-net-worth residency and state income taxation.

  • You enjoy advising sophisticated high net worth clients and their families on significant decisions and complex state tax controversies.

  • You have the judgment to lead high-stakes matters involving significant tax exposure, sensitive client circumstances, and challenging state tax authorities.

  • You enjoy building a business—originating opportunities, expanding client relationships, and developing strong referral networks across the Private Wealth ecosystem

  • You enjoy developing senior professionals, building high-performing teams, and creating opportunities for others to lead with increasing independence.


What you’ll do:

  • Serve as a senior strategic advisor to high net worth individuals, families, business owners, executives, and family offices on their most significant state income tax matters.

  • Lead the firm's most complex residency, domicile, and multistate individual income tax matters, including significant planning engagements, audits, appeals, and controversies. Serve as the senior escalation point for difficult technical and judgmental issues and guide clients through significant risk and resolution decisions.

  • Provide executive-level quality and risk oversight for significant engagements, including review of higher-risk positions, technical analyses, controversy strategies, documentation, and client communications.

  • Partner with leaders in Baker Tilly's Private Wealth practice to establish and execute a coordinated strategy for delivering residency and state income tax services to high net worth clients nationally.

title: Meewerkend teamleider intensief, KDC Rivium 4e straat Capelle aan den IJssel
location: Capelle aan den IJssel, Zuid-Holland, Nederland
description:
Voor ons nieuw te openen Kinderdagcentrum (KDC) in Capelle aan den IJssel zoeken wij Teamleiders! Het ene moment werk je met cliënten en het andere moment ondersteun je een medewerker of stem je af met collega’s. Spreekt de combinatie van leidinggeven én meewerken je aan? Dan is deze functie echt iets voor jou.

Wat ga je doen?

Als meewerkend teamleider geef je straks leiding aan een team van (activiteiten)begeleiders. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van zorg, coördineert de zorgverlening, voert het personeelsbeleid uit en zorgt voor effectief werkoverleg. Daarnaast werk je zelf mee. Zo ken je de cliënten en weet je wat er speelt binnen het team. Je staat daardoor dicht bij je collega’s en cliënten en draagt actief bij aan goede zorg.

Je wordt aangestuurd door de sectormanager en binnen de sector overleg je regelmatig met andere teamleiders, waarbij ruimte is om vraagstukken te delen en samen te reflecteren.

Wie zoeken we?
Wij zoeken een teamleider die zichtbaar en betrokken is op de werkvloer. Iemand die richting kan geven en keuzes durft te maken. Verder heb jij;

  • Je hebt een afgeronde zorg gerelateerde opleiding op mbo 4-niveau, zoals SPH, MMZ4, verpleegkunde of soortgelijk.

  • Daarnaast heb je een managementopleiding gevolgd of ben je bereid deze te gaan volgen.

  • Je hebt ervaring als leidinggevende of bent een ervaren persoonlijk begeleider die een volgende stap wil maken.

  • Je kent de uitgangspunten van Triple-C en draagt ze uit.

Wat krijg je?
Een veelzijdige baan waarbij je samen met je collega’s kijkt naar mogelijkheden en niet naar beperkingen. ASVZ wil niet alleen een goede zorgverlener zijn, maar ook een goede werkgever. Een organisatie waar je met plezier werkt en waar je je verbonden voelt met je collega’s. Verder kun je rekenen op;

  • Mogelijkheid tot een vast contract, afhankelijk van je kwalificaties

  • Een functie van 32 of 36 uur per week, met werktijden op doordeweekse dagen tijdens kantooruren

  • Salaris volgens de CAO Gehandicaptenzorg (€ 3.296,00 tot € 5.200,00 o.b.v. 36 uur, FWG 50 of 55).

  • 8% vakantiegeld en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering.

  • Aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling en doorgroeimogelijkheden, naar b.v. sectormanager.

Bouw mee aan ons nieuwe KDC!
Rond februari 2027 openen we de deuren van een nieuw Kinder Dag Centrum (KDC) in Rivium Capelle aan den IJssel. Een unieke kans om vanaf het allereerste begin mee te bouwen aan een warme, inspirerende en ontwikkelingsgerichte omgeving voor kinderen en jongeren.

Op deze locatie bieden we intensieve begeleiding aan kinderen en jongeren met een ernstig, matig of licht verstandelijke beperking (EVB/MVB/LVB). Er komen drie groepen:

  • Jonge kinderen van 4 tot 8 jaar;

  • Kinderen van 8 tot 14 jaar;

  • Jongeren van 14 tot 18 jaar.

Binnen ASVZ werken we volgens de uitgangspunten van Triple-C. We kijken niet in de eerste plaats naar gedrag, maar naar de mens achter het gedrag. Met onvoorwaardelijke ondersteuning, een veilige omgeving en een betekenisvolle daginvulling creëren we de voorwaarden waarin kinderen zich kunnen ontwikkelen en zich gezien voelen.

Wat deze functie extra bijzonder maakt, is dat je vanaf de start meebouwt aan een nieuwe locatie én een nieuw team. Je denkt mee over de inrichting van de groepen, de invulling van het dagprogramma en de activiteiten die aansluiten bij de mogelijkheden en interesses van de kinderen.

Het dagprogramma is afwisselend en ontwikkelingsgericht. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan ontwikkelingsgericht spel, praktische en zelfredzaamheidsvaardigheden, gym- en bewegingsactiviteiten, wandelen en buiten spelen, koken en samen beleven of kringmomenten en sociale activiteiten.

Goed om te weten: je hoeft niet te wachten tot de nieuwe locatie haar deuren opent. Je kunt al vóór de opening bij ASVZ starten. Je wordt ingewerkt op het KDC aan de Lage Weide, zodat je de organisatie, de doelgroep en de werkwijze goed leert kennen. Zodra de nieuwe locatie opent, stap je samen met je nieuwe collega's over.

Samen bouwen we aan een plek waar ieder kind de ruimte krijgt om zich te ontwikkelen, zich veilig voelt en met plezier naartoe komt.

Enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan direct en kom een keer meekijken!
Heb je nog vragen? Stel ze gerust door contact op te nemen met Kirsten Muijs-Kooning, sectormanager, via 06-23684256.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Liever niet.
Ben je zzp'er? Solliciteer dan alleen als je bij ASVZ in loondienst wil komen.

title: Estimator I
description:
About Us:

Since 1980, DynaTen Corporation (a Comfort Systems USA Company) has delivered high-quality Commercial Construction and Service Solutions across the greater North Texas market. We partner with our clients to provide technical expertise and high-level execution on every project. As a result, DynaTen is a trusted provider of HVAC, Plumbing, and Building Automation Controls solutions.

Our culture is built on accountability, teamwork, and a commitment to developing our people. We take pride in promoting from within, supporting both field and office teams, and delivering results the right way. We offer strong long-term career opportunities, excellent benefits, and a positive, team-oriented work environment.

Position Summary

The Estimator prepares and coordinates accurate, competitive estimates for commercial HVAC, plumbing, piping, controls, and related mechanical work. This role translates bid documents and customer requirements into a clear scope, cost, risk, and execution plan for management review. This position reports to the Senior Estimator.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop complete labor, material, equipment, subcontract, and indirect-cost estimates for assigned commercial mechanical bids.

  • Review plans, specifications, addenda, schedules, alternates, and contract requirements; document scope, assumptions, exclusions, and risk.

  • Perform or validate takeoffs for plumbing, piping, sheet-metal, equipment, fixtures, valves, supports, insulation, and related systems.

  • Prepare pre-bid questions, material matrices, vendor and subcontractor solicitations, bid comparisons, and estimate recapitulations.

  • Coordinate with engineering, BIM, operations, procurement, and field leaders to validate means, methods, productivity, phasing, and constructability.

  • Prepare professional proposals and required bid forms and participate in estimate reviews, interviews, and handoff meetings.

  • Maintain accurate historical cost, productivity, vendor, and outcome data and apply lessons learned to future estimates.

  • Manage priorities and milestones so deliverables are complete, accurate, and submitted on time.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of commercial construction estimating, project engineering, field leadership, or closely related mechanical experience.

  • Working knowledge of commercial plumbing, mechanical piping, sheet-metal, equipment, labor productivity, and construction sequencing.

  • Ability to read and interpret plans, specifications, addenda, contracts, and technical submittals.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and estimating, takeoff, document-management, and collaboration software.

  • Strong numerical accuracy, organization, communication, judgment, and deadline management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, architectural engineering, construction science, or a related field.

  • Journeyman-level trade experience or completion of a mechanical apprenticeship.

  • Experience with Autodesk Revit, AutoCAD, Fabrication, Power BI, and mechanical estimating platforms.

  • Experience with design-build, conceptual, negotiated, healthcare, data center, or other complex projects.

What you can expect

  • Exceptional health, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Paid Employee-Only Medical Coverage.

  • In-house and manufacturer-led training and leadership development.

  • Long-term career growth into operations, sales, technical, and/or leadership roles.

  • Comprehensive benefits package and employer-sponsored professional memberships.

  • 401(k) match, PTO, holiday pay, and more.

  • Eligibility for the annual incentive program based on role and plan terms.

Working Conditions

Work is performed in an office with regular visits to active construction sites, customer facilities, shops, or meetings. Site visits may require walking uneven surfaces, using stairs, wearing required PPE, and exposure to weather, noise, dust, and moving equipment. Local travel and schedule flexibility are required based on project needs.

  • Collect and remove trash and soiled linen from assigned areas.

  • Replenish paper products, soap, and other essential supplies throughout the hospital.

Required

description:
Job Title

Asset Management Coordinator

Job Description Summary

The IT Asset Management Coordinator is responsible for the end-to-end oversight and deployment of IT hardware and software assets across their entire lifecycle. This role ensures the company maintains accurate asset records, aligns with ITIL standards, complies with security protocols, and executes deployments and decommissions efficiently. The ideal candidate is process-oriented, detail-driven, and capable of operating at both tactical and strategic levels. This position supports BAU (Business-as-Usual) activities as well as enterprise-level IT projects.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

1. IT Asset Lifecycle Management

  • Procure and track IT assets including desktops, laptops, monitors, mobile devices, and software licenses using ERP platforms such as Workday and JD Edwards. Ensure all purchases adhere to procurement policies and approved hardware standards to optimize cost and standardize equipment company-wide.
  • Maintain centralized and real-time inventory records of hardware and software assets within asset management systems like Microsoft Intune, SCCM, and Symphony, including serial numbers, user assignments, warranty status, lease terms, and physical locations.
  • Monitor asset utilization rates and lifecycle milestones to identify hardware nearing refresh, lease expiration, or underutilized software licenses that could be reclaimed or redeployed, ultimately optimizing asset ROI.
  • Coordinating provisioning and logistics for employee lifecycle events, including new hires, internal transfers, role changes, and terminations, to ensure all users have the right technology setup and returned devices are reimaged or decommissioned.
  • Assist with license management and software entitlement, tracking license thresholds, renewal dates, and usage patterns to ensure compliance with vendor agreements and prevent overages or underuse.

2. Equipment Decommissioning & Return Processing

  • Execute the end-to-end process for decommissioning assets, including secure data wiping, physical inspection, categorization (reuse/recycle/e-waste), and updating systems of record to reflect retired or returned assets.
  • Physically receive and process returned devices, sorting them by condition, model, and department, and updating inventory logs accordingly. Package or prepare items for repair, reuse, or certified disposal per company sustainability and data security policies.
  • Monitor return tasks within Workday and internal systems, identifying users who have failed to return equipment and conducting proactive follow-ups via email, Slack, or coordination with managers/HR to retrieve company property.
  • Submit incident tickets (e.g., CrowdStrike or internal security system) for any stolen, lost, or unreturned devices to initiate device locking, remote wiping, or forensic investigation, ensuring compliance with cybersecurity protocols and reducing data breach risk.
  • Manage on-site inventory or depot areas, ensuring all equipment is labeled, organized, and stored properly to facilitate quick access and turnaround times for redeployment or vendor pickup.

3. Coordination & SLA Monitoring

  • Submit and track vendor repair and warranty service tickets, including coordinating on-site tech visits, RMAs, and mail-in repair logistics. Ensure clear documentation of asset condition and outcome to prevent disputes or delays.
  • Track performance metrics using internal dashboards or Excel trackers. Evaluate against contractual Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) such as time to resolve, ticket closure rate, and response time to drive accountability and service improvements.
  • Support vendor management meetings by preparing reports on ticket volumes, failure rates, cost trends, and user feedback. Participate in strategic discussions to optimize service delivery and consolidate vendor agreements when needed.

4. End-User Support & Software Deployment

  • Use deployment tools such as Autopilot and Intune to remotely push required software applications and security patches to devices before shipment or upon first login. Troubleshoot deployment failures or imaging issues with internal tech teams.
  • Assist in user acceptance testing (UAT) for new software rollouts or OS builds by gathering structured feedback, documenting bugs or feature issues, and coordinating with software vendors and internal IT teams for fixes and releases.
  • Create and maintain user guides and IT documentation, such as knowledge-based articles (KBAs), self-service portals, and software deployment checklists to improve end-user experience and reduce support ticket volume.

5. IT Project Support & Administrative Functions

  • Support company-wide IT initiatives and refresh cycles, working alongside Project Managers and other IT stakeholders to track device orders, coordinate imaging, prepare shipping, and ensure timely rollout to impacted teams or departments.
  • Maintain project documentation including deployment schedules, inventory logs, budget spend tracking, post-implementation reports, and communication templates to streamline project execution and audit readiness.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 1–3 years of experience in IT Asset Management, IT Support, or Procurement in a corporate or enterprise setting.
  • Strong understanding of ITIL principles, particularly around configuration and incident management.
  • Familiarity with at least one major ticketing system (e.g., ServiceNow, JIRA, Freshservice).
  • Technical fluency with Windows PCs, MacBooks, and mobile device ecosystems.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Suite for communication and asset tracking.
  • Must be able to lift and carry up to 50lbs.

Preferred:

  • Experience with endpoint management tools like SCCM, Intune, Autopilot, or JAMF.
  • Knowledge of software licensing, compliance, and true-up processes for enterprise software (e.g., Microsoft, Adobe, Atlassian, Power BI Pro).
  • Familiarity with legal compliance and data handling practices (GDPR, SOX, ISO/IEC 19770).
  • Financial or budgeting experience, particularly within IT or procurement contexts.

Key Competencies:

  • Extreme attention to detail – Capable of maintaining high data accuracy across multiple platforms and systems.
  • Process-driven – Comfortable following and improving documented workflows, standard operating procedures, and escalation paths.
  • Multitasking and prioritization – Able to manage high volumes of tickets, orders, and project responsibilities concurrently.
  • Proactive mindset – Identifies inefficiencies, anticipates equipment needs, and suggests cost-saving or time-saving measures.
  • Clear communication skills – Strong written and verbal communication across technical and non-technical audience

title: Järjestelmäasiantuntija, rakennusautomaatio (Oulu)
description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme kokenutta rakennusautomaatioalan ammattilaista vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Ouluun. Kyseessä on suorarekrytointi, eli tehtävään valittava henkilö työllistyy suoraan asiakasyrityksemme palvelukseen.

Tarjolla on vastuullinen ja monipuolinen rooli, jossa pääset työskentelemään vaativien rakennusautomaatioprojektien parissa. Tehtävä painottuu erityisesti rakennusautomaatiojärjestelmien ohjelmointiin, käyttöönottoon ja tekniseen asiantuntijatyöhön osana projektien toteutusta.

Työssäsi vastaat rakennusautomaatiojärjestelmien ohjelmoinnista ja käyttöönotosta sekä niiden toiminnan varmistamisesta projektien eri vaiheissa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu järjestelmien testaus, optimointi ja vianhaku sekä automaatio- ja LVI-prosessien käytännön soveltaminen erilaisissa kiinteistö- ja rakennushankkeissa. Lisäksi toimit teknisenä asiantuntijana projekteissa ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, projektitiimien sekä muiden sidosryhmien kanssa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on jo käytännön kokemusta rakennusautomaation ohjelmointi- ja käyttöönottotehtävistä. Menestyäksesi tehtävässä ymmärrät automaatio- ja LVI-prosessien toimintaa sekä osaat soveltaa osaamistasi käytännön projektityössä.

Erityisen tärkeää tehtävässä on Siemens-osaaminen. Toivomme sinulta kokemusta Siemens Desigo -ympäristöstä sekä Siemensin rakennusautomaatiojärjestelmien ohjelmoinnista, käyttöönotosta ja ylläpidosta. Myös kokemus Schneider Electricin järjestelmistä katsotaan eduksi, mutta roolin painopiste on ennen kaikkea Siemens-ratkaisuissa.

Lisäksi toivomme sinulta:

  • tehtävään soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta (esim. insinööri AMK)
  • oma-aloitteista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta
  • kykyä toimia itsenäisesti sekä osana projektitiimiä
  • halua kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi ja syventää teknistä osaamistasi

Tarjoamme

Tarjoamme vakituisen työpaikan vakavaraisen asiakasyrityksen palveluksessa sekä mahdollisuuden työskennellä mielenkiintoisten ja teknisesti haastavien rakennusautomaatioprojektien parissa. Saat tueksesi kokeneen organisaation, jossa ammattitaitoa arvostetaan ja osaamisen kehittämiseen panostetaan.

Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, haethan mahdollisimman pian, sillä paikkoja täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si palkkatoivomuksineen oheisen hakulinkin kautta. Huomioithan, että haastattelemme potentiaalisia hakijoita jatkuvasti.

Käy myös katsomassa työntekijävideomme suorarekrytoinnista

Mestarit Henkilöstöpalvelut Oy on rakennusalan ja talotekniikan toimialoilla toimiva henkilöstöpalveluyritys. Yrityksille tuotamme henkilöstöpalveluratkaisuja vahvalla ammattitaidolla. Työntekijöillemme olemme turvallinen ja luotettava työnantaja ja väylä rakennusalan uusiin haasteisiin. Mestareiden toiminta perustuu vahvoihin kumppanuussuhteisiin ja asiakaslähtöisyyteen.
