title: Senior Director, Finance - International Division, Global Occupier Services
description:
Job Title

Senior Director, Finance - International Division, Global Occupier Services

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Senior Director, Finance – International Division, Global Occupier Services

London
Global Occupier Services

Cushman & Wakefield is a global leader in commercial real estate services, helping clients transform the way people work, shop, and live. The firm’s 53,000 employees in more than 70 countries provide deep local and global insights that create significant value for occupiers and investors around the world.

Cushman & Wakefield is among the largest commercial real estate services firms with revenues of $10.1 billion across core services of agency leasing, asset services, capital markets, facilities services (branded C&W Services), global occupier services, investment management (branded DTZ Investors), tenant representation, and valuations & advisory.

We have an exciting opportunity for an accomplished and strategic Senior Director of Finance to lead the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) and Client Finance functions across the International Division of Global Occupier Services, encompassing the EMEA and APAC regions.

This highly visible leadership role serves as the primary finance partner to the International Division President, providing financial leadership, strategic recommendations, and operational insight to drive growth, profitability, and business performance across multiple clients, regions, and service lines.

The Senior Director will build and lead an integrated team of Finance Directors & Managers responsible for FP&A and Client Finance and will provide dotted-line leadership to the Controllership organization to ensure consistent financial governance, reporting, and execution. The role will also champion finance process excellence, systems enhancement, and financial technology initiatives to improve consistency, scalability, visibility, and decision-making across the organization.

The successful candidate will be highly effective in operating within a complex, global, and highly matrixed organization. They must possess strong commercial acumen, the ability to synthesize insights from multiple financial and operational data sources, and the ability to drive outcomes in an environment where systems, processes, and data structures may vary across countries and service lines. This role requires a leader who can influence across organizational boundaries, build alignment among diverse stakeholders, and bring consistency, accountability, and strategic focus to a fragmented operating environment.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Finance Leadership & Business Partner

  • Serve as the primary strategic finance partner to the International Division President and regional client delivery and service line leadership teams.
  • Provide financial leadership and drive business strategy, growth initiatives, investments, organizational design, and operational priorities.
  • Influence strategic decision-making through financial analysis, scenario planning, and risk assessment that drive actionable recommendations.
  • Serve as a unifying finance leader across a complex and highly matrixed international organization, driving consistency in financial planning, performance management, and decision support.
  • Lead executive reviews of business performance, including revenue, profitability, utilization, productivity, headcount, and margin trends.
  • Establish consistent performance metrics, reporting standards, and operating rhythms across EMEA and APAC, navigating varying levels of financial maturity and system capabilities.
  • Drive adoption of business intelligence, planning platforms, artificial intelligence, and advanced analytics solutions within finance.
  • Foster a culture of financial accountability and ownership throughout the organization.

FP&A & Client Finance Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end financial planning process for the Global Occupier Services International Division, including long-range plans, annual operating plans, and monthly rolling forecasts.
  • Consolidate regional financial results and provide executive-level insights regarding performance, risks, and opportunities.
  • Drive forecasting accuracy, consistency, and accountability across all countries, clients, and service lines.
  • Ensure finance teams deliver timely, accurate, and actionable financial reporting to support business and client decision-making.
  • Drive improvements in client profitability, utilization management, revenue realization, and cost management across a fragmented systems landscape.
  • Partner with the GOS commercial organization, to review and approve financial models for significant new business pursuits, contract renewals, and strategic account investments.
  • Provide executive oversight for the financial onboarding and transition of new client accounts, partnering with Client Finance, Commercial, Transitions, and Account Leadership teams to ensure transitions are implemented accurately and on schedule, and financial outcomes align with underwritten expectations.
  • Lead annual merit increase, bonus planning, and incentive compensation processes for supported business areas.
  • Lead, develop, and mentor Finance Directors and finance leadership teams across APAC and EMEA, building a high-performing finance organization focused on partnership, execution, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and development plans for finance leaders.
  • Maintain standardized Client Finance practices, processes, reporting frameworks, and financial controls aligned to global standards.
  • Foster strong connectivity between Client Finance, FP&A, Controllership, Operations, and Client Delivery teams to ensure a coordinated approach to client financial management.
  • Build strong relationships with senior client stakeholders and internal account leaders, serving as an escalation point for complex financial, commercial, and operational matters impacting strategic accounts.
  • Sponsor corporate and client finance technology transformation initiatives focused on process optimization, automation, scalability, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Provide dotted-line leadership to regional controllership teams to ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity of corporate financial reporting.

Qualifications Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.
  • 12+ years of progressive finance leadership experience, including FP&A, commercial finance, business partnering, and financial management.
  • Experience supporting international professional services operations across multiple countries and commercial structures.
  • Experience leading client finance function, including, but not limited to reporting, budgeting, forecasting, PO management, contract compliance, and cash management.
  • Demonstrated success leading finance teams within a real estate, professional services, consulting, technology services, marketing services, or project-based business environment.
  • Deep understanding of revenue forecasting, client profitability, utilization management, workforce planning, pricing strategy, and operational finance.
  • Significant experience partnering with executive leadership teams.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and financial modeling capabilities.
  • Proven ability to influence outcomes within highly matrixed organizations.
  • Experience operating in environments with fragmented data, evolving processes, and multiple financial systems.
  • Exceptional communication, influence, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred

  • Experience with global planning and reporting platforms such as Workday, OneStream, Anaplan, Adaptive Planning, Oracle, SAP, Power BI, Tableau, or similar technologies.
  • Real Estate, Real Estate Services, or Professional Services experience
  • Prior responsibility for international finance organizations spanning both APAC and EMEA.
  • Demonstrated success leading organizational change and finance modernization programs.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will:

  • Be recognized as the trusted strategic finance advisor to the Division President, International.
  • Deliver consistent and high-quality finance support across APAC and EMEA.
  • Improve forecast accuracy, business visibility, and financial performance management.
  • Drive profitable growth through stronger commercial decision-making and client profitability oversight.
  • Enhance financial processes, reporting capabilities, and technology-enabled decision support.
  • Build and develop a world-class international finance organization with strong alignment across FP&A, Client Finance, and Controllership.
  • Ensure highest quality of client finance delivery
  • Successfully lead finance transformation initiatives that improve scalability, efficiency, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Bring structure, consistency, and actionable insights to a geographically dispersed business operating within a highly matrixed organization and fragmented data environment.
  • Create greater organizational alignment through enhanced reporting, governance, processes, technology, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Help shape the long-term strategy and performance trajectory of the international business.

AI Output & Data Evaluation

  • Produce analytical reports and technical summaries

Research & Fact Checking

  • Fact-check AI-generated outputs and supporting assertions
  • Compare findings against reliable technical or research sources where appropriate
  • Identify unsupported, outdated, or misleading information
  • Document validation findings clearly and precisely

Data Annotation & Quality Assurance

  • Annotate data and analytical content according to defined guidelines
  • Review labelled examples for consistency and quality
  • Apply professional judgement to ambiguous or nuanced cases
  • Identify recurring quality issues and recommend improvements

Technical Documentation & Professional Writing

  • Draft and edit research summaries, experiment reports, technical documentation, and analytical materials

  • Communicate quantitative concepts accurately and concisely

Asynchronous Collaboration

  • Incorporate feedback into evolving evaluation workflows
  • Contribute to consistent quality across distributed project teams

title: Meewerkend teamleider (intensief), KDC Lage Weide Rotterdam
description:
Als teamleider bij ASVZ heb je een veelzijdige functie. Het ene moment werk je met cliënten op het Kinderdagcentrum (KDC), het andere moment ondersteun je een medewerker of stem je af met collega’s. Spreekt de combinatie van leidinggeven én meewerken je aan? Dan is deze functie echt iets voor jou.

Wat ga je doen?

Als meewerkend teamleider geef je leiding aan een team van (activiteiten)begeleiders. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van zorg, coördineert de zorgverlening, voert het personeelsbeleid uit en zorgt voor effectief werkoverleg. Daarnaast werk je zelf mee. Zo ken je de cliënten en weet je wat er speelt binnen het team. Je staat daardoor dicht bij je collega’s en cliënten en draagt actief bij aan goede zorg.

Je wordt aangestuurd door de sectormanager en binnen de sector overleg je regelmatig met andere teamleiders, waarbij ruimte is om vraagstukken te delen en samen te reflecteren.

Wie zoeken we?
Wij zoeken een teamleider die zichtbaar en betrokken is op de werkvloer. Iemand die richting kan geven en keuzes durft te maken. Verder heb jij;

  • Je hebt een afgeronde zorg gerelateerde opleiding op mbo 4-niveau, zoals SPH, MMZ4, verpleegkunde of soortgelijk.

  • Daarnaast heb je een managementopleiding gevolgd of ben je bereid deze te gaan volgen.

  • Je hebt ervaring als leidinggevende of bent een ervaren persoonlijk begeleider die een volgende stap wil maken.

  • Je kent de uitgangspunten van Triple-C en draagt ze uit.

Wat krijg je?
Een veelzijdige baan waarbij je samen met je collega’s kijkt naar mogelijkheden en niet naar beperkingen. ASVZ wil niet alleen een goede zorgverlener zijn, maar ook een goede werkgever. Een organisatie waar je met plezier werkt en waar je je verbonden voelt met je collega’s. Verder kun je rekenen op;

  • Mogelijkheid tot een vast contract, afhankelijk van je kwalificaties

  • Een functie van 32 of 36 uur per week, met werktijden op doordeweekse dagen tijdens kantooruren

  • Salaris volgens de CAO Gehandicaptenzorg (€ 3.296,00 tot € 5.200,00 o.b.v. 36 uur, FWG 50 of 55).

  • 8% vakantiegeld en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering.

  • Aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling en doorgroeimogelijkheden, naar b.v. sectormanager.

De werkplek

Op het Kinderdagcentrum (KDC) van ASVZ aan de Lage Weide worden kinderen en jongeren met een matige tot ernstige verstandelijke beperking (MVB/EVB) begeleid. Binnen de locatie werken we zowel binnen de reguliere als de intensieve zorg. De kinderen variëren in leeftijd van ongeveer 4 tot 18 jaar en hebben ieder hun eigen mogelijkheden, ondersteuningsbehoeften en ontwikkelvragen.

De teams bieden een betekenisvol en passend dagprogramma, met een combinatie van belevingsgerichte en ontwikkelingsgerichte activiteiten en waar mogelijk laagdrempelige schoolse vaardigheden. Structuur, voorspelbaarheid, veiligheid en aansluiten bij de individuele behoeften van het kind zijn hierbij belangrijk.

Voor de teams betekent dit dat er sprake is van een veelzijdige en dynamische werkomgeving. Binnen de intensieve zorg is meer behoefte aan nabijheid, verzorging en een voorspelbare omgeving. Binnen de reguliere zorg ligt meer nadruk op ontwikkeling, vaardigheden en het vergroten van zelfstandigheid. In alle situaties staat het gewone leven en de kwaliteit van bestaan van het kind centraal.

Binnen ASVZ kijken we niet alleen naar gedrag, maar vooral naar de mens achter het gedrag en naar de behoefte die daaronder ligt. We bieden onvoorwaardelijke ondersteuning en zoeken samen naar wat een kind nodig heeft om zich veilig, gezien en van betekenis te voelen.

Je komt te werken in één van drie teams (team 4, 5 of 7), ieder met een eigen samenstelling en dynamiek. Een team bestaat uit 2 groepen met 7 kinderen en bestaat met de teamleider uit ongeveer 6 collega’s. Team 7 is recent ontstaan uit een samenvoeging van twee groepen en bevindt zich daardoor volop in een fase van teamvorming en het ontwikkelen van een gezamenlijke werkwijze. De teams bieden daarmee ieder hun eigen uitdaging, maar hebben één gezamenlijke basis: betrokken medewerkers die zich dagelijks inzetten voor een waardevolle en passende dag voor de kinderen. In de sollicitatiegesprekken kijken we graag met jou wat het beste bij jou past.

Als teamleider krijg je de ruimte om samen met medewerkers verder te bouwen aan sterke teams, een professionele samenwerking en goede kwaliteit van begeleiding. Een omgeving waarin je vooruitdenkt, mogelijkheden ziet en medewerkers helpt om iedere dag het verschil te maken voor de kinderen.

Enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan direct en kom een keer meekijken!
Heb je nog vragen? Stel ze gerust door contact op te nemen met Marjolein Kleij, Teamleider KDC, via 0612032677.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Liever niet.
Ben je zzp'er? Solliciteer dan alleen als je bij ASVZ in loondienst wil komen.

title: Business Analyst / Appian Consultant | Financial Services
description:
Enquadramento da Função

Procuramos um Business Analyst / Appian Consultant para integrar projetos de transformação no setor de Financial Services, trabalhando na interseção entre negócio e tecnologia.

A função terá um forte foco em Business Process Management (BPM), workflow automation e soluções low-code baseadas em Appian, apoiando instituições financeiras na otimização de processos, melhoria da eficiência operacional e transformação digital.

Principais Responsabilidades

Levantar, analisar e documentar requisitos de negócio e funcionais através de workshops, entrevistas e interação com stakeholders;

Analisar, redesenhar e otimizar processos de negócio, identificando oportunidades de automação e ganhos de eficiência;

Desenvolver e manter modelos AS-IS e TO-BE, process flows e documentação funcional;

Documentar business requirements, user stories, use cases, backlog items e functional specifications;

Apoiar a criação, priorização e gestão do backlog;

Traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais e técnicos para as equipas de implementação;

Apoiar o desenho e implementação de soluções de BPM, workflow e low-code, com particular foco em Appian;

Participar em projetos BPM end-to-end, desde o levantamento de requisitos e desenho dos processos até à implementação, testes e validação;

Apoiar atividades de testing, validation e User Acceptance Testing (UAT);

Trabalhar como elemento de ligação entre stakeholders de negócio e equipas tecnológicas;

Participar em reuniões, workshops e sessões de trabalho com clientes;

Contribuir para iniciativas de process improvement, digital transformation e operational excellence.

Requisitos

Entre 2 e 5 anos de experiência em Consulting, Business Analysis, Process Transformation ou projetos de transformação suportados por tecnologia;

Experiência prática em levantamento de requisitos, Business Analysis e Stakeholder Management;

Experiência na documentação de user stories, use cases, process flows e modelos AS-IS / TO-BE;

Experiência hands-on com Appian em projetos de process automation, workflow ou BPM;

Experiência em projetos BPM end-to-end, desde a definição dos requisitos de negócio até à implementação funcional e técnica;

Capacidade para traduzir requisitos de negócio em especificações funcionais e técnicas;

Experiência prática na criação, priorização e gestão de backlog;

Conhecimentos de workflow automation, business rules, process orchestration e tecnologias low-code;

Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas;

Boa capacidade de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders;

Inglês mínimo B2.

Valorizamos

Experiência anterior em Banking, Insurance ou Wealth & Asset Management;

Conhecimento de processos e operating models do setor financeiro;

Experiência em ambientes Agile;

Conhecimentos de Azure DevOps ou Jira;

Experiência na condução de workshops e requirements discovery sessions;

Certificações ou formação em Appian, Business Analysis, Agile, BPM ou plataformas low-code;

Participação em projetos de transformação digital end-to-end;

Familiaridade com ferramentas emergentes de Inteligência Artificial, incluindo Microsoft Copilot.

Perfil Procurado

Procuramos um profissional que combine uma forte capacidade de Business Analysis com experiência prática em Appian e BPM.

O perfil deverá sentir-se confortável entre negócio e tecnologia, conseguindo compreender um problema operacional, mapear o processo atual, desenhar o processo futuro e transformar as necessidades identificadas em requisitos suficientemente claros para implementação tecnológica.

Mais do que um perfil puramente funcional ou técnico, procuramos alguém capaz de funcionar como verdadeira ponte entre o negócio e as equipas de delivery, com consulting mindset, orientação para o cliente e foco na criação de valor.

title: Senior Business Analist
description:
Je vindt hier een korte omschrijving van deze vacature. Nog vragen? Of benieuwd of dit een passende rol voor jou is? Neem contact met ons op!

title: Senior Systems Administrator (Windows Infrastructure)
description:
We are looking for a Senior System Administrator​ to complete our consultants Workforce Management Service on behalf of the European Space Agency (ESA) for their location in ​Noordwijk​, The Netherlands. Please be informed this position requires full on-site support.

Please note, the successful candidate will be employed by ATG Europe (or one of its subsidiaries). Furthermore, upon selection, they will be subject to a general security screening performed by an external provider (further information will be provided at the interview stage).

ATG is dedicated to diversity and inclusion and is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, handicap any other reason protected by relevant state or municipal legislation, we are pleased to consider all eligible candidates for employment.

The successful candidate will be tasked with, but not limited to:

  • Administer and maintain the on-premises Microsoft Configuration Manager (ConfigMgr/SCCM) infrastructure, including site servers, SQL databases, distribution and management points, boundaries, collections, and client health;

  • Monitor system availability and performance; analyse logs, alerts, and user-reported incidents; and implement timely corrective and preventive actions;

  • Support ESA/ESTEC Technology Labs users with Windows system deployments, upgrades, maintenance, and hardware changes, including memory, storage, and network interface components;

  • Manage server patching and update deployment, including software update groups, maintenance windows, compliance reporting, remediation, and controlled rollback where required;

  • Perform operating system deployment, application packaging, and task-sequence management for server builds; maintain standardised automation and troubleshoot deployment failures;

  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, configuration records, operating procedures, and evidence required for service reviews, audits, and knowledge transfer;

  • Collaborate with team members on major incident resolution, root-cause analysis, problem management, and the delivery and closure of infrastructure projects;

  • Coordinate with corporate IT services, networking, cybersecurity, and facility management teams, as well as external suppliers where applicable;

  • Work in accordance with ITSM practices and IT Service Operations processes and tools, with onsite presence Monday to Friday from 08:30 to 17:30.

Please ensure that your CV clearly explains how you meet the mandatory requirements. If it doesn’t align completely with the essential criteria, it could result in rejection.

  • Master’s degree in computer science, information technology, systems engineering, or a related discipline, with at least four years of relevant professional experience; or

  • Relevant IT studies or equivalent technical qualifications, with at least ten years of progressively responsible experience in enterprise Windows infrastructure administration;

  • Strong professional communication, stakeholder-management, and teamwork skills, with the ability to explain technical matters clearly and produce concise operational documentation;

  • Advanced hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Configuration Manager (ConfigMgr/SCCM), including infrastructure administration, client management, software distribution, patching, application packaging, operating system deployment, task sequences, and compliance reporting;

  • Strong Windows Server administration skills, including hands-on knowledge of Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), domain controllers, users and groups, organisational units, Group Policy, trusts, replication, delegation, authentication, permissions, DNS integration, Active Directory SSO, Kerberos, PowerShell scripting, security hardening, and troubleshooting in enterprise environments;

  • Sound understanding of network and storage fundamentals, including firewalls, routers, switches, DMZs, WAN, LAN/VLANs, VPNs, NAS, SAN, Active Directory SSO, and Kerberos;

  • Practical knowledge of infrastructure monitoring, log analysis, capacity and performance management, backup and recovery principles, and incident diagnostics;

  • Demonstrated experience working within controlled enterprise environments, applying change, configuration, incident, problem, and security-management procedures;

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to work independently, prioritise competing demands, and operate effectively with limited supervision;

  • Proven knowledge of ITSM good practices; ITIL Foundation certification (version 3 or 4) is preferred;

  • Relevant Microsoft or infrastructure certifications are an advantage. The successful candidate must be willing to complete additional certifications through the ATG training programme;

  • Interest in space-related engineering activities and ESA programmes, with an appreciation of service continuity, information security, and operational reliability;

  • Fluency in spoken and written English at CEFR level B2 or above; knowledge of additional languages is an advantage;

  • Candidates must be eligible to work in the EU.

Please submit your application in English via the apply button below. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.

title: Lead Strategic Alliances
description:
Help shape the future of property decisioning in India

Valocity is trusted digital infrastructure for property decisions. Across India, Australia, New Zealand and the United Arab Emirates, we help leading financial institutions transform property decisioning through AI-enabled technology, trusted data and connected digital workflows.

In India, our platform supports digital mortgage valuation, project finance and legal workflows across a connected ecosystem of lenders, valuers, legal professionals and property data. Why this role matters

Winning a lender is only the start. This role owns what happens next: deepening the relationship across every level of the partner's hierarchy, making sure contracts, integrations and compliance keep pace with the partnership and making Valocity the first call whenever anything valuation-related comes up. It is a relationship management and commercial growth role at heart, built around the existing lender portfolio rather than new-logo acquisition.

What you will be doing


1. Relationship management and penetration deepening

  • Own and grow relationships across a portfolio of live lender partners (banks and non-banking financial companies, NBFCs) from operational teams through to senior leadership
  • Set and run a structured meeting cadence for each account, so every level of the partner's hierarchy stays engaged and informed
  • Build Valocity into the natural first call for anything remotely related to valuations within each partner organisation
  • Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities across Valocity's product suite and lead the onboarding of newly adopted functions


2. Renewals, contracts and commercial negotiations

  • Lead commercial negotiations for contract renewals, working towards five-year terms across the lender portfolio
  • Manage addendums like Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act and other regulatory updates to existing contracts
  • Drive full technical integration to completion across all onboarded lenders
  • Work with legal and commercial teams to keep renewal timelines, terms and risk on track


3. New lender onboarding and scale-up support

  • Own the go-live process including the internal approval process for new banks and NBFCs going live with Valocity, coordinating every requirement needed to reach go-live
  • Build and execute scale-up plans as partners move from pilot to pan-India rollout


4. Governance and insights

  • Run periodic audits and hygiene checks across lender accounts to confirm adherence to process, compliance and data standards
  • Partner with the data and analytics team to produce management information system (MIS) reporting and insights that support account reviews and internal decision-making

What you will bring

  • 10-12 years in relationship management, key account management or customer success, ideally within BFSI, fintech or a B2B SaaS business serving banks and NBFCs
  • Experience managing senior stakeholder relationships inside a bank or NBFC and comfort navigating a large, matrixed organisation
  • A track record of leading commercial negotiations and closing renewals or contract amendments
  • Working knowledge of lending, valuation or credit processes is an advantage
  • Comfortable working from MIS and dashboards and translating the data into a partner conversation
  • Based in Mumbai, or willing to relocate

Why Join Valocity

  • Join a high-growth global technology company with a significant India opportunity
  • Work directly with senior leaders and some of India's leading financial institutions
  • Help modernise property decisioning across lending, valuation, project finance and legal workflows
  • Represent trusted digital infrastructure built for regulated environments
  • Build a career with meaningful growth, ownership and impact

At Ctrl Alt ideas win on merit, teams work closely with leadership, and everyone has a voice in shaping what we build next.

We believe that hard work should come with real reward. You won’t just join a company - you’ll help build one. Last year alone, we grew from 17 to 50 people, and this year we’re going faster and further. That means real responsibility, meaningful impact, and the opportunity to grow alongside a company that’s redefining the future of finance through the tokenization of alternative assets.

If you’re excited by scale‑up energy, ownership, and the chance to help shape both a business and a culture, Ctrl Alt is where you can do the most rewarding work of your career.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our team and help us build the future of tokenization at Ctrl Alt. As a full‑stack engineer you’ll be working within small feature teams to deliver solutions to real problems that make it into the hands of users within days, not months. You will work closely with colleagues in product to understand design and use your initiative as well as skill to implement technical solutions.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Design, build and maintain high performing, flexible and scalable solutions
  • Build upon our existing app to create products and features that help our users understand their investments, manage their portfolios and participate in voting rights of their assets
  • Build APIs for our partners to access and place orders our platform
  • Take a loosely defined problem through to a valid, technically sound, thoroughly documented, tested, and implemented software solution
  • Collaborate with team members and other engineers across the company
  • Advocate best coding practices to raise the bar for you, your team and the company
  • Mentor engineers on your team supporting them in their growth

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • 3+ years experience as a Software Engineer
  • Proficiency working with TypeScript/JavaScript backend frameworks (Express, NestJS or similar)
  • Comfortable writing backend code to be performant and efficient
  • Experience building RESTful application interfaces and designing APIs
  • Experience working as a part of a multi‑person development team that utilizes automated testing, CI/CD pipelines and peer reviews in an Agile Environment

Nice to haves:

  • Strong engineering principles
  • Excellent communication skills - written and verbal
  • Experience in security‑first technical architecture
  • Experience in React and NextJS

Our Benefits

Join a scaling fintech building the next generation of investment banking. You’ll work at the intersection of capital markets and cutting‑edge blockchain technology, helping drive and shape the future of financial infrastructure.

What it’s like working at Ctrl Alt

Build and own the future of finance

Take real responsibility in shaping digital capital markets, with the autonomy to lead decisions and drive impact.

Solve meaningful problems with exceptional people

Tackle complex challenges at the intersection of finance and technology alongside leaders with experience from Morgan Stanley, Credit Suisse, UBS, and Revolut.

Grow fast in a high‑performance environment

Stretch beyond your comfort zone through close collaboration, rapid feedback, and continuous learning.

Innovate and make your mark

Bring bold ideas to life and influence our platform, products, and how we operate from day one.

How we support you

  • Competitive salaries with regular reviews that reflect your impact, performance, and progression.
  • Generous stock options so you directly share in the company’s growth and long‑term success.
  • Premium private healthcare to support your physical wellbeing.
  • 26 days of annual leave, plus your birthday off, and regional bank holidays - with flexible leave so you can take time off when you need it.
  • An enhanced parental leave policy to support you and your family at every stage.
  • A MacBook, screens, and any additional equipment you need to perform at a high level.
  • Access to salary sacrifice schemes covering childcare, groceries, EV cars, tech, pensions, bikes, and subscriptions. (UK Only)
  • Modern, centrally located offices in London, Belfast, Dundalk, and Dubai - designed for collaboration and focus.
  • An annual learning and personal development budget for training, exams, certifications, and qualifications - whatever helps you move forward.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:

Based in DFW, Texas; our company is a mid-sized, mechanical contractor that has been in operation since 1980. We use state-of-the-art CAD/BIM software tools and offer an exciting environment of design-build/design-assist spanning a diverse array of challenging projects.

Position Summary

Our company is seeking a senior construction project management professional that will be responsible for HVAC and plumbing related construction projects i.e. managing, supervising, planning, communicating, executing and completing assigned projects. The position carries the responsibility to ensure that the project is implemented effectively within cost, schedule, quality and safety parameters.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Managing multiple full mechanical construction projects of various sizes.

  • Maintaining and monitoring general conditions, work scope and specifications of project contract/subcontracts– before, during and upon completion of project.

  • Supervising Project Engineers and General Superintendents.

  • Collaborating with field labor supervision to plan, organize and schedule project work and assure compliance with contractual documents, plans, and specifications.

  • Reviewing contracts and subcontract agreements ensuring compliance and accountability.

  • Creating project schedule of values, project budget and cost code schedule.

  • Ensuring proper safety policies and methods are utilized on assigned projects in conjunction with our company Safety Professional and stated policy.

  • Effectively purchase materials, equipment and subcontracts and maintain on-going controls and records in accordance with accounting policies.

  • Composing and submitting progress payment applications, review subcontractor payment applications.

  • Collaborating with the design team on design-build projects.

  • Developing favorable relationships with clients in a business development capacity.

  • Proven project management skills with a minimum of 8 years’ experience in project management with full mechanical contracting or related construction firms.

Financial Responsibilities

  • Protects the company’s interest by managing all financial aspects of the contract.

  • Reviews the final estimate and ensures the proper loading of those numbers into the project cost system.

  • Prepares and submits various contract billings to ensure proper cash flow during contract performance.

  • Provides periodic status and end of contract cost and budget analysis.

  • Reviews all schedules of values for contract billings to assure billings are done ahead of our cost. Usual overbilling goal is to be billed 20% greater than our costs.

  • Completes project closeout within 2 weeks of warranty date or final project billing to obtain retainage funding.

  • Completes lien process when contract issues call for its use.

Required Qualifications

  • Construction Management, Mechanical Engineering degree desired or equivalent relevant work experience.

  • Experience with New Construction and Renovation projects is highly desirable.

  • Proficiency with software tools including Timberline accounting Software, MS. Word, Excel, Outlook, CAD and other related engineering software tools.

  • Proficient in multiple trades (Specifically HVAC, Mechanical, Plumbing, and Building Automation Systems).

  • Experience with design-build/design-assist construction. Ability to work with the design team.

  • Ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced work environment.

  • Ability to interface with construction industry professionals with professionalism and credibility.

  • Must be able to prepare/coordinate on submittals/shop drawings and operations and maintenance manuals.

  • Negotiating experience in construction change orders and project presentations is required.

  • High achievement orientation and execution.

  • A minimum of three years’ experience managing PM’s and PE’s.

What you can expect

  • Exceptional health, dental and vision insurance.

  • Paid Employee Only Medical Coverage

  • In house and manufacturer led training, leadership development

  • Long-term career growth into operations, sales and/or leadership

  • Comprehensive benefit package and employer sponsored memberships

  • 401k match, PTO, Holiday Pay, and more!

  • Annual incentive program

  • Compensation for Technician commute time

  • Stable work with a guaranteed 40 hours per week minimum

Working Conditions

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for periods of time; talk or hear; perform fine motor, hand, and finger skills in the use of a keyboard, telephone, or writing. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk; and reach with arms and/or hands. title: Senior RF Systems Test Engineer

System Test & Verification

RF / SDR Testing

Hardware / Software Integration

  • Develop test and measurement solutions using Python, MATLAB, C/C++ or equivalent programming languages.
  • Support automation of laboratory testing and measurement activities.

Product Qualification

  • Support product qualification and environmental testing.
  • Perform or coordinate testing covering areas such as vibration, temperature, humidity, shock and EMI/EMC.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Electronic, Electrical, Computer Engineering or a related discipline.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in test, verification, validation or systems integration.
  • Strong hands-on experience with RF, SDR and/or wireless communication systems.
  • Strong understanding of RF fundamentals and test & measurement techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with equipment such as spectrum analysers, network analysers, channel emulators/simulators, signal generators or similar RF instrumentation.
  • Experience with hardware/software integration and system-level troubleshooting.
  • Experience developing and executing test plans, test cases and verification procedures.
  • Programming or test automation experience using Python, MATLAB, C/C++ or similar.

Particularly Relevant Backgrounds

title: Junior Controller

Ook ben je een aanspreekpunt voor leveranciers en Van der Valk-vestigingen. Of het nu gaat om een vraag over een factuur of een financiële verwerking die anders verloopt dan verwacht, jij brengt de situatie in kaart en helpt mee aan een passende oplossing.

Daarnaast ondersteun je bij financiële controles, verschillende aangiftes en administratieve processen, waaronder onze giftcardadministratie.

Jouw carrière in Finance begint hier. Ontdek, analyseer en maak het verschil.

Finance staat natuurlijk niet stil. Daarom werk je ook mee aan projecten en nieuwe ontwikkelingen. Denk aan AI, Peppol, fiscale vraagstukken en het verder digitaliseren van onze processen. Je hoeft hier nog geen specialist in te zijn. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je nieuwsgierig bent, graag leert en het leuk vindt om mee te denken over verbeteringen.

Je komt terecht in het Finance-team van Valk Service Center en Valk Inkoop. Samen met negen collega’s zorg je ervoor dat onze financiële processen soepel verlopen. Iedereen heeft zijn eigen verantwoordelijkheden, maar we werken ook veel samen en zoeken elkaar makkelijk op.

Je krijgt volop de ruimte om mee te kijken, vragen te stellen en steeds meer onderdelen van Finance eigen te maken. Loop je ergens tegenaan of zie je iets opvallends? Dan duiken we er samen in en zoeken we naar de beste oplossing. We delen kennis, houden elkaar scherp en helpen elkaar verder.

De organisatie

Werken bij de toekan betekent werken bij de meest gastvrije hotels van Nederland. Een stralende glimlach op de gezichten van onze gasten, daar doen we het voor! Je komt te werken bij het Valk Service Center en Valk Inkoop. Dit is de faciliterende organisatie voor meer dan 70 Van der Valk hotels in het binnen- en buitenland. In verschillende teams zoals marketing, Revenue management en HR ondersteunen we samen onze hotels op de best mogelijke manier. Dit doen we op ons moderne kantoor in het mooie Van der Valk Hotel in Breukelen en vanuit het distributiecentrum in Eindhoven.

Jij

Jij bent analytisch, nieuwsgierig en wilt begrijpen hoe financiële processen in elkaar zitten. Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor detail en vindt het leuk om uit te zoeken waarom iets anders loopt dan verwacht. Je bent leergierig, maakt nieuwe systemen snel eigen en denkt actief mee over hoe processen slimmer en efficiënter kunnen worden ingericht.

title: MSc Thesis Internship: Robot Learning with Human Neural Supervision
description:
We are looking for a Master’s student to conduct their thesis within our prototyping and applied systems team, contributing to research at the intersection of robot learning, multimodal data, and brain–computer interfaces.

Robot demonstrations capture what a person does, but not necessarily when they recognize an error, reconsider an action, or initiate a correction. We investigate whether EEG-derived annotations can identify demonstration segments that are particularly useful for training autonomous robots.

Working closely with researchers and engineers, you will tackle a focused validation question:
can neural-informed selection or weighting of demonstration data improve robot policy performance or reduce the amount of training data required?

The project combines egocentric or teleoperation recordings, framewise behavioral annotations, and densely sampled mental-state classifier outputs. Your work will focus on downstream robot-learning experiments, with support from our neuroengineering team for interpreting the neural signals.

The role is intended to align with a Master’s thesis, subject to topic fit and university supervision.

Start: By agreement, as soon as possible
Duration: 4–6 months
Availability: 10-20 hours per week

What you will do

  • Define a tractable research question and evaluation protocol with the team

  • Prepare aligned demonstration data and annotations for robot-policy training

  • Implement methods for selecting or weighting demonstrations using neural and behavioral information

  • Compare against random selection and non-neural baselines, potentially including policy-influence methods

  • Train and evaluate robot policies in simulation and/or on available hardware

  • Assess task success, generalization, and data efficiency using controlled experiments and statistical analysis

  • Document reproducible experiments and contribute to your thesis and potential research publications

The thesis will address one well-defined validation step rather than require building the complete recording, neural-analysis, and robot-learning pipeline.

What we offer

  • Hands-on research connecting human neural signals with robot learning

  • Close collaboration with BCI researchers and applied-systems engineers

  • The opportunity to develop a rigorous thesis with practical relevance

  • A pragmatic, low-hierarchy environment with room to take ownership

  • Flexible scheduling around exams and coursework

  • Support for scientific writing and potential dissemination of the results

What you bring:

  • Current enrollment in a Master’s program in Robotics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field

  • Strong interest in robot learning, imitation learning, or learning from demonstrations

  • Solid Python programming skills and experience with a machine-learning framework such as PyTorch

  • Familiarity with training and evaluating machine-learning models

  • An understanding of experimental design, data leakage, and meaningful baseline comparisons

  • Ability to translate an open research question into a manageable implementation and evaluation plan

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating across disciplines

Nice to have:

  • Experience with imitation learning, reinforcement learning, or vision-language-action models

  • Familiarity with robot-learning tools such as LeRobot, RoboMimic, or simulation environments

  • Experience with multimodal time-series data, dataset curation, or data valuation

  • Experience running reproducible experiments across multiple training seeds

  • Exposure to EEG or brain–computer interfaces; prior neuroscience experience is not required

  • Prior involvement in research projects, open-source contributions, or scientific writing

title: Senior Scientist 1, Toxicology
description:
Job Description Summary

-Directs and manages toxicological and/or pathological studies data in preclinical safety and efficacy testing on new and marketed products. Establishes policies for use of contract laboratories and consultants. Support audit and HAQ from FDA and other regulatory agencies. Support in conducts and summarizes toxicology safety studies on new drug substances. Improves methods for drug safety evaluation; analyzes and prepares reports of findings; performs advisory functions in dealing with items found to contain toxic material; and completes and/or reviews toxicology section of submissions to regulatory agencies.
-Senior Scientist I:Independently conceives and executes experiments that implement project strategy and test independently‐ generated hypotheses. May bring new technique(s) into lab/ process. Increasingly proficient at supporting multiple activities in parallel. Provides input to operational and/or strategic discussions related to own technical knowledge.


Job Description

Major accountabilities:

  • Senior Scientist I:Designs/executes experiments and identifies next steps based on analysis of own data and data from other lab contributors.
  • Independently modifies existing lab techniques/processes and implements techniques new to the lab.
  • Communicates results and conclusions to project meetings.
  • May provide input to internal/ external publications including writing relevant sections.
  • Skilled in collaboration across project team labs.
  • May suggest/build new network connections within existing project teams.
  • Routinely trains members of lab and broader project team in familiar techniques.
  • Expected (if needed) to undertake organizational responsibility (such as equipment power user, lab safety rep).
  • Accountable for increasingly complex experiments; key contributor to the success of drug discovery, technology, and/or early development projects.
  • Brings ideas from a concept or question to a decision in experimental design, based on previous observations.
  • Reporting of technical complaints / adverse events / special case scenarios related to Novartis products within 24 hours of receipt

Minimum Requirements:

  • Graduate/ Postgraduate in Life Sciences with 5-7 years relevant experience working in pharmaceutical GLP setting.

  • Good working knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements

  • Knowledge of animal welfare requirements related to study conduct

  • Good communication skills, and excellent logistical/planning skills

  • Previous experience with software for online information and program management is a plus


Skills Desired

Animal Models, Bioinformatics, Collaboration, Data Analysis, Ethics, Problem Solving, Regulatory Compliance, Toxicology

title: Remote | Data Engineer — $140,000–$180,000/year
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
We are sharing a full-time opportunity for an experienced Data Engineer with strong expertise in Python, SQL, Apache Spark, AWS, distributed data processing, and scalable data architecture to build and operate the infrastructure supporting AI-driven products and research initiatives.

The role will focus on designing and scaling distributed data pipelines, managing large datasets across cloud environments, and building reliable data systems that support processing, experimentation, analytics, and model development at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Scalable Data Pipeline Development

  • Design, build, and maintain large-scale data pipelines
  • Ingest and transform data from multiple structured and unstructured sources
  • Develop reliable workflows for high-volume data processing
  • Improve pipeline scalability, maintainability, and operational performance
  • Support downstream analytics, experimentation, and model-development requirements

Distributed Data Processing

  • Develop distributed processing workflows using Apache Spark
  • Optimise large-scale data transformations and computational workloads
  • Design partitioning strategies appropriate for high-volume datasets
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across distributed environments
  • Apply cloud-native technologies to scalable data-processing workflows

Data Architecture & Storage

  • Design scalable architectures across SQL and NoSQL systems
  • Build storage layers that support reliability, performance, and growth
  • Evaluate database and storage technologies for different workload requirements
  • Improve data accessibility while maintaining system integrity
  • Apply sound architecture principles to large and complex datasets

AWS Data Infrastructure

  • Design and implement cloud-native data architectures on AWS
  • Support high-volume ingestion, processing, storage, and distribution
  • Build infrastructure that can scale with increasing data workloads
  • Improve reliability and operational efficiency across cloud data systems
  • Apply AWS services appropriately across different data-processing scenarios

Python & SQL Engineering

  • Write efficient Python code for data ingestion, transformation, validation, and analysis
  • Develop performant SQL queries and data-processing logic
  • Improve existing pipelines and transformation workflows
  • Apply strong engineering standards to production data systems
  • Maintain clear and reusable data-processing code

Data Quality, Monitoring & Reliability

  • Ensure data quality and integrity throughout pipelines and storage layers
  • Implement monitoring for data workflows and infrastructure
  • Identify failures, anomalies, and processing issues
  • Improve operational reliability through automation and validation
  • Establish processes that support consistent and trustworthy data delivery

Cross-Functional AI & Data Collaboration

  • Collaborate with AI researchers, data scientists, and engineering teams
  • Support data-intensive applications and experimentation
  • Provide infrastructure for model-training and evaluation workflows where relevant
  • Translate research and product requirements into scalable data systems
  • Adapt infrastructure as AI and data requirements evolve

Ideal Profile

  • Strong professional experience in data engineering or distributed data systems
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Spark or comparable distributed-processing frameworks
  • Strong experience with AWS data services and cloud-native architecture
  • Experience working with both SQL and NoSQL databases
  • Demonstrated experience processing and managing large-scale datasets
  • Strong understanding of data partitioning and performance optimisation
  • Experience designing scalable and reliable data architectures
  • Familiarity with automation, orchestration, and data-pipeline monitoring
  • Strong understanding of data quality and operational reliability
  • Exposure to AI/ML workflows or research environments is advantageous
  • Familiarity with LLM-related training, evaluation, or prompt-experimentation datasets is beneficial
  • Experience with data-visualisation tools such as Matplotlib, Seaborn, or Plotly is a plus

Engagement Details

  • Full-time engagement
  • Fully remote
  • Base compensation: $140,000–$180,000/year
  • Work will involve Python, SQL, Apache Spark, AWS, distributed data processing, and scalable data architecture
  • Strong experience with large-scale data systems and cloud infrastructure is central to this role
  • Responsibilities will span data ingestion, transformation, storage, monitoring, and operational reliability
  • The role may support AI/ML experimentation, model-development workflows, and LLM-related data infrastructure
  • Data volumes, infrastructure requirements, and technical priorities may evolve as products and research initiatives scale

title: Teammanager Zorg
description:
Voor wie zorg jij vandaag? Misschien vervul jij binnenkort de rol van Teammanager Zorg binnen de Hartekamp Groep in cluster 2 op het mooie woonzorgpark in Heemstede. Wij zoeken een ervaren en bevlogen leidinggevende die zich thuis voelt in een complexe zorgomgeving en samen met zorgprofessionals wil bouwen aan toekomstbestendige zorg voor onze cliënten. Herken jij jezelf in een coachende en daadkrachtige leiderschapsstijl en weet jij hoe je teams begeleidt in complexe zorgsituaties? Lees snel verder!

Wat bieden wij?

  • Salaris volgens CAO Gehandicaptenzorg in FWG 60 (€4.077,- tot €5.926,- o.b.v. 36 uur), passend bij jouw ervaring en expertise;

  • Jaarcontract met uitzicht op vast voor 32 -36 uur;

  • Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals pensioen via PFZW, 8% vakantiegeld en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering;

  • Een warm welkom met een sterk inwerkprogramma, trainingen en een buddy die je echt op weg helpt;

  • Volop ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen en extra fiscale voordelen via Flex Benefits (zoals fiets, laptop of sportabbonement).

Teammanager Zorg

Werken als Teammanager Zorg bij cluster 2 betekent leidinggeven in de complexe zorg, waar professionele nabijheid, duidelijke kaders en stevige teams essentieel zijn. Op ons woonzorgpark in Heemstede werk je met cliënten met intensieve begeleidings- en ondersteuningsvragen. De ondersteuningsvragen verschillen, maar de gemene deler is duidelijk: de zorg is intensief en vraagt om vakmanschap, rust en continuïteit.

Als Teammanager Zorg geef je richting aan de ontwikkeling van verschillende woonlocaties en vertaal je dit naar een concreet jaarplan. Je bent direct leidinggevende van circa 60 medewerkers en werkt nauw samen met verschillende disciplines. In deze rol leg je verantwoording af aan en adviseer je de Directeur Zorg.

Je geeft leiding vanuit een coachende visie, met oog voor de ontwikkeling van mensen en het vermogen om mee te bewegen met veranderingen, zonder de inhoud en kwaliteit van zorg uit het oog te verliezen. Je bent zichtbaar en benaderbaar op de werkvloer, schakelt gemakkelijk in een dynamische omgeving en weet hoe belangrijk stabiliteit, rust en duidelijkheid zijn binnen de complexe zorg. Je ondersteunt zorgprofessionals in hun groei en weet teams verder te versterken.

Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het bewaken en verder verbeteren van de zorgkwaliteit. Je signaleert kansen voor interne en externe samenwerking, zoals binnen het cliëntennetwerk, regio-overstijgende initiatieven en organisatie-overstijgende samenwerkingen, en draagt actief bij aan zorgvernieuwing.

En bovenal lever je in deze rol iedere dag een betekenisvolle bijdrage aan de kwaliteit van leven van onze cliënten.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt minimaal een hbo diploma richting Zorg & Welzijn, eventueel aangevuld met een management (in de zorg) opleiding;

  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar leidinggevende ervaring, bij voorkeur binnen de gehandicaptenzorg en/of GGZ, in een complexe zorgcontext;

  • Je bezit sterke coachende en sociale vaardigheden en weet verschillende belangen samen te brengen;

  • Je weet strategisch beleid te vertalen naar concrete doelen;

  • Je bent zichtbaar, benaderbaar en handelt proactief;

  • Je bent bereid om, wanneer de situatie daarom vraagt, buiten kantoortijden beschikbaar te zijn;

  • Interne kandidaten zijn bereid een opleiding te volgen.

Enthousiast? Reageer dan snel!

Zie jij jezelf al als onze nieuwe Teammanager Zorg en ben je klaar om bij te dragen aan de toekomst van de complexe zorg? Solliciteer dan direct via onderstaande knop. Onze recruiter Naomi neemt zo snel mogelijk contact met je op. Heb je vragen? Neem dan contact met haar op via 06-11954798 of 023-5101401 (optie 2).

De gesprekken vinden na uitnodiging plaats.

Een adviesgesprek met de Centrale Cliëntenraad en Centrale Vertegenwoordigersraad maken onderdeel uit van de procedure. Tevens is een assessment onderdeel van deze procedure.

Voor aanvang van het dienstverband dient een geldige VOG te worden overgelegd. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Interne kandidaten hebben bij gelijke geschiktheid voorrang in de procedure.

title: Youth Development Professional, Aliquippa
company: Boys & Girls Clubs of Western Pennsylvania
description:
Location: Aliquippa Clubhouse; Aliquippa, PA
Pay: $17/hour
Status: Part-time, hourly

Job Summary

The Youth Development Professional will be hands-on with the youth to implement curriculum and programming on a day-to-day basis. This role is responsible for the supervision and safety of all program participants as well as relationship building. This role will ensure that they follow all DHS Chapter 3270 Regulations and BGCA Safety requirements.

Requirements

  • A high school diploma or a general educational development certificate and 2500 hours experience working with children. (Can be babysitting excluding your own family members)
  • An interest in a variety of youth programs including technology, art, sports, STEM, mentoring and recreation.
  • Proficient in Google Suite.
  • The usual and customary methods of performing the job's function require the following physical demands: lifting & carrying up to 50 pounds, pushing, any/or pulling, climbing to include steps, balancing, stooping, standing, sitting, kneeling, crawling, crouching, and signification fine fingered dexterity. Perform all additional duties and tasks assigned by leadership/supervisors.
Responsibilities
  • Create and support the facilitation of meaningful lesson plans and activities for all youth served.
  • Implement educational programming to include: STEAM, mentoring, athletics, literacy and activities.
  • Ensure the safety of all program participants while in care.
  • Encourage participation in clubhouse community events.
  • Promote and stimulate membership in the Clubhouse through programs, services, and outreach activities.
  • Participate in monthly incentive programs that focus on literacy, STEM, Art, Mentoring, Athletics and Social/Emotional Learning activities.
  • Work in conjunction with volunteers, tutors, and students to participate in an ongoing education improvement program
  • Promote a fun, safe and inclusive environment for all ages.
  • Offer input regarding department programs, in partnership with the approval of Program Manager.
  • Observe and report any maintenance and operation concerns of the department’s physical property, ensuring Club member safety at all times to the Clubhouse director.

Onboarding process

  • Must complete a health physical and TB test
  • 3 letters of Reference needed upon hiring
  • Clearances Act 33, Act 34, Act 151 and NSOR letter.
  • Mandated Reporter Certification within 45 days of hire
  • 10 hours of DHS training (can be done virtually)
  • Attend CPR, Pediatric First Aid training within the first 90 days of hire.

Who We Are

For over 135 years, the Boys & Girls Clubs of Western Pennsylvania (BGCWPA) has been a trailblazer in youth development, committed to unleashing the potential of every child. Rooted deeply in the values of safety, fun, and inclusivity, BGCWPA prides itself on cultivating an environment where every child and employee can flourish.

At the heart of our vision lies a commitment to providing opportunities that transcend boundaries. Through creative and forward-thinking programs, we aim to equip our youth with the skills, knowledge, and resilience necessary for a brighter future. BGCWPA is not merely an organization; it is a dynamic force that shapes destinies, cultivates dreams and empowers the leaders of tomorrow.

As a proud affiliate of Boys & Girls Clubs of America, BGCWPA aligns itself with a nationwide network of organizations dedicated to empowering young people. Our collective impact extends beyond our local community, fostering positive change on a national scale. Annually, BGCWPA reaches over 12,300 young individuals through a rich tapestry of innovative programs, services, and outreach initiatives.

Commitment to Inclusion

BGCWPA is committed to building a culturally diverse community and we believe in the importance of equity and inclusion. We understand that every individual brings a unique set of skills and experiences. While our job description lists specific qualifications, skills, and competencies, we also recognize that true potential can often transcend those lines. If you're enthusiastic about social impact and helping others succeed, even if you don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

We provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. Our organization prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Senior Superintendent
description:
About Us:

Since 1980, DynaTen Corporation (a Comfort Systems USA Company) has delivered high-quality Commercial Construction and Service Solutions across the greater North Texas market. We partner with our clients to provide technical expertise and high-level execution on every project. As a result, DynaTen is a trusted provider of HVAC, Plumbing, and Building Automation Controls solutions.

Our culture is built on accountability, teamwork, and a commitment to developing our people. We take pride in promoting from within, supporting both field and office teams, and delivering results the right way. We offer strong long-term career opportunities, excellent benefits, and a positive, team-oriented work environment

Position Summary

The Sr. Superintendent leads multiple large or complex project teams responsible for the safe, timely, and high-quality installation of commercial HVAC, plumbing, piping, and related mechanical systems. The role converts project requirements into executable work plans, develops field talent, and coordinates closely with project and trade partners. This position reports to the General Superintendent.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead multiple large or complex project teams performing work on commercial HVAC, plumbing, piping, and related mechanical systems and establish clear expectations for safety, quality, productivity, and conduct.

  • Build and communicate portfolio work plans using drawings, schedules, coordination information, labor budgets, material status, and jobsite constraints.

  • Plan manpower, tools, equipment, access, prefabrication, deliveries, and work areas to support reliable production.

  • Review project documents, identify constructability issues and scope gaps, and elevate requests for information before they affect the work.

  • Coordinate sequencing and access with project management, general contractors, other trades, vendors, inspectors, and commissioning teams.

  • Verify installations against drawings, specifications, codes, approved submittals, and quality checklists; drive timely correction of deficiencies.

  • Track installed quantities, labor performance, schedule status, material needs, and constraints; provide accurate daily or weekly reporting.

  • Coach employees, assign work, document performance, recognize strong results, and address conduct or performance concerns with management.

  • Lead pre-task planning, job hazard analysis, toolbox talks, housekeeping, and incident prevention activities.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 10 years of commercial mechanical construction experience in mechanical work, including progressively responsible field leadership.

  • Demonstrated ability to plan labor and material, read project schedules, and lead safe, productive installation work.

  • Strong working knowledge of applicable drawings, specifications, codes, testing requirements, and quality standards.

  • Ability to use mobile devices and standard construction software for drawings, reporting, time, and documentation.

  • Strong communication, coaching, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Completion of a recognized apprenticeship or technical training program.

  • OSHA 30-hour Construction credential and current competent-person or equipment certifications relevant to assigned work.

  • Experience on large healthcare, data center, laboratory, manufacturing, or other complex commercial projects.

  • Experience with lean planning, prefabrication, BIM-enabled work packages, and production tracking.

What you can expect

  • Exceptional health, dental and vision insurance.

  • Paid Employee Only Medical Coverage

  • In house and manufacturer led training, and leadership development

  • Long-term career growth into operations, sales and/or leadership

  • Comprehensive benefit package and employer sponsored memberships

  • 401k match

  • PTO and Holiday Pay

  • Annual incentive program

  • Stable work

Working Conditions

Must have the ability to perform the duties above in a non-controlled environment. This will include climbing ladders, working on ladders and elevated surfaces, maintain in good working conditions, tools, materials, and equipment required to your work area. Working exposed to the elements during (when required) at all times of the year. All employees are required to always wear PPE and always follow Safety procedures.

title: Security Engineer (Living in Malta or Hold an EU Passport) *Fluent in English
description:
Security Engineer (Living in Malta or Hold an EU Passport) *Fluent in English

Technical Role – Regulated Banking Sector (Malta)


Role Overview:


The Security Engineer will form part of a team responsible for architecting, leading, and continuously improving the security framework of a regulated bank in Malta, in strict adherence to Malta Financial Services Authority (MFSA) guidelines. This is a hands-on, technical position focused on the day-to-day protection of the bank’s digital assets, infrastructure, and data.

.

Responsibilities:


Be part of the team that:

  • Designs, implements, and optimizes advanced security controls and enterprise-scale protective measures utilizing industry-leading brands, including next-generation firewalls, DLP, SIEM, and EDR solutions etc.
  • Participates in incident response efforts for sophisticated security threats, coordinating root cause analysis and post-incident reviews.
  • Conducts and oversees comprehensive vulnerability assessments, threat modelling, penetration testing, ensuring findings are prioritized and resolved effectively.
  • Implements bank-wide security policies, standards, and technical architectures to meet and exceed MFSA and international regulatory requirements.
  • Assists as technical liaison for internal and external audits, regulatory exams, and due diligence processes.
  • Assists in championing security awareness and the provisioning of security training to Bank employees.
  • Continuously monitor the threat landscape, proactively advising on the impact of new risks, technologies, and regulatory changes relevant to the Maltese banking sector.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure secure design, integration, and operation of banking applications and infrastructure, leveraging automation where possible.
  • Contribute to the development and testing of business continuity and disaster recovery strategies from a security perspective.


Qualifications & Experience:


  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Proven experience (3+ Years) in a Technical Security Engineering role, preferably within Banking or Financial Services.
  • Familiarity with MFSA regulations, EBA guidelines, and applicable EU directives for banking and data protection (e.g., PSD2, GDPR).
  • Hands-on experience with security tools such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, SIEM, endpoint security, and vulnerability management platforms.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CEH, CISSP, CISM, or similar) are considered an asset.


Key Competencies:


  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Attention to detail and ability to work independently in a regulated environment.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, with a focus on technical clarity.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with integrity and discretion.
  • Commitment to continuous professional development and learning.

title: Information Technology Auditor
description:
The IT Auditor will be responsible for conducting IT audits across multiple clients and industries, assessing the adequacy and effectiveness of IT controls, identifying technology-related risks, and ensuring compliance with applicable standards, regulations and internal policies.


Job responsibilities:

  • Evaluate the effectiveness of clients' IT controls across different industries, business processes, systems and technology environments.

  • Conduct IT audits to assess compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, internal policies and procedures.

  • Identify and assess IT risks and control weaknesses, and recommend appropriate improvements or mitigating measures.

  • Assist in developing IT audit scopes, audit programmes, risk assessments and audit procedures.

  • Evaluate IT General Controls, application controls and other technology-related controls, and recommend improvements where appropriate.

  • Review areas including user access management, change management, IT operations, backup and recovery, system development, cybersecurity, business continuity and third-party IT services, where applicable.

  • Assess whether application systems and related controls adequately support business processes and transaction processing.

  • Review relevant IT governance, cybersecurity and information security practices against applicable standards and frameworks.

  • Perform walkthroughs, interviews, document reviews and control testing to obtain sufficient audit evidence.

  • Prepare audit working papers and reports documenting audit procedures performed, findings identified and recommendations for improvement.

  • Discuss audit findings and recommendations with client personnel and management.

  • Perform follow-up reviews to assess the implementation status of agreed corrective actions.

  • Prepare and present reports that reflect audit results and document the proposed process.

  • Engage in continuous knowledge development regarding sector’s rules, regulations, best practices, tools, techniques, performance standards, relevant regulations, industry practices, technology risks, emerging technologies and audit methodologies.

  • Collaborate with internal audit, cybersecurity and other engagement team members where necessary.

  • Perform other ad-hoc duties and assignments as assigned.


Job Requirement:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Cybersecurity or a related field.

  • Qualifications or academic background in Accounting, Auditing or related disciplines would be an added advantage.

  • CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) certification is a minimum professional certification requirement for candidates who do not possess other relevant professional certifications.

  • Candidates possessing other relevant professional certifications such as CIA, CISM, CISSP, CRISC, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor or equivalent will also be considered.

  • Relevant experience in IT audit, technology risk, IT governance, IT compliance, internal audit or a similar role is preferred.

  • Prior experience in performing IMDA SSIR audits, Cyber Trust Mark assessments, Cyber Essentials Mark assessments and/or Data Protection Essentials (DPE) assessments would be an added advantage.

  • Good knowledge and understanding of IT systems, IT controls, information security and IT risk management.

  • Familiarity with IT standards and frameworks such as COBIT, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST or other relevant frameworks.

  • Able to appreciate business process issues and understand business transaction scenarios and how application systems support business operations.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Good audit documentation and report-writing skills.

  • Excellent communication skills in both oral and written English.

  • Resourceful and able to work independently with appropriate supervision.

  • Logical thinking, good attitude, fast learner and good team player.

  • Able to handle multiple tasks and assignments.

  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

  • Willing to travel to client premises where required.

title: Process Development Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated Process Development Engineer to join our Development team. This role is responsible for the development, optimization, and validation of manufacturing processes for new products. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring robust, capable, and customer-approved manufacturing processes that consistently meet quality, cost, and delivery expectations.


This position requires strong analytical skills, hands-on engineering expertise, and the ability to collaborate across multiple functions, including Project Management, Quality, Production, and customers.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, optimize, and validate individual manufacturing processes for new products entering production.
  • Conduct PFMEA (Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) and integrate risk mitigation actions into process and layout design.
  • Ensure corrective and preventive actions are effectively implemented and sustained.
  • Define optimal process windows through Design of Experiments (DOE), capability studies, and engineering analysis.
  • Lead the development of internal manufacturing processes.
  • Define and validate processing parameters for welding, decoration, lacquering, assembly, and other manufacturing operations.
  • Validate customer artwork requirements and coordinate the procurement of decoration materials and product-specific equipment.
  • Specify and order equipment required for production processes
  • Analyze trial data generated during process development and refine parameters to ensure product specifications and customer requirements are consistently achieved.
  • Maintain and update product specifications with validated process parameters.
  • Coordinate process validation activities and ensure all validation requirements are successfully completed.
  • Prepare Pre-Production Samples (PPS) and associated documentation for customer approval.
  • Present validation parts to Quality for final process validation and investigate any validation failures.
  • Collaborate with Quality, Production, Tooling, and Project teams to implement solutions for process-related issues.
  • Ensure all products and processes are fully validated and approved before production launch.



Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience in process development, manufacturing engineering, or new product introduction within a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of PFMEA, DOE, process validation, capability studies, and statistical analysis techniques.
  • Experience with customer approval processes such as PPS, PPAP, or equivalent submission requirements.
  • Familiarity with welding, assembly, decoration, lacquering, or similar manufacturing technologies is considered an asset.
  • Ability to analyze technical data and make evidence-based decisions.
  • Strong problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and engineering-related software tools.
