title: Persoonlijk Begeleider Crisis- en observatie-unit
description:
Voor wie zorg jij vandaag? Op de Crisis- en Observatie-unit op in Heemstede zoeken we een nieuwe collega die stevig in zijn of haar schoenen staat. Als Persoonlijk Begeleider (24 – 32 uur per week) ben jij er op de momenten dat het er écht toe doet. Jij biedt structuur, veiligheid en vertrouwen aan cliënten in een kwetsbare fase van hun leven. Ben jij die daadkrachtige begeleider die rust brengt in de storm? Dan verwelkomen we je graag op onze unieke locatie op woonzorgpark in Heemstede.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Salaris volgens CAO Gehandicaptenzorg in FWG 45 (€3.052 tot €4.262 o.b.v. 36 uur), passend bij jouw ervaring en expertise

  • Jaarcontract met uitzicht op vast voor 24 -32 uur.

  • Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals pensioen via PFZW, 8% vakantiegeld en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering.

  • Een warm welkom met een sterk inwerkprogramma, trainingen en een buddy die je echt op weg helpt.

  • Volop ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen en extra fiscale voordelen via Flex Benefits (zoals fiets, laptop of sportabbonement)

De Crisis en Observatie-unit

Op de Crisis- en Observatie-unit bieden we specialistische zorg aan cliënten die tijdelijk worden opgenomen vanuit een acute of onveilig situatie. Je werkt met een diverse groep cliënten met uiteenlopende achtergronden, intelligentieniveaus en complexe problematiek. Er is sprake van moeilijk verstaanbaar gedrag, psychiatrische aandoeningen en systeemproblematiek. De zorgvraag is intensief en vraagt om snel schakelen en duidelijke communicatie. Geen dag is hetzelfde! Het is een dynamische werkomgeving waar jouw stabiliteit het verschil maakt.

''Als de sleur van het dagelijks leven niets voor jou is, dan is dit de juiste werkplek. Je komt terecht in een ervaren team waarin iedereen zijn eigen unieke kwaliteiten meebrengt. Samen zijn we op zoek naar nieuwe talenten die ons team willen versterken. Het werk is niet elke dag vechten, chaos en paniek. Integendeel: de meeste dagen zijn juist ontzettend gezellig en waardevol, zowel met collega's als met cliënten. Wat dit werk zo bijzonder maakt, is dat je als begeleider cliënten ondersteunt in een moeilijke periode van hun leven. Samen met het team help je hen stap voor stap weer grip te krijgen op hun situatie. Het mooiste moment is wanneer een cliënt de behandeling afrond met een glimlach op het gezicht. Met elkaar zorgen we er elke keer weer voor dat cliënten zich gezien en gehoord voelen.''

Jouw functie

Als Persoonlijk Begeleider bied je zorg die gericht is op het stabiliseren van de cliënten en het ondersteunen van de cliënt bij hun terugkeer naar de eigen omgeving. Vanuit de Crisis- en Observatie-unit wordt er nazorg geboden. Als Persoonlijk Begeleider draai je het pb-schap van één of meerdere cliënten, waarbij je alle zaken rondom de cliënt coördineert: van het opstellen van het zorgplan en het organiseren van het dagprogramma tot het onderhouden van contact met het netwerk. Daarnaast voer je intake- en evaluatiegesprekken en ben je actief betrokken bij de dagelijkse begeleiding en ondersteuning. Je werkt intensief samen in een multidisciplinair team, met als gezamenlijk doel: cliënten de best passende zorg en begeleiding bieden in een kwetsbare fase van hun leven.

Bekijk hier een korte documentaire en krijg een inkijkje in het werk op onze Crisis- en Observatie-unit. Je ziet hoe wij dagelijks het verschil maken en hoe jij daar straks misschien ook een rol in speelt.

“Onze deur staat altijd open. Spreekt deze functie jou aan, twijfel je? Bel gerust eens met ons via 023-5833201.”

Pas jij in dit plaatje?

  • Je hebt minimaal een mbo-niveau 4 diploma in de richting van Zorg & Welzijn;

  • Je toont lef en daadkracht en denkt actief mee over hoe de begeleiding beter kan;

  • Je werkt zelfstandig, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking op met je team;

  • Je hebt een scherp observatievermogen en signaleert gedrag snel en adequaat;

  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar. Zowel in de ochtenden, avonden en weekenden.

Solliciteren? Dat kan via onderstaande link.

Wil jij de uitdaging aangaan als Persoonlijk Begeleider Crisis- en Observatie-Unit? Solliciteer via een van onderstaande knoppen. Onze recruiter Naomi neemt zo snel mogelijk contact met je op. Heb je vragen? Neem dan contact met haar op via 06-11954798 of 023-5101401 (optie 2).

Voor aanvang van het dienstverband dient een geldige VOG te worden overgelegd. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Interne kandidaten hebben bij gelijke geschiktheid voorrang in de procedure.

title: Franchise Business Consultant
description:
Franchise Business Consultant

Remote Northern California | Up to 90% Travel

At Denny’s, our franchisees are business owners—and our Franchise Business Consultants are some of their most important partners.

We’re looking for an experienced restaurant or franchise operations leader who knows that driving results isn’t just about identifying what’s wrong or telling someone what needs to change. It’s about asking the right questions, listening to understand, building trust, creating buy-in, and turning conversations into action.

The right person brings a genuine “How can I help?” mentality—but also has the confidence and backbone to address missed commitments, reinforce brand standards, and have difficult conversations when needed.

If you know how to build real partnerships AND create accountability, this could be a great fit.

What You’ll Do

As a Franchise Business Consultant, you’ll serve as a key field partner to Denny’s franchisees, supporting approximately 90–100 restaurants and 10–12 franchisee relationships within your assigned market. You’ll:

  • Build trusted, productive relationships with franchisees and their leadership teams.
  • Ask thoughtful, open-ended questions to understand challenges, uncover root causes, and help franchisees take ownership of solutions.
  • Turn conversations into clear commitments—what needs to happen, who owns it, and by when.
  • Follow through on agreed-upon actions and address missed commitments directly and constructively.
  • Use restaurant KPIs, financial results, guest feedback, and operational observations to guide meaningful business conversations.
  • Help franchisees connect operational execution to traffic, profitability, guest experience, and long-term business health.
  • Coach and influence through credibility, business insight, and relationships—not simply authority.
  • Reinforce Denny’s brand standards and help franchisees understand the “why” behind expectations and initiatives.
  • Partner with franchisees on promotions, pricing strategies, CRM programs, technology rollouts, and other brand initiatives.
  • Identify trends, risks, and opportunities across your market and bring field insights back to Regional Operations and Support Center partners.
  • Document key conversations and commitments and maintain disciplined follow-through from conversation through execution.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?

We’re looking for someone who is:

A Listener & Question-Asker
You’re curious. You seek to understand before jumping to a solution and know how to ask questions that get beyond the surface of a problem.

A True Business Partner
You build credibility and trust with business owners while understanding that real partnership requires shared responsibility and accountability.

Comfortable with Accountability
You don’t shy away when commitments aren’t met. You can revisit expectations, understand what got in the way, and create clarity around what happens next.

A Courageous Communicator
You’re articulate, direct, and respectful. You can have difficult conversations, challenge when necessary, and hold firm without damaging the relationship.

An Influencer
You know how to create buy-in through relationships, business insight, and communication—even when you don’t have positional authority.

Business-Minded
You understand restaurant operations and the financial drivers behind them. You can use data to ask better questions and help operators make stronger business decisions.

A Strong Follow-Through Person
You document commitments, stay organized, circle back, and make sure important conversations actually result in action.

What You’ll Bring

  • Multi-unit restaurant, hospitality, franchise operations, consulting, or comparable business experience.
  • Demonstrated success building relationships and influencing business owners or operational leaders.
  • Strong operational and financial acumen with the ability to translate performance data into action.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • The ability to navigate challenging conversations with confidence, professionalism, and good judgment.
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Food Safety Manager Certification or the ability to obtain certification as required.
  • Bilingual capabilities are a plus.

A Few Important Details

This is a highly field-based role with up to 90% travel, including overnight travel. You’ll need a valid driver’s license and flexibility to work days, evenings, weekends, or holidays when business needs require.

You’ll also spend significant time inside our restaurants, so comfort working in an active restaurant environment is essential.

Why This Role Matters

Our franchisees have invested their businesses, their teams, and their livelihoods into the Denny’s brand. They deserve a partner who understands that responsibility.

title: Operational Resilience Risk Specialist
description:
About Northern Trust


As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.


Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.


With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.



Role Overview

The Operational Resilience Risk Specialist serves as a senior subject matter expert within the Operational Risk Management function, providing independent second-line oversight and challenge of the organization's Operational Resilience, Business Continuity (BC), and Disaster Recovery (DR) programs.

The role is responsible for assessing and monitoring resilience risks, evaluating the effectiveness of resilience controls and governance processes, and providing credible challenge to business and technology stakeholders. The position supports the organization's ability to prevent, respond to, recover from, and learn from disruption events while ensuring compliance with regulatory expectations and enterprise risk management requirements.

The successful candidate will partner with business units, technology teams, and resilience program owners to strengthen resilience capabilities, review resilience risk assessments, evaluate continuity and recovery preparedness, and provide reporting and insight to senior management and risk governance forums.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Resilience Oversight

  • Provide independent second-line oversight and challenge of the Operational Resilience framework, policies, standards, and associated governance processes.
  • Review and assess the effectiveness of operational resilience capabilities across Important Business Services (IBS), critical business processes, and supporting interdependencies.
  • Monitor operational resilience risk exposure and identify emerging risks, control weaknesses, and areas requiring remediation.
  • Support the development and enhancement of resilience-related risk metrics, key risk indicators, and management reporting.

Business Continuity Risk Oversight

  • Provide oversight of Business Continuity Management (BCM) activities, including Business Impact Analyses (BIAs), business continuity plans, recovery strategies, and testing programs.

Disaster Recovery Risk Oversight

  • Provide independent oversight of enterprise Disaster Recovery governance, planning, and testing activities.

Risk Assessment and Assurance

  • Perform risk-based reviews and quality assurance activities across Operational Resilience, BC, and DR programs.
  • Evaluate the design and effectiveness of resilience-related controls.
  • Assess issues, vulnerabilities, audit findings, regulatory observations, and self-identified control weaknesses.
  • Support thematic reviews, deep-dive assessments, and targeted risk reviews.

Governance, Reporting and Regulatory Engagement

  • Prepare and deliver concise risk reporting for senior management, risk committees, and governance forums.
  • Escalate material resilience risks, control deficiencies, and regulatory concerns as appropriate.

Qualifications and Experience

Required

  • Several years of experience in Operational Risk, Operational Resilience, Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, Technology Risk, Audit, or related risk management disciplines.
  • Strong knowledge of Operational Resilience frameworks, Business Continuity Management, and Disaster Recovery methodologies.

Preferred

  • Experience within a regulated financial services environment.
  • Familiarity with regulatory requirements and industry guidance, including DORA, PRA/FCA Operational Resilience requirements, FFIEC guidance, Basel operational risk principles, and other relevant resilience regulations.

Work Authorization


Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment.


Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks.


Working with Us


As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.


Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.


Reasonable Accommodation


Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

Job Title: Director, Major Gifts

Organizational Unit: Development
Reports To: Chief Development Officer
Supervises: Mid-level Giving & Prospecting Officer

Location: Equality Now is a remote organization. This position may be based in Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Virginia, or Washington, D.C., with a strong preference for candidates based in New York.


MISSION OBJECTIVE:

The Director, Major Gifts plays a pivotal role in advancing Equality Now’s global mission by leading and growing a major gifts portfolio, including gala sponsorships, mid-level giving and donor engagement. In partnership with the Chief Development Officer and Chief Executive Officer, the Director translates Equality Now’s development strategy into actionable fundraising plans, strengthens donor pipelines and systems, and cultivates meaningful relationships with individuals, family foundations, and philanthropic networks.This role spans strategy, donor cultivation and stewardship, portfolio management, events, executive engagement, and team leadership, and collaborates closely with Annual Giving & Development Operations functions. It requires an experienced fundraising leader with sound judgment, strong relationship-management skills, cross-cultural fluency, and the ability to translate Equality Now’s complex legal and programmatic work into compelling opportunities for philanthropic investment.


The Director will have the opportunity to shape and strengthen Equality Now’s Individual and Major Giving program during an important period of organizational growth. The successful candidate must be comfortable building systems, navigating complexity, inspiring donors and colleagues, and building the capacity of supervisee(s) and other junior staff focused on securing sustainable revenue to advance legal and systemic change for women and girls worldwide.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

The following provides a general outline of the role. It is not exhaustive, and responsibilities may evolve at the discretion of the CDO based on organizational needs and priorities.

Purpose: Innovate for Mission Expansion

  • Serve as the senior lead for operationalizing the Individual & Major Giving strategy, translating our 2026-2030 development strategy into actionable plans, systems, and donor pathways across the full Individual Giving portfolio.
  • Drive the execution and refinement of Equality Now’s high-touch major donor growth strategy, including implementing a network-mapping approach, strengthening Advisory Board and Ambassador engagement, building individualized strategies for UHNW, and designing innovative donor/prospect engagement initiatives (eg-salons, donor cohorts, donor journeys, in-kind/volunteer opportunities for mission impact)
  • Partner with the CEO and CDO to support high-value donor/prospect cultivation and shape donor-facing opportunities aligned with organizational priorities, advising on donor motivations, portfolio insights, and potential engagement opportunities.
  • Provide strategic leadership to align all tiers of individual giving—major gifts, gala sponsorships, mid-level, and annual giving—ensuring cohesive messaging, clear donor journeys, and seamless handoffs between donor segments.
  • Lead maintenance and continuous improvement of pipeline development and tracking practices, including
    donor qualification, engagement strategies, moves management, and standardized systems that enhance efficiency, clarity, and visibility across the portfolio.
  • Lead/guide the development of donor-facing cases for support, investment opportunities, and strategic offerings, ensuring they reflect Equality Now’s mission, program vision, and funder-aligned messaging.

Engagement: Advocate

  • Manage a portfolio of high-value donors and prospects, cultivating deep, trust-based relationships with individuals and family foundations capable of $10,000–$250,000+ giving, while identifying opportunities and supporting leadership-level engagement.
  • Support CEO and CDO engagement with top-tier donors and prospects, preparing strategic briefings, donor intelligence, outreach recommendations, follow-up plans, and bespoke cultivation opportunities.
  • Oversee and elevate the mid-level donor program, ensuring a compelling donor journey that supports upgrades and helps to surface and convert major donor prospects.
  • Engage and activate Advisory Board members and other supporters and ambassadors, partnering with them to leverage networks, cultivate prospective donors, support events, and build community around Equality Now.
  • Serve as an external ambassador for Equality Now, representing the mission with fluency in global women’s rights and human rights–cultivating relationships and expanding networks in philanthropic and peer spaces.
  • Ensure donor experiences reflect mission-driven, community-centered engagement, including opportunities to meet international staff, join learning conversations, attend cultivation events, and participate in curated donor experiences.
  • Strengthen departmental and cross-departmental collaboration, to ensure donor messaging is programmatically accurate, compelling, and aligned with organizational impact narratives, and that the development program gains efficiencies and effectiveness through collaboration across corporate, institutional and individual giving.

Delivery: Define Project Cycle

  • Lead the operational management of the entire Major & Mid-levelGiving portfolio, overseeing processes, timelines, deliverables, and performance standards across major gifts, gala sponsorships, mid-level giving, and annual giving.
  • Implement and oversee strong systems for donor/prospect planning and tracking, including moves management, portfolio assignment, forecasting, and performance analytics, ensuring leadership always has clear visibility into pipeline health.
  • Partner with the Manager, Annual Fund & Development Operations, to ensure excellence in development operations, data integrity, analytics, and annual fund growth strategies.
  • Contribute to the planning and execution of high-impact donor events with Comms & Development colleagues, including the gala, cultivation salons, and community-building convenings, ensuring events advance the 2026-2030 development strategy and build momentum for donor/prospect engagement and pipeline development.
  • Develop individualized donor strategies and annual engagement plans, ensuring they are tailored to the donors’ interests, mission-centered, and coordinated with leadership involvement and organizational priorities and opportunities.
  • Produce high-quality donor communications and materials, partnering with Programs and Communications to prepare proposals, impact updates, donor briefings and reports, strategic correspondence, and leadership-level messaging.
  • Ensure accurate reporting, analytics, and revenue projections, synthesizing donor engagement metrics, portfolio movement, and pipeline health to support leadership decision-making and organizational planning.
  • Drive continuous learning and adaptive planning, integrating donor insights, event performance, campaign outcomes, and Strategic Plan benchmarks into ongoing improvements to Major Giving and Mid-level gift operations.


SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

This position supervises staff and is responsible for providing leadership, guidance, development, and performance management. Responsibilities may evolve based on organizational needs.

Leadership and Team Management

  • Provide clear direction, priorities, and performance expectations to direct reports.
  • Hold regular check-ins, monitor performance, provide timely feedback, and support professional growth.
  • Foster an inclusive, accountable, transparent, and high-performing team culture.
  • Address operational and personnel issues promptly, fairly, and in coordination with People & Culture when appropriate.

Performance and Development

  • Conduct performance reviews and identify individual and team development needs.
  • Coach and mentor staff to strengthen fundraising, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
  • Promote cross-functional learning and knowledge sharing.

Operations and Workflow

  • Manage workflows, priorities, workloads, leave, and coverage to maintain operational continuity.
  • Monitor progress, quality, and outcomes against agreed objectives.
  • Hold regular team meetings to communicate priorities, share updates, and address challenges.

Compliance and Collaboration

  • Ensure adherence to organizational policies, ethical standards, safeguarding requirements, and applicable laws.
  • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration across departments and leadership.
  • Model Equality Now’s values of integrity and accountability, inclusiveness, resilience, and empathy.


POSITION REQUIREMENTS & TARGET SKILLS PROFILE:
The Director will be thoroughly committed to Equality Now’s mission. The position requires deep subject-matter expertise, visionary leadership, and functional integration capacity. Specific requirements include:

Substantive Knowledge

  • Deep expertise in major gift fundraising, high-touch donor engagement strategies, and best practice moves management, ideally in a global nonprofit setting, with demonstrated success in securing 5–7 figure gifts from individuals and family foundations
  • Strong understanding or direct experience in event fundraising, high-touch donor engagement and strengthening development operations and workflows.
  • Familiarity with global human rights, women’s rights and gender equality funding landscapes (highly desirable). Understanding of legal, advocacy and movement building approaches is a plus.
  • Proven ability to manage, mentor and develop staff.


Communication Skills

  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Spanish, French, or Arabic is a plus.
  • Adept at fostering cross-cultural collaboration and cultivating trust-based relationships consistent with the mission and values of Equality Now.
  • Exceptional donor relationship management and communication skills, with a demonstrated aptitude for translating complex legal, financial, and programmatic concepts into compelling, polished, audience-specific decks, proposals and cases for support.
  • Strong listening, verbal and interpersonal skills to engage professionally and effectively with HNW donors, senior leadership, partners, and staff across geographies and cultures.
  • Adept at facilitating cross-functional collaboration, ensuring clarity, transparency, and strategic alignment between Development, Programs, and Finance, while fostering trust, accountability, and mutual respect across diverse and dispersed teams.


Execution Skills

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, with a focus on strategic delivery and operational excellence.
  • Proven ability to recruit, mentor, and manage staff, fellows, and consultants, fostering high-performing, accountable teams, while modeling inclusive leadership, ensuring all voices are heard, valued, and meaningfully integrated into decision-making processes.
  • Strategic and creative thinker with a record of translating vision into measurable outcomes.
  • Strong project management skills with a track record of meeting deadlines and producing high-quality deliverables in fast-paced environments.
  • Highly organized, results-oriented, and adaptable, with experience in database management (Raiser’s Edge NXT or equivalent).
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally and domestically, sometimes on short notice, to support regional teams, engage with partners, and represent Equality Now.

Targeted Specialized Knowledge

  • Bachelor's degree required, Master’s degree, Continuing Education or significant professional experience in relevant fields is highly desired (e.g., International Relations, Nonprofit Management, Public Policy, Law, Human Rights, CFRE certification, etc)
  • 10+ years of progressively responsible fundraising experience, including substantial, independent donor-facing work and staff/program management responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated success working in a global human rights, gender equality, or related international NGO context, with proven ability to navigate diverse and complex organizations is preferred.


COMPENSATION:

At Equality Now, our compensation philosophy reflects our commitment to advancing the human rights of women and girls through lasting legal and systemic change. We approach pay holistically, recognizing base salary as one part of a broader total rewards package designed to support employee wellbeing, growth, and long-term engagement.

  • Base Salary Range: $120,000–$140,000 USD


The final offer will be determined based on several factors, including geographic location, relevant experience, demonstrated skills, qualifications, and internal equity. Equality Now also provides a comprehensive total rewards package, including health and retirement benefits, generous leave, and professional development opportunities.


HOW TO APPLY:

Due to the anticipated volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.


Equality Now is strong because it is diverse. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Equality Now is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employees are selected based on their qualifications and ability, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, language, political or other opinion, nationality, ethnic or social origin, disability, pregnancy, mental status, HIV status, age, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. We welcome and value all forms of diversity.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Arondite

Arondite is a defence technology company building the foundational software and AI to power the autonomous age. Our aim is to revolutionise the way organisations collaborate with sensors, robots and autonomous systems and use the data they generate. We are driven by our determination to help defend our collective democratic values and by our strong belief that an elite group of engineers can make a big difference. We are ambitious, well‑funded and building for the long‑term.

You will join Arondite at a pivotal moment in the company’s journey. Our company is being built by exceptional engineers – people who find high‑impact and technically challenging work engaging and exciting, and who consistently deliver outsized impact. You will collaborate with other brilliant minds to solve some of the world’s hardest and most important problems.

You will have ownership and autonomy from Day One. There is no corporate ladder at Arondite. From your first day, you will directly influence the design, functionality, and direction of Arondite’s product offering. We hire the best people and give them extremely high levels of autonomy; the sky is the limit for an individual with the right ambition.

If you are motivated by our mission and if you want to be part of a growing team of outstanding people, then we want to hear from you.

You will be driving the development of software to enable autonomous systems to collaborate, process large sensor datasets, and build graphical user interfaces that involve the presentation of complex information in an intuitive way to enable tasking and control of multiple assets.

You will be expected to write high quality code that will drive the planning and execution of operations in mission‑critical environments. You will iterate closely with end users to rapidly add and improve the most relevant features to support their priorities – this may sometimes involve working outdoors and at other sites.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing, building, and testing the core software platforms and user interfaces at Arondite
  • Iterating with customers and users to better understand and implement their requirements
  • Interfacing with and testing autonomous and robotic systems in the field
  • Collaborating with engineers with diverse skill sets, including AI/ML, networking, and robotics
  • Driving a culture of excellence within the engineering team and the wider company

Experience Required:

We are open to candidates of all levels of experience, from senior engineers looking to lead a team or be a high‑value IC, to new‑grads looking to start their career with a bang.

We are looking for candidates with experience across the development stack, from frontend UX experts who delight in producing a polished and beautiful experience, to networking maestros who understand and optimise the complex topology required to support our platform (and everything in‑between).

Requirements

You should have:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical/scientific subject (or equivalent experience)
  • Strong core programming skills in either
    • Server‑side languages such as C++, Java, Rust or Python, OR
    • Front‑end development in TypeScript or JavaScript, using frameworks such as Angular or React
  • A deep enthusiasm for expanding your knowledge of a diverse technology stack

Ideally, you would also have:

This is not an additional list of requirements; this reflects the tech stack currently used at Arondite; any experience in these areas is a bonus

  • Understanding of working on embedded / resource constrained devices
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL
  • Experience of machine learning applications
  • Experience with frontend mapping frameworks (e.g., Cesium, Mapbox, Leaflet)
  • Knowledge of application security best practices and secure coding principles (e.g., OWASP Top 10)

Note: We want Arondite to bring together individuals from diverse backgrounds and perspectives. We don’t expect everyone to have experience across each of these areas. Please apply even if you only partially fulfil this list.

Right to Work

We require that all candidates have an existing Right to Work in the UK at the time of application.

Security clearance

We believe in working closely with defence customers. As a result, this role will require the individual to hold a clearance or be willing to undergo UK security vetting to Security Check (SC) or above. This normally requires having continuous residency in the UK for at least 5 years.

Office vs Hybrid working

We are focused on building a positive, collaborative engineering‑driven culture. We therefore believe in making the office a friendly, comfortable and fun place to be, and we try to work from the office where possible. Of course, there are times when it makes sense for you to work from home and that’s OK. You may also need to travel to visit customers, depending on your role. But in general you should only apply to join Arondite if you’re excited to come into the office and work in person by default.

Application process

Generally, our interview process is comprised of the following stages:

  1. CV submission with initial questions
  2. Introductory Teams call (30 mins)
  3. In‑person technical interview (1‑2 hours)
  4. Final interview with one of Arondite’s Founders (30 mins)
  • Highly competitive base salary
  • Generous equity in EMI share options in a well‑funded and growing startup
  • 7% employer pension contribution
  • Free breakfast and lunch every day; free pizza and beers weekly
  • Private health and dental insurance
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Relocation support
  • Access to any resources, equipment and training that you need to do your job in a world‑class way
  • The opportunity to work with and learn from exceptional colleagues with excellent academic experience and deep industry knowledge

title: Business Analyst - PA26AUTRQ3136
description:
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.


Job Description


Business Analyst – Role Profile

Role Purpose

The Senior Business Analyst works collaboratively across business and technology teams to analyse, design, and deliver process and system improvements. Operating within a hybrid transformation environment, the role plays a key part in defining requirements, optimising workflows, supporting intelligent automation initiatives, and ensuring high-quality delivery through structured testing and stakeholder engagement.

The role supports strategic transformation programmes across the business, including operational re-engineering, service enhancement, capacity creation, automation delivery, and the adoption of AI-powered solutions across the full trading and operational lifecycle.

In addition to supporting AI and automation initiatives, the Business Analyst is expected to utilise AI-enabled tools and techniques to accelerate business analysis, process discovery, requirements gathering, documentation production, testing activities and overall delivery execution while maintaining governance, quality and compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements & Analysis

  • Engage with stakeholders to gather, analyse, validate and document business requirements.
  • Produce clear and structured documentation including Process Design Documents (PDDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, business cases, use cases and process maps.
  • Analyse current business processes to identify inefficiencies, risks and opportunities for optimisation, automation and AI adoption.
  • Evaluate new technologies, automation opportunities and AI capabilities, ensuring strong business cases and measurable benefits.
  • Act as the bridge between business teams, technology teams, data teams and operations functions.
  • Leverage AI-powered analysis tools to accelerate requirements gathering, documentation creation and impact assessments.
  • Apply data-driven analysis techniques to identify opportunities for process improvement and business value creation.

Process & Workflow Design

  • Own the definition and design of future-state operating models and workflows.
  • Model business processes using Business Optix or equivalent process modelling platforms.
  • Facilitate workshops, interviews and discovery sessions with stakeholders across multiple business functions and locations.
  • Ensure all process changes follow appropriate governance, change control and documentation standards.
  • Take ownership of process and tool design on behalf of business stakeholders and secure approval.

Automation, AI & Agentic Capabilities

  • Support the design and delivery of RPA and intelligent automation solutions.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to integrate AI, Machine Learning, LLMs, VLMs and Agentic AI capabilities into business processes.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI for decision support, document processing, workflow orchestration, knowledge management and conversational experiences.
  • Elicit, document and validate requirements for Agentic AI solutions, including governance controls, escalation paths and human-in-the-loop processes.
  • Support the design of digital workers and multi-agent workflows that automate end-to-end business processes.
  • Work closely with Automation Developers, AI Engineers and Solution Architects to translate business needs into scalable solutions.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging automation and AI technologies and assess their applicability to business challenges.

UAT Ownership

  • Create and manage the full UAT lifecycle, including test strategies, plans, scripts and acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate UAT execution with business users and stakeholders.
  • Ensure defects are logged, triaged and resolved efficiently.
  • Validate that delivered solutions meet business, regulatory and operational requirements.
  • Leverage AI-assisted testing tools to generate test cases, test scenarios and regression coverage.
  • Support automation testing initiatives and intelligent quality assurance practices.
  • Establish traceability between requirements, testing activities and delivered outcomes.
  • Provide clear reporting on quality, risks and production readiness.

Delivery & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Support delivery teams throughout design, build, testing and implementation phases.
  • Monitor project progress and ensure alignment with business objectives and timelines.
  • Develop strong relationships across Operations, Technology, Risk and Business functions.
  • Support change adoption and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Coach stakeholders in identifying and prioritising automation and AI opportunities.
  • Promote efficient use of AI-enabled delivery tools within transformation projects.

Essential Skills & Experience

Technical & Analytical

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst within change, transformation or technology programmes.
  • Strong requirements gathering, process analysis and documentation skills.
  • Experience using Generative AI tools such as Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise or equivalent enterprise AI solutions.
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure quality and accuracy.
  • Experience with process modelling and BPM tools.
  • Experience supporting or designing RPA and automation solutions.
  • Strong analytical capability with experience using Excel, SQL, Jira and reporting tools.
  • Experience in process re-engineering and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to build business cases and conduct cost-benefit analysis.
  • Strong planning, organisation and delivery management skills.

AI & Automation Skills

  • Understanding of AI, Machine Learning, LLMs, VLMs and Agentic AI concepts.
  • Ability to identify and quantify AI opportunities within business processes.
  • Strong experience with conversational AI, copilots and intelligent automation platforms.
  • Understanding of process mining and task mining concepts.
  • Knowledge of Responsible AI principles, model limitations and governance practices.
  • Awareness of AI-related data privacy, security and compliance considerations.

Personal & Professional

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capability.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously.
  • Innovative and pragmatic problem-solving mindset.
  • Comfortable challenging assumptions and driving constructive change.
  • Self-motivated individual with strong ownership and accountability.

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Experience within Asset Management, Wealth Management, Life & Pensions or Financial Services.
  • Knowledge of UK collective investments and third-party administration models.
  • Experience working within Agile delivery environments.
  • Lean Six Sigma, ECBA, CBAP or equivalent qualifications.
  • Experience with a variety of AI platforms.
  • Exposure to process mining technologies.
  • Experience supporting Agentic AI or AI-enabled transformation programmes.
  • Exposure to development technologies such as SQL Server, C#, Java, VBA, HTML or CSS.
  • Experience with Blue Prism, UiPath or equivalent automation technologies.

Job Title

Director, Data Engineering Delivery

Job Description Summary

Reporting to the Global Head of Data Architecture & Engineering, the Director of Data Engineering Delivery will be a member of the Global Data Leadership team and will help shape data engineering strategy, standards, and execution across the organization. The role requires fluency with Databricks and the Azure ecosystem today, and the adaptability to evaluate and adopt additional data technologies as our platform evolves.

The Director of Data Engineering Delivery will be equally comfortable managing the deliverables and pipeline of work for a team of data engineers as they are building data platforms and developing the engineers who build on them. This is a hybrid technical and people leadership role: the successful candidate will lead, mentor, and grow a team of 5–8 data engineers and analysts whilst also contributing hands-on to data engineering deliverables on Databricks and Azure.

Job Description

Technical Leadership

  • Platform ownership: Lead the design, build, and continuous improvement of scalable data pipelines, Lakehouse architectures, and data products on Databricks and Azure, ensuring our engineering and architectural standards for performance, reliability, and cost are consistently delivered.
  • Hands-on contribution: Remain an active practitioner by contributing to high-impact pipelines, code reviews, architecture reviews, and complex troubleshooting.
  • Quality and governance: Champion data quality, observability, security, and governance practices, embedding them into the team’s engineering lifecycle and platform standards.

People Leadership

  • Team management: Directly manage a team of 5–8 data engineers, owning hiring, onboarding, performance management, compensation recommendations, and retention.
  • Coaching and development: Provide regular coaching, feedback, and career development planning for each team member, with clear growth paths for both individual contributor and leadership tracks.
  • Culture and engagement: Foster an inclusive, high-trust team culture grounded in psychological safety, technical curiosity, accountability, and continuous learning.

Project and Work Orchestration

  • Delivery ownership: Plan, prioritize, and orchestrate the team’s portfolio of data engineering work, ensuring on-time, on-quality delivery aligned with global data and business priorities.
  • Agile execution: Establish and refine agile delivery practices (intake, estimation, sprint planning, retrospectives) that balance discovery work, platform investment, and run-the-business commitments.
  • Risk and dependency management: Proactively identify, communicate, and resolve risks, blockers, and cross-team dependencies, escalating clearly and constructively when needed.
  • Operational excellence: Own production health for the team’s data products, including SLAs, on-call posture, incident response, and post-incident learning.

Stakeholder Management and Cross Team Collaboration

  • Business partnership: Build trusted relationships with business and technology stakeholders, translating their objectives into clearly scoped, prioritized data engineering outcomes.
  • Global team collaboration: Partner closely with peers across the Global Data Leadership team - architecture, data engineering, AI, governance, and product - to deliver cohesive, end-to-end data solutions.

title: Magazijnmedewerker (24-32 uur)
description:
Magazijnmedewerker

Ben jij een gedreven teamspeler met een passie voor logistiek en wil je deel uit maken van ons keukenteam? Dan hebben we de perfecte kans voor jou! Ga dan aan de slag als keukenhulp bij het allerleukste familiebedrijf van Nederland!


WAT GA JE DAN PRECIES DOEN?
Als magazijnmedewerker is er bij Van der Valk meer mogelijk dan je denkt. Bij ons leer je wat gastvrijheid is: wij zeggen geen nee, maar bieden een alternatief. Daarnaast zijn er volop kansen om door te groeien en kun je bij ons flexibele (horeca)uren werken. En:

  • Je ontvangt, controleer en slaat leveringen op in het magazijn, de koelingen en de vriezer;

  • Je houdt het magazijn en overige opslagplaatsen netjes, schoon en overzichtelijk;

  • Je zorgt voor een overzichtelijke indeling en je werkt efficient bij het opruimen van de leveringen;

  • Je geeft door als producten bijna op zijn


WAAROM PAST DEZE BAAN BIJ JOU?
Je zit vol met energie en vindt het leuk om met het team te zorgen voor een goed draaiende keuken. Je bent vriendelijk tegen je collega’s. Gastvrijheid betekent voor jou nét die stap extra zetten om ervoor te zorgen dat onze gasten het hotel verlaten met een glimlach. En:

  • Je kunt efficient en ordelijk werken;

  • Je kunt goed in teamverband werken, maar ook zelfstandig;

  • Je hebt oog voor detail;

  • Je bent communicatief- en sociaalvaardig.


WAAROM WE BIJ VAN DER VALK STRALEN

Werken bij Van der Valk betekent: werken in de meest sfeervolle omgeving, de leukste collega’s en volop doorgroeimogelijkheden. We werken hard om ervoor te zorgen dat gasten een fantastisch verblijf ervaren. Natuurlijk maken we ook veel plezier met elkaar! Daarnaast kan je in ieder geval rekenen op:

  • De mogelijkheid om parttime te werken;

  • Alleo app, waarin je punten spaart die je kunt besteden bij Van der Valk maar ook bij vele andere bedrijven;

  • 30 % korting bij de restaurants van Van der Valk International;

  • Hotel overnachting tegen een speciaal personeelstarief;

  • Een sportschool abonnement/bedrijfsfitness, tegen een kleine vergoeding van 10 euro per maand;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden


LEER ONS KENNEN!

Van der Valk Hotel ’s-Hertogenbosch-Vught maakt onderdeel uit van het grootste horeca familiebedrijf van Nederland. Dit hotel valt met een aantal andere hotels in het binnen- en buitenland onder de holding Van der Valk International (VDVI). Onder VDVI vallen 10 hotels in Nederland: Hotel Noordwijk, Hotel Hoorn, Hotel Amersfoort- A1, Hotel Leusden-Amersfoort, Hotel Tiel, Hotel ‘s-Hertogenbosch-Vught en Hotel Nuland-‘s-Hertogenbosch, Hotel Gorinchem A27, Hotel Gorinchem A15 en Hotel Lelystad. Wat leuk dat je enthousiast bent geworden van deze functie! Tijd om te solliciteren! Heb je nog vragen dan kun je bellen met 073-6587706.

Hopelijk tot snel!

title: Junior Strategy & Transformation Consultant
description:
De rol binnen CowManager

CowManager levert koemonitoringsystemen aan professionele melkvee- en vleesveebedrijven wereldwijd. We zijn een tech scale-up met 250+ medewerkers, actief in meer dan 40 landen en met entiteiten in onder andere Nederland, de VS, Nieuw-Zeeland, Duitsland en het VK. We zien volop kansen in de markt en hebben grote internationale groeiambities. Die groei brengt continu nieuwe strategische en transformatievraagstukken met zich mee.

Als Junior Strategy & Transformation Consultant word je onderdeel van het Strategy & Transformation team, bestaande uit de Head of Strategy & Transformation en twee Strategy & Transformation Leads. Samen met het managementteam werk je aan de strategie van CowManager, ondersteun je strategische besluitvorming en help je belangrijke transformaties van begin tot eind te realiseren.

De projecten zijn zeer divers. Je werkt bijvoorbeeld aan het ontwikkelen en vertalen van meerjarenstrategieën naar concrete plannen, waaronder go-to-marketplannen voor verschillende landen. Ook werk je aan het optimaliseren van het operating model, nieuwe productlanceringen en operationele verbeteringen die bijdragen aan schaalbaarheid, efficiëntie en duurzame groei. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met teams als Product en Commerce en krijg je steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid voor strategische vraagstukken en transformaties.

“Wat deze functie voor mij zo leuk maakt, is de combinatie van vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte om te leren. Je krijgt de kans om zelf initiatief te nemen, ideeën van A tot Z op te pakken en je eigen stempel te drukken. Tegelijkertijd kun je altijd terugvallen op je team en manager om te sparren, samen te werken en van elkaar te leren.”

– Liselotte Nellestijn, Strategy & Transformation Lead

Wat je gaat doen

  • Meewerken aan de strategie van CowManager en deze vertalen naar concrete plannen en initiatieven;

  • Het managementteam ondersteunen bij strategische besluitvorming, bijvoorbeeld over nieuwe platformen, uitbreiding van productiecapaciteit of het betreden van nieuwe markten;

  • Strategische transformatieprojecten end-to-end managen, van initiatie tot implementatie;

  • Samenwerken aan strategische en operationele vraagstukken binnen onder andere Commerce, Product Management en Finance;

  • Draagvlak creëren en interne en externe stakeholders betrekken, bijvoorbeeld door werksessies te faciliteren, belangen samen te brengen en af te stemmen met teams en management;

  • Ons bedrijf en de markt analyseren om datagedreven besluitvorming te ondersteunen, bijvoorbeeld door de winstgevendheid van verschillende kanalen te analyseren en hierover te adviseren;

  • In de modder staan om verandering daadwerkelijk te realiseren, zowel op ons hoofdkantoor in Harmelen als in de landen waar we actief zijn.

Wie ben jij?

Een innovatieve, internationale en snelgroeiende organisatie spreekt je aan en je krijgt energie van de kans om bij te dragen aan de verdere groei van CowManager. Verder heb je:

  • Een hbo- of wo-diploma op het gebied van strategie, bedrijfskunde of een ander relevant vakgebied;

  • 1–3 jaar relevante werkervaring waarin je een strategische toolkit hebt opgebouwd;

  • Conceptueel denkvermogen en sterke analytische vaardigheden;

  • Affiniteit met technologie en digitale oplossingen. Ervaring met hardware, productontwikkeling of digitale oplossingen in de agrarische markt is een pré;

  • Het vermogen om makkelijk met verschillende stakeholders te communiceren en mensen mee te nemen, in zowel het Nederlands als Engels;

  • Een pragmatische en proactieve aanpak en de drive om resultaten te boeken én te borgen;

  • Enthousiasme om te werken binnen een snelgroeiende organisatie in de agricultuur.

Wat wij bieden

  • Een afwisselende functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf;

  • De kans om direct impact te maken en samen te werken met C-level stakeholders;

  • Een salaris tussen €3.900 en €4.600 bruto per maand o.b.v. fulltime, exclusief 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Een variabele eindejaarsbonus tot 10% van het jaarsalaris;

  • Een pensioenplan waarvan CowManager 2/3 betaalt;

  • 25 verlofdagen op basis van 40 uur, met de mogelijkheid extra dagen bij te kopen;

  • Kilometervergoeding voor woon-werk- en zakelijk verkeer;

  • Jaarlijks €250 netto vitaliteitsbudget op basis van 40 uur;

  • €500 budget voor een ergonomische thuiswerkplek;

  • Een bijzondere werkplek met uitzicht op de weide en onze koeien.

Hoe ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit?

Na je aanmelding beoordeelt ons recruitmentteam jouw profiel en volgt bij een positieve evaluatie een korte telefonische kennismaking. Daarna heb je een eerste gesprek met directe collega’s uit het team, inclusief een korte case om je analytisch vermogen en strategisch inzicht te toetsen. Het tweede gesprek is met collega’s uit het managementteam. Na een positief proces volgt een aanbod en hopen we je snel bij CowManager te verwelkomen.

title: Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) Operator
description:
The Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) Operator serves as a centralized operational hub for monitoring systems and safety infrastructure across all JD North America store locations. Operating within a 24/7 high-volume monitoring environment, the GSOC Operator leverages modern surveillance platforms, environmental telemetry, and real-time communication tools to safeguard store personnel, customers, physical assets, and inventory.

This position demands constant situational awareness, rapid incident verification, seamless coordination with emergency services, and meticulous enforcement of corporate security and data privacy policies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Systems & Video Monitoring: Continuously monitor video surveillance cameras, environmental sensors, LVT, smoke systems, and intrusion alarm systems across all North American store locations to maintain 24/7 situational awareness.

  • Alarm Verification & Incident Response: Verify alarms remotely via live video feeds and sensor data to eliminate false alarm calls, and initiate immediate action for break-ins, unauthorized access, or suspicious activities.

  • Breakfix: Coordinate and track breakfix tickets for malfunctioning security hardware, cameras, alarms, and store access systems, liaising with field technicians and vendors to ensure rapid resolution.

  • CCTV View Approvals: Review, process, and approve or escalate requests for CCTV footage and live view access in strict compliance with company privacy and legal guidelines.

  • Assigned Auditing: Conduct routine compliance and operational audits (such as alarm testing, camera coverage checks, and access log reviews) as assigned by the SOC Supervisor.

  • Emergency Coordination: Function as a primary point of contact during emergencies to coordinate directly with local law enforcement and emergency services.

  • Access Control & Asset Tracking: Manage access control cards, alarm user permissions, store keyholders, and monitor GPS trackers on targeted stock items to assist with theft recovery.

  • Remote Delivery Support & Safety: Provide remote oversight for out-of-hours store deliveries by unsetting alarms, opening shutters, and monitoring lone delivery drivers.

  • Field Safety & CCTV Requests: Action CCTV retrieval and access requests centrally while monitoring field team body cameras to ensure staff safety.

  • Threat Communication: Utilize two-way audio talk-down capabilities to communicate directly with potential threats on-site when necessary.

  • Crisis Management Support: Assist as an operational hub during critical incidents, natural disasters, or civil unrest to support business continuity.

Qualifications

  • Experience: Experience operating within a Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), central monitoring station, retail asset protection environment, or emergency dispatch center is ideal, but not required.

  • Technical Skills: Hands-on proficiency with Video Management Systems (VMS), physical access control software, alarm monitoring dashboards, GPS asset tracking platforms, and ticketing systems.

  • Regulatory Compliance: Comprehensive understanding of video surveillance ethics, data privacy compliance, evidence handling standards, and retail security protocols.

  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication capabilities, with demonstrated composure when broadcasting live talk-down advisories or relaying details to emergency responders.

  • Schedule Flexibility: Ability to work flexible shifts, including overnight, weekend, and holiday rotations in a 24/7/365 operational setup.

Core Competencies

  • Situational Awareness: Maintains continuous focus across multiple display arrays to detect anomalies and identify security risks before escalation.

  • Decisiveness & Emergency Response: Rapidly assesses live telemetry and video footage under high-pressure scenarios to execute appropriate response protocols.

  • Technical Troubleshooting: Efficiently identifies hardware/software failures and oversees vendor maintenance to preserve total security coverage.

  • Data Integrity & Confidentiality: Manages sensitive video feeds, access permissions, and personal data with strict adherence to company guidelines.

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
Your mission will be to verify and validate flight software throughout its development lifecycle, ensuring that every software component performs safely, reliably, and predictably in the demanding conditions of space operations. You will work closely with software and systems engineers to define verification strategies, automate testing activities, and identify issues before they become mission risks.In an environment where systems must operate autonomously and reliably once deployed, your work will be essential to mission success.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain verification and validation plans for embedded software running on FreeRTOS-based platforms.
  • Create and execute unit, integration, and system-level test cases.
  • Develop and maintain automated test frameworks and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Verify real-time performance, including task scheduling, interrupt latency, deadlines, memory usage, and synchronization mechanisms.
  • Execute test campaigns on target hardware, engineering models, and simulation environments.
  • Analyze software failures, perform root cause investigations, and collaborate with developers to resolve issues.
  • Measure and report test coverage, requirements traceability, and software quality metrics.
  • Conduct robustness and fault-injection testing, including communication failures, memory corruption scenarios, watchdog behavior, and recovery procedures.
  • Support compliance with applicable aerospace software engineering and quality standards.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes, automation tools, and verification methodologies.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 2–5 years of experience in embedded software development or software testing.
  • Hands-on experience with FreeRTOS or another Real-Time Operating System (RTOS).
  • Strong programming skills in C and ability to analyze complex embedded software codebases.
  • Experience using Python for test automation and tooling development.
  • Practical experience with hardware debugging and laboratory instrumentation, including JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and serial interfaces.
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD environments such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar.
  • Knowledge of embedded communication protocols including SpaceWire, CAN, I2C, SPI, and UART.
  • Professional working proficiency in English.
Nice to Have
  • Previous experience in flight software, spacecraft systems, propulsion systems, or safety-critical environments.
  • Familiarity with ECSS, DO-178C, IEC 61508, or comparable standards.
  • Knowledge of static analysis tools and coding standards such as MISRA C, Polyspace, LDRA, cppcheck, or VectorCAST.
  • Experience with ARM Cortex-M architectures, memory maps, and Memory Protection Units (MPU).
  • Experience with platform emulation, simulation, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), or Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) environments.
  • Familiarity with requirements and traceability tools such as DOORS, Polarion, or Jama.
  • Previous experience in the space, aerospace, or defense sectors.
What We Offer
  • The opportunity to contribute directly to cutting-edge space technologies and real missions.
  • A highly technical and collaborative environment where engineers have a direct impact on product and architecture decisions.
  • Access to hardware, testing facilities, and end-to-end system development activities.
  • Professional growth within a fast-growing New Space company.
  • Specialized training in aerospace standards, verification methodologies, and advanced engineering tools.
  • The chance to help shape the future of space transportation and in-orbit operations.

title: Hoofduitvoerder nieuwbouw
description:
Geef leiding aan de bouw van 531 studentenwoningen in Nijmegen. Als Hoofduitvoerder bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht stuur je een omvangrijk binnenstedelijk nieuwbouwproject aan, direct naast station Nijmegen-Lent. Een unieke kans om mee te bouwen aan een toekomstbestendige woonomgeving én aan een organisatie die volop groeit in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw en vastgoedontwikkeling.


Dit wordt jouw baan

Als hoofduitvoerder bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht werk je aan projecten die zichtbaar impact maken op de leefomgeving van morgen. Een mooi voorbeeld daarvan is de realisatie van 531 studenteneenheden aan de Spoorstraat in Nijmegen, direct naast station Nijmegen-Lent. Een omvangrijke binnenstedelijke nieuwbouwontwikkeling bestaande uit drie gebouwen met 300 zelfstandige studio's, een woontoren met 77 groepswoningen, gezamenlijke voorzieningen en groene buitenruimtes. Een project waarin techniek, logistiek, veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking samenkomen en waar studenten straks prettig kunnen wonen, studeren en ontmoeten.

Sinds begin dit jaar zijn we uitgegroeid van een renovatiespecialist naar een brede Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast onze vertrouwde renovatie- en transformatieprojecten bouwen we volop aan woningbouw-, utiliteits- en ontwikkelprojecten. Dat betekent een gevarieerde portefeuille met uitdagende projecten in Midden-Nederland én volop kansen voor ervaren uitvoerders die willen meebouwen aan onze groei.

Als hoofduitvoerder ben jij eindverantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van één of meerdere projecten. Je bewaakt de planning, kwaliteit, veiligheid en voortgang en zorgt ervoor dat alle betrokken partijen als één team samenwerken. Daarbij ben je zichtbaar aanwezig op de bouwplaats en weet je precies wat er speelt bij jouw collega's, onderaannemers en bouwpartners.

Je creëert een werkomgeving waarin veiligheid, vakmanschap en samenwerking centraal staan. Ook wanneer de druk toeneemt, houd jij het overzicht en zorg je voor focus binnen het team. Je krijgt daarbij veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om jouw project naar een succesvolle oplevering te leiden.

Wat deze functie extra interessant maakt, is de fase waarin onze organisatie zich bevindt. Je werkt niet alleen aan aansprekende projecten zoals de studentenhuisvesting in Nijmegen, maar ook aan woningbouw-, utiliteits-, renovatie- en transformatieprojecten die de komende jaren het gezicht van Midden-Nederland bepalen. Hier bouw je niet alleen aan mooie projecten, maar ook aan de toekomst van Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Hier zit je op jouw plek

Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling.

Dat betekent dat je terechtkomt in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. Met ruim 100 collega's binnen onze werkmaatschappij bouwen we niet alleen aan duurzame woningen, utiliteitsprojecten en leefomgevingen, maar ook aan de toekomst van onze eigen organisatie. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen.

Hier krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar midden in een frisse organisatie die zich verder ontwikkelt en waarin ondernemerschap, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Samen bouwen we aan projecten waar we trots op zijn én aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst.

Dit breng jij mee

Jij bent een leider op de bouwplaats. Iemand die overzicht houdt, rust brengt wanneer het spannend wordt en altijd weet waar de prioriteiten liggen. Veiligheid staat voor jou nooit ter discussie. Je bent zichtbaar aanwezig, spreekt mensen aan waar nodig en creëert een cultuur waarin veilig werken vanzelfsprekend is.

Daarnaast krijg je energie van het realiseren van complexe projecten en het bouwen aan sterke teams. Je weet hoe je mensen motiveert, verantwoordelijkheid geeft en samen resultaten behaalt waar iedereen trots op is. Juist in een omgeving die volop in ontwikkeling is, voel jij je thuis. Je denkt mee, ziet kansen en helpt onze organisatie verder groeien.

Verder breng je mee:

-Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding richting Bouwkunde of vergelijkbaar;

-Ruime ervaring als zelfstandig uitvoerder of hoofduitvoerder binnen woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, renovatie of transformatie;

-Het vermogen om meerdere disciplines, bouwpartners en collega's succesvol te verbinden rondom één gezamenlijk doel;

-Natuurlijk leiderschap en de vaardigheid om teams te coachen, ontwikkelen en inspireren;

-Een sterk gevoel voor planning, kwaliteit, veiligheid en kostenbewust bouwen;

-Een gestructureerde manier van werken en het vermogen om ook onder druk het overzicht te bewaren;

-Affiniteit met digitale bouwprocessen en moderne hulpmiddelen die bijdragen aan een efficiënte uitvoering;

-Ervaring met BIM, KYP Project of vergelijkbare systemen is een pré.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're hiring a Senior Data Engineer to own our data platform and build the infrastructure supporting operational analytics, governance, and emerging AI capabilities. If you love designing elegant data systems, thrive with autonomy, and want to make a meaningful impact at scale, this role is for you.

You'll work end-to-end on data pipeline architecture, design systems that scale, and collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure data quality, security, and performance. This is a high-ownership role where you'll shape technical decisions, mentor through collaboration, and contribute to broader platform architecture.

This is a fixed-term contract role, 12 months engagement.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end design and delivery of data pipelines, from ingestion to transformation to serving
  • Design data models and storage architectures that support both operational and analytical workloads
  • Build and maintain infrastructure for data quality, observability, and governance
  • Contribute to broader product and platform architecture, working alongside other software engineers as priorities shift
  • Design systems that are extensible enough to support AI/retrieval-based features over time
  • Contribute significantly to key technical decisions, escalating trade-offs where they intersect with broader priorities
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on platform and deployment decisions
  • Work with attention to data sensitivity and system constraints in a regulated environment

What We're Looking For

  • 5–7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of production data systems end-to-end
  • Strong data engineering fundamentals: ETL/ELT pipeline design, data modeling, batch and streaming processing
  • Strong proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language, with a track record of building production-grade backend systems
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: API design, system architecture, ability to work across the stack when needed
  • Experience working with cloud-native data platforms or lakehouse architectures
  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and taking a leading role in technical decisions
  • Strong communication skills; able to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders

Bonus

  • Experience with Databricks, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, or similar lakehouse tooling
  • Experience building data pipelines to support retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or other AI/ML workflows (embedding generation, vector store population)
  • Experience in public sector or other regulated environments with data sensitivity requirements
  • Experience with cloud-native deployment platforms
  • Relevant technical certifications or technical assessment scores with dates

title: Regional Planner/Scheduler
description:
Job Title

Regional Planner/Scheduler

Job Description Summary

Job Description

This role combines the responsibilities of the Planner/Scheduler, CMMS Administrator, and Inventory Management Specialist. Primarily responsible for receiving all written and electronic customer work requests, verifying completeness of all entries, entering information into the CMMS, determining appropriate supervisor, and assigning work orders. The Regional Planner/Scheduler plans and schedules work utilizing the computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS, etc) and standard procedures to optimize maintenance resource utilization and productivity. Responsible for effective configuration and utilization of the CMMS, including data capture, backlog management, labor management/resource productivity, performance reporting, material management, etc. as required to meet the strategic long-term objectives of the RME (reliability, maintenance and engineering) team.

Team spirit and commitment to customer service is required.


This position is responsible for managing all activities related to planning and scheduling operations, maintenance, and engineering resources by performing the following duties personally or through subordinate supervisors

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Schedule maintenance activities including service requests and preventive/corrective maintenance. Work closely with the account. Management team to ensure effects on operations are recognized, well planned and coordinated. Develop, generate and disseminate the maintenance schedule.
  • Analyze maintenance and project resource requirements and assign mechanical, electrical, and engineering services as required. Identify resources and materials required to execute the requested work.
  • Coordinate maintenance activities and details with other departments, preparing specifications and work packages. (Work packages include materials, labor, special tools/equipment and written procedures to insure a safe & efficient working environment. Where Work Permits are required, verify completeness and include with work packages.)
  • Ensure the work packages are complete and all materials, labor and equipment are available prior to scheduling work. Ensure plans, schedules and resources needed are well-defined, documented and meet customer requirements. Perform QA function in work order process.
  • Maintain a comprehensive backlog of all maintenance activity by work type (CMMS). Recognize the priority of the work order backlog and re-schedule when appropriate seeking direction from the Work Manager.
  • Maintain an accurate asset registry within the CMMS.
  • Communicates with Building Manager/Requester to determine total scope of work and priority of the project or service request work to be performed. Submits written notifications to Building Managers to coordinate upcoming shutdowns.
  • Administers the preventative maintenance tracking and documentation programs, assigns and distributes the work to the appropriate supervisor, reviews scope and frequency of assignments with the supervisor and makes changes where required.
  • Acts as a contact/liaison between O&M staff and the requesting department for the planning and scheduling of work performed by O&M site team.
  • Reviews monthly performance reports for accuracy and make corrections when necessary. Ensures all established costs, quality, and delivery commitments are met. Reviews production and operating reports and highlights the resolution of operational and maintenance problems.

OTHER ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS / DUTIES:

  • Collaborate with the account management team and client management team to identify, develop, and deploy best practices (i.e. safety, quality control, training, standards and qualifications, maintenance practices, etc.).
  • Attend daily/weekly meetings to develop the next day/week's schedule, reviews the status of scheduled work orders, and discusses new, incoming work orders.
  • Recommend and arrange alternatives for resource schedule constraints - eg. change assignments, over-time, utilization of 3rd party.
  • May estimate job requirements for preventative maintenance activities including number/type of O&M staff to be assigned and number of man-hours per task.
  • May identify opportunities to improve process, planning or performance through analysis of work order flow, project demands and expectations. May review utilization and cost data to recommend corrective actions to reduce costs.
  • Perform administrative activities associated with the effective management of operations, including compiling, storing and retrieving data for reports.
  • Other duties as assigned

JOB FUNCTIONS: PERCENTAGE OF TIME SPENT BY CATEGORY

SAFETY 10%

PJHAs / Observations / Communications / Permits

PERFORM ASSIGNED TASKS / ADMINISTRATIVE

Job estimating, Work Order Completion / Feedback 65%

Customer Relations

Maintain daily job status update system and scheduling

MEETINGS 20%

Safety, Planning/Scheduling, Employee(s), Customer

BREAKS/LUNCH 5%

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each job duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

Education:

  • High school/GED with equivalent experience; Associates degree in maintenance technology, preferred.

Skills:

  • Good oral/written communication skills and possess tact.
  • Time management skills.
  • Strong administrative and mathematical skills with willingness to handle paperwork.
  • Have a working knowledge of personal computers. Able to navigate CMMS and MS Excel.
  • Have good planning and organizational skills.
  • Ability to understand what constitutes good instructions.
  • Able to read blueprints and shop drawings.
  • Understanding of the proper use of work orders, priorities, scheduling, etc.
  • Ability to keep multiple jobs in controlled motion—simultaneously.
  • Style and capability commanding respect within both maintenance and operating organizations.


Cushman & Wakefield also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health, vision, and dental insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life, and disability insurance programs, and paid and unpaid time away from work. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, Cushman and Wakefield provide eligible employees with competitive pay, which may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, total hours worked, job type, business line, and applicability of collective bargaining agreements.


The compensation that will be offered to the successful candidate will depend on factors such as whether the position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement, the geographic area in which the work will be performed, market pay rates in that area, and the candidate’s experience and qualifications.


The company will not pay less than minimum wage for this role.

title: Cash Processor
description:
