title: Salesforce Developer
description:
About NomuPay

Founded in 2021, NomuPay is on a mission to be the world’s preferred global payments partner.

We help businesses thrive at scale by simplifying the complexities of cross-border payments and empowering merchants to expand globally with ease. Through strategic acquisitions, including Total Processing in 2023, we’ve built an all-in-one payments solution that brings together pay-ins, payouts and acquiring capabilities through a single, seamless platform.

Today, we support businesses across multiple markets and industries, from e-commerce and marketplaces to enterprises with complex payment requirements.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a Salesforce Developer to help us build, evolve and scale a business-critical Salesforce platform.

The Role

This is a hands-on development role where you’ll work across both Salesforce development and configuration, choosing the right technical approach to solve business problems.

You’ll work closely with teams across Product, Operations, Risk, Sales and Technology, turning business requirements into scalable, secure and reliable Salesforce solutions.

You’ll also play an important role in helping us mature our Salesforce engineering practices, including development standards, testing, source control, CI/CD and release management.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build, test and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions using both programmatic and declarative capabilities.
  • Develop high-quality Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC), while maintaining and modernising legacy components where appropriate.
  • Configure and enhance Salesforce using custom objects and fields, page layouts, metadata, Flow, validation rules and other declarative automation.
  • Build, maintain and optimise secure REST API integrations between Salesforce and third-party applications.
  • Monitor integrations, troubleshoot issues, implement effective error handling and maintain clear technical documentation.
  • Work closely with Product, Operations, Risk, Sales and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical and reliable solutions.
  • Own development through the full lifecycle, from technical design and development through to testing, release, production support and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to a robust Salesforce engineering practice through source control, automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD and effective deployment processes.
  • Apply strong data, access and security principles across the Salesforce platform.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve development speed and quality while maintaining accountability for testing, security, code quality and production readiness.

What We're Looking For

  • 5–7 years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, with a strong track record of delivering production solutions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong technical experience with Apex, triggers, asynchronous processing, Lightning Web Components, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, SOQL/SOSL and Flow.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce development best practices and the ability to combine code with declarative configuration.
  • Demonstrable experience across Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.
  • Strong experience building and supporting REST API integrations with third-party systems.
  • Good understanding of Salesforce governor limits, platform performance and the Salesforce security model.
  • Experience with permission sets, profiles, roles, sharing rules and secure access design.
  • Experience with source-driven development and Salesforce CI/CD, including automated testing, code review, deployment and release processes.
  • Practical experience using AI coding assistants to improve development efficiency and quality.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II; Platform Developer certification is also valued where supported by strong hands-on experience.
  • Certifications in Platform Development Lifecycle and Deployment Architect or Platform Integration Architect.
  • Experience with Salesforce DX, Salesforce CLI and Git-based workflows.
  • Experience with modern CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with integration middleware or event-driven integrations.
  • Previous experience working within financial services, fintech or payments.
  • Experience improving Salesforce engineering or delivery practices, including mentoring or coaching colleagues.
  • Exposure to Salesforce DevOps and release-management platforms.

Why Join NomuPay?

This is an opportunity to have a genuine impact on a platform that is central to how our business operates.

You’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Own and shape a business-critical Salesforce platform, with the freedom to improve how we build and deliver.
  • Work directly with stakeholders across Product, Operations, Risk, Sales and Technology.
  • Influence how Salesforce development, integration, testing and deployment practices evolve across NomuPay.
  • Work on meaningful, high-impact projects within a growing global payments business.
  • Join a nimble, ambitious and mission-driven team where your work can make a visible and lasting difference.

If you're a Salesforce Developer who enjoys solving complex problems, improving engineering standards and building technology that genuinely supports a growing business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Head of Risk & Decisioning
description:
About Olea:

Olea is a digital infrastructure platform that connects global liquidity with trade and supply chain opportunities, fueling growth and unlocking potential worldwide. Olea has diverse liquidity pools with varying appetite and focuses. Olea’s vision is to connect capital to opportunity. It has a strong conviction in the role of trade to support sustainable economic development across countries, particularly emerging markets, particularly Asia where many smaller suppliers are based. Olea supports suppliers and buyers in over 70 corridors.



Role summary:

We are seeking a highly analytical, commercially minded and technically fluent leader to establish and lead Olea's Risk & Decisioning function. In this role, you will lead the evolution of Olea's decision infrastructure: from traditional quantitative credit risk models and analytical tools through to AI-native decision-support systems. The role is accountable for improving the quality, consistency, speed and transparency of decisions across Olea's pre-trade, at-trade and post-trade workflows. The Head of Risk & Decisioning will partner closely with the CRO, Commercial, Legal, Compliance and Operations stakeholders while working closely with Product Engineering, Data & AI Operations and other tech teams to ensure that Olea's data, models and AI agents are translated into measurable business impact while remaining explainable, auditable and aligned to risk appetite.

Responsibilities:



  • Leadership: Establish and lead the Risk & Decisioning unit (within Technology) serving as the product owner translating CRO-defined risk appetite, product requirements and expert judgement into scalable risk controls. Move fluidly between policy interpretation, model design, data requirements, AI-agent evaluation, implementation and executive communication.

  • Trusted decisioning infrastructure. Combine risk expertise, quantitative methods with operating discipline to build a trusted decision layer for Olea. Establish standards governing the methodology, validation, governance and performance expectations of Olea’s risk analytics applications including Olea’s proprietary credit risk models. Own the design, requirements, development and continuous improvement of Olea’s emerging AI agent workforce encompassing risk, legal, compliance and commercial decision-support agents.

  • Governance & controls. Ensure every model, agent and decision the team produces is traceable, explainable, auditable and designed to support accountable, human decision-making.
    Define success measures, controls and escalation pathways for each agent. Establish lifecycle standards for model and agent development.

  • Cross-team collaboration & value realisation. Partner closely with business stakeholders and provide direction to Product Engineering and Platform teams to ensure decisioning capabilities are implemented, operationalized, monitored and continuously improved in production. Operate with a product lens, translating business priorities into roadmaps, adoption and measurable business outcomes.



  • Technical mentoring & culture. Guide and support risk & engineering colleagues to develop the next generation of data science & AI engineering talent. Mentor and guide colleagues to elevate data and AI literacy across the organization.

Role specific technical competencies:

  • Leadership & industry experience: 8+ years of experience building analytical products, machine learning or AI-enabled capabilities that delivered measurable business outcomes preferably within financial services, transaction banking, fintech, or trade finance. Domain expertise in credit, counterparty and structural risk across cross-border trade, supply chain finance, invoice financing or factoring is an advantage.
  • Technical excellence. Hands-on experience developing & implementing credit risk models (PD, LGD, EAD), risk analytics solutions and/or other AI-enabled decision-making capabilities. Strong understanding of statistical modelling, machine learning, model governance and modern AI evaluation approaches including governing AI agents and agentic workflow is required. Experience with fraud detection, anomaly monitoring and/or use of alternative data sources is an advantage.
  • Engineering capabilities. Strong proficiency in Python, SQL and modern data engineering practices. Familiarity with AI-native workflows and building applications using technologies such as TypeScript, FastAPI, Postgres and Docker on cloud-native platforms is strongly preferred. Experience deploying models in a production environment is an advantage.
  • Communication skills. Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to document and explain modelling methodology, AI capabilities, limitations and business implications clearly, concisely and in an actionable manner to non-technical audiences.
  • People leadership. Experience leading or mentoring small technical or analytical teams.

Qualifications (training, licences, memberships and certifications):

  • An advanced degree (or a bachelor’s degree with first class honors) in a quantitative discipline such as Data Science, Statistics, Biostatistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Finance, Economics or a related field of study.

Note:

Olea is committed to diversity and inclusion. By providing equal opportunities we foster a work environment which embraces diversity and gets the best out of the broadest spectrum of people to sustain business performance and competitive advantage. We build an inclusive culture by demonstrating respect for each other’s unique strengths and perspectives to enable every employee to develop a sense of belonging and have the opportunity to maximise their potential.

title: Real Estate Agent
description:
Job Title – Real Estate Agent

Location: Dubai, UAE

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Real Estate Agent to support property buyers, sellers, and investors across the Dubai real estate market.

The role will involve generating leads, understanding client requirements, presenting suitable residential and investment properties, arranging property viewings, negotiating transactions, and managing clients throughout the sales process. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of the Dubai property market, excellent communication skills, and a proactive approach to business development.

The role will cover opportunities across apartments, villas, townhouses, luxury residences, off-plan projects, and investment properties, with a strong focus on delivering transparent and client-focused property advisory.

Key Responsibilities

Sales & Business Development

  • Generate new property sales opportunities through cold calling, networking, referrals, social media, property portals, events, and personal contacts.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective buyers, investors, sellers, and property owners.
  • Respond promptly to inbound enquiries and qualify leads based on budget, location, property type, and investment objectives.
  • Develop new client relationships and consistently expand the personal sales network.
  • Follow up with prospects regularly and convert qualified leads into property transactions.
  • Achieve monthly and quarterly sales and revenue targets.

Client Consultation & Property Advisory

  • Understand clients' property requirements, financial objectives, preferred locations, and timelines.
  • Recommend suitable properties based on client needs, budget, lifestyle preferences, and investment objectives.
  • Provide accurate information regarding property specifications, pricing, payment plans, availability, and transaction processes.
  • Explain relevant market information and comparable properties to support informed client decisions.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Dubai communities, property values, new developments, and market activity.

Property Sales & Viewings

  • Arrange and conduct property viewings for prospective buyers and investors.
  • Present property features, amenities, location benefits, and investment considerations professionally.
  • Coordinate with developers, property owners, landlords, and other brokers to arrange access to properties.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of available ready and off-plan inventory.
  • Identify suitable alternatives when a property does not meet the client's requirements.
  • Follow up after viewings to understand client feedback and progress the opportunity.

Off-Plan & Developer Sales

  • Develop knowledge of upcoming and existing off-plan projects across Dubai.
  • Maintain awareness of developer launches, inventory, pricing, payment plans, and promotional offers.
  • Present suitable off-plan opportunities to investors and end-users.
  • Coordinate with developer sales teams regarding availability, booking procedures, documentation, and client requirements.
  • Build professional relationships with developer representatives and channel partners.

Negotiation & Deal Closure

  • Negotiate property prices, offers, payment terms, and transaction conditions between buyers and sellers.
  • Support clients throughout the offer and counteroffer process.
  • Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to move transactions efficiently toward closure.
  • Explain booking procedures, agreements, deposits, commissions, and transaction requirements to clients.
  • Maintain regular communication with all parties until the transaction is successfully completed.
  • Identify opportunities for repeat business and client referrals.

Transaction & Documentation Support

  • Assist clients with the documentation required for property transactions.
  • Coordinate with administrative, legal, finance, developer, and conveyancing teams as required.
  • Support the preparation and completion of relevant transaction documents.
  • Maintain accurate records of client interactions, property details, offers, and transactions.
  • Ensure all activities are conducted in accordance with applicable Dubai real estate regulations and internal procedures.

Client Relationship & After-Sales Support

  • Build long-term relationships with buyers, investors, sellers, and property owners.
  • Maintain regular communication with clients before, during, and after transactions.
  • Provide appropriate post-sale assistance and coordinate with relevant teams on outstanding requirements.
  • Identify opportunities for additional purchases, resale, leasing, referrals, and future investment.
  • Develop a strong personal client network to generate recurring business.

Market Research & Networking

  • Monitor Dubai property prices, market trends, new launches, inventory, and transaction activity.
  • Track developments across key residential and investment communities.
  • Attend property exhibitions, networking events, developer launches, and industry activities.
  • Build relationships with investors, entrepreneurs, business owners, landlords, developers, and other industry professionals.
  • Maintain strong awareness of competing properties and market pricing.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Real Estate, Marketing, Finance, or a related field is preferred.
  • 1–4 years of experience in Dubai/UAE real estate sales, property brokerage, sales, or a related client-facing role.
  • Fresh candidates with strong sales ability and relevant UAE real estate knowledge may also be considered.
  • Proven ability to generate leads and convert prospects into clients.
  • Strong understanding of Dubai's residential property market is preferred.
  • Experience with off-plan and/or secondary-market property sales is an advantage.
  • RERA-related real estate knowledge or certification is preferred.
  • Existing network of buyers, investors, property owners, or developers will be an advantage.

  • Lead generation and prospecting
  • Client relationship management
  • Dubai property market knowledge

  • Negotiation and closing skills
  • Investment-focused client advisory
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Networking and relationship building
  • CRM and lead management
  • Self-motivated and target-oriented approach
  • Strong follow-up and time management
  • Professional presentation and customer service
  • Ability to work independently and within a sales team

What We Offer

  • Competitive commission-based earning potential
  • Attractive incentives linked to sales performance
  • Access to residential, luxury, and investment property opportunities
  • Exposure to off-plan projects and leading Dubai developers

title: Service Adviseur parttime
description:
Sterke banden smeed je niet alleen in de werkplaats

Jij bent de schakel tussen klant en monteur; jij zorgt dat de klant zich gehoord voelt, dat de planning klopt en dat de monteurs kunnen doen waar ze goed in zijn. Dat doe je in een jonge, diverse ploeg waar je gewaardeerd wordt en niemand een grap uit de weg gaat. En elke vrijdag? Dan sluiten we de week af met een hapje en een drankje en als het weer meewerkt gaat de BBQ aan.

Salaris: €2.750 tot €3.500 bruto per maand o.b.v. fulltime
Uren: 24h-32h uur per week
Locatie: Papendrecht
Vakantiedagen: 25 dagen o.b.v. fulltime (extra dagen afhankelijk van leeftijd)
Contract: Tijdelijk contract met uitzicht op vast

Zonder jou loopt de werkplaats vast
Je begint de dag met een overzicht van de planning. De eerste klant staat al aan de balie, jij verwelkomt ze, luistert naar het verhaal en zorgt dat de monteurs weten wat er moet gebeuren. Tussendoor beantwoord je telefoons, verwerk je orders en houd je klantdossiers bij. De ene keer geef je een kostenraming door aan een vaste klant, de andere keer stel je een bezorgde rijder gerust over zijn grote beurt. Jij houdt het overzicht, schakelt snel en zorgt dat elke klant met een goed gevoel wegrijdt. Aan het einde van de dag sluit jij de boel netjes af.

Jij hoeft ons niks te bewijzen
Maar voor de volledigheid: je hebt een afgeronde mbo-opleiding en minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in een soortgelijke functie. Je bent administratief sterk, communicatief vaardig en hebt affiniteit met auto's. Je verkoopt alleen wat de klant echt nodig heeft, niet meer, niet minder. Bij ons is alles bespreekbaar zolang je positief ingesteld bent en het beste voor de klant vooropstelt.

Wij zijn Profile DBS
Van APK tot zomerbanden, van carcheck tot velgen: bij Profile DBS regelen we het allemaal, vanuit vestigingen door heel Nederland. Bij ons kom je niet alleen particulieren tegen, maar ook grote vloten. Van kleine personenwagens tot zware bedrijfsvoertuigen, wij houden ze allemaal rijdend met mensen die trots zijn op wat ze doen.

Benieuwd? Reageer gewoon. Geen brief nodig, even bellen mag ook. Laat je gegevens achter of bel Alexandra via 06-34987201. We spreken je snel.

title: Keikkaluontoinen kuorma-autonkuljettaja, Vantaa
description:
Haemme asiakkaallemme Vantaalle kuorma-autonkuljettajia sesongin keikkatöihin!
Sopisiko keikkaluontoinen työ elämäntilanteeseesi? Löytyykö sinulta C-ajokortti ja voimassa oleva ammattipätevyys? Jos vastasit kyllä ja olet valmis työskentelemään erityisesti loppuvuoden kiireisimmän sesongin aikana, jatka lukemista, sillä meillä saattaa olla juuri sinulle sopiva työmahdollisuus.
Kuvaus työstä
Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme kuorma-autonkuljettajaa Vantaalle keikkaluontoiseen sesonkityöhön. Työpäivät alkavat Itä-Vantaalla sijaitsevalta terminaalilta, ja ajot suuntautuvat pääasiassa lähialueen terminaaleihin noin 100–150 kilometrin säteellä. Työ koostuu pitkälti terminaalien välisestä runkoajosta sekä tarpeen mukaan suurempien lähetysten noutamisesta.
Kuljettajan tehtäviin kuuluu myös kuorman käsittelyä, mutta lastaamiseen ja lähetysten skannaamiseen on lähtökohtaisesti apua saatavilla terminaalilla. Työssä pääset siis keskittymään ennen kaikkea itse ajamiseen ja kuljetusten sujuvaan hoitamiseen.
Työ on keikkaluontoista sesonkityötä, ja tehtävässä on mahdollista aloittaa heti tai sopimuksen mukaan. Työvuoroja on tarjolla erityisesti kiireisimmän sesongin aikana 16.11.–13.12., joten toivomme sinulta hyvää käytettävyyttä kyseiselle ajanjaksolle. Hyvin sujuneen sesongin jälkeen työvuoroja voi olla tarjolla myös pidempään.
Työvuoroja on tarjolla maanantaista sunnuntaihin, ja vuorot ovat pääsääntöisesti noin 8 tunnin mittaisia. Työ painottuu iltapäiviin ja iltoihin, ja työpäivä alkaa tavallisesti klo 12–13. Työvuorojen ajankohdat voivat kuitenkin vaihdella, joten toivomme sinulta valmiutta työskennellä joustavasti myös aamuvuoroissa sekä viikonloppuisin.
Jos seuraavat asiat ovat hallussa, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö
  • Sinulta löytyy C-ajokortti ja voimassa oleva kuljettajan ammattipätevyys
  • Olet mahdollisimman hyvin käytettävissä 16.11.–13.12.
  • Olet valmis työskentelemään joustavasti maanantaista sunnuntaihin sekä aamu- että iltavuoroissa
  • Suomen kielen taito - työnjohtokielenä on suomi
  • Hyvä työmoraali - työ on itsenäistä ja aikatauluissa pysyminen on tärkeää
  • Luotettavuutta - me luotamme sinuun työntekijänä, joten toivomme että luotat meihin työnantajana
Vision työntekijälupaus
Oli visiosi työelämästä kirkas tai vasta hahmottumassa, me autamme molemmissa tapauksissa. Varmistamme, että työsopimukset ja varusteet ovat kunnossa, ja että ammattilaisena saat osaamistasi vastaavan palkan. Olemme tukena ja turvana, jos sellaista tarvitset. Meille on tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi.
Visiolaisena saat tässä tehtävässä:
  • Palkkauksen kuorma-autoalan TES mukaisesti
  • Palkanmaksun kaksi kertaa kuukaudessa
  • Jokaiseen työtehtävään soveltuvat työvarusteet
  • Päivittäisen tuen työasioissa
Onko meillä yhteinen visio? — Näin teet työpaikkahakemuksen
Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakijoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme työntekijä, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus. Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta!
Näin saat lisätietoa tehtävästä
Jos haluat lisätietoja tehtävästä, niin voit lähettää rekrytoinnista vastaavalle henkilölle, Ville Pitkäniemelle, sähköpostia otsikolla "Haettu työ" osoitteeseen ville.pitkaniemi(at)visiohr.fi. Arvostamme, että sähköpostissa kysyt vain työtehtävään liittyviä asioita. Jätä esimerkiksi itsesi esittely ja myyntipuheet varsinaiseen hakemukseen.
Tsemppiä hakemuksen tekoon!


Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut
Visio Logistiikka on osa Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut -konsernia, joka on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilöstöpalvelualan yritys. Pelaamme reilua peliä ja tarjoamme töitä niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Yhdistämme työntekijät ja työnantajat niin, että molemmat löytävät juuri tarpeisiinsa sopivan ratkaisun. Yhteistyö perustuu kaikkien kolmen tahon keskinäiseen luottamukseen.
Jos haluat reilun työnantajan, joka arvostaa osaamistasi ja huomaa työpanoksesi, se on Visio!

title: Full Stack & AI-Augmented Software Developer
description:
Full Stack & AI-Augmented Software Developer

We build web and mobile applications, business systems, and AI-powered tools for SMEs across Malaysia and Singapore. Small team, real ownership — you'll take features from "client described a vague problem" to "it's live and working." The single most important thing we're hiring for: you can figure out how something works without documentation. A lot of our work involves inheriting someone else's codebase, integrating with an API that has no docs, or debugging a production issue where the error message is a lie.

What you'll do:

Build and maintain web apps in React and mobile apps in React Native

Write backend services and automation in Python and Node.js

Integrate third‑party systems — REST, webhooks, and APIs that are undocumented or badly documented

Inspect, trace, and reverse-engineer existing systems: legacy code, unfamiliar databases, network traffic, third‑party payloads

Debug production issues end to end — front end, API layer, database, server

Build AI-assisted tooling: document/OCR pipelines, chat agents, data extraction and verification flows

Deploy and maintain on Ubuntu/Docker

Requirements:

Core skills — this is what we're really testing for:

Troubleshooting. You can isolate a bug systematically instead of guessing. You know how to bisect a problem, read a stack trace properly, and reproduce reliably before you fix.

Reverse engineering. Comfortable working out how an undocumented API or an inherited codebase behaves — reading network traffic, tracing call paths, testing hypotheses against a live system.

Critical thinking. You question requirements that don't make sense, spot the edge case the client didn't mention, and don't accept "it works on my machine" from yourself or from an AI.

Technical:

3–5 years hands‑on experience

React and React Native (shipped at least one app to a store or internal distribution)

Python and Node.js for backend/automation

Solid SQL — can debug a slow query and write non‑trivial joins unaided

Daily practical use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) — and the judgement to know when the output is wrong

Nice to have:

LLM API work: structured output, RAG, vision/OCR

Self-hosted inference (Ollama, vLLM, local GPU)

Mobile release experience — App Store / Play Store submission, OTA updates

Experience integrating with business/accounting systems

Malaysian business context: SST, MyInvois e-invoicing, local payment gateways

Flexible working hours & arrangements

Competitive remuneration & Performance bonus

Weekly badminton & monthly team building

Who Are We?

C&W Services is the industry leader in cutting-edge maintenance and janitorial programs for facilities ranging from corporate office portfolios and manufacturing plants to large public venues—keeping our client’s facility running smoothly all the time.

What’s The Job?

Title: Industrial Mechanical Technician - Skilled

Salary: up to $33.34
Hours: Tuesday - Friday, 7:00a - 5:30p

What’s in it for me?

  • Weekly pay on Fridays.

  • Comprehensive benefits day one, including Employee Perks and Daily Pay Program

  • Advancement opportunities.

  • Training to work in a cutting-edge facility.

  • Company provided safety apparel and uniforms.

What Will I Be Doing?

Here are just a few things you can expect to do daily:

  • Team member must be able to work in a team oriented and safety conscious environment. “Safety First” expectations include, but are not limited to, PJHA process, Observation process, and compliance with all company / site safety guidelines and procedures.

  • Assigned tasks list to include, but not limited to repairs and preventive maintenance on pumps, conveying systems, piping, heat exchangers, power transmissions, and other power-driven rotating equipment. Repairs and preventive maintenance to be performed in conformance with established standards. Expectation of task completion to range from task completion with direct supervision to task completion without supervision, reliant upon assigned tasks and employee’s development.

  • This position requires the employee to work without supervision.

  • Assist in formulating preventive maintenance standards / work procedures while performing those duties and provide work order feedback on discrepancies noted in service delivery.

  • Must have working knowledge of the following topics: using hand / power tools, precision alignment, rigging, pipefitting, welding, blueprint reading, mathematics, Preventive/Predictive Maintenance.

  • Employee will perform any and all other duties that are assigned by the responsible supervisor.

  • Must be able to use hand tools on a daily basis such as power tools (hand grinders, saws, impact wrenches, drill press, and hydraulic pullers), and rigging equipment. Also perform welding, using a cutting torch as required.

  • Must be able to operate and have knowledge of simple and complex heavy industrial equipment such as forklifts, scissors lifts, basket trucks, and skid loaders.

  • Works from elevated areas such as ladders, platforms, scaffolding, etc. utilizing fall protection equipment as necessary to complete tasks

  • Must have the flexibility to work all shifts including holidays and weekends as demanded by the job.

  • Ensures compliance with all company / customer regulations, policies, and procedures.

  • Achieve performance expectations set forth as part of performance appraisals to include employee development planning.

  • Communications with all team members to assist the development of short- and long-range planning in assist of the company’s goals and objectives

  • Maintain personal tools required for your job to include an up to date documented personal tool list. Required tool listing to be supplied as part of employment.

  • Meet physical requirements of the job. Physical requirements of the job will be provided to you prior to employment.

  • Perform assigned tasks in a safe, effective, and efficient manner.

  • Accurate and timely administrative duties to include, but not limited to, time accounting and work order completion.

  • Must maintain positive customer and employee relations.

What Makes Me Qualified?

Don’t meet all of the requirements but are still interested in working for us? Please apply and we will review your resume for other roles!

  • Education: Possess a high school degree or an approved GED. AA degree in Industrial Maintenance preferred, but not required.

  • Experience: 5+ years' experience in industrial maintenance and/or 4+ years education in industrial maintenance technologies / engineering preferred.

What are the physical demands of the role?

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • The ability to observe details at close range (within a few feet of the observer).

  • Control Precision — The ability to quickly and repeatedly adjust the controls of a machine or a vehicle to exact positions.

  • Manual Dexterity — The ability to quickly grasp, manipulate, or assemble objects.

  • Substantial lifting (up to 50 pounds) is required

  • Ability to move for extended or continuous periods of time

  • Ability to ascend and descend staircases, ladders, and/or step stools

  • Ability to operate applicable hand tools, power tools, and equipment

  • Ability to operate forklifts or other vehicles in a safe manner

  • Ability to wear a respirator while performing job duties

  • Communication/ Expression —The ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand.

  • Information Ordering — The ability to arrange things or actions in a certain order or pattern according to a specific rule or set of rules (e.g., patterns of numbers, letters, words, pictures, mathematical operations).

What is the work environment?

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; toxic or caustic chemicals; risk of electrical shock and vibration. The employee is occasionally exposed to extreme heat and extreme cold, wet and/or humid conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually very loud.

title: Software Engineer
description:
• Design, build and operate software systems and APIs
  • Lead technical design decisions and own product features end-to-end
  • Specialise into backend, frontend, full-stack, mobile, DevOps or SRE
  • Work for global tech giants, UK fintechs, banks, scale-ups and the public sector

What does a Software Engineer do?

Software Engineers design, build, test and operate software systems. Day-to-day work mixes coding (typically in Python, JavaScript / TypeScript, Java, Go or Ruby), technical design, code review, debugging, system architecture decisions, and on-call incident response. UK engineers operate across many product areas: consumer apps, fintech, infrastructure, AI / ML, gaming, defence and healthcare. The career has a famously flat hierarchy — Senior Engineer is a destination role at most companies, paying £80,000–£140,000+ at top UK employers without requiring management responsibility.

UK salary ranges

UK software engineering pay scales sharply by employer tier. London-based global tech offices (Google, Meta, Amazon, Apple) pay top of market — £70,000–£100,000 base for new graduates, plus equity and bonus pushing total comp to £120,000–£180,000. Top UK fintechs (Monzo, Wise, Revolut, Stripe) pay close to global tech. UK financial services (HSBC, Barclays, JPMorgan) pay £55,000–£80,000 base. Public sector and SMEs sit at £40,000–£55,000.

title: Linux & Data Center Systems Administrator
description:
The Linux & Data Center Systems Administrator is responsible for the administration, availability, security, and ongoing maintenance of Linux-based systems, virtualization platforms, and physical data center infrastructure.

The role combines Linux system administration, virtualization, hardware management, troubleshooting, automation, patching, backup operations, and hands-on data center activities. The position works closely with infrastructure, network, security, and other IT teams to maintain reliable and secure production environments.


Key Responsibilities:

Linux Systems Administration

  • Administer and maintain Linux operating systems across production and non-production environments.
  • Troubleshoot operating system, application, performance, storage, networking, and service-related issues.
  • Perform Linux OS installation, configuration, upgrades, and lifecycle management.
  • Manage OS patching, security updates, and remediation activities.
  • Configure and maintain system services, packages, repositories, users, permissions, and access controls.
  • Manage backup and recovery procedures for Linux systems.
  • Perform backup validation and support system recovery when required.
  • Develop and maintain automation and operational scripts using Bash and Python.
  • Automate repetitive administration, maintenance, monitoring, and troubleshooting tasks.
  • Investigate system logs and identify root causes of infrastructure incidents.
  • Apply Linux security best practices, system hardening, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Support capacity, performance, and availability management of Linux servers.
  • Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides.

Virtualization Administration

  • Administer and maintain virtualization environments based on KVM and VMware ESXi.
  • Provision and configure virtual machines.
  • Configure virtual CPU, memory, storage, networking, and other VM resources.
  • Troubleshoot hypervisor, virtual machine, storage, networking, and performance issues.
  • Perform hypervisor installation, configuration, maintenance, and upgrades.
  • Manage host and VM lifecycle activities.
  • Support patching and security updates of virtualization infrastructure.
  • Monitor virtualization infrastructure availability, health, capacity, and resource utilization.
  • Support migration, recovery, and maintenance activities involving virtual machines and hypervisor hosts.
  • Participate in troubleshooting incidents affecting virtualized services and infrastructure.

Data Center & Hardware Administration

  • Administer and maintain physical server infrastructure, primarily Dell and HPE hardware.
  • Install, configure, provision, and decommission physical servers.
  • Perform hardware troubleshooting and coordinate replacement of failed components.
  • Manage server firmware, BIOS, drivers, and hardware-related patching.
  • Perform firmware and software patching/repatching of new and existing hardware.
  • Configure and manage server remote management interfaces such as Dell iDRAC and HPE iLO.
  • Monitor physical server health, hardware alerts, temperatures, power usage, and component status.
  • Diagnose server hardware issues involving CPU, memory, storage, RAID, networking, power supplies, and other components.
  • Work with data center services and support teams during hardware installations, replacements, maintenance, and infrastructure changes.
  • Perform rack-level activities including server installation, cabling, power connectivity, and hardware replacement.
  • Work with Power Distribution Units (PDUs) and related power infrastructure.
  • Perform remote and local power management of servers and infrastructure equipment.
  • Monitor and control power consumption within the data center environment.
  • Support power planning and capacity management for racks and infrastructure.
  • Maintain accurate records of physical infrastructure, server configuration, and hardware lifecycle.
  • Coordinate with vendors and data center providers for hardware support and replacement activities.

Troubleshooting & Operations

  • Provide operational support for Linux, virtualization, and physical server infrastructure.
  • Troubleshoot incidents from the operating system through the virtualization and hardware layers.
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring infrastructure issues.
  • Participate in infrastructure maintenance and planned change activities.
  • Support production incidents and service restoration activities.
  • Work with networking, storage, security, application, and data center teams to resolve cross-platform issues.
  • Implement preventative actions to improve infrastructure stability and availability.

Security & Patch Management

  • Maintain secure configuration of Linux systems and virtualization infrastructure.
  • Apply security patches, firmware updates, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Support security hardening according to organizational standards.
  • Review operating system and infrastructure vulnerabilities and coordinate remediation.
  • Ensure privileged access and administrative permissions follow security requirements.
  • Support security audits and provide infrastructure-related technical information when required.


Requirements

  • Strong Linux system administration and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience with Linux patch and package management.
  • Experience with backup and recovery operations.
  • Bash and Python scripting and automation
  • Linux security and system hardening.
  • Experience administering KVM and VMware ESXi virtualization environments.
  • Virtual machine provisioning and troubleshooting.
  • Physical server administration.
  • Experience with Dell and HPE enterprise servers.
  • Hardware troubleshooting and component replacement.
  • Experience working in data center environments.

Preferred Knowledge

  • Configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible.
  • Infrastructure monitoring and alerting systems.
  • Centralized logging and log analysis.
  • Enterprise backup solutions.
  • SAN/NAS and enterprise storage concepts.
  • Linux networking and firewall configuration.
  • TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VLAN, and network troubleshooting.

  • High-availability and clustering concepts.
  • IT-based incident, problem, and change management processes.

Founded in early 2010, Webbing is a global data MVNO that delivers enterprise grade, global connectivity and IoT services across more than 200 countries and 600+ mobile carriers' networks. Webbing's secured network delivers network protection and web content intelligence.

Enterprise customers can manage, monitor, and optimize data usage in real-time with Webbing's powerful software platform. title: Client Lead
description:
Role Overview

The Client Lead makes sure client work is delivered on time, on budget and to a high standard. You are the day-to-day point of contact on your accounts and the person who holds them together across every channel working on them.

You work across several accounts at once as part of a pooled Client Lead team, allocated to accounts by workload. Your focus is delivery and the client’s day-to-day experience: turning briefs into clear, well-run work, keeping it moving through the agency, tracking budgets and account margin, and staying accountable for whether the work hits its targets. It is a senior, client-facing role that combines hands-on ownership of delivery with enough channel knowledge to make decisions and challenge the work.


Purpose

  • Own the operational success of your accounts: work delivered on time, on budget and to target.
  • Act as the named day-to-day client contact, owning the communication rhythm and the client experience between strategic touchpoints.
  • Be the connective tissue between the brief and the delivery, translating briefs into clear deliverables, targets and timelines.
  • Keep work flowing through the agency by removing blockers and resolving competing priorities.
  • Protect account margin day to day, flagging over-servicing and scope creep before they land.


Responsibilities


Brief Intake and Set-Up

  • Take ownership of briefs, working with channel specialists to define deliverables, targets and timelines.
  • Translate what has been agreed into a deliverable plan, flagging gaps or misalignment before work starts.
  • Run kick-off and onboarding for new work, ensuring the right people are involved at the right points.


Delivery Ownership

  • Own timelines, milestones and delivery coordination across your accounts; there is no separate project management layer behind you.
  • Monitor delivery against client objectives, flag issues early and coordinate the response when performance is off track.
  • Bring enough channel knowledge to sense-check delivery proposals and challenge misalignment with the client’s goals.
  • Specialists own their own tickets and the quality of their work; you QA delivery against the plan and escalate when guidance is not being followed.


Client Communication

  • Act as the named primary point of contact on assigned accounts, attending client calls and meetings as the day-to-day owner.
  • Let specialists speak directly to the client on their own work, while you keep the overall conversation joined up and on track.
  • Support the account’s senior relationship owner at QBRs and strategic reviews.
  • Own the client portal as the primary communication and visibility tool on your accounts, keeping it the single source of truth for work in flight.


Working with the Client Partner/ Revenue Owner

  • Keep the account’s revenue owner continuously up to speed on delivery health, risks and growth signals through a regular rhythm; they should never need to shadow the account to know its state.
  • Handle scope and over-servicing conversations at working level with the client and specialists; escalate to the revenue owner when the resolution is commercial (scope change, fees, contract).
  • Escalate anything threatening retention on a Tier 1 or 2 account to the Revenue owner within 24 hours.
  • Highlight growth opportunities to the revenue lead where possible


Budget and Account Margin

  • Track budgets, hours and resource against client commitments, proactively flagging overruns or underspend.
  • Carry account margin day to day: spot over-servicing and scope creep early and raise them with the account’s senior relationship owner.
  • Flag risks and growth signals from the day-to-day work to the account’s senior relationship owner.


Flow of Work

  • Remove blockers and keep work moving across the agency.
  • Raise resource conflicts through the weekly resourcing pass and make practical calls on sequencing within your accounts.
  • Keep delivery data (Forecast, the client portal) accurate and up to date.


Requirements

  • Strong operational instincts: able to hold multiple accounts together, sequence work and keep delivery on track under competing demands.
  • Enough channel knowledge across SEO, paid media, creative and wider digital to sense-check work and make informed calls, without needing to be a specialist in any one.
  • Confident, credible client communicator, able to own the day-to-day relationship and represent the work clearly.
  • Commercially aware: understands budgets, margin and the difference between delivering activity and delivering results.
  • Comfortable taking ownership, making decisions and holding others to deadlines and standards.
  • Shows radical candour: gives praise, motivational feedback and constructive challenge as each is needed.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and multiple stakeholders.


Marketing

In this role, you will be expected to contribute both independently and collaboratively at the department level to drive the overall success of our marketing efforts. You will play an active role in thought leadership initiatives that support lead generation and help maximise the department’s impact. This includes contributing to a range of activities such as blogging, content creation, event support, and other marketing tasks.

  • Collaborate with the marketing team to provide insights and ideas for campaigns and content.
  • Stay informed on the latest digital marketing trends, sharing knowledge with colleagues and clients.
  • Be involved with thought leadership initiatives, promoting yourself and Hallam through a variety of channels.


Workplace Culture

At Hallam, we believe that a positive and inclusive workplace culture is the foundation of our success. Every employee plays a crucial role in fostering this environment by embodying and promoting our company values in their daily work and interactions.

  • Uphold and embody the agency’s core values in daily work and interactions with clients and colleagues.
  • Promote a positive, inclusive and dynamic workplace environment.
  • Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, learning and well-being.


DEI

At Hallam, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. Regardless of your role, you will be responsible for contributing to this culture by embracing diversity, promoting equity, and supporting an inclusive environment where different perspectives are encouraged and respected.

  • Foster inclusivity by being a welcoming and respectful colleague, valuing diverse perspectives and treating all colleagues, clients and stakeholders with dignity and respect.
  • Promote equal opportunities by supporting initiatives that ensure all team members have equal access to growth, development and advancement.

title: Kirvesmies, NIVALA
description:

Työtehtäviin kuuluu monipuolisia navettarakentamisen kirvesmiestöitä. Hakemillamme henkilöillä on jo kokemusta rakennusalalta ja kyky itsenäiseen työskentelyyn.

Odotamme sinulta:

  • Aiempaa kokemusta kirvesmiehen töistä (kokemus navetta- tai maatalousrakentamisesta on eduksi)

  • Mielellään omia perustyökaluja

  • Kykyä työskennellä huolellisesti ja omatoimisesti

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen: vähintään 17,00 €/h (tai enemmän osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan)

  • Majoitusmahdollisuuden paikkakunnalla pientä vuokraa vastaan

  • Epassi-henkilöstöedun

Paikkoja: 2

Sijainti: Nivala

Palkkaus: Vähintään 17,00 €/h / neuvoteltavissa

Majoitus: Järjestettävissä (pientä vuokraa vastaan)

Aloitus: Heti!



Asiakkaastamme, työstä ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää haastattelussa.

Täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!

---



Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.

Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

title: Lumityöntekijöitä - Espoo
description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme reippaita ja motivoituneita lumityöntekijöitä Espoon alueelle talvikauden ajaksi.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu pihojen, kulkuväylien ja yhteiskäyttöalueiden talvikunnossapito. Työkohteet sijaitsevat pääasiassa Espoossa, Espoonlahden ja Finnoon alueella. Tässä työssä pääset tekemään monipuolisesti käsilumitöitä sekä erilaisia hiekoitus- ja jäänpoistotöitä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Olet ahkera ja oma-aloitteinen tekijä, joka tarttuu työhön reippaalla otteella ja on valmis työskentelemään joustavasti sää- ja työtilanteen mukaan. Hyvä fyysinen kunto on tehtävässä tärkeää, sillä työ on aktiivista ja ulkona tapahtuvaa.

Tehtävässä edellytämme:

  • voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia
  • voimassa olevaa Tieturva 1 -korttia
  • sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa
  • hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja valmiutta ulkotyöhön
  • huolellista ja työturvallista työskentelyotetta.

B-ajokortti ja oma auto katsotaan eduksi, sillä työkohteet sijaitsevat eri puolilla Espoonlahden ja Finnoon aluetta.

Mitä työ tarjoaa?

Työ alkaa perehdytyksellä marraskuun alkupuolella, ja lumityövuoroja on tarjolla talvikauden aikana sään ja työtilanteen mukaan. Työssä toimit osana tiimiä, jossa tehtyä työtä raportoidaan ja dokumentoidaan. Saat käyttöösi laadukkaat työvälineet, joiden asianmukaisesta käytöstä ja huolenpidosta vastaat.

Palkkaus: 14,66 euroa/tunti (Infra-alan TES)

Työ sopii hyvin esimerkiksi opiskelijalle tai lisätyöksi muun työn rinnalle, sillä työvuoroja tarjotaan tarpeen ja sääolosuhteiden mukaan.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jätä hakemuksesi meille – käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana!

Julianna Grönberg

Meidän työntekijämme viihtyvät parhaiten asiakkaillamme!


Wulff Works on se parempi henkilöstövuokrausyritys. Meillä konkarit etsivät sankareita: tunnistamme hyvät työpaikat ja työnantajat, jotka arvostavat tekijöitä. Palvelemme valtakunnallisesti ja tapaat meitä jo kahdeksalla paikkakunnalla Suomessa.

title: Remote | Medical Coder — $25–$40/hour
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
We are sharing a specialised consulting opportunity for experienced Medical Coders with strong expertise in ICD-10, CPT, Evaluation & Management coding, clinical documentation review, and coding quality assurance to contribute to an advanced AI training and medical-data evaluation project.

Selected professionals will review and annotate medical records, assign and validate ICD-10 and CPT codes, apply E&M leveling guidelines, and provide structured feedback on coding edge cases and documentation quality. The work requires strong coding judgement, current reference materials, and consistent attention to accuracy and compliance. No prior experience in AI is required.

Key Responsibilities

Medical Record Coding & Annotation

  • Review clinical documentation and assign appropriate ICD-10 and CPT codes
  • Annotate medical records accurately based on documented diagnoses and services
  • Validate coding decisions against supporting documentation
  • Identify incomplete, ambiguous, or inconsistent clinical information
  • Maintain high standards of coding accuracy across repeated assignments

ICD-10 & CPT Application

  • Apply current ICD-10 coding guidance
  • Assign CPT codes based on documented procedures and services
  • Use official coding references to support coding decisions
  • Identify discrepancies between documentation and proposed codes
  • Maintain compliance with applicable coding standards and conventions

Evaluation & Management Coding

  • Apply official E&M leveling guidelines
  • Evaluate documentation against relevant E&M requirements
  • Assess coding accuracy across varied clinical scenarios
  • Identify undercoding, overcoding, or unsupported level selection
  • Document coding rationale clearly when clarification is needed

Clinical Documentation Review

  • Review diverse forms of clinical documentation
  • Identify documentation gaps affecting code assignment
  • Flag ambiguous or unsupported coding scenarios
  • Apply professional judgement to challenging coding cases
  • Collaborate with project stakeholders to resolve interpretation issues

Coding Quality & Feedback

  • Provide structured feedback on coding guidelines and edge cases
  • Identify recurring coding errors or areas requiring clarification
  • Contribute recommendations that improve dataset consistency
  • Support quality-control processes across medical coding tasks
  • Help refine workflows and standards for coding evaluation

AI Training & Dataset Validation

  • Contribute domain expertise to medical-code datasets used for AI training
  • Review coded examples for accuracy and internal consistency
  • Evaluate AI-generated or model-assisted coding outputs where required
  • Provide expert feedback to improve model understanding of coding rules
  • Support validation of clinically grounded coding datasets

Ideal Profile

  • Active AAPC Certified Professional Coder (CPC) certification is required
  • Strong working knowledge of ICD-10 coding
  • Strong working knowledge of CPT coding
  • Solid understanding of Evaluation & Management leveling guidelines
  • Experience coding across diverse clinical documentation types
  • Strong attention to detail and coding accuracy
  • Ability to explain coding decisions clearly in written and verbal formats
  • Access to current official ICD-10 and CPT coding references
  • Access to current E&M guidelines
  • Familiarity with digital annotation tools is advantageous
  • Experience contributing to data-driven or quality-review projects is beneficial
  • Strong commitment to coding compliance and continuous professional learning
  • No prior AI-training or model-evaluation experience is required

Engagement Details

  • Independent contractor engagement
  • Fully remote
  • Compensation: $25–$40/hour
  • Work will involve medical-record annotation, ICD-10 coding, CPT coding, E&M leveling, dataset validation, and coding-quality review
  • Active CPC certification is required
  • Strong coding accuracy and documentation-review skills are central to this engagement
  • Assignments may involve a range of clinical specialties, documentation types, and coding scenarios
  • Project scope, workload, coding guidelines, and evaluation standards may evolve depending on project requirements
  • Work must be completed without using confidential, proprietary, or personally identifiable patient information belonging to any employer, client, healthcare organisation, institution, or other third party

title: VMware Lead Solution Architect
description:
Lead Datacenter & Cloud Solution Architect

We are looking for a highly experienced Datacenter & Cloud Solution Architect to support a strategic infrastructure transformation initiative focused on defining the next-generation enterprise datacenter architecture, technology stack, and operating model.

The role requires a strong combination of hands-on infrastructure knowledge, enterprise architecture capability, and executive-level advisory skills. The successful candidate will help shape a future-state architecture that is technically sound, resilient, scalable, commercially supportable, and suitable for long-term business growth.

Role Overview

The architect will lead the technical assessment of the existing infrastructure landscape and translate business, operational, resilience, security, and technology requirements into a clear set of architecture principles and future-state recommendations.

A key part of the role is maintaining an independent and technology-neutral perspective while evaluating different infrastructure, virtualization, cloud, and managed-service options.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities will include:

  • Assessing the current datacenter and infrastructure environment
  • Identifying technology dependencies, constraints, lifecycle risks, and modernization opportunities
  • Defining future-state architecture principles and technical standards
  • Designing target architecture across:

    • Compute
    • Storage
    • Networking
    • Virtualization
    • Platform services
    • Backup and recovery
    • Disaster recovery
    • Monitoring
    • Automation
    • Infrastructure management
  • Evaluating alternative technology and architecture scenarios
  • Comparing different platforms and technology providers objectively
  • Assessing feasibility, complexity, compatibility, operational impact, lock-in, and strategic alignment
  • Developing technical decision frameworks and architecture comparison models
  • Assessing opportunities to reuse existing infrastructure and identifying refresh requirements
  • Defining high-level migration strategies, dependencies, sequencing, and major risks
  • Evaluating internal, hybrid, and managed operating models
  • Providing technical assumptions to support sizing, licensing, lifecycle, support, migration effort, and cost assessments
  • Supporting executive stakeholders with clear technical recommendations and decision materials

Expected Deliverables

The role may contribute to or own outputs such as:

  • Current-state infrastructure assessment
  • Architecture requirements and guiding principles
  • Future-state datacenter architecture
  • Technology option analysis
  • Feasibility and risk assessment
  • Architecture decision framework
  • Recommended technology stack
  • High-level migration roadmap
  • Compatibility and lifecycle assessment
  • Infrastructure sizing assumptions
  • Licensing and support assumptions
  • Migration and operational effort estimates
  • Hardware refresh assumptions
  • Technical inputs for Bill of Materials and cost modelling
  • Operating model considerations
  • Executive architecture recommendation
  • Technology selection documentation

The architect will provide the technical foundation for financial and commercial evaluations, while not being responsible for commercial negotiations or detailed financial modelling.

Cloud & Hybrid Architecture

Strong experience with Microsoft Azure is required, particularly across:

  • Landing zone architecture
  • Identity and security integration
  • Networking
  • Compute and storage
  • Governance and policy
  • Monitoring and observability
  • Hybrid connectivity
  • Cloud operating models
  • Cost optimization and FinOps considerations

Experience designing architectures that span on-premise, hybrid, and cloud environments is essential.

Infrastructure Expertise

Candidates should bring strong end-to-end knowledge of enterprise infrastructure, including areas such as:

  • Enterprise compute platforms
  • Storage architectures
  • Datacenter networking
  • VMware and/or Hyper-V environments
  • Enterprise backup and recovery platforms
  • Virtual Desktop Infrastructure
  • Windows and Linux environments
  • Database infrastructure
  • Monitoring and management platforms
  • Automation and orchestration
  • Disaster recovery and business continuity
  • Datacenter facilities and infrastructure dependencies

Transformation & Migration Experience

The ideal candidate will have previously supported large-scale infrastructure or cloud transformation programs involving complex environments, multiple systems, business units, or locations.

Relevant experience may include:

  • Datacenter consolidation or modernization
  • Cloud and hybrid-cloud migrations
  • Virtualization platform transformation
  • Infrastructure refresh programs
  • Application and workload migration planning
  • Operating model redesign
  • Managed-services transitions
  • Platform standardization
  • Infrastructure lifecycle modernization

The architect should be able to define migration waves, dependencies, technical sequencing, resource assumptions, risks, and validation requirements.

Architecture & Advisory Skills

The role requires the ability to operate effectively between senior management and deeply technical teams.

You should be comfortable facilitating workshops and working with stakeholders across:

  • Infrastructure
  • Network
  • Cybersecurity
  • Cloud
  • Operations
  • Architecture
  • Project and program management
  • Vendor management
  • Technology suppliers and service providers
  • Senior IT leadership

Strong written communication is essential, particularly the ability to produce concise and well-structured architecture reports, executive recommendations, and technical decision documents in English.

Vendor-Neutral Approach

A core requirement of the role is the ability to assess technologies independently and objectively.

Candidates should be comfortable evaluating competing architectures based on criteria such as:

  • Technical fit
  • Scalability
  • Resilience
  • Security
  • Compatibility
  • Operational complexity
  • Migration effort
  • Vendor dependency
  • Lifecycle considerations
  • Supportability
  • Strategic flexibility

Experience Profile

We are looking for a senior or lead-level architect with extensive experience in infrastructure, datacenter, cloud, systems management, or enterprise architecture.

A strong profile would typically include significant experience with complex enterprise environments and direct ownership of infrastructure architecture or transformation assessments.

Experience with large infrastructure estates, distributed operational environments, managed services, DevSecOps, FinOps, vendor orchestration, and operational governance will be particularly valuable.

Exposure to AI infrastructure readiness, accelerated computing, or emerging datacenter requirements associated with AI workloads would also be considered an advantage.

Engagement

This is a senior architecture advisory engagement requiring strong technical ownership, independent judgement, and the ability to translate complex infrastructure topics into clear recommendations for decision-makers.

Commercial terms will depend on experience, availability, and scope of responsibility.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
CDK Global, LLC seeks Staff Software Engineer at its facility located at 11809 Domain Drive, Suite 200, Austin, TX 78758.

#LI-DNI

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Apply specialized expertise in large-scale data engineering, ETL architecture, database design, and cloud migration across Azure and AWS platforms. Architect and implement enterprise ETL and data processing systems using Azure Data Factory, SSIS, AWS Glue, and cloud storage platforms such as Azure Data Lake and AWS S3. Design and maintain data models, ingestion frameworks, and transformation logic supporting CRM workflows and enterprise data services. Lead the design and buildout of new ETL environments for cloud readiness, including migration from on premise SQL Server and SSIS workloads to Azure Data Factory. Lead cross-functional engineering efforts involving data platform teams, cloud engineering, CRM engineering, security, and infrastructure. Lead the ETL engineering team in migrating the full on prem ETL environment to Azure Data Factory, including technical planning, dependency management, pipeline conversion, and QA validation. Coordinate delivery for core CRM processing systems including dealer data ingestion (DMSSOR), reference data processing, customer access databases, and pod migration workflows. Solve complex technical challenges involving large-scale data ingestion, cloud integration, ETL optimization, and legacy system modernization. Redesign legacy ETL pipelines to operate efficiently in Azure, including conversion of SSIS packages into ADF pipelines. Modernize multiple legacy VB6-based systems by converting logic to C# (SSIS) and decommissioning outdated components. Implement enterprise-wide data retention, archiving, and purging processes to improve system performance and ensure compliance. Provide architectural leadership and technical direction for cloud migration and enterprise data initiatives. Develop system architecture diagrams, migration strategies, and cloud transition plans for ETL workloads. Define data integration approaches for the Connected Communications Platform (CCP) migration from on prem SQL to AWS S3 and AWS Glue. Lead design and implementation of the Master Data Management (MDM) “Golden ID” solution to provide unified customer identity across dealership platforms. Mentor engineers and provide specialized technical guidance on cloud ETL, data modeling, SQL optimization, and cloud migration processes. Provide technical direction on ADF pipeline development, data architecture, SQL Server and PostgreSQL optimization, and cloud transformation. Conduct code reviews, data model reviews, and architectural evaluations. Partner with functional leadership to influence platform modernization priorities and architectural decisions. Collaborate with product leaders, cloud engineers, and CRM stakeholders to determine migration timelines, resource requirements, and technical prioritization. Support roadmap discussions related to decommissioning legacy systems and migrating to DMSSOR/Gen SOR. Support cross-functional teams with technical expertise related to cloud systems, data integration, and ETL performance. Assist CRM engineering, infrastructure, and security teams with data flow design, cloud ingestion patterns, ADF/SSIS processing logic, and ETL optimization. Maintain compliance with CDK policies, security standards, and data governance requirements. Ensure adherence to cloud security, IAM configuration, data encryption, retention policies, and regulatory requirements across ETL and CRM systems. Meet expected deliverables for cloud migration, data platform modernization, and enterprise integration projects. Deliver migration milestones for Azure ETL, CCP cloud transition, MDM implementation, Sunset Legacy DMS systems and DMS system modernization. 100% Telecommuting.

REQUIREMENTS:

This position requires a Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field and 8 years of experience as a Software Developer, or related occupation. Additionally, the applicant must have employment experience with: (1) Using Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL to design, develop, and support relational database solutions, including creating tables, views, stored procedures, and functions, as well as writing and optimizing complex queries through indexing, execution plan analysis, and query tuning for transactional and reporting systems; (2) Using ETL and data integration tools such as AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and Azure Data Factory on Microsoft Azure to extract, transform, and load data across enterprise systems, including operating data pipelines and validating data accuracy and performance in cloud environments; (3) Using application development technologies such as ASP.NET, C#, VB, ADO.NET and Python to build and integrate application-level data access layers with backend databases; (4) Using database administration tools such as SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), SQL Server Agent, Maintenance Plans, and Azure SQL Managed Instance’s automated management features to support backup and restore operations, index maintenance, statistics updates, and routine database health monitoring; (5) Using application and system monitoring tools such as AppDynamics, New Relic, Logic Monitor, and Azure Monitor to observe production environments, identify performance issues, and support troubleshooting of database and application systems; (6) Using reporting and analytics technologies such as SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS), and cloud data platforms like Snowflake to build and support analytical datasets and reporting solutions for business and operational use; (7) Using source control and release management tools such as Git, Team Foundation Server (TFS), Azure DevOps, and Harness CI/CD to manage code versions, support continuous integration and deployment, and maintain application and database codebases; (8) Working with CI/CD processes and tools, including Git, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket, Liquibase (DB Deployment), Terraform, and Harness to support version control, automate deployments, and manage environment configurations across development and production systems; (9) Working in Agile/Scrum environments using tools such as Jira and Confluence; participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and team collaboration activities; (10) Designing data models and supporting data warehouse environments, including dimensional modeling; developing datasets and queries to support reporting and business intelligence tools such as Snowflake, Power BI or Tableau; (11) Designing and supporting relational and NoSQL databases, including Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB, working with structured and semi structured data and supporting both transactional and analytical workloads in distributed environments; and (12) Monitoring and troubleshooting databases and application performance using tools such as AppDynamics, New Relic, Redgate, AWS CloudWatch, SQL Profiler, and Azure Monitor; investigating issues, analyzing trends, and supporting incident resolution in production environments.

location: Pakenham, West Gippsland & Latrobe Valley VIC
description:
Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 per year

Position: Junior ICT Business Analyst

Company: SJ Transport Services Pty Ltd trading as A & J Car Rentals

Location: 10 Southeast Boulevard, Pakenham VIC 3810

Position Type: Full-Time

Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 plus superannuation

Company Overview

SJ Transport Services Pty Ltd trading as A & J Car Rentals is a Melbourne-based vehicle rental and transport business providing reliable and competitively priced vehicle rental solutions to individuals and businesses.

The company offers a range of cars, passenger vans, moving vans, minibuses and trucks for short-term and long-term hire and supports its operations through vehicle booking and reservation systems, customer records, fleet information, rental transaction records and operational reporting processes.

A & J Car Rentals is committed to providing reliable and well-maintained vehicles, efficient customer service and value-for-money rental solutions. As the business continues to grow and its reliance on technology-enabled booking, fleet and administrative systems increases, the company is seeking a suitably qualified ICT Business Analyst to support the ongoing analysis, development and improvement of its business systems and operational processes.

Position Overview

The ICT Business Analyst will work closely with management, rental operations staff, fleet personnel, administrative employees and external ICT service providers to identify, analyse and document business and system requirements across the organisation.

The position will focus on the systems and processes supporting vehicle bookings and reservations, customer information, rental transactions, fleet availability, operational records and management reporting.

The successful candidate will analyse existing business processes and ICT systems, identify areas for improvement, develop functional and system requirements, support system testing and implementation, and assist in ensuring that technology solutions are aligned with the operational requirements of A & J Car Rentals.

Key responsibilities

  • Liaise with Senior Business Analyst and Management, rental staff, fleet personnel and administrative users to identify, analyse and document business and ICT system requirements relating to vehicle bookings, reservations, rental transactions, customer records, fleet information and operational reporting.

  • Analyse existing business processes, procedures, work practices and system workflows to identify inefficiencies, information gaps and opportunities for improvement.

  • Review existing booking, reservation, fleet management and administrative systems and recommend practical improvements to system functionality and business processes.

  • Translate business requirements into functional requirements, system specifications, user stories, workflow documentation and acceptance criteria for ICT service providers and developers.

  • Develop business process maps, workflow diagrams and data models to document how booking, customer, rental, fleet and operational information is captured, processed and reported.

  • Liaise with management, system users, software developers and external ICT providers to clarify business requirements and support the design and configuration of suitable ICT solutions.

  • Analyse the flow and integration of data between vehicle reservations, customer records, fleet availability, rental transactions and management reporting systems to improve data accuracy and consistency.

  • Prepare and undertake system testing and User Acceptance Testing, including developing test scenarios, recording results, identifying system defects and confirming that solutions meet documented business requirements.

  • Support the implementation and deployment of new or modified ICT systems and processes, including data validation, system configuration checks, user support and post-implementation review.

  • Prepare and maintain system documentation, user guides, procedures and training materials and collect user feedback to identify opportunities for further system and process improvements.

Skills and Qualifications Required

  • Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Information Technology or a closely related discipline.

  • Minimum one year of relevant professional work experience.

  • Demonstrated ability to gather, analyse and document business and system requirements and translate operational requirements into practical ICT solutions.

  • Sound knowledge of business process analysis, workflow mapping, functional specifications, system testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with management, operational staff and external ICT or software service providers.

Applicants are invited to submit a current CV and cover letter outlining their relevant qualifications and professional experience.
