title: Project Manager
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Impact Housing (IH) is a vertically integrated modular design-builder and developer headquartered in Southern California.

Our mission is to continuously evolve the world’s most sophisticated and efficient housing delivery system. We pursue this mission by reimagining every element of how multifamily projects are designed, manufactured, and built—driving down costs, shortening schedules, and expanding access to high-quality housing for the people who need it most, whether through LIHTC or unsubsidized projects.

To date this decade, the IH team has built or is actively developing close to 1,500 modular units demonstrating a scalable, repeatable path to affordability. With the capability to produce approximately 1,000 units per year today, IH is expanding to meet growing demand in San Diego, Los Angeles, and beyond.

We are now entering the next stage of our growth and strengthening every team across the company to achieve our next set of goals. We plan to manufacture and build more than 10,000 units through 2030. To accomplish this, we are implementing the Lean Standard Model company-wide; deploying AI at every level of the company; and positioning IH as a national thought leader in modular development.

The foundation for our success is firmly in place. Join us as we scale our operations, transition into a higher-capacity manufacturing facility powered by smart automation and robotics, expand our production capacity by more than 3x in the Western U.S., and prepare for future national growth.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Project Manager owns assigned pursuits and active projects from preconstruction through delivery, joining an existing bench of two project managers. The role carries schedule, budget and scope for its projects and is the point of coordination between the Yorba Linda manufacturing facility, the architect of record, the site general contractor and the client.


Impact Housing builds a defined product line rather than whatever a developer brings, so the position is as much about fitting a project to the product and the production schedule as it is about conventional construction management. This seat is timed to arrive with the project volume the expanded business development team is expected to generate.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own assigned projects end to end — schedule, budget, scope and change management — from preconstruction through certificate of occupancy.
  • Lead preconstruction activity including feasibility review, site logistics planning, module take-off coordination, and support of entitlement and permitting.
  • Coordinate design between the manufacturing facility, the architect of record and the site general contractor, resolving conflicts before they reach the production line.
  • Plan factory-to-site logistics — production slot coordination, transportation routing and permitting from the plant to sites across California, crane and set sequencing.
  • Maintain the client-facing reporting and meeting cadence, and serve as the client’s primary day-to-day contact on assigned projects.
  • Support business development at the pursuit stage with technical input, diligence responses and schedule and constructability review of proposals.
  • Feed project findings into the cross-vertical Problem Resolution Request and Non-Conformance processes.


Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Run project and coordination meetings and publish minutes with owners and due dates.
  • Maintain project schedules and update the pipeline production Gantt.
  • Review and process submittals, requests for information and change orders.
  • Coordinate with plant production scheduling on slot timing and sequencing.
  • Track committed cost against contract and report variances.
  • Communicate with the client, architect and general contractor on open items.
  • Visit project sites during set and finish phases and document progress.

QUALIFICATIONS


Years of Experience: Five to eight years managing multifamily or commercial construction projects from preconstruction through delivery, with full schedule and budget accountability.


Prior Experience: Construction. General contractor, developer, or offsite and modular manufacturer. Working knowledge of California entitlement and permitting is required. Modular, offsite or panelized construction experience is strongly preferred; candidates from conventional multifamily construction with demonstrated interest in industrialized delivery will be considered.


Required Skills and Attributes

  • Schedule and budget control on concurrent projects without losing detail on either.
  • Ability to hold a general contractor, an architect and an internal production team to the same schedule.
  • Clear client-facing communication, including delivering bad news early.
  • Fluency with construction documents, submittals, RFIs and change order process.
  • Valid California driver’s license and reliable transportation.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Affordable housing and LIHTC project experience, including funding-driven schedule constraints.
  • Procore, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project or Primavera P6.
  • Familiarity with third-party in-plant inspection and certification regimes such as NTA, and with HCD requirements for factory-built housing.
  • Experience with Type III and Type V multifamily construction.
  • Bilingual English and Spanish.

EDUCATION AND CREDENTIALS

Bachelor’s degree required. Preferred disciplines: construction management, architecture, civil or structural engineering. PMP certification preferred.



COMPENSATION

  • Competitive Salary + Bonus
  • Health Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA
  • Vacation
  • Sick time
  • Holiday pay
  • Ownership of company equity
  • 401K Retirement Plan

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This position is based in Los Angeles with regular travel to the Yorba Linda manufacturing facility and to project sites across California, including multi-day site presence during module set. The Project Manager must be able to access active construction sites, climb ladders and stairs, walk uneven terrain, and wear required personal protective equipment.

NOTE
This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) of this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. All duties and responsibilities are essential functions and requirements and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities.

Impact Housing is an equal opportunity employer, drug-free workplace, complies with ADA regulations and does not discriminate against any employee or job applicant because of race, color, religion, national origin, medical condition, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, physical or mental disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

For more information about Impact Housing, visit .

title: Applications Development Engineer
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.



Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Broadband Plasma (BBP) division is the market-leading optical inspection system used by logic, foundry, and memory customers to detect critical defects at advanced nodes. These tools combine broadband plasma technology with unmatched sensitivity and speed to support high-volume manufacturing.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.



Preferred Qualifications

  • Customer support: Product value demonstration during beta testing, Head-to-Heads (H2H) and tools in the ramp phase, thereby enabling product penetration/adoption at world-wide customers. This includes investigating semiconductor manufacturing yield issues and providing inspection solutions; creating & sharing product value statements and use-cases with engineering, marketing and sales groups; training customers and other applications engineers.

  • Product Demonstration: Provide specific product demonstrations on all aspects of highly complex products to customers and assess potential applications to meet customer needs

  • Product Characterization: Work on test plan development and execute detailed characterization of the tool/algorithm performance and provides clear feedback to the Engineering teams for product improvement, especially during Alpha/Beta tests.

  • Problem Diagnosis/Troubleshooting: Respond to customer requests and perform routine to moderately complex problem diagnosis and problem resolution.

  • Customer Relationship: Interacts with customers to educate and coordinate activities. Good working knowledge of customer use case and is expected to understand customer needs and improve customer relations.

  • Training: Conduct customer product demonstrations and technical training including on-site training of Field Applications Engineers and end users.

  • Documentation: Document all test results and lessons learned in BKMs (Best Known Methods), training documents, Demo reports, or, Alpha/Beta test reports and transfer product knowledge to Field Applications teams.

  • Presentation/Communication Skills: Generate demo and test reports and strong presentation skills for internal and customer review.

Requirements:

  • We are looking for high energy, self-driven and motivated engineers who are interested in working in High Tech. The semiconductor space is a fast paced, high stress environment that gives applications engineers a lot of autonomy to work and drive projects on their own. Ideal candidates appreciate the opportunity to have high levels of accountability, working well with limited supervision and thrive in a work environment where they can drive projects on their own.

  • Candidate must have Master’s or bachelor's degree in Engineering, Physics, Material Science, or related fields.

  • Must have excellent oral and written communication, organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills.

  • Candidate must be a strong team player.

  • >70% travel will be required

Minimum Qualifications

Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.


Use of AI Statement

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.



We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.


KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

title: Surveyor
description:
We are seeking a surveyor who will lead all team members and mining operations at our mining facilities in Brookwood, Alabama. We expect this person to be a role model for the "Warrior Way" and uphold the highest standards of professionalism, integrity, and teamwork.

Who We Are:

All teammates are required to work in a manner that exemplifies the “Warrior Way” - Safer, Accountability, Follow Through, Excellence, Responsibility. Mining positions may be required to work various shifts, rotating schedules, weekends, and holidays as scheduled. We provide a generous compensation and benefits package, including incentive plans, 401(k) match, paid time off and company paid medical, dental and vision care - all of which start the day you join the team!

About the Role:

You must have excellent knowledge of surveying methods, equipment, and software, such as total stations, and AutoCAD. You must be able to work independently and as part of a team and handle complex or challenging survey situations. It is required to follow all applicable State and Federal safety rules and regulations, and all applicable Company-issued safety guidelines and policies.

Responsibilities:

  • Follow all applicable State and Federal safety rules and regulations, and all applicable Company-issued safety guidelines and policies.

  • Conduct underground surveys of the mine workings, using various tools and software, such as total stations, and AutoCAD.

  • Ensure the accuracy and reliability of the survey data and report any errors or discrepancies.

  • Download data to use and update survey plans, maps, and drawings, using AutoCAD and other software.

  • Provide survey data and information, in a time0ly manner, to support mine planning, design, development, and production.

  • Must be able to provide accurate survey data and information to support mine planning, design, development, and production.

  • Run check surveys.

  • Maintain and calibrate survey equipment and software and troubleshoot any issues.

  • Properly care for survey equipment.

  • Keep records of survey work and data and submit reports as required.

Who You Are:

At least 3 years of experience in underground surveying, preferably in underground coal mining. Preferred bachelor's degree in surveying and geomatics sciences, or related associate degree.

  • Excellent knowledge of surveying methods, equipment, and software, such as total stations and AutoCAD.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Handle complex or challenging survey situations and communicate those plans with proper management.

  • Must have good communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.

  • Attention to detail, accuracy, and quality.

  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

  • Must be familiar with construction layout surveying.

Environment and Safety:

  • Improve on safety standards by holding safety meetings, conducting safety interactions, and taking corrective action where required.

  • Ensure adherence to State, Federal and Company workplace policies and standard work procedures for risk identification, risk assessment and risk control.

  • Maintain a high level of safety performance through effective communication, monitoring, and revision of standard work procedures.

  • Identify and report safety risks, accidents, incidents, injuries, and property damage at the workplace.

  • Attend and participate in scheduled safety meetings and training.

  • Investigate accidents and near misses with a view toward positive action, through training, equipment set-up or equipment repair and report on findings and conclusions.

  • Maintain environmental awareness amongst the workforce by holding meetings and involving the environmental department in related subjects.

  • Ensure adherence to environmental policy, work standards, management plans and regulatory obligations and requirements.

  • Integrate environmental policies, programs, and practices into all activities of the organization.

Physical Requirements - Underground:

  • Must be able to stand for long periods of time on uneven, rocky surfaces.

  • Must be able to sit for up to 4 hours to operate equipment or vehicles.

  • Must be able to walk for up to 4 hours at a time.

  • Will need to walk through different sections of the mine with different amounts of clearance and headroom.

  • Walking ability will be based on SCSR emergency evacuation plan required and approved by MSHA.

  • Must be able to wear the required protective footwear, hearing and eye protection, and other personal protective equipment as required by Company and MSHA.

  • Must be able to bend or stoop for a full work period because of mine height.

  • Must be able to climb up and down stairs/steps and climb on and off equipment and ladders.

  • Must be able to do repetitive hand and wrist motions (push, pull, twist, handle), and have quick reflex movements of the arms and legs as well as good hand to eye coordination.

  • Must be able to lift 25 to 50 pounds frequently and occasionally lift items weighing up to 75 pounds.

  • Must be able to work in extreme conditions, including but not limited to changing weather conditions, dust, mud, varying levels of noise from low to high decibels, varying degrees of light and dark, in and around artificial light and in a confined work area.

Job Title

Mobile Operating Engineer

Job Description Summary

Responsible to ensure the efficient operation and maintenance of HVAC, mechanical, electrical and plumbing equipment and systems for the assigned property(s). Responsibilities include (but are not limited to) maintaining a clean and safe working environment, performing rounds, conducting routine assessments, performance of day-to-day preventive and corrective maintenance, painting, and housekeeping for assigned properties.

Job Description


• Perform all plumbing, electrical, or HVAC requirements of the building(s)
• Maintain heating equipment, up to and including chillers (air and/ or water cooled), DX units, pumps, cooling towers, fan coil units, VAV, and air distribution systems, etc.
• Monitor and adjust all mechanical/pneumatic equipment, steam stations, control gauges, distributor panels, valves, thermostats, diffusers, and other equipment necessary to provide a comfortable environment for the buildings
• Verify field conditions and perform any preventative maintenance inspections and complete any necessary repairs or adjustments as needed.
• Monitor Energy Management
• Repair doors, ceilings, hand railings, and floors and other general repairs, adjustments and installations about the property
• Perform repairs to plumbing fixtures (water closets, urinals, flush valve assemblies, lavatories, etc.)
• Perform preventive maintenance duties in accordance with C&W standards, building protocol, manufacturer recommendations and industry best practices. including changing filters, cleaning coils, flushing condensers, punching tubes, greasing fan, pump and motor bearings as required, inspecting and adjusting belts, replacing motor bearings, aligning pulleys and shafts, monitor condenser, chilled, heating and secondary water chemical treatment and its associated feed equipment, clean and maintain cooling towers, and perform annual inspections and other scheduled routines as directed.
• Replace lamps, light fixtures, reinstall or replace signage, verify rooms are clean and clear of obstructions and debris

• Check for properly operating emergency exit signs and lights and ensure free and clear access to emergency stairs and exits. Perform additional fire and life safety inspections as per NFPA and local jurisdiction, C&W standards, building protocol and as directed by superiors and property management

• Document and report activities to supervisor
• Respond immediately to emergency situations (fire, evacuation, equipment failure, etc.) and customer concerns
• Comply with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agency, and company directives as relates to building operations and practice safe work habits
• Complete all required C&W Safety Training as scheduled annually
• Comply with C&W Uniform Dress Code while working and maintain a neat and clean appearance while on the property at times other than working hours

KEY COMPETENCIES:
• Technical Proficiency
• Initiative
• Flexibility
• Multi-Tasking
• Sense of Urgency

IMPORTANT EDUCATION:
• High School Diploma of GED Equivalent
• Graduate of apprentice program or trade school preferred

IMPORTANT EXPERIENCE:
• 5+ years of related work experience in operating HVAC, plumbing, mechanical systems in a commercial property setting.

ADDITIONAL ELIGIBILITY QUALIFICATIONS:
• Appropriate license/permit for trade as may be required, (i.e. Journeyman or Master License or City Licenses, such as Refrigeration Certificate of Fitness, High Pressure Boiler License, High Pressure Steam Operator, etc.)
• Required to have certification as a Universal Technician for CFC’s depending on market licensure requirements
• Possess and maintain a valid driver’s license and good driving record with periodic checks (where applicable)
• Basic Computing Skills in Outlook, Excel & Word
• Experience in operation, maintenance and basic repair of HVAC, boilers, heaters, pumps, refrigerant systems, compressors, water systems, etc.
• Knowledgeable in energy management systems, techniques and operations.
• Thorough knowledge in all building systems operations, maintenance and repair.

May be only maintenance staff member on duty during certain shifts; may be required to work extended periods of time without relief when responding to priority/emergency situations (including overtime type assignments); may require shift work and/or on call duties.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:
This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines. Regularly required to travel outside between properties in varying weather conditions.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
• Must have ability to stoop, stand, climb, frequently lift a minimum of 50 lbs. of equipment (pumps, tools, ladders) and safely install rigging/lifting devices
• Regularly required to crouch and reach to install/move equipment by bending forward at the waist

title: IT Field Technician
description:
IT Field Technician

(Open to applicants living within commuting distance of Albuquerque, NM.)

If you are a self-starter, take this step to learn about a new career with us!

Job Description

We are seeking a skilled and adaptable IT Field Technician to provide on-site and remote support for hardware, software, and network systems. This role involves installing, configuring, and troubleshooting desktops, laptops, servers, routers, switches, and peripheral devices such as printers and scanners. The technician will assist with maintaining LAN and WAN environments, diagnosing connectivity issues, and ensuring optimal network performance. Responsibilities include delivering technical support to end-users, resolving hardware and software problems, documenting service actions, and IT inventory. The technician will also support IT security by applying updates, configuring firewalls, and ensuring antivirus protection. Additional duties include training users on basic IT procedures, managing equipment inventory, installing structured cabling, and conducting scheduled or emergency on-site visits. Strong collaboration with internal teams, clients, and vendors is essential for resolving complex technical issues and coordinating repairs or replacements. The ideal candidate will demonstrate excellent problem-solving skills, maintain compliance with data protection standards, and manage their schedule effectively to meet service-level agreements and client expectations. This role requires flexibility, a proactive approach to learning new technologies, and the ability to respond promptly to critical IT issues when needed.

Requirements

  • Basic knowledge of computer hardware, software, and networking is essential. This includes familiarity with operating systems (e.g., Windows, macOS), hardware components, and common software applications.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills are essential. Field Technicians often interact with end-users and must be able to explain technical issues and solutions in a clear and understandable manner.

  • Field Technicians need the ability to diagnose and troubleshoot common hardware and software problems. Logical thinking and problem-solving skills are crucial.

  • Excellent customer service skills are important, as Field Technicians often work directly with end-users who may be experiencing technical issues or frustrations.

  • The ability to manage time efficiently and prioritize tasks is crucial, especially when responding to multiple service requests in a field setting.

  • Familiarity with basic networking concepts, such as IP addressing, DHCP, and DNS, is beneficial as Field Technicians often work with networked devices.

  • Provide remote support to end-users or remote locations through phone, email, or remote desktop tools to diagnose and resolve issues,

  • Must be available for emergency on-call duty to address critical IT issues outside of regular business hours, if required.

  • Must demonstrate strong schedule management skills to ensure timely, reliable IT support and effective utilization of field technician resources. This includes proficient appointment scheduling, task prioritization, route planning, time management, cross‑team coordination, workflow optimization, adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs), and the ability to respond efficiently to urgent or unforeseen service needs.

  • All positions require the successful completion of a criminal background check, and further background checks if the position involves access to sensitive information or secure facilities.

  • This position requires travel to different locations, which requires a valid driver’s license, intermittent DMV checks, and a reliable personal vehicle.

IronEdge is the premier IT solutions provider for small-to-medium sized businesses. We love what we do, and our team loves working together to eliminate the frustration companies face with technology. As a service-centric company with a culture that always puts people first, IronEdge is dedicated to providing a fun, fulfilling and inclusive environment where teammates can excel in their specialized roles. Jij zorgt ervoor dat slimme gebouwen ook écht slim functioneren. Je programmeert en test gebouwbeheersystemen, stelt installaties in bedrijf en optimaliseert regelingen voor comfort, prestaties en energieverbruik.

title: Product Manager Mission Payload Land (m/f/d)

Join Quantum-Systems and drive mission-critical payload capabilities to make a real impact. As Product Manager Mission Payload Land, you own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for payload capabilities across our Land Domain Vehicle Portfolio.

You operate at the intersection of customer value, technical feasibility, and commercial viability; working in tight collaboration with payload providers and internal engineering teams. You balance tactical mission requirements against platform constraints, make build-or-buy trade-offs consciously, and define high-value ConOps and payload configurations that the organization can execute against.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • End-to-End Product Management: Own the vision, roadmap, and lifecycle management for mission payload integration across the UGV portfolio from discovery and concept validation to operational deployment

  • Market Screening & Ecosystem Management: Screen the market to identify, evaluate, and stand up partnerships with payload vendors across the domains ISR, Electronic Warfare, Communications, Combat Engineering, Logistics, and more

  • Continuous Discovery & Experimentation: Drive prototyping and experimental integration of partner payloads including mechanical, E/E, and software integration interfaces and assess performance and usability

  • Build-or-Buy & Productization: Prioritize payload capabilities based on mission utility and drive formal build-or-buy decisions for high-value use cases

  • Engineering & Vendor Collaboration: Serve as the functional bridge between external payload suppliers, customer stakeholders, and internal engineering teams

  • Iterative Delivery: Consolidate customer, user, and field operational insights to set product priorities and continuously convert requirements into shipped capabilities


What you bring to the team:

  • Multiple years of hands-on experience in technical product/project management or systems engineering, ideally at a Tier-1 Defence Electronics, C4ISR, or Sensor Subsystem OEM

  • Strong commercial instincts paired with a solid technical foundation, enabling you to liaise seamlessly between engineering teams and external customer stakeholders

  • A proactive, solution-oriented approach with a proven ability to deliver results in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment

  • Fluency in English to effectively engage with our global team and international customers; German is a plus


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

Headquartered in New York and Tel Aviv, with R&D based in Tel Aviv, and backed by TLV Partners, Insight partners, and Jibe Ventures.

We’re building an AI-Native platform that automates global compliance in real time.

We sit at the intersection of Legal-AI and fintech company, solving one of the hardest infrastructure problems in global business: real-time equity and compliance automation.

You’ll explore complex, domain-specific challenges, define research directions, and translate promising ideas into practical product capabilities. Your work will span applied research, experimentation, and model development—including building and adapting large and small language models using proprietary data, domain knowledge, and modern training techniques.

You’ll work with complex financial documents, structured and unstructured financial data, and legal and compliance data and knowledge, developing approaches that help AI interpret and reason across these sources.

Working closely with the CTO, engineering teams, and domain experts, you’ll have significant ownership over both the questions we investigate and the approaches we take. We’re looking for someone who combines strong research fundamentals with the drive to build, test, and bring ideas into production.


What You’ll Do

• Lead applied AI research efforts. Identify meaningful opportunities, shape the research roadmap, and drive initiatives from initial exploration through validation and implementation.

• Build and improve models. Develop, train, and adapt models using approaches such as fine-tuning, post-training, distillation, and other relevant techniques.

• Work with complex documents and data. Explore methods for understanding and reasoning over financial documents, structured business data, and legal and compliance information, in collaboration with domain experts.

• Drive rigorous experimentation. Formulate hypotheses, build datasets and evaluation frameworks, and systematically measure performance, reliability, and tradeoffs.

• Connect research to real-world applications. Collaborate with engineers and domain experts to turn research outcomes into scalable, production-ready capabilities.

• Advance our research practices. Evaluate emerging methods, share findings, and help establish strong standards for experimentation, model development, and responsible use of data.

Requirements

What You’ll Bring

• 6+ years of experience in AI/ML research or applied science, with a strong background in deep learning and recent hands-on experience with language models.

• Proven experience building, training, or adapting models, including ownership of data preparation, experimentation, and evaluation—not just integrating third-party model APIs.

• Strong proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks, such as PyTorch, and familiarity with the language-model training ecosystem.

• A solid understanding of model architectures, optimization, training methodologies, and evaluation..

• Strong research judgment: the ability to frame ambiguous problems, design meaningful experiments, analyze results, and make evidence-based decisions.

• The ability to work independently, take technical ownership, and collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and domain experts.


Nice to Have

• An M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or an equivalent research track record.

• Experience with advanced post-training methods, reinforcement learning, synthetic data, knowledge distillation, or efficient model training and inference.

• Experience in document understanding, information extraction, or reasoning across structured and unstructured data, particularly in financial, legal, or compliance domains.

• Research publications, meaningful open-source contributions, or a track record of bringing research into production.


Why Join Slice

  • Build with purpose: Apply AI to solve global compliance at scale.
  • High ownership: Work directly on product-critical systems with real customer impact.
  • Technical depth: Work across architecture, UX, and infrastructure.
  • Collaboration: Partner with top engineers and alumni of elite technology units.
  • Team culture: Collaborative, ambitious, and impact-driven.
  • Startup energy: Join a high-growth company backed by top investors, scaling globally, and redefining fintech infrastructure.

Job Title

Operating Engineer

Job Description Summary

Responsible to ensure the efficient operation and maintenance of mechanical, electrical and plumbing equipment and systems for the assigned property(s). ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Perform all plumbing, electrical, or HVAC requirements of the building(s)
• Maintain heating equipment, chillers (air and/ or water cooled), DX units, pumps, cooling towers, fan coil units, VAV, and air distribution systems, etc.
• Monitor and adjust all mechanical/pneumatic equipment, steam stations, control gauges, distributor panels, valves, thermostats, diffusers, and other equipment necessary to provide a comfortable environment for the buildings
• Verify field conditions and perform any necessary repairs or adjustments
• Monitor Energy Management

• Check for properly operating emergency exit signs and lights and ensure free and clear access to emergency stairs and exits. Perform additional fire and life safety inspections as per NFPA and local jurisdiction, C&W standards, building protocol and as directed by superiors and property management
• Document and report activities to supervisor

May be only maintenance staff member on duty during certain shifts; may be required to work extended periods of time without relief when responding to priority/emergency situations (including overtime type assignments); may require shift work and/or on call duties
WORK ENVIRONMENT
This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines. Regularly required to travel outside between properties in varying weather conditions.

title: Head of Bunker – Shipping & Mining
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Head of Bunker to lead and manage the company's bunker procurement, planning, supply, and cost-control activities across its shipping and mining-related operations.

The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of marine fuel procurement, bunker trading, vessel operations, fuel quality, supplier management, and commercial negotiations, with proven experience supporting tug & barge, bulk carrier, and mining/coal transportation operations.

This position will play a key role in ensuring reliable fuel availability, competitive bunker costs, effective supplier relationships, and strong control over fuel consumption and operational expenditure.

Key Responsibilities

Bunker Procurement & Strategy

  • Develop and execute the company's overall bunker procurement strategy for the fleet and related operations.
  • Manage the procurement of marine fuel, including MGO, MFO, VLSFO, and other applicable marine fuels.
  • Monitor bunker requirements based on vessel schedules, voyage plans, fleet deployment, and operational forecasts.
  • Negotiate bunker prices, payment terms, credit facilities, and commercial conditions with suppliers.
  • Develop competitive sourcing strategies to optimize bunker purchasing costs.
  • Monitor global and regional bunker price movements and identify favorable purchasing opportunities.
  • Establish and maintain relationships with reputable bunker suppliers, traders, and physical providers.

Fleet Bunker Planning

  • Coordinate closely with Operations, Commercial, Technical, and Finance teams to forecast and manage vessel fuel requirements.
  • Develop bunker plans based on vessel routes, estimated consumption, port availability, and voyage schedules.
  • Ensure timely bunker delivery to avoid vessel delays or operational disruption.
  • Review vessel fuel consumption against budget, voyage estimates, and historical performance.
  • Identify abnormal consumption patterns and coordinate with relevant departments for investigation.
  • Optimize bunker purchasing locations based on price, availability, vessel schedule, and operational requirements.

Shipping & Mining Operations

  • Support bunker requirements for tug & barge, bulk carrier, offshore, and other vessels involved in shipping and mining-related transportation.
  • Understand fuel requirements associated with coal transportation, barging, transshipment, and mine-to-port logistics.
  • Coordinate bunker planning with mining production schedules and vessel deployment.
  • Ensure adequate fuel availability for vessels operating in remote mining and marine locations.
  • Develop contingency plans for potential fuel supply disruptions, weather conditions, port restrictions, and unexpected changes in vessel schedules.

Cost Control & Optimization

  • Monitor total bunker expenditure and identify opportunities for cost reduction and operational efficiency.
  • Analyze bunker prices, consumption, supplier quotations, and purchasing performance.
  • Establish and monitor bunker budgets and forecasts.
  • Compare actual fuel consumption against planned consumption and investigate significant variances.
  • Develop regular reports covering bunker price trends, purchasing performance, fuel consumption, and cost savings.
  • Work with Finance to ensure accurate invoice verification, reconciliation, and payment processes.

Supplier & Vendor Management

  • Build and maintain a reliable network of bunker suppliers, traders, physical providers, and fuel service companies.
  • Conduct supplier evaluation based on price competitiveness, quality, reliability, credit terms, and service performance.
  • Negotiate commercial agreements and framework arrangements with strategic suppliers.
  • Monitor supplier performance and resolve issues related to delivery, quality, quantity, documentation, and invoicing.
  • Maintain appropriate supplier diversification to reduce dependency and supply-chain risk.

Bunker Quality & Quantity Control

  • Ensure bunker deliveries comply with applicable quality specifications and contractual requirements.
  • Coordinate bunker sampling, testing, documentation, and quality verification where required.
  • Review bunker delivery notes, quantity measurements, and supporting documentation.
  • Investigate discrepancies between ordered, delivered, and consumed quantities.
  • Coordinate with vessel Masters, Chief Engineers, surveyors, suppliers, and relevant third parties regarding bunker quantity or quality disputes.
  • Support the investigation and resolution of off-specification fuel and bunker-related claims.

Risk Management & Compliance

  • Establish appropriate controls to minimize bunker procurement, pricing, quality, quantity, and supply risks.
  • Ensure bunker purchasing activities comply with company policies, contractual requirements, and applicable maritime regulations.
  • Monitor potential risks associated with supplier credit, fuel quality, delivery locations, and market volatility.
  • Establish contingency plans for critical fuel supply requirements.
  • Maintain proper documentation and audit trails for bunker procurement transactions.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop the bunker/procurement team.
  • Establish clear processes, responsibilities, approval mechanisms, and performance standards.
  • Develop team capabilities in bunker procurement, market analysis, negotiation, and fuel cost management.
  • Coordinate effectively with Operations, Commercial, Technical, Crewing, Finance, and senior management.
  • Ensure timely communication of bunker requirements, market developments, risks, and purchasing decisions.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Maritime, Shipping, Logistics, Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related field.
  • Minimum 8–10 years of relevant experience in bunker procurement, marine fuel, shipping operations, maritime procurement, or related industries.
  • At least 3–5 years in a managerial or leadership position.
  • Strong understanding of marine fuel procurement and bunker operations.
  • Proven experience negotiating bunker prices and commercial agreements.
  • Strong network with bunker suppliers, traders, physical providers, and maritime service companies.
  • Experience supporting tug & barge, bulk carrier, coal transportation, or mining-related shipping operations is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of vessel fuel consumption, voyage requirements, and marine fuel specifications.
  • Strong analytical, negotiation, commercial, and financial skills.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication capabilities.
  • Good command of English and Bahasa Indonesia, both written and spoken.
  • Willing to travel to vessels, ports, terminals, and operational sites when required.

title: Senior Product Manager, Medical Imaging
description:
We’re on a mission to change the future of
clinical research. At Perceptive, we help the
biopharmaceutical industry bring medical
treatments to the market, faster.
Our mission is to change the world
but to do this, we need people like you.

What can we offer you?

Apart from job satisfaction, we can offer you:


YOURSELF
• 25 days’ holiday (with the option to buy more)


HEALTH
• Health Cash Plan
• Optional private health, dental insurance, and health screens
• Cycle to work scheme


WEALTH
• Generous pension scheme with up to 10% employer contribution

• Season ticket loan

About the role

As Senior Product Manager, Medical Imaging, you'll specialise in Medical Imaging and Clinical Trials SaaS solutions, using your significant experience as a Product Manager to drive portfolio business strategy and market success of cutting-edge cloud-based platforms which revolutionise
medical imaging workflows in Clinical Research.

Forming part of the Perceptive Imaging R&D Group and collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across our international network, you'll be tasked with defining product portfolio strategy based on customer needs, market trends and business goals, focusing on automated workflow platforms and integrated SaaS solutions which accelerate clinical trial timelines whilst ensuring regulatory compliance.

Leveraging deep expertise in clinical trial operations and SaaS platform management, you'll focus on translating industry trends and technological developments to generate business advantages. A genuine enthusiast, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping business opportunities into innovative, commercially successful solutions delivering transformative value to the life sciences industry.

Key Responsibilities

AI & Automation Strategy

  • Define and own the product vision for a comprehensive AI-enabled medical imaging SaaS platform serving clinical trials globally.

  • Develop strategic roadmaps that integrate the latest scientific developments to reduce manual review time and accelerate trial timelines.

  • Collaborate with technical teams to identify opportunities for automation, predictive analytics, and intelligent image processing (automated quality control, protocol deviation detection, biomarker quantification).

  • Create compelling business cases for automation and AI investments, demonstrating ROI through efficiency gains, reduced error rates, and improved trial outcomes.

SaaS Platform Development

  • Drive platform strategy for multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS solutions supporting diverse imaging modalities (MRI, CT, PET, ultrasound, digital pathology)

  • Establish SaaS metrics and KPIs including platform uptime, scalability targets, user adoption rates, customer success metrics, and trial efficiency improvements

  • Define integration strategies with existing clinical trial management systems (CTMS), electronic data capture (EDC), and PACS/imaging vendor ecosystems

Strategic Planning & Execution

  • Translate strategy into actionable roadmaps and prioritize features based on clinical impact, business value, user needs, and technical feasibility

  • Align the product vision with business goals and market opportunities

  • Collaborate with clinical trial sponsors, imaging CROs, and site users to gather insights and validate product direction

  • Collaborate with commercial, marketing and customer success teams to ensure product-market fit and go-to-market alignment

  • Collaborate with Product Owners and Solution Architects to translate business requirements into technical feasibility assessments and platform architecture decisions

  • Work with Product Owners to ensure user requirements are translated into detailed functional requirements and user stories aligned with clinical workflows

Market and Competitive Intelligence

  • Analyse competitive landscape in medical imaging SaaS, emerging AI capabilities, and regulatory trends to inform product evolution

  • Monitor industry trends and competitor offerings to inform product strategy

  • Develop differentiated value propositions per customer segment

Product Lifecycle Management

  • Manage the full product lifecycle from concept to retirement, with emphasis on continuous business value delivery, ensuring continuous alignment with business objectives.

  • Monitor product performance through clinical trial outcomes, imaging throughput metrics, AI model performance, and user satisfaction

  • Lead thestrategy for product launches including go-to-market planning, user training programs, and customer success enablement

  • Establish feedback loops with clinical users to drive continuous improvement in automation accuracy and workflow efficiency

  • Establish feedback loops with external customers to drive continuous product improvement, including new features

  • Develop evolution strategies of existing products to cloud-based SaaS platforms.

Budgeting and Financial Oversight

  • Manage product budgets for large initiatives, including resource allocation and financial viability assessments.

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide functional leadership to other Product Managers, offering guidance on product development, clinical trials domain expertise, coaching and performance feedback.

  • Foster a culture of innovation, data-driven decision making, and customer-centricity.

Stakeholder Relationship management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including senior leadership and clients.

  • Serve as the voice of the customer and market within the organisation

  • Represent the organization at industry events, conferences, and forums to influence market perception and gather insights.

Business analysis & Process Improvement

  • Lead the analysis of clinical imaging workflows, user journeys, and operational bottlenecks to identify automation opportunities.

  • Evaluate usability and accessibility of product designs and prototypes.

  • Drive business process reengineering initiatives to eliminate manual data entry, reduce imaging review cycles, and accelerate trial database locks

Regulatory Compliance & Quality Management

  • Ensure SaaS platform adheres to regulatory requirements (21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, GDPR, GxP) and industry standards (DICOM, HL7 FHIR)

  • Collaborate with Quality department to maintain validation documentation, audit trails, and compliance evidence

  • Collaborate on the design of AI/ML features with explainability and clinical validation requirements in mind

  • Maintain awareness of FDA guidance on AI/ML in medical devices and clinical decision support

Clinical Trial Domain Expertise & Workflow Optimization

  • Deep engagement with clinical imaging workflows including image acquisition, quality control, transfer, central review, and endpoint adjudication

  • Partner with clinical operations to identify automation opportunities in imaging charter development, site qualification, protocol compliance monitoring, and data management

  • Design features that address specific clinical trial challenges: multi-site standardization, reader blinding, inter-reader variability, protocol adherence tracking

  • Ensure platform capabilities support diverse therapeutic areas (oncology, neurology …) with specialized imaging endpoints

Functional Competencies (Technical knowledge/Skills)

  • Strategic thinker with demonstrated experience in SaaS product management and platform scaling.

  • Strong product mindset balancing user-centric design with technical feasibility and business viability.

  • Expertise in Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe), SDLC, and product lifecycle tools.

  • Strong commercial mindset and ability to align product strategy with business goals.

  • Experience in market analysis, customer segmentation and value proposition design.

  • Data-driven decision maker with proficiency in product analytics and A/B testing.

  • Good understanding of medical imaging.

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SaaS architecture patterns (microservices, APIs, multi-tenancy).

  • Knowledge of imaging data standards (DICOM, NIfTI).

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to translate complex concepts for diverse audiences.

  • Strong stakeholder management capabilities across technical teams, clinical users, and executive leadership.

  • Demonstrated leadership and mentoring capabilities with focus on talent development and team building.

  • High interpersonal awareness and ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

  • Demonstrable adaptability with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, regulated, and cross-functional environment.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration in emerging technology spaces.​

Experience, Education and Certifications

title: Chief Engineer
location: Client Site - USA - GA - Atlanta - 40 Perimeter Center E
description:
Job Title

Chief Engineer

Job Description Summary

The Chief Engineer is responsible for leading the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of mission-critical data center infrastructure. This role oversees maintenance, operations, vendor activity, and infrastructure projects across electrical, mechanical, cooling, monitoring, and life-safety systems to support maximum uptime, operational resiliency, and compliance with applicable data center standards.

Job Description

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

  • Lead daily operations and maintenance of mission-critical infrastructure, including UPS systems, generators, switchgear, PDUs, CRAC/CRAH units, BMS, EPMS, and DCIM platforms.
  • Ensure high availability and minimize downtime through proactive monitoring, preventive maintenance, incident response, and continuous risk reduction.
  • Supervise, coach, and coordinate a multidisciplinary technical team supporting 24/7 data center operations.
  • Monitor and respond to alarms from BMS, EPMS, and DCIM systems; lead troubleshooting, escalation, and root cause analysis for critical incidents.
  • Develop, maintain, and enforce standard operating procedures, methods of procedure, emergency operating procedures, and change management practices.
  • Oversee vendor and contractor activities, including maintenance, testing, construction, commissioning, and turnover work within the critical environment.
  • Promote and enforce compliance with safety requirements and critical environment protocols, including lockout/tagout, electrical safety, arc flash safety, and site access procedures.
  • Support capacity planning, infrastructure upgrades, equipment lifecycle planning, and expansion projects in coordination with operations, engineering, and project teams.
  • Maintain accurate documentation, including shift logs, maintenance records, incident reports, asset information, and operating procedures.
  • Support commissioning, QA/QC, and turnover of new or modified systems to ensure alignment with design intent, operational requirements, and site standards.
  • Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reliability, operational efficiency, safety, and risk mitigation.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in critical facilities, data center engineering, or comparable mission-critical environments.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of supervisory or leadership experience managing technical or facilities teams.
  • Strong working knowledge of data center electrical and mechanical systems, including UPS systems, generators, switchgear, PDUs, HVAC, cooling systems, and fire/life safety systems.
  • Hands-on experience with BMS, EPMS, DCIM, or similar monitoring and control platforms.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical one-lines, schematics, sequence of operations, construction drawings, and technical documentation.
  • Experience supporting commissioning, QA/QC, MEP coordination, and turnover activities for new or modified infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with applicable standards and regulatory requirements, including Uptime Institute guidance, NFPA, NEC, OSHA, and site-specific safety requirements.
  • Demonstrated troubleshooting, decision-making, problem-solving, and incident management skills in high-pressure operating environments.
  • Ability to participate in on-call rotations and respond to critical incidents as required by site operations.

title: Senior Backend Software Engineer - Innovations
description:
Duties And Responsibilities

At Globe, our goal is to create a wonderful world for our people, business, and nation. By uniting people of passion who believe they can make a difference, we are confident that we can achieve this goal.

Job Description

The Backend Software Engineer is a hands-on engineering role responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining reliable backend services, APIs, integrations, and supporting application components. The role works within an engineering team under the guidance of Senior Engineers and Technical Leads and contributes to the development of innovative products and emerging technology initiatives within Globe. Sample projects may include Globe Cloud, Scam Shield, Globe Starlink, AI Products, and other innovation-driven initiatives. The Backend Software Engineer is expected to independently deliver well-defined features, contribute to technical and solution discussions, follow established engineering standards, and collaborate effectively with product, QA, platform, and other engineering teams. The role is primarily focused on backend development, including API development, system integrations, data processing, cloud-native services, distributed applications, and the technical exploration and implementation required to bring new product ideas from concept and experimentation into production. As part of an innovation-focused environment, the engineer should be comfortable exploring new technologies, rapidly building and validating solutions, and adapting to evolving product and technical requirements while maintaining appropriate engineering quality and standards.

Duties And Responsibilities

Backend Development

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, integrations, and application components.
  • Translate functional and technical requirements into maintainable software implementations.
  • Build RESTful APIs and service-to-service integrations.
  • Develop backend applications using technologies such as Node.js, NestJS, Python, Go, Java, or similar technologies.
  • Work with relational and non-relational databases.
  • Implement validation, authentication, authorization, error handling, and application logging.
  • Integrate applications with internal systems, enterprise platforms, and third-party APIs.
  • Contribute to asynchronous and event-driven workflows using queues, messaging platforms, and background processing.
  • Troubleshoot application defects and production issues within assigned systems.

AI-Assisted Software Development

  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of day-to-day software engineering workflows.
  • Leverage AI tools for code generation, code explanation, refactoring, test generation, debugging, documentation, and technical research.
  • Write clear and effective prompts or instructions that provide sufficient technical context for AI-assisted development tasks.
  • Review, validate, test, and understand AI-generated code before incorporating it into the codebase.
  • Recognize that AI-generated solutions may be incomplete, insecure, inefficient, or incorrect and apply engineering judgment before adoption.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate development without compromising code quality, security, maintainability, or established engineering standards.
  • Follow organizational policies regarding source code, sensitive information, credentials, customer data, and appropriate use of AI tools.
  • Continuously learn and adopt emerging AI-assisted engineering practices and development tools.

Application Development

  • Collaborate with frontend engineers on API contracts and application integrations.
  • Support end-to-end troubleshooting across backend services, databases, frontend applications, and external systems.
  • Understand application flows and dependencies across multiple services.
  • Contribute to shared application components and technical improvements where appropriate.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

  • Develop and maintain applications deployed on cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS.
  • Work with containerized applications and cloud-native deployment environments.
  • Assist with application configuration, deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Use managed cloud services for compute, storage, databases, messaging, and application integration.
  • Follow established CI/CD and release-management processes.

Engineering Quality

  • Write clean, reusable, testable, and maintainable code.
  • Write unit, integration, and automated tests for developed features.
  • Participate in peer code reviews and incorporate technical feedback.
  • Follow established software engineering principles, coding standards, and design patterns.
  • Follow secure coding and data-handling practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve code quality, reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Participate in debugging and root-cause analysis.
  • Maintain appropriate technical documentation.

Delivery & Collaboration

  • Own assigned features and technical tasks from development through deployment.
  • Provide realistic estimates and communicate delivery risks or blockers early.
  • Participate in planning, refinement, stand-ups, retrospectives, and technical discussions.
  • Collaborate with engineers, Technical Leads, Product Managers, QA Engineers, and other stakeholders.
  • Support testing, deployment, and production validation activities.
  • Contribute technical input during solution discussions while working within established architecture and engineering standards.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Professional experience in software development with a strong focus on backend engineering.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals.
  • Experience developing backend applications, APIs, and system integrations.
  • Experience with at least one backend language or framework such as Node.js/NestJS, Python, Go, Java, or equivalent.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
  • Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development workflows.
  • Experience building or consuming REST APIs.
  • Understanding of application testing, debugging, logging, and error handling.
  • Basic understanding of cloud-native application development.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or equivalent coding assistants.
  • Ability to critically review and validate AI-generated code rather than relying on generated output without verification.
  • Understanding of security and privacy considerations when using AI tools during software development.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or similar cloud environments.
  • Experience with Docker and containerized applications.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes or managed container platforms.
  • Experience with messaging or event-driven technologies.
  • Familiarity with Redis, Firestore, Snowflake, or similar data platforms.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines.
  • Understanding of microservices and distributed-system fundamentals.
  • Exposure to Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, SOLID principles, or similar software design practices.
  • Experience integrating applications with enterprise or third-party systems.
  • Experience incorporating AI-assisted development into regular engineering workflows to improve development speed, testing, debugging, documentation, or code quality.

AI Application Development — Strong Plus

  • Knowledge and hands-on experience developing AI-powered applications is a strong advantage. Relevant experience may include:
  • Building backend applications that integrate with Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI APIs.
  • Developing AI-powered capabilities such as conversational assistants, copilots, intelligent search, summarization, classification, and workflow automation.
  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
  • Understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool/function calling, and context management.
  • Experience developing agentic or multi-step AI workflows.
  • Familiarity with AI application frameworks or orchestration tools such as LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience integrating models and APIs from providers such as OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, or equivalent platforms.
  • Understanding of AI application evaluation, testing, observability, tracing, and quality monitoring.
  • Awareness of common AI application concerns including hallucination, latency, cost, security, data privacy, and reliability.
  • Ability to combine traditional backend engineering practices with AI capabilities to build reliable, production-ready AI applications.
  • Deep AI/ML research experience or model training expertise is not required; practical experience building
  • software applications that effectively use modern AI capabilities is considered a strong plus.

Expected Level of Ownership

  • The Backend Software Engineer is expected to:
  • Own individual backend features, APIs, integrations, bug fixes, and technical tasks.
  • Contribute to technical design, estimation, code reviews, testing, deployments, and engineering improvements.
  • Collaborate on larger system designs and cross-service implementations.
  • Support end-to-end application troubleshooting when required.
  • Use AI-assisted development responsibly to improve productivity while remaining accountable for the correctness and quality of delivered code.
  • Escalate significant architectural decisions, major production risks, and cross-team technical dependencies.
  • Work with Senior Engineers and Technical Leads on complex technical decisions.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Globe’s hiring process promotes equal opportunity to applicants, Any form of discrimination is not tolerated throughout the entire employee lifecycle, including the hiring process such as in posting vacancies, selecting, and interviewing applicants.

This is a pivotal role supporting the efficient operation of our workshop and maintenance function. title: Data Analyst (Payment Performance and Optimization) - fully remote within Europe (m/f/d)
description:
The Team
Every successful transaction tells a story - of trust, performance, and precision. In our company, payments are not just a backend function; they are the engine that drives revenue, customer experience, and risk management.

Our Payments team sits at the intersection of Product, Operations, Finance, and Risk. We are deeply data-driven and relentlessly focused on clarity. We believe that when payment data is structured, transparent, and reliable, better decisions follow, and performance improves across the entire business.

This role strengthens the analytical backbone of Payments. It brings structure to KPIs, ownership to reporting, and confidence to decision-making.

Your Role
As our Payments Data Analyst, you will own payments reporting and KPI governance end-to-end in Power BI. The role reports to the Head of BI, with Payments and high-level management as key stakeholders.

This is an experienced individual contributor role for someone who thrives on precision, consistency, and analytical depth. You will ensure our payment performance data isaccurate, structured, anddecision-ready. You will translate complex operational and business questions into robust SQL logic and clear, actionable dashboards.

Your work will make trends visible, anomalies understandable, and risks measurable – enabling the company to act with confidence.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Own and continuously improve end-to-end payments dashboards in Power BI
  • Maintain andoptimizethe payments BI infrastructure and data organization
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and governance across all payment KPIs
  • Standardize KPI definitions across Product, Operations, Finance, and Risk
  • Translate business questions into structured SQL queries and meaningful reporting
  • Lead ad-hoc investigations (authorization drops, decline spikes, PSP comparisons, recovery performance)
  • Proactivelyidentifyanomalies, performance trends, and emerging risks
  • Improve documentation and clarity of payment data models
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure reporting aligns with operational reality
  • Collaborate closely with the BI team for peer review and quality assurance before findings and reports reach stakeholders
What You'll Need
  • 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics (payments or fintech strongly preferred)
  • Advanced Power BIexpertise(data modeling, DAX, performance optimization)
  • Strong SQL skills, with confidence querying andvalidatingcomplex tables in SQL Server
  • Familiarity with Azure and Microsoft Fabric is a plus
  • Experience working with payment data (PSPs, recurring flows, refunds, chargebacks)
  • Deep familiarity with core payment KPIs, including:
    • Authorization rate (gross vs. net)
    • Decline reason analysis
    • Retry performance
    • Involuntary churn & recovery
    • Fraud and chargeback ratios
  • A strong mindset for data structure, governance, and documentation
  • Ability to explain complex data clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Rigorous self-review habits and willingness tovalidatefindings with colleagues before sharing them onward
  • Direct experience with PSPs or acquirers (e.g.Adyen, Checkout)
  • Experience with payment orchestration platforms (e.g.Spreedly)
  • Experience in subscription or recurring billing environments
  • Basic Python skills for analysis or automation
What You Can Expect On Board
  • A fully remote setup within Europe, built on trust and autonomy
  • High ownership and real impact on revenue-critical systems
  • Cross-functional collaboration with senior stakeholders
  • A culture that values clarity, precision, and thoughtful decision-making
  • The opportunity to shape the payments analytics foundation of a growing company
  • Annual company summer getaway + team meetups across the EU
If you see dashboards not just as reports but as decision engines - if you care about clean definitions, structured logic, and measurable impact - this role is for you.

Join us in building a payments analytics foundation that drives smarter decisions, stronger performance, and sustainable growth.

title: Head of Service Management and Vendor Operations
description:
Better begins here

Crown Resorts is a great place to visit and it’s an even better place to work, a place where you can play your part in creating fun, memorable, world-class experiences for our guests and our people. We value passion, optimism, and an appetite for change - for the better. Here, you’ll be part of the team, empowered to explore more, experience more and supported by your leader to grow and develop.

The Opportunity

Crown Technology is entering a major new chapter. We're looking for a Head of Service Management & Vendor Operations to own that relationship from the ground up.

You'll be the single point of accountability between Crown and our MSP partner — leading the transition, then owning the ongoing governance, performance and commercial management of the arrangement across all three Crown properties (Melbourne, Sydney, Perth).

It's a role built for someone who wants real ownership rather than layers of process. There's no team sitting beneath you — this is you, embedded in the detail, working directly alongside the vendor and Crown's technology leadership to make the partnership work.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the transition. Own the mobilisation of all four workstreams from Crown's internal teams to the MSP, including knowledge transfer, cutover planning and go-live readiness.
  • Be the primary interface with the MSP. Chair governance forums, hold the vendor to account against SLAs, KPIs and contractual commitments, and build a partnership that gets stronger over time.
  • Manage it both ways. When the vendor flags a genuine issue on Crown's side — a system that's unreliable, access that's not working — you'll be the one who takes that back into the business and gets it fixed. T
  • Own the commercials. Manage contract variations, invoicing, scope changes and renewal planning, and support budgeting and forecasting across the outsourcing arrangement.
  • Drive service outcomes. Oversee ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change and request management delivered by the MSP, and report transparently to senior technology leadership on performance, risk and value.
  • Get into the detail. When something's not working, you won't be managing it from a distance — you'll be learning the service alongside the vendor and figuring out the fix together.

What You'll Bring

  • Proven experience managing large-scale managed service provider or outsourcing relationships, ideally across multiple service towers.
  • Strong grounding in ITIL service management practices — ITIL Foundation required, Expert/Managing Professional highly regarded.
  • A track record of leading outsourcing transitions: mobilisation, knowledge transfer, parallel running and stabilisation.
  • Confidence managing the commercial side of vendor contracts — variations, invoicing validation, renewal negotiations.
  • A genuinely hands-on mindset. This role suits someone who'd rather roll up their sleeves and solve a problem with the vendor than escalate it and wait — willingness matters as much as prior expertise.
  • Comfort operating without a team beneath you — this is an individual expert role with real autonomy and real accountability.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the relevant Casino Special Employee Licence(s) as required by jurisdiction (VCGLR, NSW L&G, DLGSCI).

On top of exciting career possibilities, we offer better exposure to experiences and learning. To see our range of benefits and opportunities visit Crown Resorts Careers.

Our Crown Community celebrates uniqueness and embraces diversity. We welcome the creativity, insights and experiences from people of different race, age, religion, cultural background, gender, people with disability, people who identify as LGBTIQ+ and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander; people like you.
