description:
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.


Job Description


Job Title: Pharmacy Claims Lead

Location: Remote/Current Location USA

Getting to know us:

SS&C Health provides core technology across pharmacy and medical claims processing; cost management and care delivery; and member engagement and provider insight solutions. Our team emphasizes a culture in which individuals feel connected, accomplished, and equipped to do what they do best while having fun doing it: Work hard, play hard.

We are composed of highly talented and motivated individuals with diverse skill sets. We promote a collaborative work environment and encourage out-of-the-box thinking to fuel new and innovative solutions. To guarantee individual and organizational success, SS&C invests in the latest technologies to increase operational efficiencies and offers professional development opportunities for those looking to advance their careers.

Why You Will Love It Here!

  • Flexibility: Hybrid Work Model & a Business Casual Dress Code, including jeans

  • Your Future: 401k Matching Program, Professional Development Reimbursement

  • Work/Life Balance: Flexible Personal/Vacation Time Off, Sick Leave, Paid Holidays

  • Your Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program, Parental Leave

  • Wide Ranging Perspectives: Committed to Celebrating the Variety of Backgrounds, Talents and Experiences of Our Employees

  • Training: Hands-On, Team-Customized, including SS&C University

  • Extra Perks: Discounts on fitness clubs, travel and more!

What You Will Get To Do:

Pharmacy Claims Lead

  • Pharmacy Claims Lead provides strategic and operational leadership for pharmacy claims adjudication, configuration, and oversight within a rules-based claims environment, with a focus on automated validation, monitoring, and issue resolution processes aligned to current NCPDP standards.

  • This role owns the integrity and performance of pharmacy claims functionality across Commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid lines of business, with direct accountability to operational metrics, quality measures, and contractual performance guarantees.

  • The Pharmacy Claims Lead leads a team responsible for configuring, testing, validating, and monitoring claims logic and related workflows, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and scalability. This role operates at the intersection of business requirements, system behavior, and data outcomes, and is critical to maintaining claims integrity in a technology-driven organization.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team responsible for pharmacy claims configuration, validation, monitoring, and issue resolution.

  • Shift team focus from manual execution to configuration, controls, and outcome-based monitoring.

  • Establish performance expectations tied to claims accuracy, processing quality, system reliability, and service-level attainment.

  • Build capability in data interpretation, root cause analysis, and operational control thinking.

  • Prioritize work across competing demands, ensuring the team is focused on high-impact activities that protect performance guarantees.

  • Develop talent for a technology-enabled environment, including analytical and systems-based thinking.

Operational Ownership & Controls

  • Own pharmacy claims adjudication logic and operational behavior, including Transition and Long Term Care (LTC).

  • Ensure claims configuration and system rules are properly implemented, tested, and continuously validated against business and regulatory requirements.

  • Monitor claims performance and system outputs to identify defects, anomalies, and downstream impacts.

  • Drive resolution of complex issues through root cause analysis, not just issue remediation.

  • Move the function toward proactive monitoring and exception management, reducing reliance on manual review and reactive fixes.

  • Partner with technology teams to strengthen validation, monitoring, and issue resolution capabilities, improving the reliability and effectiveness of automated claims processing.

Analytics, Compliance & Performance Management

  • Develop and maintain operational dashboards and metrics that track claims performance, financial accuracy, and compliance adherence.

  • Use data to detect trends, identify risks, and drive corrective action.

  • Ensure adherence to federal, state, and contractual requirements, including performance guarantees tied to claims outcomes.

  • Support audit readiness through effective documentation, traceability of logic, and validation of system behavior.

  • Evolve reporting from static metrics to actionable insights that drive operational decisions.

Strategy, Systems & Transformation

  • Serve as the functional authority for pharmacy claims logic and adjudication behavior.

  • Partner with business, compliance, clinical, and technology teams to translate requirements into system configuration and measurable outcomes.

  • Evaluate system capabilities and emerging technologies to improve scalability, accuracy, and automation.

  • Lead initiatives that modernize claims operations, including reduction of manual work, improved configuration governance, and enhanced monitoring.

  • Influence how pharmacy claims operations evolve from legacy workflows to technology-enabled, data-driven processes.

What you will bring:

  • Demonstrated leadership experience in a complex operational or systems environment, including direct people management or equivalent leadership responsibility.

  • Experience leading teams responsible for configuration, validation, monitoring, or operational control functions.

  • Strong analytical capability, including ability to interpret data, identify patterns, and drive action.

  • Experience with operational metrics, reporting, and performance measurement.

  • Proficiency with Excel and SQL; ability to work with structured data and translate it into insights.

  • Strong stakeholder management across technical and business domains.

  • Ability to lead through ambiguity, change, and evolving operating models.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with emphasis on root cause analysis and prevention, not just resolution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in healthcare, pharmacy operations, or related field.

  • Experience in pharmacy claims, PBM operations, or adjudication systems.

  • Experience in highly regulated environments with accountability for compliance and audit outcomes.

  • Exposure to automation, workflow optimization, or system modernization initiatives.

  • Experience working with claims monitoring, exception management, or controls frameworks.

  • Project leadership experience in cross-functional environments.

Leadership Expectations

  • Builds a culture of accountability, precision, and continuous improvement.

  • Develops teams to operate in a controls-oriented, data-driven environment.

  • Demonstrates sound judgment balancing operational execution, system behavior, and contractual obligations.

  • Drives execution with focus on outcomes, not just activity.

  • Partners across the enterprise to ensure claims operations are aligned with technology and business strategy.

  • Embraces change and actively supports the transition to a modern, automated claims environment.

title: Servicedesk Medewerker (32-40 uur)
description:
Je vindt hier een korte omschrijving van deze vacature. Nog vragen? Of benieuwd of dit een passende rol voor jou is? Neem contact met ons op!

Als Servicedesk Medewerker ben je het eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten. Je luistert naar hun vraag, lost technische problemen op en zorgt dat zij probleemloos verder kunnen werken. Je bent voor klanten het gezicht van de organisatie.

Deze werkgever is een ICT-dienstverlener op de Noord-Veluwe. De organisatie verzorgt systeembeheer, cloudwerkplekken en maatwerksoftware voor het mkb. Het bedrijf groeit en werkt vanuit een vestiging met korte lijnen en veel persoonlijk klantcontact.

Jij bent technisch onderlegd, klantgericht en communicatief sterk. Je vindt het leuk om mensen verder te helpen en legt een technische oplossing rustig en begrijpelijk uit. Je werkt nauwkeurig en pakt een melding op tot die echt is opgelost. Daarnaast heb jij:

  • een afgeronde mbo-opleiding niveau 4 in de ICT;

  • basiskennis van Windows 10- en Windows 11-omgevingen;

  • ervaring met Microsoft 365 en basisgebruikersbeheer;

  • een rijbewijs B, zodat je ook op locatie kunt ondersteunen;

  • goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een servicegerichte houding.

In deze rol is het essentieel dat je vloeiend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft vanwege de communicatie met klanten en collega's. Ook is de voorkeur dat je in de omgeving van de werkgever woont, in verband met (deels) werken op kantoor.

Kun jij je (deels) herkennen in deze vacature? Reageer dan vooral! We gaan graag met jou in gesprek om jou beter te leren kennen. Neem contact met ons op!

title: Toimistoassistentti Vihtiin
location: Uusimaa, Espoo, Kauniainen, Kirkkonummi, Lohja, Nurmijärvi, Siuntio, Vihti
description:
Etsitkö monipuolista työtehtävää, jossa yhdistyvät asiakaspalvelu ja käytännön ongelmanratkaisu? Haluatko työskennellä vaihtelevassa roolissa, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole täysin samanlainen?

Haemme asiakkaallemme Vihtiin toimistoassistenttia. Tehtävä sisältää monipuolisesti toimiston ja asiakkaiden päivittäisten asioiden hoitoa ja organisointia. Päivittäiseen työhösi kuuluu esimerkiksi kulkulupien tekeminen sekä laskutusaineiston valmistelu ja toimittaminen tilaajille. Asiakaspalvelu on sinulle luontaista ja tunnollisuutesi ja paineensietokykysi ansiosta työskentelet vastuullisesti myös itsenäisesti. Olet järjestelmällinen, ja useampikin naru pysyy yhtä aikaa käsissäsi.

Tietotekniset valmiutesi ovat tämän päivän tasalla ja pystyt tuottaa tekstiä myös englannin kielellä, sillä tehtävässä tulet käyttämään päivittäin Exceliä ja kommunikoit sähköpostitse myös englanniksi.

Sovit tähän työhön, jos sinulta löytyy:

  • Aikaisempaa kokemusta toimistoassistentin tai toimistosihteerin työstä
  • Perustason IT-osaaminen ja valmius käyttää tietojärjestelmiä päivittäisessä työssä
  • Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito
  • Omatoimista asennetta tarttua työtehtäviin itsenäisesti
  • Ajokortti ja oma auto

Me tarjoamme sinulle:

  • TESin mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan, joka maksetaan aina ajallaan. Tässä työssä tuntipalkkasi määritellään osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.
  • Hyvät työvaatteet ja muut työssä tarvittavat varusteet
  • Mukavan ja rennon työporukan
  • Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa

Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

”Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti”, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

  • Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.
  • Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa, kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 13.
  • Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.
  • Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi!

Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti, eli jätä hakemuksesi pian! Toivomme, että voisit aloittaa työt mahdollisimman pian.

Hakemisen jälkeen kuulet meistä lyhyen ajan kuluessa. Jos etenet rekrytointiprosessissa, tapaat ensin Workerin työntekijän rennossa haastattelussa, jonka tavoitteena on tutustua tarkemmin sinuun ja osaamiseesi. Viimeisessä vaiheessa pääset tapaamaan myös asiakasyrityksen yhteyshenkilön.

Lisätietoja tästä työstä ja muista Workerin tarjoamista työmahdollisuuksista voit kysyä emmi.rajala@worker.fi. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

Join the Corendon family as our brand new F&B Supervisor!

We are looking for you as our F&B Supervisor at the Corendon Amsterdam New West Hotel!

Corendon Amsterdam New West hotel is located in Amsterdam New West and opened its doors in 2015. With a 1000m2 spa and a Boeing 737 Suite, it is an absolute attraction for many guests. This year the hotel became part of Marriott and has its own Mondi restaurant. This is where we are looking for you! To strengthen our team. As an F&B Supervisor you are responsible for the restaurant, the meeting rooms and our foodbar. You ensure that everything runs via our brand standard to the last details. description:
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.


Job Description


Job Title: Senior Cloud Solutions Architect

Locations: Hybrid: Waltham, MA or Dallas, TX. Remote: TX, FL, GA, TN, or NC

Get To Know The Team:

Intralinks | SS&C Technologies is looking for a Senior Cloud Solutions Architect to join a team to design secure, resilient, and highly scalable AWS and Private Cloud multi-region environments for our most strategic customers and internal platforms. You will own architectural tasks end-to-end — from network topology and identity boundaries to workload placement, data protection, and operational readiness — partnering with your team, engineering, security, and operations teams to turn ambiguous requirements into reference architectures that ship.

This is a hands-on, senior individual-contributor role for someone who has spent years in the weeds of AWS (or other public clouds) networking and cloud security and now wants to shape the platform decisions that others build on.

What You Will Get To Do:

  • Design and review AWS architectures across compute, storage, data, and serverless — with an emphasis on multi-account, multi-region, and hybrid connectivity patterns.
  • Lead the design of enterprise-grade AWS networking: VPC design, CloudWAN, Transit Gateways, endpoints, Direct Connect, Route 53, hybrid DNS, and segmentation strategies for regulated workloads.
  • Define and evolve the cloud security architecture: IAM and identity federation, KMS and key management, encryption in transit and at rest, secrets management, network security controls, and detection/response tooling (GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, Config, Inspector, etc).
  • Partner with Operations, SRE, and engineering to codify architecture as Terraform / CDK modules and guardrails (SCPs, Config rules, Control Tower).
  • Serve as the escalation point for the hardest cloud problems — performance, cost, blast radius, compliance — and drive them to resolution.
  • Coach engineers and architects; raise the bar on cloud, networking, and security craft across the organization.

What You Will Bring:

Required:

  • 7+ years of experience designing and operating production cloud environments, with 5+ years focused primarily on AWS.
  • Deep expertise across AWS networking: VPC design, subnetting, routing, Transit Gateway, VPN and Direct Connect, PrivateLink, Global Accelerator, CloudWAN, and inspection architectures.
  • Strong cloud security background: IAM policy authoring, least-privilege design, KMS, encryption strategy, network segmentation, WAF/Shield, and cloud-native detection and response.
  • Hands-on infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation) and capable of contributing to code, pull requests, and GitHub Actions writing a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication — you can move fluidly between whiteboard, executive slide, and CLI.

Nice to Have:

  • AWS certifications such as Solutions Architect Professional, Advanced Networking Specialty, or Security Specialty.
  • Experience designing for regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI, FedRAMP, or similar) and translating controls into concrete architecture and guardrails.
  • Track record of leading architecture reviews, threat models, and well-architected assessments for real workloads.
  • Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid architectures (Azure, GCP, Private Cloud interconnect).
  • Familiarity with container and platform ecosystems (EKS, service mesh, API gateways).

How You Work:

Systems thinker. You reason about failure modes, blast radius, and second-order effects before shipping.

Pragmatic. You know when to buy, when to build, and when good beats perfect.

Security-first, but not security-only. You balance controls with developer velocity and business context.

Teacher. You leave the room — and the docs — better than you found them.

What Could Set You Apart:

Send your resume and a short note or cover letter with an example of a cloud architecture that you’re proud of.

Why You Will Love It Here!

  • Flexibility: Hybrid Work Model & a Business Casual Dress Code, including jeans
  • Your Future: 401k Matching Program, Professional Development Reimbursement
  • Work/Life Balance: Flexible Personal/Vacation Time Off, Sick Leave, Paid Holidays
  • Your Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program, Parental Leave
  • Wide-Ranging Perspectives: Committed to Celebrating the Variety of Backgrounds, Talents, and Experiences of Our Employees
  • Training: Hands-On, Team-Customized, including SS&C University
  • Extra Perks: Discounts on fitness clubs, travel and more!

title: Rautarakenneasentaja, Lahti
description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme kolmea rautarakenneasentajaa / rakennusmiestä Lahden datakeskuksen rakentamiseen.

Haemme rakenteilla olevalle datakeskustyömaalle kolmea reipasta tuumasta toimeen tarttuvaa tekijää. Työnkuva pitää sisällään rautarakenteiden asentamista pulteilla ja hitsaamalla. Työ ei välttämättä edellytä kaikilta siihen osallistuvilta hitsaustaitoa, mutta mikäli sellaista löytyy vyöltä, katsotaan se suureksi eduksi.

Työt alkavat sopivien henkilöiden löytyessä. Alustavan arvion mukaan töitä on tarjolla kuukaudeksi, mutta odotettavissa on, että hyvälle tekijälle on luvassa töitä pidemmäksikin aikaa.

Tehtävän kuvaus

Jos seuraavat asiat ovat hallussa, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö

Hakeaksesi tätä työpaikkaa, sinulla tulee olla,

  • Kokemusta rautarakenteiden asentamisesta, hitsaustaito suureksi eduksi - etsimme ammattilaista, jolta asiat sujuvat eikä tarvitse olla vahtimassa
  • Voimassa olevat ammattikortit (työturvallisuuskortti ja tulityökortti) - jos ei ole, niin asia on hoidettava kuntoon ennen töiden aloitusta.
  • Hyvä suomen kielen taito - työnjohtokieli on suomi.
  • Korkea työmoraali – työ on itsenäistä ja vastaat itse työnjäljestäsi.
  • Sosiaaliset taidot kunnossa – tulet toimeen ihmisten kanssa tiukoissakin paikoissa.

Vision työntekijälupaus

Oli visiosi työelämästä kirkas tai vasta hahmottumassa, me autamme molemmissa tapauksissa. Varmistamme, että työsopimukset ja varusteet ovat kunnossa, ja että ammattilaisena saat osaamistasi vastaavan palkan. Olemme tukena ja turvana, jos sellaista tarvitset. Meille on tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi.

Visiolaisena saat tässä tehtävässä,

  • Osaamisesi mukaan määräytyvän palkan
  • Palkanmaksun kaksi kertaa kuukaudessa.
  • Jokaiseen työtehtävään soveltuvat työvarusteet.
  • Päivittäisen tuen työasioissa.

Onko meillä yhteinen visio? — Näin teet työpaikkahakemuksen

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakijoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme työntekijä, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus. Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta!

Voit parantaa omia mahdollisuuksiasi tulla valituksi, kun:

  • liität hakemukseesi ansioluettelon (CV) tai kirjaat aikaisemmat työpaikkasi kuluneelta viideltä vuodelta,
  • kerrot, miten aiemmissa työpaikoissa opitut asiat tukevat sinua pärjäämään hakemassasi uudessa tehtävässä.

Näin saat lisätietoa tehtävästä

Lisätietoa avoimesta työpaikasta saat kysymällä sähköpostitse osoitteesta helsinki(at)visiohr.fi. Otsikoi viestisi haetun työtehtävän mukaisesti ja palaamme sinulle 1-3 työpäivän aikana.

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilöstöpalvelualan yritys. Pelaamme reilua peliä ja tarjoamme töitä niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Yhdistämme työntekijät ja työnantajat niin, että molemmat löytävät juuri tarpeisiinsa sopivan ratkaisun. Yhteistyö perustuu kaikkien kolmen tahon keskinäiseen luottamukseen.

Jos haluat reilun työnantajan, joka arvostaa osaamistasi ja huomaa työpanoksesi, se on Visio.

The role is primarily based at the McLaren Technology Centre.

What You'll Do

At McLaren Racing, software plays a critical role in how we innovate, make decisions, and improve performance on and off the track.

We're looking for experienced Python Software Engineers to join our Software & Data Science team on a fixed-term contract basis and help deliver Factory Flow, one of the most significant technology and business transformation programmes at McLaren Racing.

This is an opportunity to work on software that directly impacts how we design, manufacture, and race Formula 1 cars.

Qualifications

  • Experience delivering software solutions using agile methodologies and software engineering best practices.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented design, software architecture, and engineering principles, including SOLID.

title: Nuorempia sähköasentajia

description:
Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme nuorempia sähköasentajia pitkäkestoiseen projektiin.

Työskentelet työparin kanssa yritysasiakkaiden kiinteistöissä sekä yksityisasiakkaiden kodeissa Uudenmaan alueella. Työ on liikkuvaa ja asiakaspalvelupainotteista, joten odotamme sinulta huolellista ja vastuullista työotetta. Tehtäviisi kuuluu sähkömittareiden vaihtoja erilaisissa kiinteistöissä.

Edellytämme hakijalta vähintään vuoden aikaisempaa työkokemusta sähköalalta. Valittu henkilö perehdytetään huolellisesti työtehtäviin ja projektin käytäntöihin. Työtä tehdään 7/7-työkierrolla. Projektin edellytyksenä on Suomen kansalaisuus sekä tarvittaessa hyväksytysti läpimenevä turvallisuusselvitys.

Sovit tähän työhön, jos sinulta löytyy:

  • Yli 1 vuoden kokemusta sähköistysalasta
  • Sähköalan koulutusta
  • Tiimityöskentelyä sekä itseohjautuvaa asennetta
  • Voimassa olevia työ- ja sähkötyöturvallisuuskortti
  • Suomen kielen osaamista ja asiakaspalvelutaitoja
  • B- ajokorttia ja auton käyttömahdollisuutta

Eduksi katsomme, että olet tehnyt raportointia erilaisilla ohjelmilla.

Me tarjoamme sinulle:

  • TESin mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan, joka maksetaan aina ajallaan. Tässä työssä tuntipalkkasi asettuu 14-15 euron välille, ja se määritellään osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.
  • Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa
  • Kattavan perehdytyksen sekä edellytykset, että onnistut työtehtävässä
  • Mukavan ja rennon työporukan
  • Työtehtävän mukaiset hyvät työvaatteet ja muut tarvittavat varusteet
  • Luotettavan ja rehdin työnantajan, sekä vakavaraisen asiakasyrityksen
  • Mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisesti eri kohteissa ja eri tehtävissä

Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

”Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti”, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

  • Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.

  • Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa, kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 14.

  • Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.

  • Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.


Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi!

Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti, eli jätä hakemuksesi pian! Toivomme, että voisit aloittaa työt mahdollisimman pian.

Hakemisen jälkeen kuulet meistä lyhyen ajan kuluessa. Jos etenet rekrytointiprosessissa, tapaat ensin Workerin työntekijän rennossa haastattelussa, jonka tavoitteena on tutustua tarkemmin sinuun ja osaamiseesi. Viimeisessä vaiheessa pääset tapaamaan myös asiakasyrityksen yhteyshenkilön.

Lisätietoja tästä työstä ja muista Workerin tarjoamista työmahdollisuuksista voit kysyä Emmi Rajalalta emmi.rajala@worker.fi tai numerosta 050 473 0642. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

description:
GeForce NOW streams high-end games from NVIDIA's cloud to hundreds of millions of devices at latency that matches local play.   • Highly proficient in Java and C/C++, and comfortable working in a large, long-lived codebase.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Familiarity with low-latency video streaming pipelines, including video codecs, display, color spaces, scaling and other video processing operations.

  • Familiarity with video streaming networking technologies such as RTSP and WebRTC.

  • Contributions or expertise regarding multimedia implementations in AOSP.

  • Proficiency in using AI developer tools & models for enhanced productivity.

title: Economist
location: CW Site - USA - CA - San Diego - 12830 El Camino Real
description:
Job Title

Economist

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Design and maintain internal data models to support client decision-making related to commuting impact, workforce
accessibility, location strategy, and real estate investment planning. Quantify the strategic and financial impact of real estate decisions,
taking into consideration of confounding or mitigating external factors. Analyze labor markets, workforce trends, and geographic cost
dynamics using modern data science and business intelligence tools. Translate complex data into compelling, client-ready insights
through dashboards, reports, maps, and presentations. Interpret and communicate findings from external econometric datasets and
studies to help clients and internal teams apply these insights to real-world scenarios. Collaborate across teams to refine analytic
methodologies and enhance internal modeling capabilities. Serve as the primary point of contact on client engagements, managing
scope, timelines, and deliverables. Contribute to proposal development and participate in business development efforts, including
analytical strategy for pitches and solution framing. Mentor junior analysts and guide technical execution, communication quality, and
professional growth.
Requirements: Master's degree in Economics, Business, Accounting, Finance, Urban Planning or related field (willing to accept foreign
education equivalent) plus four (4) years of experience as Consulting Analyst/Manager or related occupation performing economic or
statistical analysis in a business or consulting environment OR, alternatively, Bachelor's degree in Economics, Business, Accounting,
Finance, Urban Planning or related field (willing to accept foreign education equivalent) plus six (6) years of experience as Consulting
Analyst/Manager or related occupation performing economic or statistical analysis in a business or consulting environment. Experience
must include three (3) years with the following: analyzing labor markets, demographics, and financial modeling of lease options and
translating insights into actionable real estate requirements; managing client relationships for key accounts; developing and delivering
presentations for new-business pursuits or client acquisition; mentoring junior associate in project execution and career development.
Experience must include (quantitative experience requirements not applicable to this section): performing data ingestion and data
cleaning, implementing models in Python or R, and interpreting results; executing end-to-end analytical workflows for causal inference
modeling, including difference-in-differences, propensity score matching, and randomized controlled trials; developing data pipelines
and producing analytical dashboards or spatial analyses using Power BI, Tableau, and ESRI ArcGIS. Direct reports (Strategy Analyst,
Consulting Analyst, 2 Senior Consultants, and Consultant). 5% domestic travel.

Hybrid Position (4 days/week in office, 1 day remote)

title: Vrijwilliger Gastheer/Gastvrouw PSV Academy
description:
Versterk PSV als gastheer of gastvrouw op PSV Campus De Herdgang

Wil jij onderdeel zijn van de club waar passie, ontwikkeling en topsport samenkomen? Voor de PSV Academy zijn we op zoek naar een vrijwilliger die teams, officials en scheidsrechters een warm welkom geeft op PSV Campus De Herdgang.

Als gastheer of gastvrouw ben jij vaak het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze bezoekers. Dankzij jouw gastvrijheid voelt iedereen zich direct thuis bij PSV.

Wat ga je doen?

Als gastheer of gastvrouw ontvang je de teams van de tegenstander voorafgaand aan wedstrijden op PSV Campus De Herdgang. Je verwelkomt spelers, begeleiders en (jeugd)scheidsrechters en zorgt ervoor dat zij zich welkom voelen. Daarbij bied je hen een kop koffie of thee aan en help je waar nodig met praktische vragen.

Je bent aanwezig rondom wedstrijden die plaatsvinden op doordeweekse dagen in de middag en avond. De werktijden liggen doorgaans tussen 12.00 en 20.00 uur en zijn afhankelijk van het wedstrijdprogramma.

Wie ben jij?

Jij bent een enthousiaste en gastvrije persoonlijkheid die graag mensen ontvangt en helpt. Je voelt je prettig in een dynamische omgeving en blijft ook tijdens drukke momenten rustig en vriendelijk.

Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

  • Je bent gastvrij en klantgericht;

  • Je communiceert makkelijk met verschillende doelgroepen;

  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar;

  • Je werkt zelfstandig;

  • Je bent stressbestendig;

  • Je bent minimaal 18 jaar oud.

Ook herken je jezelf in de kernwaarden van PSV: prestatiegericht, gastvrij, betrouwbaar, sociaal betrokken en innovatief.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een unieke vrijwilligersfunctie binnen een toonaangevende voetbalorganisatie;

  • Een inspirerende werkomgeving op PSV Campus De Herdgang;

  • Een hecht team waarin samenwerken centraal staat;

  • Een organisatie waar diversiteit, inclusie en respect vanzelfsprekend zijn;

  • Een vrijwilligersvergoeding;

  • Verschillende extra's die horen bij het werken voor PSV.

Maak jij de transfer naar PSV?

Lijkt het je leuk om deel uit te maken van de PSV Academy en bezoekers een gastvrije ontvangst te bieden? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Solliciteer via onze website.

De sollicitatieprocedure omvat onder andere een onderzoek naar het arbeidsverleden en het aanvragen van een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG).

title: Assistant Utility Surveyor
description:
Assistant Utility Surveyor, Cork/Hybrid



We seek to move the world forward through innovative thinking.
Woolpert is an award‑winning, global leader in architecture, engineering, and geospatial services. We blend design excellence with cutting‑edge technology to deliver exceptional client value, and as a certified Great Place to Work®, we embrace progress and innovation to create limitless opportunities for career growth.

As part of Woolpert, Murphy Geospatial – A Woolpert Company contributes deep geospatial expertise across Europe, supporting complex infrastructure, property, manufacturing, utilities, and natural‑environment projects through world‑class data capture, verification, and governance.


Position Overview


Our Subsurface Engineering department, based in Kilcullen, County Kildare is rapidly growing and because of this, we are delighted to commence the hiring process to bring on Assistant Utility Surveyors to join our team.

Murphy Geospatial have introduced innovative and alternative methods to assist in difficult and unusual engineering surveys and investigations, offering clients specially trained survey teams who can undertake specialist surveys, combining 3D deliverables with consultative recommendations.

We have been involved in projects such as Terminal 2 at Dublin Airport, Luas Cross City in Dublin, Swords BRT Scheme, Cork Main Drainage Scheme and the Galway to Mayo Gas pipeline and are currently working on many high profile and exciting projects across the country.


What You Will Do


  • Working with cutting-edge surveying equipment such as Total Stations, GPS and Data Collectors and using modern methods to provide critical information to assist our clients in decision making.
  • Accurately recording underground utility data to provide to Senior Utility Surveyors for client reporting.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to provide feedback to clients
  • Possess the right to work in Ireland.

Key Attributes


  • Excellent planning and organisation skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to work closely with team members and on own initiative.


Benefits You Will Love


At Murphy Geospatial – A Woolpert Company, you’ll join a collaborative and innovative team where your expertise makes a real impact. Our benefits include:

  • Performance‑related bonus scheme that rewards your contribution
  • Fitness and Wellbeing reimbursement programme.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Applicants requiring accommodation during recruitment may contact MGS.talentteam@woolpert.com

title: AI Product Owner
description:
Job Description Summary

GE HealthCare is a global leader in medical imaging and digital health technologies. We are seeking a highly motivated AI Product Owner to define, consolidate, and prioritize cross product inputs for a unified clinical AI capability. This role focuses on gathering and synchronizing requirements from multiple Product Managers and ensuring that AI features are designed to be as system level and agnostic as possible. Join us to help build scalable clinical AI that impacts healthcare at its core.

Job Description

Responsibilities

• Partner with Product Managers across various product lines to collect, analyze, and consolidate clinical AI needs into unified feature level requirements.

• Ensure consistent prioritization of AI requirements based on clinical impact, productstrategy, and technical feasibility.

• Maintain an ongoing feedback loop with Product Managers to refine requirements, capture gaps, and adapt prioritization as products evolve.

• Translate cross product needs into clear, structured definitions, user flows, CTQs, and feature specifications for the AI R&D team.

• Ensure alignment and consistency of requirements across teams to support development of an AI agnostic clinical capability.

• Collaborate with AI, Data, Clinical and UX functions to ensure requirements are fully understood, feasible, and traceable.

• Identify requirement-level risks, inconsistencies, or conflicts and drive resolution with relevant stakeholders.

• Maintain clear documentation of requirements, rationales, and prioritization decisions to support transparency and regulatory processes.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in biomedical engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, or related field; advanced degree is an advantage.

• Experience in Product Management, system definition, or AI/ML related productdevelopment.

• Strong understanding of AI workflows, data needs, and clinical use cases.

• Excellent skills in gathering, structuring, and communicating requirements across multidisciplinary teams.

• Ability to balance multiple stakeholders, manage conflicting inputs, and drive alignment.

• Experience with clinical or healthcare technology—medical imaging experience is a strong advantage.

• Analytical mindset and the ability to connect product needs with technical constraints.

Advantage: Hands-on experience with AI research and development.

Advantage: Familiarity with regulatory expectations for medical device software and AIsystems.

Desired Qualities

• Highly organized, detail oriented, and proactive.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and working with evolving inputs.

• System level thinker who can identify patterns, unify needs, and propose scalable solutions.

Inclusion and Diversity

title: Director of Product Management – Engagement
description:
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.


Job Description


Director, Product Management – Engagement

Location: Remote - Florida

About the Role:

The Director of Product Management – Engagement is responsible for defining and executing the product strategy for SS&C Health’s engagement portfolio. This leader will own the product vision, roadmap, investment priorities, and execution required to modernize and strengthen a mission-critical platform supporting health plan operations.

This role sits at the intersection of market strategy, client needs, healthcare domain expertise, and technology execution. The Director will translate evolving payer requirements, regulatory changes, competitive dynamics, and client priorities into a clear product strategy while partnering closely with Engineering, Operations, Client Delivery, Sales, and other Product leaders to bring that strategy to market.

The ideal candidate combines deep healthcare payer, digital, and call center expertise with strong product leadership and the ability to drive execution across complex, enterprise-scale initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for SS&C Health’s engagement portfolio, including digital experiences, call center and service capabilities, and interactive reporting and insights.

  • Define the future-state engagement experience and modernization priorities based on market trends, evolving consumer expectations, client needs, competitive positioning, operational opportunities, and technology evolution.

  • Translate strategy into clear product priorities, investment recommendations, business cases, and measurable outcomes.

  • Balance strategic modernization with near-term client commitments, operational needs, regulatory requirements, and revenue opportunities.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, personalize, and differentiate the engagement experience across channels.

Product Execution

  • Drive roadmap execution from strategy through requirements, development, release, adoption, and measurement.

  • Establish clear priorities and ensure Product, Engineering, Operations, and other stakeholders remain aligned on outcomes, scope, timing, and dependencies.

  • Partner closely with Engineering leadership to translate product strategy into executable development plans.

  • Maintain strong discipline around backlog prioritization, release planning, trade-off decisions, and product governance.

  • Proactively identify execution risks, dependencies, and barriers and drive them to resolution.

  • Establish KPIs to measure product performance, adoption, operational efficiency, client value, and business impact.

Engagement & Consumer Experience Domain Leadership

  • Serve as the product and domain leader for SS&C Health’s engagement portfolio, spanning digital experiences, call center and service capabilities, and interactive reporting and insights.

  • Define a cohesive, omnichannel engagement strategy that enables health plans to deliver intuitive, personalized, and efficient experiences across digital and assisted-service channels.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of payer member and client engagement workflows, including portals, mobile and digital experiences, communications, self-service, contact center capabilities, reporting, and related operational workflows.

  • Identify opportunities to increase digital adoption and self-service, improve access to information, reduce service friction, and enable more personalized and proactive engagement.

  • Partner with Operations and Technology to identify opportunities where automation, AI, data, and workflow orchestration can improve both the member experience and call center efficiency.

  • Define how reporting and insights should support users with timely, actionable, and interactive access to information rather than relying solely on static reporting.

  • Anticipate changes in consumer expectations, healthcare technology, and the payer market and translate them into product opportunities and investment priorities.

  • Ensure engagement capabilities are scalable, configurable, accessible, secure, and able to support the needs of diverse health plan clients and populations.

Client & Market Engagement

  • Engage directly with clients and prospects to understand strategic priorities, operational challenges, and emerging needs.

  • Distinguish individual client requests from broader market needs and scalable product opportunities.

  • Partner with Sales and Client Delivery on strategic opportunities, client roadmap discussions, and product positioning.

  • Represent SS&C Health’s engagement portfolio in executive client discussions, demonstrations, industry forums, and strategic planning sessions.

  • Incorporate market, competitive, and client intelligence into product decisions and investment priorities.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build strong partnerships across Product, Technology, Operations, Implementation, Client Success, Sales, Compliance, Finance, and other functions.

  • Create transparency around roadmap priorities, investment decisions, delivery status, and product performance.

  • Drive alignment across competing priorities and influence decisions in a complex, matrixed organization.

  • Lead and develop product management talent, establishing strong product practices, accountability, and execution discipline.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in healthcare technology, product management, consumer engagement, or related fields, with significant experience in digital, contact center, member experience, or engagement solutions.

  • 5+ years of product leadership experience, preferably with responsibility for enterprise healthcare platforms or complex digital and consumer-facing solutions.

  • Strong understanding of healthcare payer operations and the member and client experience ecosystem.

  • Demonstrated experience developing product strategy and translating it into executable roadmaps and measurable business outcomes.

  • Experience developing or modernizing digital experiences, contact center capabilities, self-service solutions, reporting and analytics, or omnichannel engagement platforms strongly preferred.

  • Strong understanding of digital technology, APIs, data and analytics, automation, AI, cloud technologies, accessibility, and emerging consumer engagement trends.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex initiatives across Product, Engineering, Operations, and other cross-functional organizations.

  • Strong executive communication, client engagement, analytical, and decision-making skills.

  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and operate effectively in a fast-moving, matrixed environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means establishing a clear strategic direction for SS&C Health’s engagement portfolio and consistently converting that strategy into execution. The Director will create greater alignment between market needs, client priorities, consumer expectations, operational opportunities, technology investment, and product delivery.

This leader will drive a more connected engagement experience across digital and assisted-service channels, increasing self-service and digital adoption while improving the effectiveness of call center interactions and access to actionable information and insights.

Ultimately, this leader will ensure SS&C Health’s engagement capabilities evolve into a modern, integrated, scalable, and differentiated experience that creates measurable value for health plans and the members they serve.

Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services.

SS&C Technologies offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and future. Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) plan with company match; paid time off, holidays, and parental leave; and professional development reimbursement opportunity.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Tuotantopäällikkö, puusepänteollisuus, VAKKARI, LAHDEN SEUTU
description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme tuotantopäällikköä vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Lahden seudulla toimivaan puusepänteollisuuden yritykseen. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan, työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen. Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme Epassin!

Kyseessä on monipuolinen ja vastuullinen tehtävä kalustevalmistuksen parissa. Roolissa pääset ottamaan kokonaisvaltaisesti vastuuta tuotannon päivittäisestä toiminnasta sekä osallistumaan projektien suunnitteluun ja läpivientiin. Tehtävä sopii henkilölle, joka viihtyy käytännönläheisessä tuotantoympäristössä, osaa pitää useammat langat käsissään ja haluaa olla mukana kehittämässä yrityksen toimintaa.

Mitä tehtävä pitää sisällään?

Tuotantopäällikkönä vastaat tuotannon sujuvuudesta ja töiden etenemisestä aina suunnittelusta valmiiseen toimitukseen asti. Päivittäiseen työhösi kuuluu muun muassa:

  • tuotannon päivittäinen suunnittelu, organisointi ja ohjaus
  • työnjohdolliset tehtävät ja tuotannon aikatauluttaminen
  • kalusteprojektien suunnittelu ja projektinhallinta
  • asiakasyhteistyö ja käytännön asioista sopiminen asiakkaiden kanssa
  • työmaakäynnit ja projektien etenemisen seuranta
  • tuotannon resurssien ja aikataulujen yhteensovittaminen
  • tuotannon toimintatapojen kehittäminen
  • aktiivinen yhteistyö yrityksen johdon ja tuotannon henkilöstön kanssa.

Tehtävänkuvaa voidaan myös muokata valittavan henkilön osaamisen ja kokemuksen perusteella.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme ennen kaikkea määrätietoista, vastuullista ja oma-aloitteista tekijää, jolla on kyky ottaa kokonaisuuksia haltuun ja viedä asioita järjestelmällisesti eteenpäin.

Toivomme sinulta soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta, esimerkiksi insinööritason koulutusta, sekä aiempaa kokemusta tuotannollisesta ympäristöstä. Kokemus puusepän-, kaluste- tai huonekaluteollisuudesta katsotaan merkittäväksi eduksi.

Arvostamme lisäksi:

  • kokemusta työnjohdosta tai esihenkilötehtävistä
  • ymmärrystä tuotannon suunnittelusta ja ohjauksesta
  • projektinhallintaosaamista
  • hyviä tietoteknisiä valmiuksia
  • kykyä toimia sujuvasti sekä asiakkaiden että tuotannon henkilöstön kanssa
  • käytännönläheistä ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta
  • kykyä tehdä päätöksiä ja kantaa vastuuta.

Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi. Ammattitaito, aikaisempi kokemus ja ennen kaikkea oikea asenne ratkaisevat.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen, kokoaikaisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan tuotannon toimintaan ja kehittämiseen.

Työskentelet tiiviissä työyhteisössä, jossa päätöksenteko on käytännönläheistä ja oman työn tulokset näkyvät konkreettisesti. Tehtävä tarjoaa sopivasti vastuuta ja haastetta kokeneemmallekin tuotannon ammattilaiselle.

Palkkaus: noin 3 000–4 000 €/kk osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan. Lisäksi maksetaan tuotantobonus.

Työsuhteessa sovelletaan puusepänteollisuuden työehtosopimusta.

Työstä, asiakkaastamme ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää työhaastattelussa.

Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!

---



Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.

Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

title: Fabric Data Engineer (1-year contract)
description:

Experience & Qualifications

Skill Area

Expected Capability

Priority

- Microsoft Cloud Data Stack: Azure Data Factory / Data Pipeline, Dataflows Gen2, SSIS, Azure Functions / Function App, Azure SQL, Azure Blob Storage and Microsoft Fabric.

title: Operations Associate – Customer Retention
description:
Who we are

At Chowdeck, we deeply value growth, excellence, speed, and empathy. Our team is a tight-knit group of creative problem solvers who are smart, kind, and committed to helping each other grow.


Where you come in

We're looking for an exceptional candidate to join our strategy and operations team as an Operations Associate – Customer Retention. This role is the engine room of customer engagement. You'll be the voice that reconnects customers with Chowdeck, turning every call into an opportunity to rebuild trust and re-ignite loyalty. You'll handle the bulk of outbound conversations, feedback logging, and follow-ups that keep our customer base strong.

This is not a 9-to-5 role. It's fast-paced, target-driven, and will often require varying hours and shifts. But if you're persuasive, resilient, and hungry to prove yourself, this is an opportunity to launch your career in tech and operations at scale, learning directly from experienced operators and building the foundation to grow into future leadership roles.


In this role you'll be required to:

  • Place outbound calls to identified customer segments using your work smartphone and contact lists provided by the Data/Growth team.
  • Understand each customer’s experience and preferences (e.g., pricing, delivery speed, service quality, alternatives they use, past order issues) through structured, empathetic conversations.
  • Apply appropriate engagement strategies — personalised offers, service recovery, discount codes, promo codes, or reassurance — to encourage renewed ordering, in line with approved playbooks.
  • Accurately log call outcomes, customer feedback, and sentiment in the designated tracking sheet after every call
  • Meet or exceed daily/weekly call volume targets and re-engagement conversion targets.
  • Escalate recurring or systemic feedback (e.g., rider issues, vendor quality, app bugs) to the relevant teams for resolution.
  • Maintain a professional, friendly, and solution-oriented tone on every call, representing the Chowdeck brand well.
  • Provide daily/weekly reports on call activity, conversion rates, and top feedback themes.
  • Identify patterns in customer feedback and suggest improvements to engagement scripts, offers, or processes.
  • Stay up to date on current promotions, service areas, and platform features to answer customer questions confidently.


You’re perfect for the Operations Associate role if you have:

  • A minimum of a Diploma or Bachelor's degree in any field.
  • 1–2 years of experience in a call center, telesales, customer retention, or customer service role (experience in tech/e-commerce/delivery is a plus).
  • Excellent verbal communication skills in English (Twi or other local languages is a strong advantage).
  • Strong persuasion, negotiation, and objection-handling skills.
  • An empathetic listener with a customer-first mindset.
  • Comfort working with targets/KPIs in a fast-paced environment.
  • Basic computer literacy; comfortable using spreadsheets.
  • High resilience — able to handle rejection and difficult conversations without losing composure.
  • Good record-keeping and attention to detail when logging call data.

We'll be extra impressed if you:

  • Have a track record of excellence beyond academics

Beyond the paycheck, Chowdeck employees get:

Specific benefits, allowances, and coverage may vary by country or city in line with local regulations and market practices. Employment decisions are based on business needs and individual merit without regard to race, color, religion, ethnicity, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, gender, or age.

title: Senior Analyst, Credit Underwriting & Analysis - Bangalore
description:
About Northern Trust


As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.


Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.


With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.



Job Summary:
Under general supervision (while working independently most of the time), the Senior Analyst – Credit Risk in Wealth Management is responsible for conducting in-depth credit analysis of high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs), privately held businesses, not-for-profit organizations, and commercial real estate clients. The Senior Analyst will analyze financial data using tools such as Moody’s Credit Lens, assess creditworthiness, and develop credit analysis reports to support underwriting and lending decisions.
In this role, the Senior Analyst manages complex credit analysis assignments, mentors junior analysts, and ensures the accuracy and quality of credit spreads. The Senior Analyst also works on strategic and special projects identified by management.
Collaboration with relationship managers and internal stakeholders is required to structure credit facilities that align with clients’ wealth management goals while adhering to Northern Trust’s risk management. This position offers exposure to sophisticated financial products, a dynamic work environment, and opportunities to develop expertise in credit analysis for the wealth management sector.


Major Duties:
• Analyzes financial statements, credit reports, and economic data to assess the creditworthiness of individuals or businesses.
• Prepares comprehensive credit reports with a high degree of independence, focusing on operational performance, financial health, and identification of key risk mitigants.
• Monitors borrower performance and ensures timely identification of potential risks by conducting thorough annual reviews.
• Mentors junior analysts to ensure adherence to established standards and guidelines.
• Contributes to division-wide initiatives and special projects as assigned by management.
• Collaborates with onshore partners and relationship managers to develop tailored credit solutions.
• Ensures adherence to Northern Trust’s credit policies, compliance standards, process-related guidelines, and controls.
• Consistently adheres to established QUALITY & QUANTITY SLAs.
• Stays informed about market trends, regulatory changes, and economic factors affecting credit risk.
• Pays attention to detail to ensure all documents are processed correctly.
• Identifies process changes to improve productivity and efficiency.

Qualifications:
• Graduation or above degree in finance, accounting, or business administration (or equivalent)
• Additional certifications such as CFA, FRM, CMA, etc., are considered advantageous but are not mandatory.

Experience & Skills:
• 2 - 4 years of experience in financial spreading and credit memo underwriting, strong financial analysis and analytical skills. Familiarity with lending products such as lines of credit and term loans is required.
• Excellent time management skills, with the ability to multitask, work independently, and handle competing priorities under pressure.
• Ability to present information in a clear and concise manner, effectively telling the story behind financials in a compelling way.
• Ability to research issues/problems and provide a ‘solution-based’ approach
• Excellent verbal and written communication and partnering skills. A confident and personable attitude with the ability to communicate effectively with onshore relationship managers and other stakeholders
• Self-motivated individual to go beyond immediate responsibilities
• Familiarity with Moody’s Credit Lens or similar credit spreading tools. Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Word and other Microsoft 365 tools.
• Capability to coach and mentor junior team members.


Shift Coverage: EMEA - 12:30PM to 9:30PM IST

About the Team
This position is within the Financial Risk Division, organizationally aligned under Global Risk. The department plays a pivotal role in the credit underwriting process, monitoring loans, assessing risks across credit portfolios thereby safeguarding the organization’s financial stability by ensuring rigorous credit analysis, adherence to regulatory standards, and the implementation of robust risk mitigation strategies. Through its oversight and expertise, the Financial Risk Division contributes significantly to the institution’s overall risk management framework, supporting prudent lending decisions and promoting long-term organizational resilience.
The Credit Services division serves the Northern Trust Wealth Management customers including Global Family Office clients through a range of lending services, including but not limited to Secured, Unsecured loans to Individuals, and their privately held entities, and Commercial Real estate lending.


Working with Us


As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.


Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.


Reasonable Accommodation


Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.



About Our Bangalore Office


The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

CDK Global is a leading provider of cloud-based software to dealerships and Original Equipment Manufacturers (“OEMs”) across automotive and related industries. The Company’s cloud-based, software as a service (“SaaS”) platform enables dealerships to manage their end-to-end business operations including the acquisition, sale, financing, insuring, repair, and maintenance of vehicles. By automating and streamlining critical workflows, the integrated platform of modern solutions enables dealers to sell and service more vehicles by creating simple and convenient experiences for customers and improves their financial and operational performance.

We are seeking a strategic, customer-focused, and execution-oriented Sr. Product Manager, OEM Integrations to own and drive a portfolio of OEM-facing products and capabilities that enable data exchange, reporting, analytics, digital connectivity, and platform modernization across automotive manufacturers.

This role will help drive roadmap, and execution for a portfolio of OEM-facing products and platforms focused on data integration, analytics, reporting, API enablement, performance measurement, and modernization of business-critical systems and capabilities, including:

  • OEM Data Integration & Connectivity Solutions

  • API & Digital Ecosystem Products

  • Data Exchange, Governance & Data Services

  • Legacy Platform Transformation & Modernization Initiatives

The Senior Product Manager will serve as the primary liaison between OEM stakeholders, engineering, sales, operations, customer success, and executive leadership to deliver scalable digital solutions that improve business performance, support enterprise transformation initiatives, and strengthen OEM partnerships. This role is responsible for identifying growth opportunities, defining strategic direction, prioritizing investments, and delivering measurable customer and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with leadership to understand the vision, strategy and drive roadmap, and execution of a portfolio of OEM-facing products and platforms supporting data integration, reporting, analytics, digital ecosystems, and platform modernization.

  • Define and prioritize product investments, strategic initiatives, and roadmap deliverables aligned with customer needs, OEM requirements, business objectives, and long-term growth strategies.

  • Partner directly with OEM stakeholders to understand business goals, operational challenges, integration requirements, reporting needs, and digital transformation opportunities.

  • Drive the development of scalable, secure, and reliable solutions that enable data exchange, connectivity, interoperability, analytics, and insights across OEM and enterprise ecosystems.

  • Define product requirements and customer-centric solutions through collaboration with Engineering, Architecture, UX, Data, Operations, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams.

  • Conduct customer research, competitive analysis, and market assessments to identify emerging trends, unmet needs, product opportunities, and potential risks.

  • Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders and customer leadership while serving as the voice of the customer throughout the product development process.

  • Communicate product strategy, roadmap priorities, investment recommendations, and business outcomes to leadership, customers, and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Use data-driven decision making and continuous improvement by leveraging customer feedback, product analytics, operational metrics, and market insights.

  • Ensure compliance with business, regulatory, security, data governance, and contractual requirements across the product portfolio.

  • Influence and align stakeholders across multiple organizations to successfully deliver complex, cross-functional initiatives that drive measurable business results.

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience in enterprise software, SaaS, data platforms, analytics, APIs, digital products, or technology-driven solutions.

  • Proven experience developing and executing product strategies and roadmaps for complex B2B products.

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers and external business partners to deliver scalable product solutions.

  • Strong understanding of product management principles, agile methodologies, customer discovery, and product lifecycle management.

  • Knowledge of APIs, data integration concepts, reporting platforms, analytics solutions, and digital ecosystems.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and lead cross-functional teams without direct authority.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to leverage data to drive decision making.

  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.

  • Proven track record of delivering customer-focused solutions that achieve measurable business outcomes.

Preferred

  • Knowledge of OEM business processes, dealer ecosystems, automotive data flows, and connected vehicle technologies.

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

  • Experience with business intelligence, analytics, reporting, and data governance solutions.

  • MBA or master’s degree in business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Lead Software Engineer with a strong full-stack development background to lead a team in designing, developing, and maintaining robust and scalable software solutions. This role involves technical leadership, mentoring junior engineers, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality applications across the entire software development lifecycle.

Job Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, development, testing, and deployment of complex full-stack applications, ensuring high performance, scalability, and security.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to a team of software engineers, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
* Drive architectural decisions and best practices for both front-end and back-end development.
* Collaborate closely with product management, UX/UI designers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications and deliver innovative solutions.
* Conduct code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across the full application stack.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and methodologies.
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends, evaluating and recommending their adoption where appropriate.
* Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering to deployment and support.

Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in software development, with a significant focus on full-stack engineering.
* Proven experience in a technical leadership or lead engineer role, including mentoring and guiding junior developers.
* Expertise in front-end technologies (e.g., React, Angular, Vue.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3) and responsive web design.
* Strong proficiency in back-end programming languages (e.g., C#, Java, Python, Node.js) and associated frameworks (e.g., .NET Core, Spring Boot, Django, Express.js).
* Extensive experience with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra).
* Solid understanding of RESTful API design and development.
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Proficiency with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong understanding of software design patterns, data structures, and algorithms.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in an agile development environment.

title: Product Owner
description:
Product Owner

Als Product Owner bij Nmbrs verbind je productvisie, gebruikersbehoeften en techniek. Je zorgt ervoor dat ons productteam de juiste prioriteiten stelt en werkt aan oplossingen die ondernemers en accountants écht verder helpen. Met jouw ervaring binnen productontwikkeling beweeg je moeiteloos tussen UX, business en techniek. Samen met developers, designers, testers en stakeholders werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling van ons product en onderzoek je hoe onder andere AI kan bijdragen aan meer waarde voor onze gebruikers.

Time to grow. Time to thrive.

Wij zijn Nmbrs. We maken slimme business software die onnodige complexiteit wegneemt voor mkb-ondernemers en de professionals die hen ondersteunen. Nmbrs brengt vier gevestigde productorganisaties samen—Payroll, Accounting, Invoicing en Reporting—met teams in Nederland, Zweden en Portugal.

We zijn één merk met een gezamenlijke ambitie, terwijl we blijven werken vanuit de expertise en kracht van onze eigen organisaties. We bundelen onze krachten waar dat logisch is en houden teams, expertise en besluitvorming dicht bij elkaar.

Voor deze functie ga je werken bij Nmbrs Invoicing in Eersel. Je werkt nauw samen met je directe collega’s op deze locatie en met onze collega’s in Portugal, en bent tegelijkertijd onderdeel van de bredere Nmbrs-organisatie.

Jouw rol

Als Product Owner ben jij de spil tussen het productteam, stakeholders en gebruikers. Je zorgt ervoor dat iedereen dezelfde richting op kijkt: van de productvisie en roadmap op hoofdlijnen tot de concrete user stories die het ontwikkelteam oppakt.

Ons multidisciplinaire productteam bestaat uit developers, designers en testers in Nederland en Portugal en werkt volgens Scrum, met sprints van twee weken. Je werkt nauw met hen samen tijdens onder andere sprintplanning, refinement en sprint reviews. AI speelt daarbij een steeds grotere rol: zowel als kans binnen ons product als hulpmiddel in de manier waarop we werken.

Concreet ga je:

  • Samen met het productteam de productvisie en roadmap bepalen en bewaken en zorgen dat deze aansluiten op de doelen van Nmbrs Invoicing.

  • Klantfeedback, marktinzichten en data vertalen naar een scherp geprioriteerde backlog en features en verbeteringen prioriteren op basis van impact voor de gebruiker.

  • Schakelen tussen UX, business en techniek om tot de juiste productkeuzes te komen en deze te vertalen naar concrete, uitvoerbare user stories.

  • Nauw samenwerken met developers, designers, testers en stakeholders tijdens sprintplanning, refinement en sprint reviews.

  • Signaleren waar AI ons product en onze gebruikers verder kan helpen en AI-tools inzetten om bijvoorbeeld data sneller te analyseren, ideeën te verkennen en processen te versnellen.

Jouw impact

Met jouw werk zorg je ervoor dat ons productteam zich richt op wat de meeste waarde oplevert voor onze gebruikers en onze organisatie. Je brengt verschillende perspectieven samen en vertaalt gebruikersbehoeften, data en bedrijfsdoelstellingen naar duidelijke keuzes voor het product.

Wanneer er bijvoorbeeld meerdere wensen, verbeteringen en nieuwe features op de backlog staan, help jij bepalen wat als eerste aandacht verdient. Je onderbouwt die keuzes met data en de verwachte impact voor gebruikers, zodat het team gericht kan werken aan verbeteringen die er echt toe doen.

Daarnaast help je ons vooruitkijken. Je signaleert ontwikkelingen in de markt en onderzoekt hoe nieuwe mogelijkheden, waaronder AI, ons product en onze manier van werken kunnen verbeteren. Zo draag je niet alleen bij aan wat we vandaag bouwen, maar ook aan de verdere ontwikkeling van Nmbrs Invoicing.

Jouw profiel

Je bent een ervaren Product Owner die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen het grote geheel en de details die nodig zijn om een developmentteam vooruit te helpen. Je verbindt verschillende disciplines en stakeholders, maakt onderbouwde keuzes en voelt je thuis in een snel veranderende SaaS-omgeving.

  • Je hebt 3–5 jaar ervaring als Product Owner, bij voorkeur binnen een SaaS-omgeving.

  • Je beweegt je moeiteloos in de driehoek UX, business en techniek en hebt sterke communicatieve vaardigheden om verschillende teams en stakeholders te verbinden.

  • Je kunt uitzoomen en het grote plaatje zien, maar ook concreet prioriteren en keuzes maken op detailniveau. Je gebruikt daarbij data om je beslissingen te onderbouwen.

  • Je hebt ervaring met Scrum/Agile werken en tools zoals Jira of vergelijkbare tools.

  • Je weet hoe je AI-tools slim kunt inzetten, bijvoorbeeld om data sneller te analyseren, backlogs te verrijken, ideeën te verkennen of processen te versnellen.

Je hoeft niet ieder denkbaar vakje af te vinken. Herken je jezelf in de rol en denk je dat je impact kunt maken? Dan horen we graag van je.

Dit bieden wij

  • Een brutosalaris tussen €4.000 en €5.500 per maand op basis van een fulltime werkweek, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

  • Een aantrekkelijke bonusregeling bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd, waarbij je tot 150% van je bruto maandsalaris kunt verdienen;

  • 28 vakantiedagen per jaar bij een fulltime dienstverband;

  • Van digitaal naar dichtbij: vier keer per jaar ontmoet je je Portugese collega’s, twee keer in Porto en twee keer in Nederland;

  • Leuke teamuitjes en toffe targettrips naar het buitenland;

  • Uitdagend werk in een snel veranderende omgeving met veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng;

  • Een hecht en gezellig team met een sterk wij-gevoel en een goede werksfeer. We lunchen samen en spreken de weekendplannen door tijdens onze vrijdagmiddagborrel, inclusief een maandelijkse SnackVrijdag;

  • Een inspirerende werkplek in Eersel, met de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken, waarbij je maximaal twee dagen per week vanuit huis werkt;

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling;

  • Een vitaliteitsregeling van €25 netto per maand en extra voordelen via a.s.r. Vitality;

  • Een pensioenregeling met 10% werkgeversbijdrage.

Let op: op dit moment kunnen wij geen relocatie-ondersteuning bieden. We moedigen daarom sollicitaties aan van kandidaten die binnen een straal van 50 km van ons kantoor in Eersel wonen.
