title: Head of Risk & Compliance
description:
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.


Job Description


Get To Know Us:

As Head of Risk & Compliance, you will provide strategic leadership and direction across Risk, Compliance and Governance for our Platform Solutions business. You will play a key role in supporting the CEO, Board, senior leadership and business teams, ensuring we maintain the highest standards of regulatory compliance, governance and risk management.

This is a senior leadership position with responsibility for fostering a strong risk and compliance culture, maintaining effective relationships with regulators and industry bodies, and ensuring the business continues to operate within applicable regulatory, legal and corporate requirements.

Why You Will Love It Here!

Flexibility: Hybrid Work Model

  • Flexibility: Hybrid Work Model

  • Your Future: Professional Development Reimbursement including access to SS&C University

  • Work/Life Balance: Competitive holiday scheme

  • Your Wellbeing: Competitive benefits designed to support the wellbeing of our staff

  • Diversity & Inclusion: Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving on Diversity

  • Training: Hands-On, Team-Customised throughout your career

What You Will Get To Do:

  • Provide strategic leadership and direction for Risk, Compliance and Governance across the Platform Solutions business.

  • Represent and report on risk and compliance activities, key issues and escalations to the Risk Management Committee, Executive Committee and Platform Solutions Boards.

  • Provide trusted advice and challenge to Board members, the CEO and business leaders on Risk, Compliance and Governance matters.

  • Ensure timely and accurate regulatory reporting to the FCA and maintain an open, transparent and constructive relationship with regulators.

  • Ensure effective corporate governance is maintained in line with current regulatory requirements and best practice.

  • Oversee risk and compliance control frameworks, including compliance monitoring programmes, risk assessments and operational oversight.

  • Identify trends, significant control weaknesses and regulatory issues, ensuring appropriate escalation and timely agreement of remedial actions.

  • Provide advice on FCA, HMRC and relevant UK legislative and regulatory requirements, including supporting the business through regulatory change.

  • Support new business and new product initiatives by providing pragmatic, commercially aware and compliant risk and compliance advice.

  • Ensure material risk and compliance issues are escalated promptly to the CEO and Board.

  • Lead and develop the Risk & Compliance team, ensuring appropriate responsibilities are delegated according to capability and experience, with effective oversight of delegated activities.

  • Promote a strong risk, compliance and governance culture, driving accountability and ownership across the business.

  • Coordinate the development, implementation and ongoing review of policies and procedures to reflect legal, regulatory and business changes.

  • Ensure appropriate risk and compliance training requirements are identified and addressed across relevant business areas.

  • Support the business in developing practical action plans to address issues identified through internal and external monitoring and reviews.

  • Maintain appropriate governance databases and registers, including gifts and benefits and personal account dealing, using these to identify trends and potential training requirements.

  • Ensure data protection and data security remain key priorities across the business.

  • Oversee financial matters relating to Risk & Compliance in line with statutory and corporate requirements.

  • Support the resolution of shareholder queries and ensure timely and accurate escalation of relevant updates.

  • Maintain appropriate engagement with industry bodies, including PIMFA and Platform Association technical meetings.

  • Monitor progress against strategic objectives, policies and plans, ensuring effective delivery and implementation.

  • Lead by example, promoting openness, transparency, accountability and a positive corporate culture across the business.

What You Will Bring:

  • Significant senior-level experience working within a regulated financial services environment.

  • Strong regulatory and technical knowledge, ideally with experience within the UK wealth management and/or platforms sector.

  • Experience in a senior Risk, Compliance, Audit, Legal or other assurance and advisory role.

  • A strong understanding of UK financial services regulation, including FCA requirements and relevant legislation.

  • Good understanding of financial services and investment product requirements.

  • Knowledge and experience of data protection and regulatory considerations within financial services.

  • A strong understanding of industry requirements, emerging developments and regulatory change.

  • The confidence and integrity to challenge, influence and escalate issues when appropriate.

  • Experience providing advice and assurance to senior management and Boards.

  • Proven ability to build strong, collaborative relationships across a complex organisation.

  • Experience implementing and managing projects or programmes across a large organisation or group.

  • Strong organisational, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines.

  • A pragmatic and solutions-focused approach, balancing effective risk management with the needs of the business.

  • Experience leading, developing and motivating a Risk & Compliance team.

  • A commitment to Consumer Duty, Consumer Outcomes and delivering fair outcomes for clients and investors.

  • A high level of personal integrity, professionalism and accountability, with a commitment to acting with due care, skill and diligence.

  • Experience working within a global regulated financial services organisation, either in an internal function or a client-facing advisory capacity, would be desirable.

  • A commitment to continuous learning, professional development and maintaining up-to-date regulatory knowledge.

.

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Enterprise Architect

Permanent Position

Hybrid from our Wimbledon Office

Are you ready to help shape the future technology landscape across our European markets?

Domestic & General is scaling fast across 12 countries, protecting the appliances that keep households running and reducing waste by extending the life of everyday devices. With an inclusive, people‑first culture recognised by Great Place to Work and the Inclusive Employers Standard, we’re now looking for a Enterprise Architect to define architectural strategy, guide investment decisions and drive the long-term transition towards a more unified global technology environment.

About the role

This is a rare opportunity to shape technology strategy across Domestic & General's Growth Markets business, spanning multiple European countries, stakeholders and technology platforms.

Working closely with senior business, product and engineering leaders, you'll define architectural direction, influence key investment decisions and help drive the transition towards a more unified global technology landscape.

This is a highly autonomous role for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, operating across diverse markets and balancing long-term strategy with practical delivery. You'll have the opportunity to influence senior decision-makers, shape technology outcomes at scale and leave a lasting impact on a growing international business.

Key responsibilities

  • Define and evolve technology and architecture roadmaps across multiple European markets
  • Drive modernisation, simplification and platform convergence initiatives
  • Provide architectural leadership for major business and technology investments
  • Influence senior stakeholders across technology, product and business functions
  • Ensure solutions meet security, regulatory and operational resilience requirements
  • Identify opportunities to improve platforms, capabilities and ways of working

About you

You're an experienced Architect who combines strategic thinking with a pragmatic, delivery-focused approach. title: Chrome Plater - 1st shift
description:
Shifts:

1st shift - 6:00am - 2:30pm Monday - Friday


At Anoplate, you will have a secure future with opportunities to move up in our business. We will train you and you will not be working on the same products day after day! Our Chrome Platers begin by learning how to prepare customer parts for the plating process. From there, your pay & career will continue to grow as you learn more surface finishing skills. There are opportunities to gain more certifications and levels or grow into quality assurance roles, environmental operations roles, on-the-job trainers, or maintenance roles. We value the skills and experience our employees gain on the production floor and promote them from within to other professional roles.


In This Role You Will:

  • As a Chrome Plater, you will use a variety of chemical solutions and finishes such as copper, zinc, gold and nickel to coat the surface of customers products to change the properties of the parts and enhance their durability.
  • Understands and adjusts plating equipment (ex. Rectifiers, pumps, hoists, filters, etc.) when necessary
  • Reads and interprets blueprints and customer work orders (Traveler).
  • Follow specific procedures to perform routine chemical plate operations on Defense, Medical and Aerospace parts.
  • Fills baskets, racks, and/or barrels with parts to be coated or plated and immerse into cleaning solutions, or spray objects with conductive solutions to prepare them for plating.
  • Grinds, polishes or rinses parts in water and dries parts.
  • Inspect coated or plated areas for defects, such as air bubbles or uneven coverage
  • Follow specific procedures to adjust voltage, monitor time, determine thickness of coating etc., in order to brush plate a variety of parts with various metal.
  • Remove excess materials or impurities from objects, using air hoses or grinding machines.
  • Operate hoists to place workpieces onto machine feed carriages or spindles.
  • Operate sandblasting equipment to roughen and clean surfaces of workpieces.
  • Plate small objects, such as nuts or bolts, using motor-driven barrels.
  • Visually inspects own work for quality of product.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.


Job Description


Principal Data Engineer

Location: Waltham MA - 10 CityPoint

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Principal Data Engineer to lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable AI/ML data platforms, distributed data processing systems, and cloud-native data services. This role requires deep expertise in Python and Java-based backend engineering, microservices architecture, machine learning pipelines, distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, Kubernetes, and AWS technologies.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience building enterprise-scale data platforms, developing production-ready ML pipelines, implementing scalable microservices, and driving engineering best practices. This role will collaborate closely with Product, Architecture, Data Science, Application Development, Analytics, SRE, and DevOps teams to deliver highly scalable, reliable, and intelligent data solutions.

Why Join SS&C

SS&C combines proprietary technology with deep industry expertise to support complex financial and health care operations. Our teams design, implement, and operate solutions that help clients manage data, automate processes, and scale their businesses with confidence.

You will work with industry experts, modern platforms, and evolving technologies, gaining exposure to real-world operational challenges and large-scale enterprise environments.

How You Will Make an Impact

  • Lead the design and development of scalable AI/ML data platforms, distributed data processing systems, and cloud-native applications.

  • Design and implement end-to-end ML pipelines including data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, validation, deployment, monitoring, and automated retraining.

  • Build scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using technologies such as Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, Spark, or similar distributed processing frameworks.

  • Develop scalable microservices, REST APIs, reusable platform services, and enterprise data processing components.

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, embedding generation services, semantic search capabilities, and vector database integrations.

  • Drive platform modernization, technical design reviews, engineering standards, and adoption of innovative technologies to improve scalability, reliability, performance, and operational efficiency.

  • Design and maintain cloud-native infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, containerized applications, and ML deployment workflows using Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform/CloudFormation, ECS/EKS, and AWS services including EC2, S3, Lambda, Redshift, Aurora, RDS, Glue, CloudWatch, and MSK.

  • Design optimized relational, NoSQL, and vector data models using PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redshift, Aurora, Milvus, Pinecone, Chroma, or similar technologies, including performance tuning, indexing, partitioning, and query optimization.

  • Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and collaborate with SRE and DevOps teams to improve platform stability, scalability, deployment automation, and ML operational workflows.

  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to engineering teams while driving best practices, governance, architecture, and continuous improvement initiatives

Required Experience

  • Strong expertise in Python, Java, Spring Boot, REST API development, and Microservices Architecture.

  • Experience building production-grade AI/ML platforms, ML pipelines, and distributed data processing applications.

  • Strong understanding of ML SDLC, MLOps, model deployment, and productionizing Python/Java applications.

  • Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka, Kafka Connect, Kafka Streams, Apache Flink, Spark, Airflow, or similar distributed data processing technologies.

  • Extensive experience designing and developing cloud-native applications on AWS.

  • Solid expertise in Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform/CloudFormation, ECS, and EKS environments.

  • Experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, or scikit-learn.

  • Strong knowledge of Oracle, PostgreSQL, Amazon Redshift, Amazon Aurora, MongoDB, and vector databases such as Milvus, Pinecone, or Chroma.

  • Experience with data modeling, feature engineering, database optimization, query tuning, indexing, partitioning, and performance improvement strategies.

  • Proven experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Maven/Gradle, SonarQube, and Infrastructure as Code.

  • Strong expertise in monitoring, logging, and observability tools including CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk, and OpenTelemetry.

  • Strong Linux proficiency and software engineering best practices.

What Sets You Apart (preferred qualifications)

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field.

  • 8+ years of software engineering, data engineering, or AI platform engineering experience.

  • Experience building scalable ML pipelines, feature engineering workflows, and enterprise AI platforms.

  • Experience with Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LLM deployment, embedding pipelines, and semantic search technologies.

  • Experience with ML orchestration frameworks such as Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, or similar platforms.

  • Strong experience designing scalable, fault-tolerant, and highly available distributed systems.

  • Experience leading enterprise-scale platform initiatives and mentoring engineering teams.

  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, architectural, and technical leadership skills.

Join SS&C, where innovation meets global opportunities. Click here to apply.

title: Verkoopleider
description:
Heb jij al verkoopervaring in de automotive en ben je klaar voor de volgende stap in je carrière? Lijkt het jou leuk om ons verkoopteam naar een hoger niveau te tillen? Heb jij interesse in een baan als verkoopleider en krijg jij energie van het behalen van commerciële resultaten én het ontwikkelen van een team? Lees dan snel verder!

Wat ga je doen?

Voor onze Van Mossel Nissan en Alpine vestiging in Amsterdam zoeken wij een verkoopleider. In deze rol houd jij je natuurlijk bezig met het verkopen van nieuwe en gebruikte auto’s, maar ben je daarnaast verantwoordelijk voor het coachen en motiveren van het verkoopteam en het overdragen van jouw kennis en ervaring.

Als meewerkend voorman ben jij continu bezig met het bedenken van nieuwe ideeën om de commerciële resultaten te verbeteren, de klanttevredenheid te borgen en de kwaliteit van het team naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Jij weet als geen ander hoe je commerciële kansen herkent en benut en weet jouw collega’s hierin mee te nemen.

Daarnaast kun je denken aan de volgende werkzaamheden:

  • Opstellen van de salesplannen;

  • Behalen van de resultaten voor zowel nieuwe als gebruikte auto’s;

  • Begeleiden, coachen en ontwikkelen van je collega’s in de verkoop;

  • Identificeren van externe (verkoop)activiteiten

  • Bewaken en verbeteren van de klanttevredenheid;

  • Signaleren van commerciële kansen en vertalen naar concrete acties;

  • In samenwerking met marketing campagnes ontwikkelen.

Wie ben jij?

Het spreekt voor zich dat je al werkervaring hebt bij een dealerbedrijf. Natuurlijk is het daarnaast fijn als je al ervaring hebt als verkoopleider.

Het belangrijkste is dat jij het verkoopteam weet te motiveren, te coachen en jouw kennis en ervaring kunt overbrengen. Jij herkent kansen, bent resultaatgericht en hebt oog voor de mensen om je heen. Je bent ambitieus en streeft ernaar om de klantverwachting altijd te overtreffen.

Verder beschik jij over:

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring bij een dealerbedrijf;

  • Een oplossingsgerichte instelling en je bent stressbestendig;

  • Commerciële en leidinggevende kwaliteiten;

  • Een sterke drive om resultaten te behalen;

  • Fulltime beschikbaarheid.

Wat bieden wij jou?

In ruim 75 jaar tijd is de Van Mossel Automotive Group uitgegroeid tot het grootste en leukste autobedrijf van de Benelux. Wij zijn ambitieus, groeien hard en willen blijven groeien. Ondanks dat wij een groot bedrijf zijn, blijven wij een familiebedrijf. Het familiaire gevoel overheerst dan ook binnen onze organisatie.

Op onze Van Mossel Nissan en Alpine vestiging in Amsterdam kom je terecht in een enthousiast, ervaren en ambitieus team. Samen werken wij iedere dag aan het behalen van onze commerciële doelstellingen en het bieden van de best mogelijke service aan onze klanten. Naast hard werken vinden wij een goede werksfeer belangrijk. We vinden het belangrijk dat collega's elkaar helpen, samenwerken en met plezier naar hun werk komen.

Wij bieden jou een zelfstandige en verantwoordelijke baan waarin je veel ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

  • Een goed salaris passend bij jouw ervaring;

  • Een bonus op basis van je prestaties;

  • Een auto van de zaak die je ook privé mag rijden;

  • Uiteraard krijg je van ons een mobiele telefoon en laptop van de zaak;

  • Het volgen van verschillende trainingen en workshops;

  • De mogelijkheid om onbeperkt gebruik te maken van onze Van Mossel Academy;

  • En natuurlijk een leuke baan binnen een snelgroeiende organisatie met fantastische collega’s!

Enthousiast?

Ben jij na het lezen van deze vacature enthousiast geworden en zie jij jezelf als onze nieuwe verkoopleider voor Nissan en Alpine in Amsterdam? Solliciteer dan eenvoudig en snel via onze website! Heb je nog vragen over de functie? Neem dan gerust contact met ons op. We vertellen je graag meer over deze mooie uitdaging!

title: Sr Consultant, Oversight & Control
description:
About Northern Trust


As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.


Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.


With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.



Role

The Business Oversight & Reporting team is a rapidly expanding business within Accounting & Fund Services (AFS) area of Northern Trust with offices in Ireland, London, Guernsey, Luxembourg, Chicago, Australia, Bangalore and Pune.

The Business Oversight & Reporting Senior Consultant is a proactive role that is responsible for oversight of the business units within AFS. The Senior Consultant provides proactive leadership and guidance to partners to strengthen controls, assess and mitigate operational risk.

This IC role which reports to the AFS Business Oversight & Reporting Lead will provide an opportunity for the successful candidate to develop knowledge and experience of a dynamic and varied environment of AFS.

Responsibilities

  • Drives engagement with stakeholders and perform risk analysis to identify priorities and key risk areas to perform proactive reviews independently to maintain quality levels & identify areas for enhancement. Provide recommendations & track implementation by the Business Units.

  • Ensure that current policies and procedures are in place (and are being followed) for business unit functions and are in compliance with organizational standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Assess Operational readiness of the business unit’s ability to take on new clients, processes, or perform system migrations.

  • Lead innovation and develop process improvements to mitigate operational risk

  • Lead AFS wide initiatives to drive reduction of risk, process improvements and adherence to controls.

  • Perform proactive reviews on the processes undergoing Strategic Change

  • Perform Root Cause Analysis of incidents within the department and identifying trends and solutions.

  • Perform Trend analysis using metrics available leading to proactive mitigation of risk.

  • Collaborate with Business Functions to assess the Business Continuity Plans (BCP), & identify gaps and deviation from BCP.

  • Track all review actions / reporting to Senior Management and plan effectively to meet the deadlines set

  • Articulate various Oversight Reports to ensure timely & effective communication to management.

  • Keep abreast of industry and regulatory developments that may impact the risk and quality of our service.

  • Demonstrate excellent communication skills and engage stakeholders continuously. Through consultation improvise the process thereby reducing risk.

Accountabilities

  • Employees are required to comply with the regulatory regime in which Northern Trust operates as appropriate to the above role

  • Employees are expected to exercise due care and diligence, ensuring the areas the incumbent is responsible for are organized and controlled

  • Employees are required to observe proper standards of market, business and personal conduct, demonstrating integrity in the execution of duties

Skills

  • Strong understanding of Risk Management and Control design & effectiveness

  • Understating of the Fund Accounting business including its strategic goals, associated products and supporting operational functions.

  • Knowledge of risk management techniques and proven ability to identify and asses risk in business processes, migration activity and new products.. Knowledge of Six Sigma & Agile or other Process Improvement methodologies in an added advantage. Proficiency in MS Office (particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI & Word).

  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry best practices like CASS, IMR, AIFMD, FATCA, UCITS V will be an added advantage

  • Must be able to think creatively and possess strong trend & data analytical skills, reasoning skills, problem solving & project management skills.

  • Strong communication, presentation & negotiation skills are necessary to consult with partners/clients throughout the organization

  • Self-starter with the ability to function independently in a fast-paced, dynamic and demanding environment.

Qualifications:

  • Overall experience of 10+ years

  • Bachelor’s degree with emphasis in Accounting, Master degree/IAQ/IOC or equivalent a plus

  • Experience in Audit/Operational Control/ Risk or equivalent

  • Accounting / financial services/ capital markets work experience or equivalent

  • Should be flexible for shifts and extended working hours.

Eligibility - Internal Partners

  • 24 months as a Consultant to move as a Senior Consultant


Working with Us


As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.


Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.


Reasonable Accommodation


Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.


About Our Pune Office


The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.


Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: IT Support Field Technician - Decommissioning Project
description:
Job Name﻿﻿: IT Support Field Technician

Job City: São Paolo

Job Location: ﻿São Paolo﻿, Brazil


Job Description﻿:

We are seeking experienced IT Support Field Technicians for a large-scale, global project to decommission and dispose of data center hardware. This role is focused on the physical de-racking, inventory management, and secure preparation of servers, networking gear, and related equipment. The ideal candidate is proficient with hardware, meticulous with documentation, and adept at following precise procedures in a data center environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Execute the physical decommissioning of IT assets including HP/Cisco/Dell servers, blade chassis, switches, and wireless controllers across multiple international sites.

Follow detailed project plans to safely power down, unrack, label, and package equipment for secure transport.

Accurately update asset inventories using provided tracking systems, ensuring a clear chain-of-custody for all equipment.

Adhere strictly to all client security policies and data destruction protocols.

Coordinate with a central Project Manager to report daily progress and resolve any on-site logistical issues.

Ensure all work is performed in accordance with health and safety standards.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

Proven experience as an IT Support Technician, Field Technician, or similar hands-on role.

Strong emphasis on practical experience with hardware decommissioning, installation, or maintenance.

Familiarity with hardware from major vendors like HP, Dell, and Cisco.

Ability to methodically follow instructions and checklists with a high degree of accuracy.

Physical capability to lift and move heavy equipment (up to 50 lbs / 23 kg).

Excellent organizational and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

CompTIA A+ or equivalent certification.

Prior experience with IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) or data center migration projects.

Awareness of data security standards (e.g., NIST 800-88).

Estamos buscando Técnicos de Campo de Suporte de TI experientes para um projeto global em larga escala de descomissionamento e descarte de hardware de data center. O foco principal desta função é a desmontagem física, o gerenciamento de inventário e o preparo seguro para transporte de servidores, equipamentos de rede e dispositivos relacionados. O candidato ideal deve ser proficiente em hardware, meticuloso com a documentação e habilidoso em seguir procedimentos precisos em um ambiente de data center.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Executar o descomissionamento físico de ativos de TI (servidores HP, Cisco, Dell, chassis de blades, switches, controladores wireless) em vários locais internacionais.
  • Seguir planos de projeto detalhados para desligar com segurança, remover dos racks, etiquetar e embalar equipamentos para transporte seguro.
  • Atualizar com precisão os inventários de ativos usando os sistemas de rastreamento fornecidos, garantindo uma cadeia de custódia clara para todos os equipamentos.
  • Aderir estritamente a todas as políticas de segurança do cliente e aos protocolos de destruição de dados.
  • Coordenar com um Gerente de Projeto central para reportar o progresso diário e resolver quaisquer problemas logísticos no local.
  • Garantir que todo o trabalho seja realizado de acordo com os padrões de saúde e segurança.

Qualificações e Habilidades Necessárias:

  • Experiência comprovada como Técnico de Suporte de TI, Técnico de Campo ou função prática similar.
  • Forte ênfase na experiência prática com descomissionamento, instalação ou manutenção de hardware.

  • Capacidade de seguir instruções e listas de verificação de maneira metódica e com alto grau de precisão.

title: Doorperson
description:
Better begins here

Crown Resorts is a great place to visit and it’s an even better place to work, a place where you can play your part in creating fun, memorable, world-class experiences for our guests and our people. We value passion, optimism, and an appetite for change - for the better. Here, you’ll be part of the team, empowered to explore more, experience more and supported by your leader to grow and develop.

The Role

We’re seeking enthusiastic and service-driven individuals to join our Crown Sydney Bell team as a Doorperson. This is a role that will see you helping to deliver a seamless and memorable arrival experience for hotel guests to one of Sydney’s most luxurious hotels.

Working at the hotel entrance, you’ll play an important part in coordinating driveway flow, supporting luggage and vehicle movements, and ensuring guests are welcomed with warmth, professionalism and a keen attention to detail. As a senior team member, you’ll work closely with our Bell Services and Valet team to keep arrivals and departures running smoothly, particularly during peak periods and promotions.

We have both Full Time and Part Time opportunities available.

What you’ll do:

  • Manage driveway traffic flow to keep arrivals and departures safe, efficient and well organised

  • Support our Bell Services and Valet team with guest arrivals, departures, luggage and vehicle coordination

  • Deliver exceptional service to all guests, including VIPs, with discretion and professionalism

  • Multitask calmly and confidently during peak periods and high guest volume

  • Maintain strong local and product knowledge to answer guest questions and provide directions

What we require:

  • A valid NSW driver’s licence (minimum Green Ps / P2)

  • Confidence driving and parking a range of vehicles (automatic and/or manual)

  • Availability to work across a 24/7 rotating roster

Working Holiday Visa holders are encouraged to apply. Candidates who hold an overseas/international licence must be willing to obtain an NSW driver licence.

What will help you stand out:

  • Experience delivering high-end customer service in a hotel or other fast-paced guest-facing environment

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to stay calm under pressure

  • A proactive “jump in and help” attitude with the ability to work collaboratively and independently.

What we offer you:

  • A full-time opportunity in an internationally recognised luxury hotel & integrated resort

  • A uniform tailored to you and laundered for every shift

  • Complimentary staff meals, including hot foods, a salad and sandwich bar, fruits and pastries

  • Discounts across Crown hotels and restaurants Australia-wide

  • Ongoing coaching, training and professional development opportunities

On top of exciting career possibilities, we offer better exposure to experiences and learning. To see our range of benefits and opportunities visit Crown Resorts Careers.

Our Crown Community celebrates uniqueness and embraces diversity. We welcome the creativity, insights and experiences from people of different race, age, religion, cultural background, gender, people with disability, people who identify as LGBTIQ+ and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander; people like you.

title: Product Manager Autonomous Trucking (m/f/d)
description:
Join Quantum-Systems and bring autonomous trucks into real-world operations. As Product Manager Autonomous Trucking, you own the end-to-end strategy, roadmap, and delivery for the MOSAIC Ground Autonomy Kit, Quantum-Systems' solution to converting heavy-duty and tactical vehicles into autonomous assets. You operate at the intersection of customer value, technical feasibility, and commercial viability and in an extremely tight partnership with Engineering: you own the customer needs, they own how we achieve it technically and by when we deliver. Together you balance product ambition against engineering reality, make trade-offs consciously, and keep the roadmap that the whole organization can execute against.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • End-to-End Product Management: Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap from discovery, concept, and validation through to certification, commercial launches, and long-term value optimization

  • Customer & Market Translation: Work directly with customers, end-users, and sales representatives to analyze operational demands and constraints, translating them into product features and services

  • Engineering Collaboration: Partner with software, hardware, safety, and systems engineering teams in product refinement, planning, and prioritization

  • Iterative Delivery: Consolidate customer, user, and field operational insights to set product priorities and continuously convert requirements into shipped capabilities

  • Ecosystem Management: Manage strategic relationships across vehicle OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, and service providers.

  • Go-to-Market Strategy: Collaborate with Product Marketing to design and execute compelling go-to-market plans, ensuring that every product release is a step forward toward market leadership

What you bring to the team:

  • Multiple years of hands-on experience in autonomous trucking, robotics, physical AI, defence tech or closely related technical fields

  • Strong commercial instincts paired with a solid technical foundation, enabling you to liaise seamlessly between engineering teams and external customer stakeholders

  • A proactive, solution-oriented approach with a proven ability to deliver results in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment.

  • Fluency in English to effectively engage with our global team and international customers

  • A track record of taking complex products from initial concept to market launch, with background in product management, service design, or solution architecture within defence, automotive, or transportation sectors is a plus


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

title: 2D Artist (f/m/d) Regular - Senior
description:
At Aesir Interactive, we bring creativity and precision together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Behind every great game stands an inspiring world and striking visuals and our Art team plays a key role in making this possible. We’re looking for a talented 2D Artist to help shape the visual identity of our current and upcoming projects, creating art that captivates and excites players around the globe. As part of our Art Department, you will create high-quality 2D assets and visual concepts that define the look and feel of our games. You will work closely with Art Directors, Technical Artists, Game Designers, and other artists to bring environments, characters, and UI elements to life. Your work will ensure that our games are visually cohesive and memorable.
  • Designing and creating high-quality 2D artwork such as concept art, character designs, environment illustrations, icons, and textures
  • Collaborating with Art Directors, Game Designers and Technical Artists to define and maintain the artistic vision of the project and ensure solid integrations
  • Creating mood boards, style guides, and paint-overs to support visual development
  • Designing and creating UI/UX mockups to shape the interaction layer of a game and produce the related UI graphics
  • Working with the 3D and Tech Art teams to ensure seamless integration of 2D assets into the game engine
  • Iterating on feedback and adapting designs to gameplay needs and technical constraints
  • Preparing promotional artwork, key art, and marketing materials when needed
  • Create beautifications and concept art for presentations of new game ideas and pitches
A creative and detail-oriented artist with a strong sense of visual storytelling and game aesthetics. You thrive in a collaborative environment, communicate effectively, and can adapt your style to different projects. You understand the purpose of your creations in the context of an interactive, narrative game product. You are passionate about games and eager to translate ideas into compelling visuals.
  • Creation of high-quality 2D art assets and concept art for characters, environments, and UI
  • Maintaining a consistent visual style across all 2D elements
  • Supporting the development of mood boards and visual direction
  • Close collaboration with the Art and Design teams to ensure the game’s artistic goals are met
  • Preparing artwork for both in-game use and external marketing materials
  • Working on presenting new game ideas and pitches
  • Experience creating key art or promotional illustrations for games
  • Knowledge of UI/UX design principles and the ability to create user-friendly interfaces on different platforms and with different inputs
  • Familiarity with 3D workflows or basic 3D modeling/lighting knowledge to support concepting
  • Understanding of game engines (e.g., Unreal Engine) and their requirements for 2D assets
  • Degree in Art, Design, or a related field or equivalent professional experience
  • Strong portfolio showcasing a variety of 2D art styles and concept art
  • Proficiency in industry-standard tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar
  • Strong understanding of color, composition, and visual storytelling
  • Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)
  • A structured, proactive, and team-oriented way of working
  • A welcoming and vibrant office just 10 minutes from Munich Central Station
  • Flexible remote work options tailored to your needs
  • A 38-hour workweek that promotes a healthy work-life balance
  • Monthly €50 credit card top-up*

  • Free drinks, coffee, tea, and a weekly fresh organic fruit basket

title: Kokeneita rengasasentajia syksyn 2026 sesonkiin Lohjalle
description:
Haemme kokeneita rengasasentajia syksyn 2026 sesonkiin Lohjalle!

Rengasasentajan työtehtäviin kuuluu muun muassa autojen vastaanotto, renkaiden asennukset, renkaiden vaihdot sekä muut mahdolliset sesonkityöt (esim. varasto- ja pesutehtävät).

Rengassesonki on kiireistä aikaa, joten et säikähdä hektistä työtahtia vaan pystyt työskentelemään tehokkaasti myös paineen alla. Sinulla ei mene sormi suuhun, vaikka vauhti kiihtyy – pysyt rauhallisena ja hoidat työsi huolellisesti alusta loppuun.

Sovit tähän työhön, jos sinulta löytyy:

  • Aiempaa kokemusta rengastöistä sekä asennuksista
  • Hyvä asenne ja oma-aloitteinen työote: olet ajoissa paikalla, teet sen minkä lupaat, uskallat kysyä apua ja olet valmis ottamaan vastaan perehdytystä ja uusia oppeja
  • Fyysistä kuntoa, sillä työ on fyysisesti kuormittavaa
  • Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa
  • Joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen ja tarvittaessa valmiutta tehdä pidempääkin päivää
  • B-luokan ajokorttia, sillä työ voi sisältää myös autojen siirtoja

Hienoa (muttei välttämätöntä) on, jos sinulla on lisäksi:

  • Tutkinto autoalalta tai osaamista esimerkiksi vannekoneista.

Me tarjoamme sinulle:

  • TESin mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan, joka maksetaan aina ajallaan. Tässä työssä tuntipalkkasi asettuu 13-15 euron välille, ja se määritellään osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.
  • Hyvät työvaatteet ja muut työssä tarvittavat varusteet
  • Mukavan ja rennon työporukan
  • Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa

Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

”Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti”, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

  • Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.

  • Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa, kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 14.

  • Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.

  • Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.


Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi!

Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti, eli jätä hakemuksesi pian! Toivomme, että voisit aloittaa työt mahdollisimman pian.

Hakemisen jälkeen kuulet meistä lyhyen ajan kuluessa. Jos etenet rekrytointiprosessissa, tapaat ensin Workerin työntekijän rennossa haastattelussa, jonka tavoitteena on tutustua tarkemmin sinuun ja osaamiseesi. Viimeisessä vaiheessa pääset tapaamaan myös asiakasyrityksen yhteyshenkilön.

Lisätietoja tästä työstä ja muista Workerin tarjoamista työmahdollisuuksista voit kysyä Rene Rahkoselta rene.rahkonen@worker.fi tai 050 5636127. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

title: Senior Specialist, Global Mobility
description:
Job Title

Senior Specialist, Global Mobility

Job Description Summary

Job Description

POSITION PURPOSE

The Global Mobility (GM) Specialist is responsible for the regional delivery of global mobility governance and consulting services to People Partners and Line Managers across their designated region, on all Global Mobility matters. This role will respond to GM queries/requests and help facilitate and manage international job moves into and out of their region, in alignment with the C&W policy and best practice. Key skills required to be successful in this role are exceptional communication skills—especially in a virtual environment, strong connection and relationship skills that enable and educate People Partners and managers on GM policies and practice. This role reports to the aligned regional People Services Director but has a matrix reporting line to the Senior Manager, Global Mobility. For the Americas region, this role will also have responsibility for the management of the US domestic relocation program, advising People Partners and Line Managers against the local policies.

The Global Mobility Specialist will utilize the relevant technology to manage GM cases and store employee relocation data. And will utilize this data for metrics and reporting analytics.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end case management for regional employee moves (intake → assessment → delivery → closeout)

  • Serve as the first point of contact for employees, managers, and People Partners on mobility inquiries and triage

  • Apply global mobility policy and regional legal/tax/immigration requirements accurately; flag exceptions and risks early

  • Coordinate vendors (immigration, relocation, tax, payroll, destination services) and hold them to SLAs, quality, and timelines

  • Provide clear guidance on costs, approvals, required documentation, and expected timelines to stakeholders

  • Maintain accurate case documentation and data in the case management/HR systems; ensure audit-ready files

  • Partner with Reward/Payroll/People Services to execute changes correctly (pay, allowances, benefits, deductions, reporting)

  • Manage issue resolution and escalations, including stakeholder updates and root-cause follow-up

  • Monitor compliance and employee experience across the lifecycle (privacy, record retention, policy adherence, service quality)

  • Produce regular reporting on volume, cycle time, spend, exceptions, and risks; recommend process improvements

  • Support regional rollout and adoption of global mobility processes, templates, and communications

title: VP of Systems Engineering - Federal
description:
VAST Data is building the data platform for the AI era. The VAST Data Platform brings together storage, database, compute, and data services into a unified architecture designed to power the world’s most demanding AI, analytics, and data-intensive environments.

We’re looking for a Vice President of Systems Engineering – Federal to lead the technical field organization supporting VAST’s U.S. Federal business.


The Role

The VP of Systems Engineering – Federal is a second-line leadership role responsible for building, leading, and scaling the Systems Engineering organization supporting VAST’s Federal business.

This leader will manage SE leaders and their teams across the Federal organization, establish the technical strategy for the business, and partner closely with Federal Sales leadership to drive growth across defense, intelligence, and civilian agencies.

This is not simply a people-management position.

We’re looking for a technical and commercial leader who can operate comfortably from the executive level down to the architecture—someone capable of advising senior government technology leaders, shaping complex AI and data infrastructure strategies, developing exceptional SE leaders, and stepping into the most technically demanding opportunities when needed.



What You’ll Do

  • Lead the Federal Systems Engineering organization, managing and developing first-line SE leaders and their teams across the U.S. Federal business.
  • Build the organizational structure, leadership bench, technical capabilities, and operating model required to scale VAST’s Federal business.
  • Partner with Federal Sales leadership to define account strategy, prioritize opportunities, penetrate strategic agencies, and win significant new programs.
  • Establish a consistently high bar for technical discovery, solution architecture, competitive positioning, POCs, executive engagement, and technical deal execution.
  • Develop SE managers into exceptional leaders who can recruit, coach, challenge, and elevate their teams—not simply administer them.
  • Remain actively engaged in VAST’s largest and most strategic Federal opportunities, particularly where executive alignment, complex architecture, or competitive differentiation is critical.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior government technology leaders, architects, program leaders, mission partners, and the broader Federal technology ecosystem.
  • Translate complex mission and business requirements into full-stack architectures spanning compute, networking, storage, data platforms, cloud, and AI infrastructure.
  • Ensure the SE organization can articulate not only how VAST works, but why its architecture matters to a customer's mission and technology strategy.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, CTO Office, Support, Alliances, and Sales to bring Federal requirements into VAST and VAST innovation into the Federal market.
  • Develop repeatable technical sales motions that increase the organization's ability to win and scale.
  • Create a culture of accountability, intellectual curiosity, technical excellence, customer obsession, and continuous development across the Federal SE organization.


Requirements


  • Significant leadership experience within Systems Engineering, Solutions Engineering, technical pre-sales, or field architecture organizations supporting the U.S. Federal market.
  • Proven experience as a second-line leader, with responsibility for developing managers as well as building and scaling larger technical organizations.
  • Demonstrated success supporting complex Federal technology sales across DoD, Intelligence Community, and/or Federal Civilian agencies.
  • A track record of helping technical organizations create and win net-new business, rather than primarily supporting an established customer base.
  • Experience building organizations in high-growth or rapidly changing environments, including recruiting exceptional talent, establishing operating rhythms, and raising the performance bar.
  • Deep full-stack technical credibility across modern data and AI infrastructure: strong understanding of distributed storage and data architectures; file and object protocols including NFS, SMB, and S3; NVMe/NVMe-oF; high-performance networking including Ethernet, RDMA/RoCE, and InfiniBand; Linux; Kubernetes and containers; cloud platforms; and modern GPU infrastructure including NVIDIA and AMD. - Strong understanding of the modern data and AI ecosystem, including technologies such as Spark, Iceberg, Delta Lake, Trino, Kafka, GPU infrastructure, AI training and inference architectures, and the infrastructure required to operate these environments at scale. - Ability to reason across the entire technology stack—compute, networking, storage, data platforms, and AI infrastructure—and challenge senior SEs and architects on solution design, performance, scalability, and tradeoffs.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to move seamlessly between deeply technical architecture conversations and strategic discussions with senior government and technology executives.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate architectural differentiation into mission impact, business value, competitive advantage, and measurable customer outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of the Federal partner ecosystem and how OEMs, integrators, channel partners, technology alliances, and other strategic partners influence Federal opportunities.
  • Ability to travel as required to support customers, partners, and the Federal organization.

title: Software Installatie Consultant
description:
Installaties en migraties van diverse software van A tot Z verwerken is jouw ding. Daarbij ben je een krak in scripting en val je terug op een brede ICT-kennis die jou installaties en migraties feilloos helpt door te komen.


Cevi is ons bedrijf dat al meer als 50 jaar een toonaangevende rol speelt als ICT-partner voor de openbare besturen (steden en gemeenten, OCMW’s, provincies, politiezones, enz.). Anderzijds bieden we hen software en bijhorende support voor diverse toepassingen, zoals voor de dienst burgerzaken, voor de dienst vergunningen, voor de dienst financiën, enz.


Als Software Installatie Consultant maak je deel uit van een ervaren Software Installatie Team dat instaat voor het installeren en onderhouden van zowel onze zelf-ontwikkelde toepassingen als software van onze partners. Dit kunnen installaties on-site bij klanten zijn als gehoste oplossingen in datacenters die in ons beheer zijn. Denk o.a. aan migraties en installaties van verschillende softwarepakketten op on-site systemen bij de klant, upgradecampagnes van software bij klanten, uitbreiding van modules op bestaande software-installaties en migraties van on-site installaties naar onze cloudplatformen.


Dit is wat je mag verwachten:

  • Je speelt een centrale rol in het installeren en onderhouden van diverse softwarepakketten. Je geeft ook ondersteuning bij incidenten.

  • Je zorgt voor het installeren en onderhouden van systeemsoftware (SQLServer, IIS webservices, back-ups, etc). Ook hier geef je ondersteuning bij incidenten.

  • Je neemt ownership over installatieprojecten, zorgt voor duidelijke communicatie en informatie aan de betrokken partijen (o.a. klanten, ontwikkelaars, productbeheer) en weet de juiste prioriteiten te zetten.

  • Je geeft technische ondersteuning aan de project managers waar nodig, bv. om correcte offertes op te stellen.

  • Je denkt actief mee met ontwikkelaars en productbeheerders om installatieprocedures, upgrades, incident management etc. van de software efficiënter te laten verlopen.

  • Je documenteert installaties en incidenten en zorgt dat installatieprocedures steeds up to date zijn.

  • Je werkt samen met en geeft ondersteuning aan de andere ICT teams en deelt je kennis met je collega's.

  • Je genoot een ICT-opleiding op bachelorniveau of hoger, of hebt een gelijkwaardige werkervaring.

  • Je hebt een grondige kennis van MS SQL, MS IIS en Powershell.

  • Kennis van SQL Cluster, IIS Cluster is een pluspunt.

  • Je bent vertrouwd met Microsoft (Azure) Active Directory.

  • Je hebt minstens een basiskennis Windows Server Systeembeheer.

  • Je bent assertief en overtuigend, maar zeker ook diplomatisch en een echte teamplayer.

  • Je neemt initiatief en verantwoordelijkheden en je bent in staat zelfstandig en probleemoplossend te werken.

  • Je steekt graag de handen uit te mouwen en je bent een doorzetter, maar wel stressbestendig.

  • Je werkt graag projectmatig en bent sterk in organisatie en gestructureerd werken.

  • Je bent sterk in het documenteren van taken, procedures, processen en projecten.

  • Je bent een aangename collega: je werkt op een constructieve en professionele manier samen met collega's doorheen de organisatie.

  • Je bent klantgericht en zorgt voor een correcte afhandeling van opdrachten en problemen.

  • Je bent Nederlandstalig met een goede kennis Engels. Kennis Frans is een voordeel.

  • Je beschikt over een rijbewijs B.


Ons aanbod

  • Een boeiende, afwisselende job waarin je jouw expertise kan inzetten én verder ontwikkelen.

  • Samenwerken met een topteam van ervaren collega's die je ondersteunen.

  • Job zekerheid: een contract van onbepaalde duur bij een stabiele en gevestigde waarde in de sector.

  • Een aantrekkelijk loonpakket met tal van extralegale voordelen: bedrijfswagen met tankkaart/laadpas, GSM met abonnement, maaltijdcheques & ecocheques, hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering en een royaal aantal vakantiedagen!

title: Begeleider MVB
description:
Zoek jij een baan waar je écht het verschil maakt? Als begeleider op onze woonlocatie Molenweer in Raamsdonksveer ondersteun je cliënten met een matig verstandelijke beperking. Je werkt binnen een betrokken team en helpt onze bewoners om een zo zelfstandig mogelijk leven te leiden, wat jouw werkdag ontzettend waardevol en divers maakt.

Een dag uit het leven van een begeleider

Stap binnen bij Molenweer, een woonlocatie in Raamsdonksveer. Hier wonen 13 mensen met een matig verstandelijke beperking, vaak in combinatie met autisme. Iedere cliënt woont zelfstandig in een eigen appartement en krijgt de ondersteuning die nodig is om zo zelfstandig mogelijk te leven.

Je start je dienst samen met je collega's en kijkt welke ondersteuning iedere cliënt nodig heeft. De ene cliënt heeft behoefte aan structuur en duidelijkheid, terwijl de ander juist begeleiding nodig heeft bij dagelijkse activiteiten of sociale contacten. Je biedt begeleiding waar nodig en ondersteunt incidenteel bij ADL-zorg. Jij kijkt verder dan gedrag alleen en hebt oog voor de mens achter de hulpvraag.

Molenweer werkt nauw samen met de naastgelegen locatie Lutteldonk. Hoewel beide locaties een eigen team hebben vanwege de verschillende ondersteuningsvragen, werk je regelmatig samen en draag je gezamenlijk bij aan een veilige en vertrouwde woonomgeving. Geen dienst is hetzelfde. Juist die afwisseling, het persoonlijke contact en de kleine successen maken jouw werk waardevol.

Wat bieden wij?

Onze medewerkers zijn het hart van onze organisatie. En daar zijn wij enorm trots op! Daarom bieden wij:

  • Salaris: €2.597 - €3.635 bruto per maand op fulltime basis [FWG 35 voor begeleider CAO gehandicaptenzorg].

  • Contract: Direct een contract voor 8-32 uur per week voor een jaar, met de intentie dit om te zetten naar onbepaalde tijd.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: Een netto vergoeding voor je woon-werkverkeer.

  • Balansverlof: Naast je vakantie-uren ontvang je extra balansverlof. Dit kun je flexibel inzetten: laat het uitbetalen voor een extraatje, spaar het op, of gebruik het voor bijvoorbeeld een nieuwe telefoon of tablet.

  • Extra’s: Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%, korting op je sportabonnement en volop ruimte voor scholing en persoonlijke groei.

  • Kom je in dienst bij Prisma en ken jij iemand die goed bij ons past? Draag een nieuwe collega aan en ontvang een aanbrengbonus van €500,- na het succesvol doorlopen van de proeftijd.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt een afgeronde MBO-opleiding niveau 3 in zorg en welzijn, bijvoorbeeld Verzorgende IG, MDGO‑VZ, oude Z‑opleiding, of een vergelijkbare opleiding.

  • Ben je beschikbaar in de weekenden en/of tijdens vakantieperiodes.

  • Je vindt het leuk om met mensen met een matig verstandelijke beperking en autisme te werken.

  • Blijf je rustig wanneer situaties onverwachts veranderen.

  • Kun je goed samenwerken en durf je verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.

  • Heb je oog voor kleine signalen en zie je wat een cliënt nodig heeft, ook als dit niet direct wordt uitgesproken.

Enthousiast geworden?
Zie jij jezelf al werken bij Prisma als flexbegeleider op Molenweer? Wacht dan niet langer en solliciteer vandaag nog!

Heb je vragen? Neem gerust contact op met Merel Bouwmeester via 06-25058014 of stuur een e-mail naar mboumeester@prismanet.nl. Wij kunnen niet wachten om jouw sollicitatie te ontvangen en je te verwelkomen in ons team!

Wij zijn Prisma. Wie ben jij?

title: On-Site Coordinator
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Impact Housing (IH) is a vertically integrated modular design-builder and developer headquartered in Southern California.

Our mission is to continuously evolve the world’s most sophisticated and efficient housing delivery system. We pursue this mission by reimagining every element of how multifamily projects are designed, manufactured, and built—driving down costs, shortening schedules, and expanding access to high-quality housing for the people who need it most, whether through LIHTC or unsubsidized projects.

To date this decade, the IH team has built or is actively developing close to 1,500 modular units demonstrating a scalable, repeatable path to affordability. With the capability to produce approximately 1,000 units per year today, IH is expanding to meet growing demand in San Diego, Los Angeles, and beyond.

We are now entering the next stage of our growth and strengthening every team across the company to achieve our next set of goals. We plan to manufacture and build more than 10,000 units through 2030. To accomplish this, we are implementing the Lean Standard Model company-wide; deploying AI at every level of the company; and positioning IH as a national thought leader in modular development.

The foundation for our success is firmly in place. Join us as we scale our operations, transition into a higher-capacity manufacturing facility powered by smart automation and robotics, expand our production capacity by more than 3x in the Western U.S., and prepare for future national growth.

POSITION SUMMARY

Impact Housing designs, manufactures, builds and operates its own buildings. Modules are produced by iManufacture in Yorba Linda, set and completed on site by iConstruct, and turned over to third-party property management. Each of those handoffs is an inspection gate, and each is a point at which a defect can pass from one vertical’s scope into another’s without a record of the condition it was in when it crossed.


The On-Site Coordinator closes that gap. The position owns the factual record of every warranty claim, construction deficiency and post-delivery defect across the owned portfolio and delivered third-party projects: what was found, when, in which unit, in what condition, and on the evidence, where it originated. It sits in corporate asset management rather than inside iManufacture or iConstruct, and that independence is the point of the job.


This is a documentation role, not an adjudication role. The Coordinator assembles evidence and prepares a written determination of origin for review; contested determinations escalate to the Senior Manager rather than being settled in the field.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain the single intake and ledger for every reported defect, warranty claim and construction deficiency across the owned portfolio and delivered third-party projects, assigning each item a unique identifier tied to property, unit, module and component serial number.
  • Capture dated photographic and written evidence to the documentation standard set out in the program SOP, and run systematic condition sweeps using Form CL-01, including full vacant-unit sweeps at turnover and at the opening of any deficiency program.
  • Assemble the evidence establishing each item’s most probable point of origin — iManufacture, iConstruct, an equipment manufacturer or vendor, property management or resident action, or design and engineering — and prepare a written determination with the supporting evidence attached.
  • Own original equipment manufacturer and vendor warranty administration: confirm registration at delivery, maintain a live register of manufacturer, distributor, registration status, coverage terms and expiration by component and property, file claims within coverage windows, and schedule vendor assessments.
  • File Problem Resolution Requests so confirmed root causes reach manufacturing, construction and design and engineering; open Non-Conformance records where product already in production requires modification; and submit product change requests to the Master CI Product Development Tracker where a recurring field defect indicates a product-level fix.
  • Coordinate retrofit, corrective and reprocessing work — sequencing crews with property management for unit access, verifying completed work against the original defect record, and re-baselining the ledger on completion.
  • Maintain the Google Drive system of record to its naming convention and keep Smartsheet status boards current.


Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Walk occupied and vacant units, document conditions with photographs and the field inspection checklist, and log findings the same day.
  • Open new ledger items and update the status, evidence and cost attribution of existing ones.
  • Coordinate with subcontractor crews and property management on unit access, scheduling and completion sign-off.
  • Chase equipment manufacturers and distributors on warranty registrations, open claims and service appointments.
  • File and update Problem Resolution Requests and Non-Conformance records.
  • Maintain the document system of record and update Smartsheet status boards.
  • Produce the weekly report on open items, aging, and accepted cost by responsible party.
  • Travel between the Yorba Linda facility and the San Diego properties as the work requires.

QUALIFICATIONS


Years of Experience: Two to four years in field coordination, construction administration, warranty and punch-list work, property maintenance supervision or quality control.


Prior Experience: Construction or manufacturing. Multifamily residential experience is required; modular, manufactured or panelized construction experience is strongly preferred. Experience performing corrective or warranty work in occupied buildings, with the resident and property management coordination that requires, is highly valued.


Required Skills and Attributes

  • Exceptional documentation discipline. This role is judged on whether the record holds up months later in front of a vendor, a client or counsel.
  • Demonstrable neutrality — the ability to record and report findings that are unwelcome to one part of the business or another, on the evidence, in writing, without being drawn into the dispute.
  • Clear written English. Determinations must be readable by a plant quality lead, a site superintendent, a property manager and an owner.
  • Working familiarity with residential mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems, sufficient to describe a failure accurately and gather the right evidence.
  • Competence with Smartsheet, Google Workspace, spreadsheets and structured photo and file management.
  • Valid California driver’s license and reliable transportation.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct exposure to packaged terminal and vertical terminal air conditioning systems.
  • Prior work inside a modular or offsite manufacturer.
  • Experience with non-conformance or corrective-action systems in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience administering manufacturer warranties and filing claims against them.
  • Bilingual English and Spanish, given the trade crews the role coordinates with.

EDUCATION AND CREDENTIALS

High school diploma or equivalent required. An associate degree or trade certification in construction management, building technology or a related field is preferred. OSHA 30 certification required within ninety days of hire.


COMPENSATION

  • $75,000 - $85,000, DOE
  • Health Benefits - Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA
  • Vacation
  • Sick time
  • Holiday pay
  • Ownership of company equity
  • 401K Retirement Plan

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This position splits between the Yorba Linda manufacturing facility and the San Diego portfolio, approximately ninety miles apart, with regular travel between the two and periodic travel to third-party project sites across California. A vehicle allowance or mileage reimbursement is provided. The Coordinator must be able to access occupied and vacant residential units, roofs, garages, mechanical spaces and active construction areas; work from ladders and lifts; lift and carry up to fifty pounds; and wear required personal protective equipment. Some work will fall outside standard business hours where resident access or vendor scheduling requires it.

NOTE
This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) of this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. All duties and responsibilities are essential functions and requirements and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities.

title: Critical Facility Technician
location: Client Site - USA - GA - Atlanta - 40 Perimeter Center E
description:
Job Title

Critical Facility Technician

Job Description Summary

The Critical Facilities Technician supports the safe, reliable operation of mission-critical data center infrastructure in a 24/7 environment. This role is responsible for monitoring, operating, maintaining, and documenting electrical, mechanical, and building systems across day, swing, and night shifts while following approved procedures, safety standards, and escalation protocols.

Job Description

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

  • Operate, monitor, and maintain critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure, including UPS systems, generators, switchgear, PDUs, CRAC/CRAH units, and related equipment.
  • Use BMS, EPMS, and DCIM platforms to monitor system performance, identify alarms, and respond promptly to abnormal operating conditions.
  • Complete preventive and corrective maintenance tasks according to approved maintenance schedules, procedures, and documentation requirements.
  • Execute Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Methods of Procedure (MOPs), and Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs) accurately and consistently.
  • Troubleshoot equipment issues, support incident response, and escalate conditions that may affect uptime, safety, or service continuity.
  • Coordinate and oversee vendor work to confirm activities are completed safely, professionally, and in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Maintain accurate shift logs, equipment readings, maintenance records, and incident documentation.
  • Follow all site safety requirements, including lockout/tagout (LOTO), electrical safety, arc flash, and OSHA-related procedures.
  • Perform routine rounds, inspections, and equipment checks to verify proper operation and identify potential issues before they affect service.
  • Support commissioning, testing, and minor project work as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience in data center operations, critical facilities, industrial maintenance, or a related technical environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a live data center, hospital, utility, manufacturing, or other mission-critical environment.
  • Hands-on experience with UPS systems, generators, switchgear, HVAC equipment, or building automation systems.
  • Certifications such as CDCTP, CDCP, OSHA 10/30, electrical safety, HVAC, or other relevant technical credentials.
  • Experience supporting commissioning, integrated systems testing, or emergency response drills.

Working knowledge of electrical, mechanical, HVAC, and fire/life safety systems used in critical environments.

Ability to use monitoring platforms such as BMS, EPMS, or DCIM to review system status and respond to alerts.

Ability to read and interpret basic electrical one-line diagrams, equipment manuals, and technical procedures.

Strong troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Familiarity with applicable safety and industry standards, including NFPA, NEC,

OSHA, and site-specific procedures.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a shift-based operations environment.

Willingness and ability to work day, swing, or night shifts, including weekends, holidays, and overtime as needed.

Relevant technical training, trade experience, military experience, or equivalent hands-on experience in facilities operations.
